Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity. Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.  Job Description You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry. As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

• Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
• Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
• Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
• Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
• Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
• Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends
Profile

• MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
• Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
• Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
• Good communication skills in English
• A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
• Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation
Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

 Employment Conditions

• Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
• Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
• Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
• The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
• Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
• Vacancy number: 27390
Important Notice Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

jobs.description: Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice between weekly and four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. At the start of your shift, you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel of the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You greet the customer, hand over the groceries and provide friendly service. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next address. This is not a job where you spend your entire shift sitting behind the wheel. Throughout the day, you regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' homes and lift grocery crates. Driving, physical activity and customer contact are all part of the position. You complete your route independently, which means you are responsible for driving safely and handling the orders carefully. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the delivery process and become familiar with the job before completing routesindependently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work every Saturday? No. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. In addition to driving, you will regularly carry grocery crates from the van to customers' doors. You will also be getting in and out of the vehicle throughout your route, so you need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Leiden? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

We provide control, predictability and better financial accountability. - Contact us directly Projects run over budget or returns lag behind? This is often due to insufficient insight into the relationship between progress, costs and planning. With good cost control you can avoid financial surprises and make timely adjustments. What is cost control and why is it crucial? Cost control, or cost management, is the process of monitoring, analyzing and adjusting project costs against budget. It is closely related to cost management: the broader set of financial control within projects. Well-organized cost control makes project costs predictable, controllable and accountable to the client, management and board. Especially in technical or long-term projects, this is essential to maintain trust, both internally and externally. cost control  How does cost control work within project organizations? Effective cost control starts with a reasoned budget, but it doesn't stop there. Throughout the project, we continue to test continuously: - How far along are we really in implementation? - What have we spent so far? - How does this compare with the original budget and schedule? - Do we need to make adjustments, and if so, where and when? We set up processes and reports in such a way that you have real-time insight into these dynamics. Not explaining afterwards, but signaling beforehand.  Earned Value Management (EVM): measuring = knowing Earned Value Management (EVM) is a widely used methodology within cost control. It links three dimensions together: - Budget (planned value) - Actual cost - Progress/performance (earned value). By monitoring these integrally, you gain early insight into deviations and trends. The job is physical, varied, and very suitable if you enjoy working with your hands. You do not need a diploma, and basic English or Polish is often sufficient on the work floor. That is why this is a popular first job for migrant workers from Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and Romania. What is a logistics worker? A logistics worker usually works in a warehouse or distribution center. You are part of a team that manages the flow of goods. Think of large centers for webshops, supermarkets, or transport companies. There are thousands of these types of locations in the Netherlands, especially around Venlo, Tilburg, Rotterdam, and Utrecht. The role is broad. Then read our article about working in a distribution center in the Netherlands . PCR vs Certification: Navigating Amazon's New Non‑GMO Requirements for Dietary Supplements  October 23, 2026 Amazon now requires all non-GMO claims for dietary supplements to be substantiated. Acceptable supporting evidence may include a polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test or certification issued under an Amazon-recognized third-party program such as IGEN™. Without valid substantiation, brands risk having 'non-GMO' claims removed, product listings suppressed or products removed from sale. For brands selling dietary supplements on Amazon, it is therefore important to identify an efficient way to meet these requirements while minimizing delays and administrative burdens. PCR or certification? While Amazon accepts both seller-supplied PCR testing and third-party certification as valid evidence of non-GMO claim substantiation, these two options offer very different operational and commercial outcomes for brands. PCR testing provides point-in-time verification and places ongoing responsibility on the brand, including managing documents, maintaining records and ensuring substantiation remains current as products, suppliers and formulations evolve. As a result, PCR testing typically serves as standalone evidence of non-GMO status, without delivering additional program or marketing benefits. Certification programs, by contrast, provide a more comprehensive, structured framework that supports substantiation requirements while offering ongoing oversight, consumer-facing recognition, and broader marketing value beyond Amazon compliance. Depending on the program, certification may also streamline enrollment and create recognizable trust signals that strengthen consumer confidence and brand positioning. Before leaving, you check your route and prepare the delivery van for the shift ahead. Once everything is ready, you head out to deliver groceries to customers throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. At every stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's door. You make sure the order is delivered carefully and provide friendly service during the handover. Empty crates may also need to be taken back with you. Then you continue to your next address. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also spend plenty of time on your feet. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and lifting grocery crates are all part of a normal working day. The routes take you through different parts of Amsterdam and the surrounding area, so your surroundings and customers change throughout the day. After completing your final delivery, you return to Beiraweg 6, finish your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous delivery experience? You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is the job physically demanding? The position involves regular physical activity. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. Ultrasound and tomosynthesis are the most prevalent modalities used for breast imaging, and each has its specific advantages and disadvantages. Ultrasound uses sound waves to create a cross-sectional image of the tissue and has excellent depth resolution, but limited resolution in directions perpendicular to the transmitted ultrasound lines. Tomosynthesis uses x rays to create a pseudo-3D representation of the breast with high in-plane spatial resolution, but low out-of-plane (depth) resolution. Therefore, both techniques are complementary to each other.We plan to develop a joint system that will use the information from each modality to improve the image quality of the other, yielding not only a multi-modality imaging system, but a joint imaging system. The combination of tomosynthesis and ultrasound into a single joint imaging system will yield improved images from two independent and complementary sources, with inherent spatial correlation, allowing for improved lesion detection, even in dense breasts, and the direct multi-modal assessment of suspicious lesions. For this multi-disciplinary project, we will be working in collaboration with the Advanced X-ray Tomography Imaging (AXTI) lab of our Department, who will be developing the X-ray aspects of this system (see accompanying vacancy).In this project, you will focus on 3D ultrasound by using an ultra-wide ultrasound transducer that is mounted in a paddle required for acquisition of tomosynthesis data. In this way, a 3D ultrasound dataset can be acquired that can be used to improve the x-ray data by using the high-axial resolution US data. Additionally, the ultrasound data can be improved by using the high-resolution x-ray data. You will develop and validate these methods using both digital and physical phantoms, working towards first patient images at the end of the project. All of this will be in collaboration with a PhD student focusing on the x-ray aspects of the project, and industry partners to facilitate the translation of these methods into clinical evaluation. Tasks will also include presenting at international scientific conferences and writing papers on the newly developed methods and study results.RequirementsYou should be a creative and enthusiastic researcher with a MSc degree in physics, mathematics, engineering, Technical medicine, or similar.Experience or interest in physics modeling, inverse problems, and/or image processing, and affinity with biomedical research.Experience in programming in python, C/C++, Matlab, or similar.Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.Good to knowThe following should be included in your application: CV, letters of motivation, list of completed courses and grades, and reprints or, preferably, links to your thesis or any scientific publications or reports that you have written.The first job interviews will take place in November 2026. Please take this into account.

jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X) in the Nuclear Pressure Equipment Team, you will join a dynamic team that works every day for our customers and, in doing so, helps create a safer and more efficient society. Vinçotte is active with various types of customers. We have developed our expertise and organization in both public and residential buildings, and we are highly entrepreneurial in the energy sector, including nuclear activities. In addition, we are highly innovative for customers in the (petro)chemical and pharmaceutical sectors, production environments, and the transport and logistics sector. With unparalleled expertise and boundless passion, we are committed to a safer society. With more than 60,000 satisfied customers, we demonstrate that the combination of our expertise, guidance, and technology makes all the difference. Vinçotte is part of Kiwa, which is itself a member of the SHV Family of Companies, and continues its commitment to innovation to deliver ever greater safety and efficiency.
 

As a 
Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. • Degree: You have a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.

• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.

• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact. 

• You work independently and in a disciplined manner. 

• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken). 

• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues.  

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

Job Description

In this hands-on position with the European Customer Analytical Services - Technology Centre of Excellence, you will perform root cause investigations into metallurgical failures and assess corrosion mechanisms. Serving clients throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, you will analyze samples from hydrocarbon process and water treatment operations-such as petroleum refineries, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and boilers. Your expertise in metallurgy and failure analysis will directly drive critical materials and reliability decisions across water and hydrocarbon process systems.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Conduct comprehensive metallurgical failure analyses and corrosion mechanism assessments, gathering necessary process information and determining required analytical approaches to determine root causes of failures in industrial water and hydrocarbon process systems

• 
Act as the technical go-to for metallurgical evaluations and materials selection, providing consulting support across the organization

• 
Operate the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM-EDXA) and other analytical instrumentation to support metallurgical examinations

• 
Execute failure analysis investigations on membrane systems (reverse osmosis, ultra-/nanfiltration membranes, flat sheet and spiral wound, as well as hollow fibre configurations), delivering clear findings and recommendations

• 
Collaborate with other laboratory departments (organic analyses, microbiological examinations, etc.) to gather comprehensive analytical data

• 
Prepare detailed, professional analytical reports and provide high-level technical input to Technology and Commercial teams

• 
Deliver work on schedule in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining compliance with all EHS policies and procedures

• 
Take ownership of customer application and R&D projects on membrane systems, including planning, execution, and reporting

•

Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills suitable for all organizational levels

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English.

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware compute systems.
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
We are looking for a 
Virtual Platform R&D Engineer to develop, enable, and maintain our baseline platform across functional models, complex simulation environments, and towards RTL prototyping. This role sits at the intersection of
 compute system architectures, system simulation, and HW/SW engineering.  
 

What you will do
 
 

• Develop, maintain and stitch virtual platforms together for complex SoC architectures, enabling architectural exploration, and system validation.  

• Build and integrate functional and performance models of compute, memory, interconnect and accelerators across multiple abstraction levels.  

• Implement the required interfaces between simulation infrastructures and support tooling to improve productivity, scalability, and model fidelity.  

• Support workload mapping and enable functional models bring-up on various execution platforms such as: QEMU, gem5, RTL, FGPA.  

• Model and simulate new architectures to analyze critical trade-offs and bottlenecks.  

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in cooperation with senior members, if needed.   

• Supervise or assist in mentoring students when necessary.  

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or other relevant domains with hands-on in compute system architectures.   

• You have a deep understanding of system-level design, modern compute and memory systems, and SoC components coupled with performance analysis skills.  

• You have proven expertise, both as a user and as a developer, with simulation frameworks or virtual platforms, such as: QEMU, gem5 or SystemC-based models.  

• You understand the boundaries of hardware and software, but you also understand how to model hardware.  

• You are a hands-on engineer; you have a research-oriented mindset with an inherited curiosity in compute system architectures.  

• You are proficient in C/C++, in bash and scripting (e.g. Python).  

• You have experience in RISC-V-based architecture.   

• You are open-minded, and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs.   

• You are a team player, as you will be part of a dynamic and distributed team.  

• You are fluent in English and you have strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across a multicultural team.

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?
At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.
This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.
You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.
Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.   

• We are looking for your excellent communication skills in English, as you will work in a multicultural team and together with our partners.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.  

• While technical knowledge and interest is crucial to be successful in this job, you will collaborate with hardware and software engineers who either deliver details to you or must pick up conclusions made by you. Data Specialist is a pivotal role, putting equipment communication capabilities into practice.  

• Commonly known as Industry 4.0 features, in semiconductor manufacturing such equipment communication feeds applications like MES, SPC, FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and AMHS (Automated Material Handling).  

• With this open position we are specifically looking for candidates who will work with Metrology equipment, i.e. measuring process results and product properties.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience.  

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials.  

• Prior experience in or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You have participated in CIM projects, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You understand measurement techniques, why different equipment is needed to measure different properties, and how measurement results can be reported.  

• You have a pro-active approach and are solution oriented. You cannot wait to roll up your sleeves and dive right into the action. You easily work independently and are an effective team player as well.  

• You thrive in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections. 
 
 

• As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:

What you will do

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.

Who you are

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.

Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Consultant

 

 

For an international trading and distribution organisation, we are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Consultant to technically optimise the existing ERP environment and improve the efficiency of Finance and Operations.

• Automation: Implementing bulk uploads, streamlining transaction processing and reducing manual tasks.

• ERP optimisation: Analysing and improving existing processes within the ERP environment, with a focus on order-to-cash and procure-to-pay.

• Integrations: Optimising data flows and connections with external systems, such as EDI and Excel-based processes.

• Relevant experience with ERP implementations.

jobs.occupation: Senior RF/MMW – Analog and Mixed Signal IC Researcher
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mmw and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.
Apply 
 

Company
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics. Imec leverages its scientific knowledge with the innovative power of its global partnerships in ICT, healthcare and energy. Imec delivers industry-relevant technology solutions. In a unique high-tech environment, its international top talent is committed to providing the building blocks for a better life in a sustainable society. Over 5000 expert scientists from over 95 countries shape tomorrow’s world with their research which is typically 5 to 10 years ahead of the market. Imec is headquartered in Leuven (Belgium) and has offices in the Netherlands, Taiwan, US, China, Japan and India. 
The Imec RF/mmWave and High-Speed ADC group in Leuven enjoys a world-class reputation in advanced high speed ADC and in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) RF Designs. In these fields our expertise is in the design of record-breaking high sampling rate ADCs and integrated RF/mm-wave front-ends in advanced CMOS and III-V based technologies. The design group also performs research in the fields of circuit design for advanced (optical) wireline communication, future RF technologies, mm-Wave sensing for life sciences, and mm-Wave imaging. 
The circuit design group is technically mentored by Piet Wambacq and Jan Craninckx and has an established state-of-the-art research reputation that has been confirmed over the years by our extensive presence in top conferences in solid-state circuit design, such as ISSCC, RFIC, ESSCIRC, VLSI and CICC. 
 
As an independent research center, we collaborate closely with top players in both industry and academia, giving our people continuous exposure to both the latest evolutions in industrial challenges and approaches, as well as into the newest emerging academic ideas and paradigms.
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mm-wave and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies. 
 

Your key responsibilities will be: 
 
 

• Research and design of innovative high-speed, low-power RF and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits in advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.  

• Drive the bottom-up evolution of these integrated circuits considering the evolution of scaling.  

• Together with the team, bring new ideas and new technical innovations based on your solid technical experience.  

• Take part in technical interactions with external partners and towards new prospects.  

• Publish your state-of-the-art research results in international conferences or journals.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a PhD degree in the domain of high-speed analog/mixed-signal and RF/mm-wave IC design or equivalent through experience.  

• You have solid design experience, and you have designed in advanced CMOS technologies (28nm, 16nmFF, 5nm).  

• You have experience designing in IIIV technologies.  

• You have a profound understanding of transistor-level circuits.  

• Experience in state-of-the-art high-speed analog/RF circuit design is a strong plus.  

• You are familiar with the various steps and tools in the design and layout of high performant analog and mixed signal circuits  

• You have solid understanding of solid-state devices, analog/RF circuits, up to the system architecture.  

• You have a broad interest in circuit design and are willing to contribute to multiple high speed analog circuit research domains  

• You can work independently yet in close collaboration with experts from other technical fields.  

• You have excellent reporting skills and can present technical results and choices clearly and concisely.  

• You can easily integrate into an international team.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

Onze klant is een hoogtechnologisch bedrijf, een spin-off van de KUL dat fungeert als één van de grootste onderzoekscentra van Europa met verschillende uitdagingen. Onze klant is volop bezig met innovatie. Wil je mee aan de wieg staan qua ontwikkelingen naar artificiële intelligentie, nanotechnologie en ICT toe? Reageer dan snel. jobs.occupation: Contracts IT - Domain Delivery Lead, Public Sector Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium (hybrid, 2 days per week on site)

Contract: Freelance, 1 to 2 years

Start: As soon as possible

Languages: Native Dutch or French, plus good English
The opportunity

Our client, a Belgian federal public administration, is running a major digital transformation programme to modernise its business applications, strengthen collaboration between teams and build a more integrated, agile IT landscape. The programme is organised into domains, each led by a Domain Delivery Lead who brings several agile squads together around one vision.

We are recruiting three Domain Delivery Leads, each owning one domain of the programme

• Platform & Integration: the cross-domain technical backbone: integration, releases, Azure cloud, DevOps, security and data migration.

• Public Sector Transformation: a high-profile, politically sensitive public service domain.

• Digital Public Services: a domain delivering strategic applications behind core public services.

All three are senior delivery and programme management roles. You lead through influence, clarity of vision and trust rather than control. You will not be writing code or building infrastructure; you make it possible for several agile teams to deliver.
What you will do

• Unite several agile squads around a shared vision and keep business and team priorities aligned

• Create the conditions for autonomy and coach teams towards maturity (servant leadership)

• Build the overall plan with the teams, manage cross-team dependencies and arbitrate priorities transparently

• Run domain rituals: cross-team syncs, reviews and retrospectives

• Remove blockers by connecting the teams with the business, IT and other domains

• Manage change requests, report progress and risks to governance bodies and escalate in good time

• Manage suppliers as partners and own the domain budget

What the client is really looking for

• A builder, not a caretaker: someone who likes to create, evolve and unite teams, brings fresh ideas and challenges existing practices.

• A servant leader: you lead through trust, remove obstacles and help squads grow in autonomy.

• A strong business to IT translator: you explain complex IT in simple business language and turn policy and business needs into a clear roadmap.

• Proven at scale in the public sector: multiple squads, budgets and capacity on large digital transformations, ideally in government.

How you work

You influence without hierarchical authority, adapt your message to every audience, handle conflict diplomatically and stay calm and solution-focused under pressure.

Please send your CV or call elif and yasin to discuss further.

We are an equal opportunities employment agency and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age.

We champion differences in technology recruitment and work with clients who actively wish to diversify their talent force - all applicants are welcome to apply

• 10+ years in a similar role, coordinating and steering multiple teams

• 5+ years of Agile delivery in complex IT environments

• 10+ years of project experience with complex stakeholder management on digitalisation projects

• 10+ years of project team leadership

• A business to IT bridge background, such as senior Product Owner, Business Relationship Manager or Programme Director

• Leading large multidisciplinary teams split across several squads

• Budget and capacity management within public budget envelopes

• Strong project management, governance and delivery practices

• Business process reengineering and change management in digital transformations

• Understanding of application lifecycle management

• Public sector experience

• Native Dutch or French speaker with good English

 

Additional must haves: platform & integration:

• Solution architecture and integration: critical path, API, messaging and batch patterns, interface contracts, versioning, reference data and workflow engines (for example Camunda)

• Release and environment management: Dtap, cross-team releases, cutover and rollback planning, end-to-end test strategy

• Azure: Landing Zone concepts, Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Kubernetes, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code and FinOps basics

• Advanced Azure DevOps (work item hierarchies, Delivery Plans, dependencies, reporting), CI/CD and branching strategies

• Security and compliance: NIS2, GDPR for sensitive personal data, RPO/RTO, retention, logging and formal risk acceptance

• Data and migration: CDC and ETL flows to a data platform, running data migration as its own workstream

• Scrum and ITIL certifications

 

Additional must haves: public sector transformation:

• Proven project management inside a public administration or public body, leading complex projects or digital transformation

• Understanding of institutional dynamics and managing conflicting priorities in a politically sensitive environment, while staying neutral

 

Nice to have

Platform & Integration only. The other two roles have no nice-to-haves; candidates are assessed on the must-haves.

• Large-scale European IT systems

• Observability

• Enterprise architecture frameworks

• Basic KQL or OData for tracking and reporting

• Microsoft Azure certification

jobs.occupation: CONSULTANT REGULATORY AFFAIRS Biocides, junior or medior
jobs.description:
Ensus Consulting BV is a consulting and services firm operating at the interface between science, government and industry. We provide tailor-made Regulatory Affairs dossier management services to national and international customers covering all aspects of dossiers related to chemicals legislations including the Biocidal Products Regulation (BPR), Plant Protection Products Regulation (PPPR), etc. In order to further expand our small regulatory affairs team, we are looking for a highly motivated new colleague.
 

After an initial period of training on-the-job, you will soon be expected to work independently. You will support companies in their regulatory challenges related to chemical products, incl. biocides and pesticides. You coordinate and support regulatory dossiers —covering both national and European chemical legislations— from start to finish. The latter includes for example setting up challenging efficacy testing scenarios, discussions with laboratories on analytical testing, dossier creation, etc. Furthermore, you will be able to take part to European discussions on drafting the guidance and commenting on existing guidance documents.
 

While we strongly value the capacity to work independently, it is also essential to cooperate with your colleagues, external partners and experts, authorities and our (inter)national customers.

The ideal candidate should:
 

be a (recent) graduate (Master or PhD level) in a life sciences discipline (chemistry, biology, biosciences, bioengineering, …).
 

be eager to develop expertise in the main aspects involved in dossier preparation: analytical chemistry, microbiology, (eco)toxicology, exposure assessment, risk assessment, modelling, classification and labelling, ...
 

preferably have relevant experience in research projects, through internships or industry trainee programmes. While demonstrated experience in executing regulatory projects (BPR, PPPR, CLP, … ) would be beneficial, it is not strictly required.
 

have the following analytical skills: a keen eye for detail, collecting and analysing data with a critical eye, enjoying solving complex problems.
 

have excellent writing (English) and organisational skills, good interpersonal skills, responsibility and a critical mind.
 

have sound skills in Microsoft Office Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and will become proficient in IUCLID 6, a software application to manage scientific data on chemicals which is used in the implementation of various regulatory programmes, after an on-the-job training.

• Manage equipment: Keep climate chambers, sensors, data loggers and other measurement equipment ready for use, and carry out checks, calibrations and preventive maintenance.
• Resolve technical issues: Troubleshoot practical technical problems and coordinate repairs with suppliers or technical services.
• Support experiments and measurement campaigns: Prepare equipment, connect sensors, start data collection and monitor measurement quality in the laboratory and on site.
• Guide users: Give researchers and students clear instructions on using equipment safely and correctly.
• Improve measurement setups: Build, test and improve setups together with researchers and technical partners.
• Maintain documentation, stock and safety: Keep technical records and stock inventories up to date, follow up on routine purchases and help maintain a safe and orderly laboratory environment.

• You hold a professional bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or scientific field, such as electromechanics, electronics and ICT, energy technology, biomedical laboratory technology or agricultural technology. Recent graduates and candidates with an equivalent level of competence gained through relevant experience are also eligible.
• Technical foundation: You enjoy hands-on work with equipment and have a basic knowledge of sensors, measurement systems, electronics or technical installations.
• Independent working: You take initiative, plan and document your work carefully, and take a focused approach to solving practical technical problems.
• Collaboration and support: You have a service-oriented approach and provide researchers and students with clear practical instructions.
• Safety and quality: You pay attention to safety, quality and good housekeeping in a laboratory environment.
• Flexibility: You are willing to travel for planned measurement campaigns and to further develop your skills in digital measurement systems and automated data collection.
• Languages and software: You communicate in Dutch and English, or are willing to further develop your proficiency in one of these languages, and you are familiar with Microsoft Office Experience in one or more of the following areas is an asset, but is not required: 

• Measuring environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, air velocity, air quality or energy consumption; 
• Physiological measurement equipment, climate control installations, building management systems or connected sensors;
• Digital data collection or software such as LabVIEW, MATLAB or Python.

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Life Sciences Transformation - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
• Location: Antwerp, Belgium (Hybrid)

• Contract: 12-Month Initial Contract (Extension Likely)

• Language: English

• Start Date: December

• Industry: Life Sciences / Healthcare

• Engagement: Freelance

Our client, a leading European Life Sciences & Healthcare organisation, is embarking on a large-scale IT, Cloud & Business Transformation Programme aimed at modernising core business applications, streamlining operational processes, and accelerating their cloud journey.

As the programme enters a critical delivery phase, they are looking for a highly hands-on Senior Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, driving requirements definition, process optimisation, and transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams.

This is not a documentation-only role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being Embedded within the business, challenging existing ways of working, facilitating workshops, and actively shaping future-state solutions.
Responsibilities

• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand current-state processes and system landscapes.

• Lead requirements gathering workshops across multiple departments.

• Analyse and document complex business processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.

• Develop current-state and future-state process MAPS.

• Define and document business, functional and non-functional requirements.

• Translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.

• Work closely with solution architects, developers, project managers and integration teams throughout project delivery.

• Support cloud migration and application transformation initiatives.

• Conduct gap analyses between legacy systems and future-state solutions.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making workshops.

• Support testing activities including UAT planning, execution and defect management.

• Track requirements through implementation to ensure business objectives are achieved.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business and technology functions.

• 7+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within complex enterprise environments.

• Proven experience working on large-scale IT transformation programmes.

• Strong background in business process analysis and optimisation.

• Experience gathering and managing requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Demonstrated experience working on cloud transformation, digital transformation, ERP, CRM or systems integration projects.

• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and influence decisions.

• Strong workshop facilitation skills.

• Experience operating in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

• Excellent communication skills with both business and technical audiences.

Preferred experience:

• Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Healthcare or Medical Devices industries.

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

• Experience supporting application migration or modernisation programmes.

• Understanding of regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of data migration, integration projects or enterprise application landscapes.

Key skills:

• Business Analysis

• Requirements Engineering

• Process Mapping

• BPMN

• Stakeholder Management

• Workshop Facilitation

• Gap Analysis

• Systems Integration

• Cloud Transformation

• Agile Methodologies

• User Stories

• Functional Specifications

• UAT Management

• Change Management

You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
 

 
 

Within Nike's European Logistics Campus, supply chain is at the heart of the athlete and consumer experience
 

Our ambition is to accelerate service, efficiency and cost improvements by combining data-driven problem solving with end-to-end solution design.
 

Within our organization, there are different teams where you could bring your expertise, with a focus on areas such as transportation, planning and operations.
 

You will work closely with operational teams, analysts, specialists, managers, and internal and external partners across our logistics network. Together, we connect expertise across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to improve performance faster and at scale.
 

You will contribute to one strong team, focused on delivering for athletes and consumers while continuously raising the bar in logistics.
 

 
 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
 

 
 
 

• Own and improve day-to-day performance: Monitor supply chain and logistics performance, identify deviations and translate insights into clear actions with the right owners and timing. 

• Turn data into decisions: Combine operational information and analytical insights to identify root causes, opportunities, risks and practical recommendations. 

• Automate day-to-day workflows: Identify repetitive, manual or fragmented activities and help redesign them into simpler, standardized and automated workflows. Partner with process owners and technology teams to define requirements, test solutions, support implementation and track adoption and value. 

• Drive continuous improvement: Structure and deliver improvement initiatives with clear scope, milestones, risks, expected outcomes and measurable business value. 

• Design end-to-end solutions: Work across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to connect local improvements to the wider logistics network. 

• Support implementation: Stay close to the operation from problem definition through testing, deployment, stabilization and handover. 

• Build scalable ways of working: Create clear processes, documentation, dashboards and routines that make improvements sustainable and reusable across teams. 

• Engage stakeholders: Facilitate discussions, align different perspectives and communicate progress, decisions and next steps clearly. 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

 
 
 

• ACT WITH URGENCYYou don’t wait for the perfect conditions. You step in, take ownership and stay close to the action. You turn insights into decisions and decisions into momentum. 

• LEAD WITH HOWHow you win matters. You bring analytical thinking and a problem-solving mindset, challenge the status quo and make the complex simple. You communicate with clarity, bring people along and build strong partnerships across the business. 

• BE FLEXIBLEThe game can change fast, and you’re ready to move with it. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, navigate ambiguity with confidence and adapt as priorities shift. You’re curious to learn different parts of the supply chain and ready to contribute wherever you can create impact. 

• PLAY TO WINYou keep your eyes on the finish line. You focus on solutions that work, value that can be measured and improvements that make a real difference. You don’t stop at the idea. You help bring it to life.  

 
 

YOUR SPORTS BAG CONTAINS
 
 

• A bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience, in supply chain, logistics, engineering, business analytics or a related field. 

• You bring a strong interest in supply chain and have built relevant knowledge or hands-on experience through your education, internships, projects or professional experience in areas such as supply chain, distribution, logistics, project delivery or process improvement. 

• Strong project-management skills, with experience structuring work around clear deliverables, milestones, risks and expected outcomes. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data and operational information into clear insights and recommendations. 

• Experience identifying workflow improvement opportunities and translating business needs into standardized or automated processes. Experience with workflow, analytics or automation tools is an asset. 

• The ability to work independently while collaborating across teams, functions and organizational levels. 

• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. 

• Professional proficiency in English. Dutch is an asset. 

• Curiosity, adaptability and a willingness to learn new processes, technologies and areas of the supply chain. 

• Experience with analytics tools, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, process mapping, simulation or supply chain technology is an asset.  

 
 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 
 

• Operational issues are translated into clear actions and sustainable improvements. 

• Manual day-to-day activities are simplified, standardized or automated where this adds value. 

• Projects deliver measurable service, cost, quality or productivity improvements. 

• Solutions are implemented successfully, adopted by the operation and scalable beyond one team or process. 

• Stakeholders understand the priorities, decisions, ownership and next steps.

With a strong presence in Belgium and an extensive European network, the company operates in a fast-paced and operationally complex environment where service quality, customer partnership, and continuous improvement are key drivers of success.With a strong footprint in Belgium and a broader European presence, the organisation is currently going through an important phase of growth. This creates a stimulating environment where commercial teams work closely with operational stakeholders to deliver long-term value for customers and drive continuous improvement across the business.

• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders within client organisations.

• Strong commercial mindset combined with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Solution-oriented with the resilience to manage challenging situations and customer escalations.

• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.

Our client is a well-established manufacturing company with a strong presence in Belgium and an international footprint.

Jobomschrijving

 Key Responsibilities
