jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the guardian of data quality making sure the information we rely on is accurate, reliable, and ready to power everything from seamless customer experiences to cutting-edge digital solutions. Think of it as being the detective, the problem-solver, and the strategist all in one, working with teams across the bank to keep our data in top shape.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Client Data Quality Analyst, here’s what your day could look like:

• Spot the gaps, fix the flaws. You’ll design and monitor data quality controls, using dashboards to track how well our systems are performing. 
• Turn data into a strategic advantage. You won’t just be fixing problems, you’ll be helping us use data smarter. That could mean:
• Upgrading dashboards so they give clearer, more actionable insights.
• Documenting metadata so everyone understands what our data means and how to use it.
• Supporting data certification and joining key committees to ensure we’re meeting the highest standards.
• Sharing your know-how with the wider Data Quality team, so we all keep getting better.
• Be the bridge between data and real-world impact You’ll get to know our client data flows and applications inside out, becoming the go-to person. Your work will directly help us improve customer experiences, streamline processes, and stay ahead in a fast-changing industry.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who:

•  Loves solving puzzles. You see data as more than numbers; it’s a story waiting to be uncovered. Experience in data quality analysis (especially in banking) is a big plus.
• Speaks “data” fluently. You understand data lifecycles, governance, and how data drives decisions. You’ve done analysis that shows real business impact and you’re passionate about digital transformation.
• Is tech-savvy (but not a coding genius). You’re comfortable with tools like Excel, MS Access, PowerPoint, and Business Objects. If you’ve worked with Collibra, Ab Initio, Tableau, SQL, or Python, even better, but what matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn.
• Communicates clearly and collaborates easily. You can explain complex ideas in simple terms (in French, Dutch, or English). You’re a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning from others.
• Thrives on challenges. You don’t shy away from tricky problems. Instead, you roll up your sleeves, ask the right questions, and push for solutions that actually work.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL Join BNP Paribas Fortis' AI Tribe, a team of 90+ AI experts driving innovation across the bank through advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.

What You'll Do

• Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
• Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
• Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
• Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
• Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
• Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies. 

 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience

• Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
• 3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
• Experience with fraud analytics, AML, or financial crime prevention.
 

Technical Skills

• Data-Centric AI & Data Engineering: Data collection, labeling, curation, enrichment, feature engineering, data quality, feedback, and large-scale data processing. 
• AI & Fraud Analytics:
• Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning for anomaly and fraud detection, model evaluation, performance monitoring, and error analysis.
• Advanced Analytics: Graph analytics, network analytics, behavioral analytics, and financial crime analytics.
• Generative AI & Foundation Models: LLMs, RAG, AI agents, deep learning , transactional model and AI-driven fraud prevention solutions.
• Programming & AI Engineering: Advanced Python, software engineering best practices, AI application development and deployment, monitoring, and end-to-end AI lifecycle management. 
 

Soft Skills

• Analytical, proactive, and results-driven.
• Strong communicator who thrives in multidisciplinary teams.
• Comfortable in an international, fast-paced environment.
 

Languages

• Fluent English + Dutch or French (professional level).

jobs.occupation: Web Content Management Engineer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Agile Production Services (APS) tribe is where IT Production happens. As part of a tight-knit group of 7 teams, we handle end-to-end Production Services, from go-live support to 24/7 on-call troubleshooting (yes, nights and weekends included).

Your role? The tech backbone of our digital operations. Whether it’s Level 2/3 support, application security, or hosting optimization, you’ll work closely with Infrastructure and Dev teams to keep our systems fast, secure, and reliable. No two days are the same - and that’s the way we like it.

AND IN DETAIL

As our WCM Specialist, you’ll be the go-to person for all things Web Content Management. 

That means:

• Ownership of WCM expertise: you’ll be the resident guru on TeamSite, headless architecture, and best practices. When teams need answers, they come to you.
• Building, integrating, improving: you’ll analyze, develop, or implement new components, working with Application Leads and integrators to push boundaries. 
• Keeping the Portal running smoothly: but not just maintaining it. You’ll help shape the future vision in our WCM guild (our tech community).
• Documentation that actually helps: you’ll turn complex setups into clear, actionable guides for stakeholders. No jargon-heavy manuals.
• Collaborating with architects: you’ll assist in cost-benefit analyses for new web implementations. 
• Security and performance first: you’ll play an active role in incident, problem, and change management. Finding issues, fixing them, preventing repeats.
• Setting standards: you’ll ensure every user, on every device, has a seamless experience.
• Monitoring and optimizing: you’ll track performance, spot bottlenecks, and keep things running at peak efficiency.
• On-call duty: One week per month (18:00–7:30), you’re the go-to person. But don’t worry: you’re never alone.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring:

• 5+ years of experience.
• OpenText mastery: you know TeamSite, LiveSite, OpenDeploy inside out, in an Agile/XP environment.
• Your tech toolkit:
• JavaScript, Node.js, NPM, React, Webpack, Jest, SASS, HTML5 are your daily drivers.
• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Nexus). You automate like it’s second nature.
• Headless WCM architecture (especially TeamSite). You don’t just understand it, you make it work.
• Sharp analytical skills. You spot problems before they happen.
 

How you work:

• Team player, but self-driven: you take initiative and own your work.
• Fast learner: new tools? You pick them up quickly and put them to use.
• Open-minded and adaptable: change is the only constant in tech, and you thrive in it.
• Detail-oriented, but big-picture aware: you follow processes without losing sight of the end goal.
• Clear communicator: whether it’s tech talk with devs or updates for management, you get your point across.
• Persistent and committed: you don’t quit until the job’s done right.
• Comfortable in a multicultural environment: different backgrounds, one shared mission.
 

Languages:

• Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must.
• Dutch and/or French? A definite plus.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

As Test Automation Engineer, you’ll join an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team at our HQ in Brussels to develop qualitative applications in a fast-changing IT landscape. Your role will contribute to innovations benefiting millions of clients, ensuring product and code quality from start to finish through test automation.

AND IN DETAIL

As a test automation engineer, you’ll be joining an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team. Together, you develop qualitative applications for a fast-changing IT landscape: an exciting and versatile challenge! 

• You monitor product and code quality, from start to finish
• You help determine the feature test plan and the test scope
• You focus maximum on automation of test cases
• You share your test results
• You identify and correct any sticking points and iron out any bugs
You know your way around :

• Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java and test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber etc.).
• Create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data for both functional and non-functional testing.
• Execute automated tests, analyze results, and report defects with detailed logs and steps for replication.
• Integrate test automation into CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines.
• Work with the development team to identify areas for automation and prioritize test cases.
• Debug and troubleshoot automation scripts and applications in various environments.
• Ensure the scalability, reliability, and effectiveness of automated test frameworks and tools.
• Maintain documentation for test automation frameworks, processes, and results.
• Have knowledge on the standards in software testing (ISTQB)

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You’re the physical embodiment of the scrum values: involvement, focus, openness and respect, with a good dose of courage to boot
• You’re inquisitive and driven—and you’re always on the ball
• You thrive in a team environment, happily sharing your knowledge and insights
• You are quick to make connections and dare to question everything that deserves to be questioned
• You obtained your bachelor or master degree in Computer Sciences or IT 
• You have a good knowledge of Dutch or French, and great English skills
You surprise us with your experience or knowledge of the tools and/or programming languages below: 

• Java
• Selenium

• Ruby

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

Robert Half is currently looking for a Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist (m/f/x) for a permanent position.

 

Our client is an international company located in Groot-Bijgaarden.

 

As a Cost Accounting, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and ensuring accurate cost tracking.
• Processing and reviewing invoices while maintaining accurate accounting records.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including reconciliations and journal entries.
• Assisting with budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis.
• Preparing financial reports and supporting internal and external audits.
• Contributing to process improvements and ensuring compliance with internal procedures.
 

The required qualifications for this position of Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist are:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent through experience.
• You have at least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Experience within the Services or Retail sector is required.

What type of breed are we looking for? 
 

Our D2C channel is where we meet pet parents directly. No middleman, no shelf to fight for. It's how we build real relationships with the people (and pets) who love our food.
 

And it's not a side project. Our webshop is a serious business in its own right, representing a significant share of everything we sell, with a subscription base, a real tech team behind it, and years of compounding growth already on the clock. You'd be stepping into something that works, with the mandate to make it considerably bigger.
 

We're looking for a 
D2C & Digital Product Manager to own the roadmap that gets us there. You'll lead our Digital Product Team (2 full stack developers, a data engineer and product designer) and report directly to our Head of D2C.
 

You won't own the P&L. You'll own the roadmap that drives it, which in practice means you decide what we build, in what order, and why.
 

What is in your bowl? 
 

Own the roadmap that drives the channel
 

You decide what we build next and what waits. That means holding a clear point of view on where the growth actually is, translating it into a prioritised roadmap, and defending it when six good ideas arrive in the same week. You'll be measured on whether the channel grows profitably and sustainably, not on how many things got shipped.
 

Turn first-time buyers into a pack that stays
 

First purchase, subscription, loyalty. That's the journey, and it's yours to design end to end. Every step where a pet parent hesitates, churns, or quietly stops caring is a step you get to fix. CAC, LTV, AOV, retention and variable margin are the scoreboard, and CRM is one of your sharpest tools for moving them.
 

Own the campaign calendar
 

Product launches, seasonal moments, always-on lifecycle flows. You plan them, build them with your team, run them, and evaluate them honestly afterwards, together with Brand and Media.
 

Lead a team of four by example
 

Two full stack developers, one data engineer, one product designer. You'll set the direction, protect their focus, coach them, and raise the bar on craft. You won't be doing their jobs, but they should never feel like they're building for someone who doesn't understand what they do.
 

Keep us ahead on new technology
 

Including AI, and including whatever comes after it. You'll have an opinion on which new tools genuinely change the work and which ones are noise, and you'll put the useful ones in front of the team rather than in a deck.
 

Our stack 
 

We've built a headless shop on 
React + Shopify, with 
Klaviyo for CRM and lifecycle and 
Contentful for content. We design in 
Figma and the team runs on 
Notion. You don't need to have used all of it. You do need to be genuinely at home in a modern digital stack.

You're commercial to the bone. You can look at a roadmap and say which item moves LTV and which one just moves a ticket to Done. You've lived with numbers like CAC, AOV, variable margin, retention and forecast accuracy, and when one of them slips you know which lever to reach for.
 

You're hands-on in the engine room. You write the copy for the test yourself rather than waiting three weeks for a copywriter. You click through the feature before it ships. When the data doesn't explain the behaviour, you call a customer. Not because nobody else will, but because you want to know.
 

You've led a team of strong individual contributors. Developers, designers, data people. Specialists who are better at their craft than you are, and who can tell within a week whether you actually respect it. You've given them direction and honest feedback, protected their focus, and helped them get better at what they do. You'll be leading four of them from day one, so this one matters.
 

You live in the middle of Marketing, Design and Technology. You're as comfortable debating a campaign angle as you are reviewing a prototype or talking through a data model with an engineer. Those three worlds meeting is where you do your best work.
 

You prioritise like saying yes has a cost. Because it does. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, and you're the one who decides. You're comfortable being the person who says not this quarter, and explaining why.
 

You build brands, not discounts. You've seen what promo-led growth does to a business over time, and it doesn't excite you. What excites you is a customer who comes back because they love the thing, not because it was 20% off.
 

You know CRM is a craft, not a send button. You've built lifecycle programmes where the timing, the segment and the message all earned their place. You can tell relevant communication from noise, and so can your customers.
 

You get people around you moving without needing the org chart. Brand, Media & Partnerships, Logistics and Finance all have their own plans. You create clarity, you build the shared one, and people follow it because it makes sense.
 

You care about pets. Edgard and Cooper were real dogs, and everything we make still starts from one question: is this actually good for the animal eating it? You need to care about that answer. Ideally you live with a cat or a dog yourself and know exactly how it feels when the food runs out on a Sunday evening. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.

As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage; you are not alone.

Your Mission

• Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
• Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
• Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
• Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
• Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
• Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.
What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

• Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
• Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation; this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.
• Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
• Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool; you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.
• Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.
• Professional working proficiency in French, Dutch and English — you will conduct requirements discussions in both French and Dutch and coordinate in English; all three are required for delivery and this is not flexible.
• Git discipline and comfort working in structured, security-conscious environments with the composure that client-facing work in defence demands.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role (we support candidates through the clearance process).
The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm; for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

Nice to have

• Experience working with logistics, maintenance, asset-management or defence-operations data.
• Prior experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a data modelling or transformation context

Join our Global Support Network (Gsn) and help ensure the reliability and availability of our healthcare IT solutions used by customers around the world.

As a Senior Support Engineer / Domain Expert, you will solve complex technical problems in business-critical customer environments, working closely with regional support teams, Cloud Operations, Professional Services, Product Management, Quality, and R&D. You will combine deep technical troubleshooting with strong customer engagement and take ownership of issues through resolution.

Beyond resolving incidents, you will help us prevent them by identifying recurring problems, improving our monitoring and observability capabilities, sharing knowledge, and contributing to more proactive and predictive support.

What you'll do

 
• Solve complex technical problems:
  
   
• Diagnose and resolve complex incidents affecting enterprise healthcare IT solutions.
   
• Take end-to-end ownership of technical issues and drive them toward resolution.
   
• Analyze logs, metrics, diagnostics, and system behavior to identify root causes.
   
• Coordinate technical activities across teams during critical customer situations.
   
• Communicate findings, recommendations, and resolution plans clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  
 
• Be a technical expert:
  
   
• Build and maintain deep expertise in our products, technologies, and solution architectures.
   
• Provide advanced technical guidance to support teams around the world.
   
• Work across enterprise applications, operating systems, databases, networking, integrations, cloud, and containerized environments.
   
• Collaborate with R&D and other specialists on challenging technical issues and escalations.
  
 
• Prevent tomorrow's incidents:
  
   
• Identify recurring issues, technical trends, and systemic problems and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions.
   
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our monitoring and observability platform, helping us identify emerging issues proactively, prevent incidents, and improve the reliability of our customers' environments.
   
• Turn lessons learned into technical documentation and reusable knowledge.
   
• Contribute ideas that improve product quality, support processes, automation, and operational efficiency.
  
 
• Help the team and our services grow:
  
   
• Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across our global support organization.
   
• Contribute to the operational readiness of new releases, upgrades, and customer deployments.
   
• Represent customer needs and operational experience when collaborating with Product Management, R&D, Quality, and other stakeholders.
   
• Explore opportunities to use automation and AI-assisted diagnostics to improve customer outcomes.
  

What will help you succeed

You enjoy solving difficult technical problems and are comfortable when the answer is not immediately obvious. You combine technical curiosity with a strong customer focus and

 
• Take ownership and follow problems through to resolution
 
• Communicate complex technical topics clearly
 
• Remain effective in high-pressure customer situations
 
• Collaborate well across teams, cultures, and geographies
 
• Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others succeed
 
• Bring a continuous learning and improvement mindset

Fluent written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or a related discipline is preferred, although equivalent professional experience...

We are looking for someone with:

• 3 to 5 years of experience in technical customer support, enterprise software support, healthcare IT, or a comparable technical role.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, ideally gained in business-critical or mission-critical environments.

• A good understanding of enterprise application architectures, networking, operating systems, databases, and system integrations.

• Hands-on Kubernetes experience, including supporting and troubleshooting containerized applications and environments.

• Hands-on AWS experience, with practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, monitoring, and operations.

• Experience analyzing logs, metrics, diagnostics, and other technical data to isolate complex problems.

• Experience working directly with customers and managing technical escalations.

• Familiarity with ITSM and ITIL-based support processes.

• Experience with healthcare IT is an advantage, but not essential.

PROJECT

You work within the multi-national research environment of the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Royal Military Academy. As a university, we conduct research in various technological domains, including unmanned systems, land mobility, and landmines manipulations, aimed at enhancing user comfort. Our work balances the development of novel and beneficial applications with efforts to mitigate potential risks associated with these technologies. As a military research lab, we focus on applications in public security and Defense. Examples of practical applications include ground robots for detecting and neutralizing landmines, unmanned vehicles for patrolling tough complex conditions, and studies to improve vehicle and environmental conditions.

 

In this position, you will work alongside a large team of research engineers, each leading their own projects. Your role will be to assist in the implementation of various projects, by contributing to the related electro-mechanical aspects. Given our strong involvement in European-scale collaborative projects, you will punctually prepare and follow on-site test campaigns, mainly on military test sites in Flanders, sometimes abroad.

 

WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You improve the team-spirit and solve interpersonal conflicts. 
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have very good knowledge of French or Dutch (oral & written) and a minimum knowledge of (or be willing to learn) the other language (oral), since lots of campaigns will be performed in Belgium. This will be tested during selection.
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral & written), which will be tested during selection.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher is likely to be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European Defence Fund projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: 15 January  2027, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours / week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• To be very clear: your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to a project that ends in Spring 2030. The financing of your contract beyond that period is therefore not 100% guaranteed. However, the RMA-MECA dept has a policy to keep the good elements and this position will in any case be required beyond that date as well, so if we're happy with you there is a high chance that we will offer you a follow-up beyond that date if you decide to stay.
• Wage scale: NBI1. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing personnel to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. Your bruto and netto salary can be simulated precisely via this tool: simulateur de salaire.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a BOSA test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€/day);
• Digital allowance: 15€/month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days/week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);

• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.

• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.
What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

About UsZymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. The RoleAs Business Operations Associate your core role will be to take ownership of projects that matter, from first idea to finished result. The job is mostly project-based. One project might be a market study for a new crop or region, the next might be designing the layout of our new offices or setting up our company OKRs.

What You'll DoYour main focus is on strategic and operational projects. You will:

The SharePoint / Microsoft 365 Specialist will administer, improve and progressively develop KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.

You will work on our SharePoint intranet, Hub architecture, departmental Team Sites, document management, permissions and automation, while also supporting colleagues with existing SharePoint solutions.

The role combines hands-on technical work with business-process understanding. You will work closely with the allocated KOMIS Manager, Project Managers and users to translate operational needs into practical and maintainable Microsoft 365 solutions.

For someone who enjoys both technology and problem solving, this role offers considerable scope to shape solutions and see the direct impact of their work across the organisation.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SharePoint & Microsoft 365

• Administer, maintain and improve KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Support Project Managers and users with existing SharePoint sites and functionality.
• Configure and progressively develop the SharePoint Online intranet and Hub architecture.
• Create and maintain departmental SharePoint Team Sites connected to Microsoft Teams.
• Configure Hub navigation, Quick Links, News templates and aggregated news.
• Troubleshoot SharePoint and Microsoft 365 issues and implement practical solutions.
Information, documents & access

• Configure document libraries, metadata, views and information structures.

• Help maintain clear, secure and manageable access structures across SharePoint.
Automation & business solutions

• Develop SharePoint Lists and, progressively, Power Automate workflows and Power Apps where useful.
• Identify opportunities to simplify or automate recurring business processes using Microsoft 365 tools.
Business support, testing & documentation

• Work with managers and users to understand business needs and translate them into practical Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Test new configurations and solutions before deployment.
• Document configurations, procedures and solutions and prepare user guidance where needed. 
QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

We are looking for someone who combines solid Microsoft 365 knowledge with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

You should have:

• At least 3 years of practical professional experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.
• Solid knowledge of SharePoint sites, document libraries, permissions, metadata, views and Hub Sites.
• Experience integrating SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams.
• Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, security groups and access management.
• Practical experience with SharePoint Lists and Power Automate.
• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills.
• Good written and spoken English.
NICE TO HAVE

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage: Microsoft Power Apps; Microsoft Graph; PowerShell or PnP PowerShell; SharePoint governance; SharePoint migration tools; Microsoft 365 security and compliance; Broader Microsoft Power Platform solutions.

You do not need to bring all of these from day one. We are particularly interested in candidates with a strong SharePoint/Microsoft 365 foundation, sound judgement and willingness to develop further.
 
WHY JOIN US

This role offers the opportunity to have a visible impact on how KOMIS collaborates, manages information and uses technology across the organisation.

We offer:

• A role with real ownership and scope to shape solutions.
• The opportunity to develop a modern SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Exposure to different teams, business processes and international projects.
• A collaborative environment where initiative and practical ideas are encouraged.
• Brussels-based hybrid working arrangement.
At KOMIS, we value practical solutions, continuous improvement and people who take ownership of their work.

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. As a hands-on 
System Engineer, with a strong focus on
 Electrical & Automation Engineering, you’ll help design, integrate, test, and optimize the systems that make complex machines work in the field.You’ll connect the dots across electrical, automation, software, hydraulics, and mechanical systems, turning individual components and subsystems into one reliable, functional machine.
Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Concept & Solution Engineering: Work directly with customers to understand their needs and challenges, challenge requirements where needed, and (co-)create technical solutions and system architectures that best addresses the problem. 

• Electrical Engineering: Design and integrate electrical architectures, components, wiring, sensors, actuators, and communication systems for off-highway vehicles and other machines. 

• Software, Automation & Controls: Program machine functions and control logic using PLCs, ECUs, and embedded systems. Integrate and commission control systems. 

• System Engineering: Connect electrical, software, hydraulic, and mechanical systems into a coherent and reliable machine architecture. Turn designs and ideas into functioning systems. 

• Testing & Commissioning: Build, integrate, commission, test, debug, and fine-tune prototypes and machines, turning concepts into reliable real-world solutions. 

• Customer Support, Training & Continuous Improvement: Support customers in the field or remotely, troubleshoot technical issues, provide hands-on training, and use customer and field feedback to continuously improve machine performance and reliability. 

ARE YOU THE ONE? You’re a
 hands-on Electrical Automation Engineer who enjoys understanding how things work, creating new solutions, and finding ways to make systems work even better. You don’t stop at the drawing board. You enjoy building, programming, testing, debugging, and improving real machines and you’re curious about what happens when your engineering meets the real world. You like digging into complex problems and don’t stop until you’ve turned your understanding into a practical and efficient solution, especially when there’s no obvious answer or manual to follow.
You approach challenges from a systems perspective, combining analytical thinking, creativity, and practical problem-solving. You’re curious, eager to learn, adaptable, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. Most importantly, you thrive in a fast-paced and ambitious environment where you can tackle complex technical challenges and see your solutions work reliably in the field.

For one of our fastest growing practices we are looking for a Data Quality Assurance Specialist.

In today’s digital world, organizations need to shift their approach to cyber security. Prevention alone is no longer sufficient. The ability to rapidly detect and respond to threats is essential. That’s where we come in. We offer MDR as a value service to a broad spectrum of customers across different verticals – all equally exciting.

Based in Belgium and the Netherlands, we help companies navigate the digital era and make data-driven decisions with confidence. We proudly serve clients in the top 200 across the Benelux, spanning a wide range of fascinating and diverse sectors.

At Davinsi Labs, we love to inspire each other, collaborate closely, and pursue excellence together. We are building a workplace where fulfillment and happiness take center stage.

Your mission: what can you expect from the job?

You will join our Managed Detection & Response (MDR) teams with a strong focus on security automation and orchestration. As a Security Automation Engineer, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and maintain automated response capabilities using Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.

Your work will directly impact how efficiently and consistently security incidents are handled across complex customer environments. You will help scale our MDR service by translating detection signals into automated, reliable, and auditable response workflows.

We strongly believe in SOAR as code: automation content is version-controlled, tested, and continuously improved.

You will contribute to and integrate with the following technologies:

• Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR
• Microsoft Defender XDR and other XDR platforms
• SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel and others)
• ITSM platforms (ServiceNow and equivalents)
• Cloud, identity, network, and third-party security tooling

Security Automation & Playbook Development

• Translate detection alerts from SIEM and XDR platforms into automated investigation and response flows.
• Implement conditional logic, enrichment steps, human-in-the-loop approvals, and automated containment actions.
SOAR as Code

• Apply software engineering best practices such as modularity, reusability, testing, and peer review.
• Contribute to standardized automation frameworks that can be reused across customers.
Platform Integrations

• Build and maintain integrations between XSOAR and:
• SIEM platforms o XDR / EDR solutions
• ITSM tools (incident creation, updates, closures) o Identity, network, and cloud security controls
• Troubleshoot and optimize integrations for reliability, performance, and scalability.
Incident Response Enablement

• Collaborate closely with Detection Engineering and Incident Response teams to define:
• Automated investigation steps o Response actions and containment strategies o Escalation and handover points to analysts
• Continuously improve response quality based on real incident feedback.
Automation Lifecycle Management

• Maintain and evolve our automation content library.
• Tune playbooks to reduce noise, false positives, and manual 

Hello, is it me you’re looking for?

Are you passionate about #AI or #cybersecurity? You love working with high profile teams with a sure taste for challenge and variety? You dream to join a fast-growing company with start-up mentality? Eager to learn continuously? Join Proximus Ada! Within Proximus’ centre of excellence for AI and Cybersecurity, a team of data scientists, ML engineers and analytics translators, supports the Proximus group and its partners in designing, developing and deploying internal AI-driven applications in line with the business needs. 

As a B2B AI Consultant, you will be responsible for the development of end-to-end AI solutions for our B2B customers. You will be involved in the design of the solution from the start, helping our customers define and scope the problem, pick the right AI architecture and technology as well as ensure implementation, integration and deployment of your solution to production. You will do so while ensuring that our technical excellence guidelines and best practices are respected. You will also play a key role in collaboration with other team members as well as knowledge sharing with both internal and external partners. 
Responsibilities  
• Develop AI applications using state-of-the-art (Gen)AI technology. 
• Translate customer requests into fit-for-purpose AI solution architectures aligned with customer needs.  
• Pilot prototypes in production processes to demonstrate their value. 
• Deploy robust, scalable AI solutions that integrate smoothly into customers’ existing systems and processes. 
• Present your results in a clear manner and discuss them with multi-functional project teams without technical background. 
• Work in close collaboration with customer business experts, including flexibility to work at the customers’ location. 
 

Profile
• PhD or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
• Proven experience (5+ years) in AI/ML engineering with a strong focus on deploying and integrating AI 
• Proven experience with B2B customer deliveries Technical skills  
• Strong expertise in Python 
• Strong knowledge of state-of-the-art AI and statistical methods 
• Proven proficiency with deploying scalable AI applications to production 
• Experience using LLM’s and commonly used libraries to interact with LLM’s (LangChain, Llamaindex, ...) 
• Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, and Azure Data & AI services 
• Strong Expertise with version control (Git, GitHub) 
• Expertise with CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development best practices 
• Experience with Agentic AI frameworks (Langgraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, …) is a big plus 
• Experience with additional Cloud services (AWS, GCP…) is a big plus 
• Experience with MLOps tools and frameworks (g. MLflow, Kubeflow, TFX) is a big plus Attitudes/Behaviour  
• Excellent problem-solving skills. 
• Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse stakeholders from data science to commercial and business profiles. 
•  Excellence: Strong commitment to excellence by consistently striving for highquality outcomes, embracing continuous improvement, and maintaining a proactive, detailoriented approach. 
• Resilience: Capacity to troubleshoot and resolve issues in complex, changing environments while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience. 
• Communication: Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts in a structured and accessible way, adapting the message to different audiences (technical, business, or executive).  
• Customer Focus: Strong customer mindset, seeking to understand business challenges, anticipate needs, and translate them into impactful AI solutions that deliver measurable value. 
• Versatility & Learning Drive: Highly adaptable professional, eager to learn new tools, technologies, and methodologies.  
• Delivery Mindset: Pragmatic, hands-on, and driven by quick, high-quality delivery with a strong can-do attitude. Languages  
• Fluent in English + French and/or Dutch

Proximus Global, combining the strengths of Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile, is transforming the future of communications and digital identity. Together, our solutions fuel innovation across the world’s largest companies and emerging brands. Our unrivaled global reach empowers businesses to create engaging experiences with built-in fraud protection across the entire customer lifecycle.Our comprehensive suite of solutions – from our super network for voice, messaging, and data, to 5G and IoT; and from verification and intelligence to CPaaS for personalized omnichannel engagement – enables businesses and communities to thrive. Reaching over 5 billion subscribers, securing more than 180 billion transactions annually, and connecting 1,000+ destinations, we honor our commitment to connect, protect and engage everyone, everywhere.Key highlights include:

• Powering over 13 billion digital communications each month
• Supporting 3,500+ active customers — including enterprises, OTTs, and mobile operators — through a presence in 50+ global offices across 100+ countries
• Managing 50% of the world’s roaming data traffic and connecting 150 million IoT devices
• Driving innovation in 5G, private networks, and IoT enablement, positioning Proximus Global as a leader in next-generation communication technologies
• Committed to a unified vision, Proximus Global is unlocking new opportunities and enabling seamless global communications for businesses worldwide
Please note that this position is based in Brussels and offered as a permanent contract (CDI). It is not a freelance opportunity. The role requires on-site presence 2 to 3 days per week.

• Ensure accurate and evolving effort estimations from project inception through detailed design and backlog management, enabling realistic planning and resource allocation. 
• Producing and maintaining comprehensive solution documentation artefacts (user stories, functiona

A job at Proximus? You’ll find that everything revolves around the idea ‘Think Possible’. This means: we always assume that something is possible, even if it seems impossible. Well, especially so, actually. Call it a way of thinking that involves being open to a world of digital solutions that make our lives easier. And our way of working smarter.

About the Role

As a CI/CD Engineer, you will contribute to the implementation and evolution of our DevOps ecosystem, supporting CI/CD tooling and promoting DevOps best practices across the organization. You’ll play a key role in enabling efficient, secure, and scalable software delivery pipelines, with a focus on GitHub, Jenkins, and related technologies.

• Provide support for Azure cloudification initiatives and ensure integration with CI/CD pipelines.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops to upskill development teams on CI/CD practices.
• Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously enhance the CI/CD ecosystem.
• Work closely with development and operations teams to ensure alignment and collaboration.
Work Environment

• Agile, hands-on technical role within a dynamic engineering environment.
• Opportunity to shape and evolve CI/CD practices across the organization.
• Collaboration with a diverse team of engineers, developers, and IT professionals.
 

Your profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in CI/CD pipeline management and DevSecOps practices.
• Solid knowledge of Agile and Scrum frameworks, with practical experience working in Scrum teams (ceremonies, roles, and continuous improvement mindset).
• Strong interest in the evolution of Artificial Intelligence, particularly AI‑powered coding assistance tools (such as GitHub Copilot), and a willingness to explore their responsible use to improve developer productivity and code quality
• Strong experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions/Runners and related tools.
• Familiarity with SonarQube and Aikido is a strong plus.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).

• Experience with build tools and package managers: Maven, Node.js, npm, Nexus, JFrog.
• Good understanding of deploying various platforms: web apps, microservices, serverless, etc.
• Familiarity with standard databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) is a plus.
• Experience with Azure and related cloud services is a plus.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• 
Fluent in English (spoken and written).

The mission of MWingz, as a Joint Venture between Orange and Proximus, is to power the first shared mobile network in the best and most efficient way. We are the Magic WINGZ for Orange and Proximus making society fly.

We offer a flexible and easily accessible working environment in the heart of Brussels, with an attractive remuneration package and numerous contemporary and personalized benefits.

Your profile

Required expertise and skills

A People Manager within our Java community is a key figure who develops talent, guides employees, and strengthens the connection between people and the broader Sopra Steria strategy. You combine technical affinity with Java development and a strong passion for coaching, growth, and people development.

• You build strong, trust-based relationships with your people and ensure they feel heard, supported, and challenged.
• You encourage them to grow, provide direction for their career path, and foster a healthy, motivating work environment.
• You focus on long-term development and sustainable growth, rather than short-term operational priorities.
What you will do

• Guide employees in their professional growth by defining objectives together, following up on development plans, and providing regular feedback.
• Act as a coach first: you listen, challenge, and support individuals in becoming the best version of themselves.
• Evaluate performance based on project outcomes and present these evaluations in HR committees, where you also share insights on potential and career progression.
• Ensure fair, qualitative, and continuous performance follow-up, with a strong focus on development rather than evaluation alone.
• Support employees in defining and shaping their career path within Sopra Steria.
• Help individuals discover their strengths, ambitions, and growth opportunities, and translate these into concrete development actions.
• Create a culture of trust, psychological safety, and open communication.
• Foster an environment where people feel safe to speak up, learn, and grow.
• Act as a mentor and sparring partner for consultants, supporting them with professional challenges or personal development questions.
• Be a trusted advisor in key moments: feedback, doubts, growth decisions, or challenges on projects.
• Contribute to the Java community by stimulating knowledge sharing and connecting people.
• Encourage collaboration and learning, without owning delivery or operational outcomes
• Translate Sopra Steria’s strategic objectives into meaningful context for your people.
• Help employees understand how they can grow within the broader organization and what opportunities lie ahead.
Impact of the role

• As a People Manager Java, you are a catalyst for individual growth and engagement.
• You make a direct impact on people’s careers, motivation, and sense of belonging.
• You ensure that talent feels supported, can develop, and remains engaged with Sopra Steria.
• Your success is reflected in strong relationships, personal growth, and long-term retention.
• You create an environment where consultants can thrive and continuously improve.
• You help build confident, autonomous professionals who contribute to the organization in their own way.

As a Senior Information Security Officer, you are the strategic leader who defines, drives and strengthens Luminus’ cybersecurity vision across the entire organization. You ensure that our IT, OT, business operations, subsidiaries and affiliates are protected against evolving cyber threats while supporting our mission to deliver reliable and secure energy services to millions of customers.

What you'll do

• You define and implement a company-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with Luminus’ business objectives, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
• Identify, assess, prioritize and report cybersecurity risks to executive leadership and governance bodies, while ensuring compliance with regulations such as NIS, GDPR and other applicable cybersecurity frameworks.
• You develop and maintain security policies, standards and governance frameworks, and ensure their effective adoption across the organization, subsidiaries and affiliates.
• Build and manage the cybersecurity roadmap, driving initiatives that strengthen resilience, compliance and operational efficiency while building on the strong foundations already in place.
• You work closely with IT, OT, business leaders, the Data Protection Officer, security operations teams and the Information Security Forum to integrate security into key activities and create alignment across the organization.
• Represent Luminus towards regulators, authorities, auditors and external partners, while chairing the Information Security Forum and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

What you'll bring

• You have at least 8 years of experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
• Extensive expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security technologies, regulatory compliance and the ability to translate security requirements into business value.
• You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can clearly explain security risks, priorities and recommendations to senior management, directors and subsidiary leaders.
• Strong influencing, organizational and prioritization skills, allowing you to build consensus, challenge stakeholders when needed and drive security improvements across a complex organization.
• You hold a relevant master's degree or have acquired equivalent expertise through professional experience.
• Recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM and ISO 27001 Lead Implementer are required. A good understanding of IT and OT environments, risk management and the energy sector is a strong asset. Fluent English and French are required.

Are you a 
Finance professional with experience in Belgian accounting and a strong interest in an international environment? Do you speak 
Mandarin and English and enjoy acting as the link between different finance teams? Are you looking for a role where you can combine your accounting knowledge with 
international collaboration, communication and coaching?
 

 
 

You will join a 
dynamic international industrial group with activities across different markets and a strong presence in both Europe and Asia. Despite its international scale, the organisation maintains 
short communication lines and a personal, family-oriented approach. You will become an important link between the finance team in the 
Waregem region and the finance team in China, giving you a unique opportunity to work across cultures and finance environments.
 

 
 

About the company
 

The organisation is part of a 
large international industrial group with activities across multiple countries. The Belgian organisation operates in a 
dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged. You will work closely with colleagues in Belgium and China and play an important role in ensuring smooth communication between both finance teams.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You follow up on 
purchase and sales invoices, payments and outstanding items and ensure that the Belgian finance administration is processed accurately and on time. 
This gives you a hands-on role with direct ownership of important accounting processes. 

• You perform and monitor 
bank bookings and financial transactions, while keeping the accounting records accurate and up to date. 
You will further strengthen your practical accounting expertise within an international environment. 

• You act as the 
financial point of contact between the Belgian site and the finance team in China, translating questions, clarifying processes and ensuring that information flows smoothly between both locations. 
This gives you broad international exposure and allows you to build a strong network across two finance organisations. 

• You support and 
coach finance colleagues in China on Belgian accounting principles, processes and reporting requirements. 
You can use your own experience to help colleagues develop while simultaneously strengthening your communication and coordination skills. 

• You will occasionally 
travel to China to strengthen collaboration with the local finance team and support the alignment of processes. 
This offers you valuable international experience and the opportunity to work directly with colleagues on-site.  

 
 

Profile requirements as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You have practical experience within 
Belgian accounting and are familiar with 
BE GAAP. 

• You speak 
Mandarin Chinese and English fluently, allowing you to communicate effectively with both the Belgian and Chinese finance teams. 

• Knowledge of 
Dutch is a nice-to-have. 

• You are comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment. 

• You have a 
coordinating and communicative personality and enjoy acting as a bridge between different teams. 

• You are willing to 
travel to China occasionally as part of your role.

Are you passionate about SAP and eager to work in an innovative IT landscape with first-adopter technologies?

At Joris Ide, SAP plays a key role in supporting and optimising our business processes across Europe. As a SAP FICO Consultant, you contribute to third-line support, system enhancements and end-to-end projects, working closely with both IT and the business. Ready to make an impact? Ide-al!

What does your day look like?

• You research new SAP applications and functionalities to support business use cases.
• You build new processes and continuously optimise existing ones.
• You roll out the SAP template to new factories and countries.
• You work closely with business process owners and key stakeholders.
• You participate in blueprint and fit-gap analyses.
• You analyse and understand business processes and requirements and translate them into functional designs.
• You configure the system and write functional and technical specifications.
• You document and test new functionalities thoroughly.
• You support the business during acceptance testing and go-live.
• You play a key role throughout all project phases, from start to finish.
• You work with the latest SAP technologies, including SAP S/4HANA.

Who are we looking for?

• You have profound knowledge of SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling)
• You are familiar with business processes and their implementation in SAP
• You have strong analytical skills
• You have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
• You enjoy working in an informal, no-nonsense environment
• You work independently but collaborate easily with colleagues
• You are interested in a manufacturing environment
• You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe
• You speak English; knowledge of Dutch or French is a plus
• You are able to debug programming codePersoonsgebonden competenties (soft skills):
• Analyseren
• Communiceren
• Initiatief
• Plannen en organiseren
• Resultaatgerichtheid
• Samenwerken

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground. 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.

 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.
