Are you an experienced procurement professional looking to make an impact in a dynamic international aviation environment? As a Senior Purchaser, you will play a key role in ensuring the availability of critical parts and materials that keep our helicopter operations running safely and efficiently worldwide.

Acting as the link between operational departments and our supplier network, you will balance urgent operational requirements with commercial performance, supply continuity, quality, lead times and cost efficiency. In addition to day-to-day purchasing activities, you will help drive continuous improvement across our procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain performance.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Managing strategically important supplier relationships and acting as the main point of contact for supplier-related matters. 

• 
Driving supplier performance improvements focused on service levels, lead times, cost efficiency and overall performance.

• 
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to resolve supplier performance issues and ensure continuity of supply. 

• 
Managing procurement activities, purchase orders and supplier agreements while ensuring compliance with agreed terms.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and proactively following up to avoid operational delays. 

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records and ERP system data.

• 
Providing support for Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations and participating in the on-call rotation approximately every 4 to 5 weeks.

• 
Acting quickly on urgent procurement requests to minimize aircraft downtime. 

• 
Supporting the development of procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain initiatives.

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, supplier performance and cost control across the organization.

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoys building strong supplier relationships.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience. 

• 
Previous experience in a purchasing role. 

• 
Experience working with ERP systems such as Navision or SAP. 

• 
Strong negotiation and influencing skills. 

• 
Professional proficiency in English; French is considered an advantage.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

• 
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• 
The ability to remain flexible and resilient under pressure.

• 
A collaborative approach and the ability to build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Are you ready to begin or further develop your career in procurement within an international aviation environment? As a Junior Purchaser, you help ensure that the parts and services needed for our base and line maintenance activities are available at the right time, in the right place and at the best possible cost.

Working closely with experienced purchasers, internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will support an accurate and reliable purchasing process. You will follow up open orders, maintain procurement data and help resolve delivery issues in accordance with our internal procedures.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Creating and managing purchase orders while checking pricing, accuracy and compliance with agreed terms and internal procedures.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and following up with suppliers to support the timely delivery of parts and services.

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records, supplier information and data within our ERP and procurement systems.

• 
Identifying and escalating potential delays, discrepancies and supply risks.

• 
Acting as a day-to-day contact for suppliers regarding order status, delivery information and discrepancies.

• 
Supporting the resolution of late deliveries, shortages and other delivery-related issues.

• 
Assisting with supplier performance monitoring and collecting information for follow-up actions.

• 
Working closely with colleagues in purchasing, maintenance, logistics and other internal departments.

• 
Contributing ideas to improve order follow-up, data quality, team efficiency and service levels.

• 
Gradually building your procurement knowledge and taking ownership of purchasing activities.

You will also participate in the Aircraft on Ground, or AOG, on-call rotation approximately once every four to five weeks. During these time-critical situations, you will coordinate with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams to help minimize aircraft downtime. This out-of-office-hours support can be provided remotely from home.

We are looking for an accurate, proactive and motivated colleague who is eager to learn and develop within an international procurement environment.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent level gained through experience.

• 
Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics or an administrative role, which is considered an advantage.

• 
Experience with an ERP system such as Navision or SAP, or a willingness to learn.

• 
Professional proficiency in English.

• 
Knowledge of French is considered an advantage.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
An interest in developing your negotiation and influencing skills.

• 
Strong organizational and analytical abilities.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented and results-driven approach.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to remain flexible under pressure.

• 
A collaborative mindset and the ability to build professional relationships.

• 
A genuine willingness to learn and grow within the role.

Middlegate Europe is a leading player in European logistics and distribution. With operational sites
in Zeebrugge, Liège, and Hull, the company combines innovative processes with a strong focus on safety,
quality, and operational reliability. To strengthen the team in Zeebrugge, Middlegate Europe is looking for an
International Truck Driver.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 
 

• Responsible for delivering goods within the specified time frame. 

• Complying with legal driving and rest periods. 

• Assisting with loading and unloading trucks and ensuring the cargo is secured. 

• Ensuring the vehicle is kept in perfect condition and clean. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a valid CE driver’s license. 

• You have some initial experience as a CE driver. 

• You are punctual, professional, and thorough in your work. 

• You speak Dutch or English well. 

• You have a flexible mindset. 

• You’re willing to spend the night on location.

Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven 
Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to provide clients with a structured, solution-oriented, and clear proposal within the agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respond to the client's questions. 
 

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include: 
 

• Analyzing and summarizing client requests. 
 

• Developing proposals for technical requests and projects in collaboration with the responsible Key Account Manager to achieve the best balance between budget, scope, and timing according to client needs. 
 

• During the bidding process, you collaborate with various support departments such as engineering, logistics, HR, SHEQ, finance, etc. You coordinate their input and deliverables while respecting deadlines to create a structured, high-quality proposal that meets both internal and external expectations. 
 

• Regularly consulting with the responsible Key Account Manager and the sales support team about the proposed solution, adjusting as needed. 
 

• Gathering the necessary cost inputs, preparing a price calculation, and reviewing it with the Key Account Manager and/or management. 
 

• Timely and accurately submitting proposals/tender documents after internal approval and following up on them with the Key Account Manager. Responding to internal and external questions and making adjustments where needed. 
 

• Acting at all times as a proud 
Sarens Ambassador and providing general sales support to the group. 

We are looking for a stress-resistant multitasker with a hands-on mentality, strong writing skills, and a solution-focused, positive attitude. You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. You possess good reading and listening skills, enabling you to detect and anticipate customer needs. You think outside the box in search of the best solution. You are a sociable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work in a structured and precise manner, with attention to detail. Customer focus, drive, and proactivity are key to success in this role. 
 

Your profile: 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (engineering, electromechanics, construction...) or equivalent through experience. 
 

• Interest in or experience with sales support, technical inside sales, tender engineering, etc. 
 

• Technical knowledge of heavy lifting and/or exceptional transport, or a strong eagerness to learn and acquire this knowledge quickly. • Strong communicator in Dutch; good knowledge of English and French. 
 

• Proficient with computers (including MS Office).

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 
 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.
 

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

Your Role:
 

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Air Freight Administration
 

 
• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.
 
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
 
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities.  
 

Customer Service
 

 
• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
 
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
 
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected.  
 

Compliance & Operational Excellence
 

 
• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
 
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
 
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
 
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required.  
 

 
 

 

Your Profile:
 

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.
 

Requirements
 

 
• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
 
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
 
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
 
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
 
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  
 

Proactive and able to work independently. 
 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
 
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues. 
 

Personal Qualities
 

 
• Customer-focused and service-minded.
 
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
 
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
 
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
 
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

jobs.occupation: Expression of interest: Logistical Field Representative
jobs.description:
We're looking for candidates interested in a potential role as Logistical Field Representative. This person will be the face to the customer, overseeing the logistics chain between Airbus Helicopters and our customer, including stock and R&O service follow-up.
Responsibilities & Main Result Areas
In-Service Support Package

• 
Ensure timely replenishment of stock in line with contractual obligations.

• 
Coordinate the pickup and on-time delivery of R&O items, aligned with the customer’s maintenance planning.

• 
Actively participate in logistical management meetings.

• 
Manage both the Contractor’s and Customer’s prepositioned stocks, ensuring the follow-up and timely replenishment or revalidation of life-limited items.

• 
Oversee the replenishment and updating of Deployment Kits in close coordination with the MoD.

• 
Represent the MoD in interactions with the Contractor when required.

• 
Manage critical spare parts matters and support performance reporting in line with contractual KPIs, in close collaboration with the MoD.

Customer Relationship

• 
Act as the primary point of contact for the customer.

• 
Possess a solid understanding of the contractual framework and operate effectively within its scope.

• 
Professionally represent the collaboration between AH and the customer, ensuring clear communication and alignment.

Reporting

• 
Ensure timely and accurate reporting of contractual activities to the Contract Manager.

• 
Monitor and follow up on logistical discrepancies, escalating issues when necessary.

• 
Work closely with the Customer CAMO to ensure proper maintenance planning, particularly regarding spares and exchange items.

Experience

• 
Minimum 3 year of relevant experience in a supply chain or logistical role  

• 
Experience in aviation MRO is an advantage.

• 
Experience with customer relations

Skills

• 
ICT literate (MS Office)

• 
Basic understanding of Part-145 and CAMO regulations

• 
Comfortable in interacting with the customer daily

• 
Languages:

• 
English: fluent in understanding – writing – speaking is a must

• 
Knowledge of Dutch and French language is an advantage

• 
Valid European car driver's license

The Account Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships while actively driving business growth. Beyond managing existing accounts, the role places a strong emphasis on proactive client development, including prospection within the existing portfolio, cross-selling, and identifying new revenue opportunities. The Account Manager acts as both a trusted advisor and a commercial driver, combining relationship management with strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
 

 
• Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with assigned clients.
 
• Ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions according to client needs and objectives, and this is within the existing HighCo DATA services package.
 
• Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess performance and identify opportunities. 

 
• Strong sales and negotiation skills
 
• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities in French, Dutch and English
 
• Customer-centric mindset with strong business acumen
 
• Ability to identify and convert opportunities into revenue
 
• Proactive and results-oriented approach
 
• Strong organizational and time management skills
 
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
 
• Team collaboration and cross-functional coordination
 
• Highly driven with a strong commercial mindset
 
• Results-oriented with a focus on growth and performance

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.

Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges. 

• Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities. 

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance.

• Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines.  

Qualifications
 
 

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 

• Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR. 

• Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis.

• Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs. 

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 

• Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders), Österreichische Rundfunksender GmbH (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept. You translate your findings into clear, digestible formats and share your knowledge internally and externally -- through technical blog posts, presentations, or trend and technology analyses. AI and automation are a permanent part of your technology radar -- always with an eye on concrete use cases in the streaming and platform environment. Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You lead the operational activities of BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You make sure PoC outcomes are properly documented and turned into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You continuously improve our Lab processes, fostering an agile, execution-oriented innovation culture. Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem -- universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners. You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives. You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility. You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities. Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally. You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats. You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends. jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) / 1610 (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description: About IONOSAt IONOS, we don't just manage servers – we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure – from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.Tasks- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.Qualifications- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in the Collaborative Project SiProtect (Molekularbiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN)  headquartered in Frankfurt am Main is seeking to fill the following position at its Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) in Müncheberg  starting as of 1 January 2027Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in the Collaborative Project SiProtect(part time, 65%)Location: Müncheberg (Brandenburg)Employment scope: part-time, 65% (26 weekly working hours)Type of contract: ideally starting on 01 January 2027; fixed term until 31 December 2030Remuneration: collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.Located east of Berlin, the Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) is situated on a modern science campus. An international team of scientists conducts insect research, complemented by an information centre with archive and library.About the projectExploring insect communities with molecular tools. How do crop resilience strategies affect insect communities - and how can molecular technologies help us monitor these changes directly in the field?As a PhD Researcher in the collaborative project SiProtect, you will investigate insect communities associated with rye and contribute to the development of innovative approaches for species identification and biodiversity monitoring.SiProtect explores how amorphous silicate (ASi) can strengthen rye resilience to biotic and abiotic stressors, including insect pests, associated pathogens and drought. Your research will connect field-based entomological monitoring with molecular identification, metabarcoding and portable nanopore sequencing.A particular focus will be the development and validation of a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION technology. The resulting workflow aims to accelerate species identification under field conditions and provide a transferable approach for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring.Your tasks- Plan and conduct entomological research activities within the SiProtect research programme, with a focus on insect communities associated with rye- Conduct standardised insect monitoring using Malaise traps, pan traps, sticky traps and sweep netting- Identify collected insects using morphological and taxonomic approaches and contribute to a reference database for rye-associated insect communities- Establish, optimise and validate metabarcoding approaches for bulk insect samples and compare their performance with conventional identification methods- Portable sequencing: Develop and validate a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencing for rapid field-based species identification- Develop and apply computational pipelines for molecular species identification and insect community analysis- Assess responses of pest and beneficial insect communities to rye resilience strategies and integrate morphological and molecular monitoring data- Contribute to interdisciplinary research within the SiProtect consortium and develop new approaches for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring- Publish research findings in international journals and present results at scientific conferences and project meetingsYour profile- Completed Master’s degree in entomology, biology, ecology, molecular biology, biodiversity research or a related discipline- Good knowledge of the major insect orders and families of the German fauna and experience using taxonomic identification literature- Basic practical experience in molecular biology, ideally including DNA extraction, polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and gel documentation- Interest in and ideally initial experience with DNA barcoding, metabarcoding or molecular species identification- Basic programming skills in R and/or Python- Experience handling dried or ethanol-preserved entomological specimens is an advantage- Ability to organize research activities independently and work in a structured and reliable manner- Strong communication skills and an interest in interdisciplinary and collaborative research- Valid Class B driving licence and willingness to undertake fieldwork- Good written and spoken English, German skills are an advantageWhat you can expectThis position offers the opportunity to combine field entomology, molecular biology, metabarcoding, nanopore sequencing and bioinformatics within an interdisciplinary research project. You will contribute to a scientifically relevant question at the interface of crop resilience, biodiversity and sustainable agriculture, while developing a transferable methodological approach for field-based insect monitoring.We look forward to welcoming a curious and collaborative researcher who is keen to develop new methods and contribute their own ideas to SiProtect.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Associate Principal, Product OperationsStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionExciting challenges. Quick decisions. Real users waiting. As an Associate Principal, Product Operations (Enterprise Device Management), you’ll own the global fleet of Android devices that restaurants use to receive and manage orders. You’ll keep configurations, rollouts, and support running smoothly across all our markets, and help shape where our device ecosystem goes next.The Global Vendor Operations team is made up of smart, driven people from around the world who work closely with our entities to help every local and regional operations team perform efficiently. We support senior management and local teams in keeping operations running smoothly. We also track how restaurant partners experience our products and services globally, and turn those insights into feature requirements for the product roadmap.As part of our Vendor Team, you’ll be the driving force behind the success of thousands of restaurants, shops, and local businesses. Your contributions will empower vendors with advanced tools to manage their operations, boosting their visibility and reach. Every feature you help build will create growth opportunities for businesses of all sizes, strengthening Delivery Hero’s ecosystem and impact.- Own our global restaurant device fleet, from allocation and provisioning to lifecycle management across all markets, and own the Key Results and initiatives that improve it, aligned with stakeholders on shared quarterly goals.- Operate and enhance our Device Management ecosystem (Android OS and devices), covering configuration, enrollment, policy and compliance management, account setup, incident and ticket troubleshooting, device support, and country-specific change requests.- Plan and run global software rollouts, including app updates, firmware upgrades, staged rollouts, rollback strategies, and post-deployment monitoring, and validate Android devices, firmware versions, and MDM configurations before release. Own projects that improve cost or efficiency.- Independently manage mid- and senior-level stakeholders across global and local operations teams, and work with the MDM Product Owner to develop integrations with internal systems and improve operational workflows.- Contribute to the product roadmap with analysis, stakeholder perspectives, and domain expertise.- Guide the day-to-day work of junior team members, share best practices beyond your own scope, and build transparency through documentation, knowledge bases, training materials, and efficient ticketing processes. On-call support for our global user base is part of the role when required.Qualifications- 6+ years of relevant experience managing large-scale Android device environments, including both consumer and B2B devices.- In-depth knowledge of an MDM platform, ideally SOTI MobiControl.- A solid understanding of networking technologies and concepts, including TCP/IP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, and mobile network connectivity.- Proven ability to manage stakeholders independently at mid and senior levels in a global, multicultural environment.- You work well in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly as priorities change.- You are analytical, independent, and communicative, with fluent English.Nice to have- Hands-on experience with other enterprise-scale MDM solutions, such as VMware Workspace ONE / AirWatch or Ivanti / MobileIron.- Additional languages.Additional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank,  Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements)  and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements)  and check out more information about moving to Berlin.- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.Heads up: exact benefits may look a little different for intern, working student, fixed-term, and part-time roles.Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire)  If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You join a team that is being built right now. Transformation of Industry is setting up a dedicated Function Controlling for the first time, and you are part of it from the start. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin. Headcount, external spend and project costs have moved, and the functional leadership team needs a clear view of the financial impact. You discuss the key drivers, challenge assumptions and agree on actions. You are close to the business, comfortable with detail and able to turn numbers into a concise management message.This is a rare moment to join. A new company is being built, and with it a new Finance organization: the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is developing into the Corporate FP&A department of that company, an organization of more than 100 finance professionals. knowledge of SAP, Power BI, SAC or comparable tools is a plus* Fluent English; additional languages are an asset but not requiredAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. The role is hands-on. You report root cause and propose countermeasures with Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and the other failure analysis engineers. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. You define the operating model, the cost center and manpower steering logic, the reporting cadence and the standards that the functions will be steered by, and you build the team that runs them.You are not starting from an empty page. A part of the team will transfer into the new unit, so you begin with experienced colleagues who know the business, the processes and you grow the team around them. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project executionWhat You Bring* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules* Business fluent English communication skillsAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

warehouses, pick & pack operations and material flow processes.- You have experience in managing large-scale investment projects and complex, cross-functional project structures.- You demonstrate strong stakeholder management skills and communicate confidently at all levels, from the shop floor to Executive Management and the Executive Board.- You have a structured, solution-oriented and assertive approach and maintain an overall perspective, even in highly complex project environments.- Very good German and English language skills, along with a strong willingness to work on-site, particularly in Künzelsau and Ingelfingen, complete your profile.WHY BERNER? - Job bike leasing (JobRad)  - Commuting allowance  - Wellpass membership & corporate benefits  - Company pension scheme  - Opportunities for further training  - Technically modern equipped workplace  - Company restaurant in Künzelsau or meal vouchers in Cologne  - Attractive conditions for our products in the BERNER online shop Apply Now – We’re Excited to Meet You! jobs.occupation: Associate Installer Support Engineer (Spanish Speaking) - (m/w/d) - Fixed Term Contract (Techniker/in - Elektrotechnik (ohne Schwerpunkt)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description: What to ExpectPlease submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. We strive to empower our channel partners to provide the best end-customer experience possible, and we are an endpoint for determining next steps and solutions for many situations.Installer Support Engineering Technicians offer real-time diagnostics and solutions for trained on-site technicians during installation and maintenance of Tesla’s residential solar, storage and home charging energy products. Strong candidates for this role will already have knowledge in the residential energy industry. Applicants should expect to become a subject matter expert (SME) with Tesla’s energy products with the ability to remotely access and troubleshoot equipment.This is an exciting, fast-paced and rewarding role, and a fantastic opportunity to dig deep into our innovative products while collaborating with some of the most talented people in the world!What You’ll Do- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.- Utilise software including Linux environments, SSH, and more for advanced troubleshootingWhat You’ll Bring- Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering field, or a minimum of 2+ years’ experience in a technician role- Fluency in English and Spanish is required for this role - Ability to independently make decisions and solve problems with limited direction- Outstanding written and verbal interpersonal communication skills- Experience and understanding of customer service, technical support and engineering environments- Ability to document interactions and steps clearly, accurately and with detail- Ability to prioritize workflows effectively according to multiple criteria- Understanding of electrical theory and experience with emphasis on AC/DC power systems or other electronic systems, devices and components- Experience troubleshooting metering and communications issues involving many variables- Understanding of commercial electrical metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation- Electrical engineering knowledge and/or experience is a plusTesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/283544?source=BA

intersection of hardware, software, and manufacturing, you will design and develop automated test solutions that help deliver high-quality medical devices to patients around the world in close working hands-on with measurement equipment and solving complex technical challenges.- You have programming experience in environments such as Python, Go, LabVIEW, TestStand, or similar technologies.- We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.What you will do- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.What we are looking for- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.- Clear written and spoken communication in English. perform dimensional quantity take-offs; identify scope implied but not explicitly shown in design documents- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance itemsWhat You’ll Bring- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage- Analytical, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; proactive communicator in a fast-paced, multicultural environment- Experience building, leading, or transitioning to a centralized estimating function — methodology, SOPs, and standardization frameworks- Proven track record as the go-to cost expert for project teams, designers, and leadership; authoritative cost advice with confidence, independence, and sound professional judgement- Availability to travel across EMEA as required (up to 50%)- English required; additional European language skills a strong plusTesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.How You’ll Make an Impact * Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholdersWhat You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantageAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

jobs.description: As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients inthe banking sector and financial services industry on complex topicsrelated to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their currentsituation, identify new requirements early on and, together with yourteam, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the wayto implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continueddevelopment of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enablingwell‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matterresponsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape thecontent development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: Yousupport and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financialservices providers in their liquidity and market price riskmanagement, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and thedesign of client-specific solutions through to implementation. Youdevelop integrated management approaches for liquidity and marketprice risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitativemodeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interestrate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you designmethodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) anddevelop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well asnet interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you alsoensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, forinstance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of yourteam and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientationand professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – bothwithin the team and with our clients. You also mentor juniorcolleagues, developing both their professional capabilities andpersonal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. Youactively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consultingportfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage andderive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support thedevelopment of new offerings and the acquisition of new clientmandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented bycertifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years ofprofessional experience in consulting or the financial industry.Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects inliquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, andinitial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinatingteam members) is also part of your profile. You have a solidunderstanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well asthe ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analyticaland quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programmingskills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar withrelevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBAGuidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is aplus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented mannerand communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of workingcomes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility withina team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (atleast B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybridYour benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road withzeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accidentinsurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additionaltravel health insurance and you can also take out a company pensionplan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remotework is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are onthe train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life ischanging—and we would like to accompany you through the differentphases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, lifesituation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” appliesfor all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanentemployees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop yourpart-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career DevelopmentCounselor) and in consideration of your project and adapt it asrequired. Define your working time model according to your personalneeds and adapt your working hours to your current life situation. Asa contract model, Family & More offers a guarantee of travel-freeweekdays that are contractually fixed. Depending on the reduction oftravel activities, your salary will be adjusted for a fixed period oftime.
