The CompanyUndagrid is part of the EnOcean group and delivers end-to-end asset tracking and IoT solutions that give customers in aviation, logistics and industry full visibility of their assets, equipment and operations. The Undagrid platform combines self-powered and battery-driven sensor devices with BLE-based indoor positioning, GPS/GNSS outdoor tracking and cellular IoT connectivity, and turns the resulting data into dashboards, analytics and reports that customers rely on every day. We are the leader in sensing and control products for IoT infrastructures and combine it with energy harvesting technologies for maintenance-free solutions that gain their energy from the environment enabling a sustainable world.The Role & YouYou are the technical face of our asset tracking platform towards our worldwide customer base. Working side by side with Sales, Product Management and Engineering, you guide customers from the first platform demonstration through deployment, training and day-to-day operations, and make sure they get measurable value out of our solutions. As an integral part of a global Customer Success team, you combine hands-on platform expertise with a strong feel for our customers’ business processes, and you turn what you learn in the field into better products.This position can be based in either Munich (Germany) , Copenhagen (Denmark) or Utrecht (the Netherlands) . We are recruiting for one role and will hire one candidate . The employment contract will be concluded with the local EnOcean entity at the selected location. Please apply only once and indicate your preferred location.#LI-HybridWhat you’ll be doing• Act as the primary technical counterpart in customer meetings alongside Sales and PM, and build strong relationships with technical, operational and management stakeholders on the customer side• Deliver compelling platform demonstrations and showcase advanced functionality in a way that creates confidence and excitement with customers• Support solution design and deployment planning for new customer projects, and support our customers worldwide in deploying EnOcean and Undagrid solutions in their network and IT infrastructure• Configure and administer the platform independently, including tenant creation, user management, dashboard setup, reporting and minor customizations to meet customer requirements• Deliver technical and operational training for customer teams, from end users to administrators and IT stakeholders• Travel to customer sites when needed to support deployments, training, workshops, troubleshooting and business reviews• Validate our solutions in the field and at customer sites, identify technical problems and drive them to resolution• Collect customer requirements and translate them into actionable improvements and product feedback, working closely with our sales, product marketing, product management and engineering teamsWhat we’re looking for• BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a relevant field, combined with 5–10 years of experience in the asset tracking, IoT, RTLS, telematics, or related industries• Solid understanding of both indoor and outdoor tracking technologies: BLE-based indoor positioning and proximity tracking, GPS/GNSS-based outdoor tracking, as well as cellular IoT, telematics and fleet tracking concepts• Experience working with asset tracking platforms, dashboards, analytics and customer reporting, as well as with tools such as Grafana, git and Jira• Experience in installing and configuring network equipment, ideally in the field of aviation or logistics• Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills across hardware, connectivity and software domains• Good understanding of business processes and operational use cases, enabling you to discuss both technical capabilities and business value with customers• Ability to communicate effectively with everyone from operational users and IT departments to senior management, paired with a hands-on, problem-solving attitude in direct customer contact• Willingness to travel worldwide and to adjust your working schedule to support Your responsibilitiesAs B2B Manager – Industry & Education , you will build strategic relationships with companies, industry associations, innovation stakeholders, and ecosystem partners across Europe. You will design and implement sponsorship and partnership models that generate income and support financial sustainability, negotiating and closing deals, while creating meaningful connections between industry and talent development initiatives.The role supports two flagship Cross-KIC initiatives: EIT STEM Tech Talent Induction and EIT Talent. EIT STEM Tech Talent Induction is building a STEM talent pipeline through trainings, skilling projects, and a community of industry partners. EIT Talent connects industry with emerging talent through Cross-KIC Innovation Challenges and supports the development of the EIT Alumni Framework and Ambassador Network.You will secure sponsorships, develop partnership opportunities, support innovation challenges, and collaborate with EIT Health, other EIT KICs, industry partners, and European stakeholders in an international environment.Your Input• You design, package and price industry engagement offers across the cluster’s education initiatives, from event and community sponsorships to sponsored Innovation Challenges.• You define target industry segments and develop value propositions covering sponsorship, talent access, co-creation and visibility formats.• You build and manage the partner pipeline through proactive outreach and leveraging EIT and Pledger networks.• You negotiate and secure financial and in-kind contributions, convert one-off sponsorships into recurring collaborations, and contribute to agreed revenue targets.• You test value propositions with partners and refine engagement models based on market feedback.• You co-organise networking events, webinars, matchmaking sessions and industry co-designed Innovation Challenges.• You manage partner relationships beyond delivery, identify follow-on opportunities, and gather feedback to improve formats and offerings.• You design, validate and continuously improve industry engagement and sponsorship models for both initiatives to support financial sustainability and partner value creation.• You identify and develop cross-KIC partnership opportunities by leveraging the networks and communities of the eight EIT Knowledge and Innovation Communities.• You monitor pipeline, revenue and KPIs, and prepare reporting and documentation in line with EIT and Horizon Europe requirements.Your skills & knowledge What you bring• You hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in business, marketing, communications, international relations or a related field, or bring equivalent experience in B2B or partnership roles.• You have proven experience in B2B business development, corporate partnerships, sponsorship sales or fundraising, with a track record of securing sponsorships for programmes, events or communities and closing agreements.• Experience in education, innovation, entrepreneurship or research environments is an advantage, while experience with European-funded projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, EIT, Erasmus+) and knowledge of the EIT Knowledge and Innovation Communities is a plus.• You are able to develop commercial offers from segmentation and value proposition development through to packaging and pricing.• You combine strong pipeline management and CRM skills with the confidence to engage partners through both cold outreach and established networks.• You bring excellent negotiation, networking, presentation and stakeholder management skills, as well as a good understanding of industry-academia collaboration and the European skills agenda.• You have strong project and event coordination skills, are able to manage multiple priorities, and are proficient in Microsoft Office.• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional European languages is a plus.What we offer• We are a 100% “Remote First” company, hiring in Germany, Spain, France and Poland.• The possibility to join offices in various locations around Europe during business travel.• Flexible working hours.• Straight forward internal communication, non-hierarchical structure, and freedom to operate with autonomy.• A large and vibrant network in the healthcare sector, with exposure to high-level and senior representatives from key players and influencers.• The opportunity to work on critical projects of European interest, contributing to improving the lives of citizens and patients.About usEIT Health is one of Europe’s largest and most dynamic health innovation communities, dedicated to improving the lives of citizens and patients and strengthening healthcare systems across the continent.Our mission is simple: to drive healthcare innovation and create positive societal impact across Europe. In a landscape marked by an ageing population, rising chronic disease, workforce shortages, and increasing pressure on healthcare budgets, our community serves as a catalyst, enabling creative thinking, cross-border collaboration, and evidence-based solutions that deliver real-world impact.As a Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), our pan-European network brings together over 80 members, exceptional in the worlds of business, education, research and health service delivery, alongside thousands of start-ups, entrepreneurs and healthcare professionals. By combining their collective expertise we help new solutions reach the people and services that need them most.For more information please visit our website: www.eithealth.eu

jobs.occupation: Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for NF1, Middle East of Germany (all genders) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role: As a Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for Neurofibromatose Typ 1 (NF1) , you will be at the heart of transforming how patients with rare diseases access life-changing therapies — your work directly influences treatment pathways and outcomes for some of the most underserved patient populations. You will own your territory like a true entrepreneur, taking full accountability for strategy, execution, and sustainable business growth across hospitals, treatment centers, and referral networks. You will develop and execute customized strategic account plans that strengthen centers of excellence, optimize referral pathways, and accelerate time-to-treatment for patients in need. Building deep, trust-based partnerships with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary teams will be your daily currency — and you will do it with scientific credibility and genuine care. Leveraging your deep scientific expertise, you will engage healthcare professionals as a peer and trusted partner, translating complex clinical evidence into meaningful conversations that drive better standards of care. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues in Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Commercial teams to align strategies and maximize impact across the healthcare ecosystem. Data is your compass: you will use CRM tools, market analytics, and territory business planning to identify opportunities, monitor performance, and continuously refine your approach. You will champion disease awareness and patient education initiatives, playing a key role in shaping the rare disease landscape in your region. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring actionable field insights back to the organization — directly influencing strategy at a national level. This is a rare opportunity to combine commercial excellence with genuine patient impact — if that drives you, this role was made for you.Your territory covers key hubs across the Middle East of Germany — mainly Dresden, Leipzig and Göttingen area — and ideally, you already call one of these regions home.Who You Are:- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related life science field; a qualification as Pharmaceutical Representative per local regulatory requirements is a plus.- You bring at least 4–5 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, with a proven track record in strategic account management and market development.- You have hands-on experience in rare disease environments and a strong understanding of the complex stakeholder dynamics involved.- You possess deep knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and patient access processes, ideally with exposure to high-cost specialty therapies.- You are scientifically agile — able to engage with complex clinical data and translate it into compelling, compliant customer discussions.- You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong analytical capabilities, taking ownership of results and thriving in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments.- You are a skilled communicator and relationship builder, experienced in working across cross-functional teams and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.- You are fluent in German and English and highly willing to travel within your territory, including overnight travel as required.- A valid driving license is required.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: Introduction: Get ready to embark on an exhilarating journey in the world of mobility technology! This job opportunity invites you to shape the future of parking systems, where you'll be at the forefront of developing a cutting-edge backend, optimizing CI pipelines, and enhancing monitoring with Datadog, all while ensuring the seamless operation of thousands of parking lots. If you're a passionate engineer with a hunger for continuous improvement and proficiency in a variety of programming languages, this is your chance to revolutionize the industry and make a direct impact on our dynamic, tech-driven team. Your Objectives & Role: Drive the Backend Vision: Define and evolve the architecture of our backend systems, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned with long-term product strategy. Align Engineering with Strategy: Act as a technical counterpart to product and business stakeholders, translating company objectives into backend initiatives with measurable impact. Drive End-to-End Ownership: Take accountability for backend projects from concept to delivery and beyond, setting the standard for reliability and quality across the lifecycle. Champion Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for clean, performant, and maintainable code; foster a culture of high standards and technical curiosity. Lead & Develop Engineers: Guide backend engineers through mentorship, coaching, and clear technical direction to grow the team’s capabilities and autonomy. Architect for Scale & Resilience: Make critical decisions on system design and performance to support a growing platform with increasing complexity and scale. Elevate Operational Maturity: Lead improvements to monitoring, observability, and developer workflows, ensuring backend systems are resilient and teams can ship confidently. Embed Security by Design: Take responsibility for backend security posture, ensuring systems meet best practices and compliance from the ground up. Be a Force for Innovation: Stay ahead of backend trends and emerging technologies; drive continuous improvement in how we build, scale, and operate our systems. Backend Development: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, Node.js, and backend frameworks such as NestJS, Flask, Fastify, or FastAPI. Cloud Expertise: Hands-on experience with AWS services like RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, EC2, and SQS. Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform or similar tools for infrastructure automation. jobs.description: Job available in 4 locations: Berlin, Halle, Remote, LeipzigWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.Location:Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central GermanyIdeally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or BerlinDiscover Impactful WorkJoin our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. The State Museum of Natural History Stuttgart (SMNS) is one of the largestand most popular natural history museums in Germany. As a modern researchmuseum, we see ourselves as a bridge between science and society, offering avibrant platform for dialogue and exchange. Innovation arises wherecutting-edge research meets our unique collection and creative outreach. We arepassionately committed to the conservation of biodiversity. The project investigates the patterns andprocesses underlying plant hyperaccumulation of heavy metals. The role also involves preparing for and participatingin a field campaign in the western United States, in close collaboration withDr Pierre Liancourt. The technician will work closely with the laboratory ofProfessor Katja Tielbörger, the principal investigator leading the HYPERSPACEproject in Germany.Your responsibilities will include:- Implementing and adapting techniques and methods in plant functionalecology, with trait measurements conducted both in the field and in thelaboratory. Plant organs (leaves, stems and roots) and soil samples will beanalysed for metal concentrations.- Contributing to data collection, formatting and management, and maintainingdetailed records of protocols and procedures.- Following appropriate hygiene and safety procedures when handling plant andsoil samples with elevated metal concentrations, both in the field and in thelaboratory.You have the following skills and knowledge:- A Bachelor’s degree in ecology or an equivalent qualification.- English proficiency at B2 level or above; C1 or C2 preferred forcommunication with international partners.- Basic knowledge of functional ecology and methods for measuringabove-ground and root functional traits.- An understanding of major plant adaptations to exposure to metals andmetalloids.- Experience in sample collection and international transport, includingrelevant regulatory requirements.- Experience in functional trait measurements using specialist software suchas WinFolia and WinRhizo.- Enjoyment of fieldwork and the physical fitness required for potentiallydemanding conditions, including mountainous terrain and remote areas.- Precision and thoroughness in laboratory work, which will account for asubstantial proportion of the role, particularly when handling plant and soilsamples with elevated metal concentrations.- Clear and open communication with a range of stakeholders, includinginternational researchers.- The ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, meet deadlines andadapt to changing workloads.- A valid Category B driving licence.- Willingness and ability to travel to the United States for fieldwork,subject to applicable travel and entry requirements; Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams. TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.  For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) as Instrument Scientist TOFTOF (m/f/d) Tasks and Responsibilities You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.  Your tasks include:  Scientific lead of TOFTOF's further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications. Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOF Experimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performance Method development in the area of neutron spectroscopy Operation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operation Pursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methods Your responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.  Qualification and Experience PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field. Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.  Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.  Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial. Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profile Persuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset. For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.de The high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees. Benefits We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such as  TUM's health offers University sports  TUM's internal continuing education and training opportunities TUM childcare (subject to availability)  Very good accessibility by public transport The position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed. Contract We are looking forward to your application via our online-portal https://karriere.frm2.tum.de until  26.11.2026.  Here you may also find other job vacancies at FRM II: https://karriere.frm2.tum.de   Technische Universität München Forschungsneutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) Personalbüro Lichtenbergstraße 1 D-85748 Garching Tel: +49 89 289 12305 oder 14910    www.mlz-garching.de www.frm2.tum.de   As part of your application, you provide personal data to the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Please view our privacy policy on collecting and processing personal data in the course of the application process pursuant to Art. 13 of the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (GDPR) at https://portal.my-tum.de/kompass/datenschutz/Bewerbung/. By submitting your application, you confirm to have read and under-stood the data protection information (https://www.tum.de/spezialseiten/datenschutz/) provided by TUM.

Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: OperationsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.03.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026Stellennummer: MER0003ZHRArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOAs the FinTech hub of Mercedes‑Benz, we connect the world of mobility with the world of payments. Our mission is simple: Transform transactions into the best possible customer experience — inside the car and beyond.What does that mean in practice? We make our customers’ lives easier by allowing them to pay for Mercedes-Benz goods and services across the entire customer lifecycle: from the purchase phase (initial financing/leasing rate, online reservation payments or down payments to full vehicle payments) through the usage phase (car-related services like fueling, charging or Digital Extras or the e-Vignette from the Mercedes-Benz Store) all the way to the retention phase (early contract settlement).ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay as a platform was launched in 2018 and is now live in 45+ markets across the globe, playing a central role in the digital business model of Mercedes‑Benz.We enable payments across all customer touchpoints, no matter where the customers are: via app, web, at the Point of Sale and even the car itself. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Stuttgart, Berlin and Singapore.Our solutions enable:- Digital Extras & subscriptions- Mobility services like fueling and charging- e-Commerce (ATC)- Online vehicle sales and full vehicle payment (in selected markets)- In-car payments- LoyaltyOUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than staying stuck because of unexpected roadblocks.In short: How we work is strongly based on our values of collaboration: Trust, innovation, responsibility, team spirit and belonging.Since we are still building new processes and products alongside our existing ones, everyone has the opportunity to shape our success – from day one!Are you ready to rethink how the world pays for mobility? Join us and help shape the future of payments!YOUR DAY AT GLANCE- You will collaborate in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment where your experience and hands-on attitude are valued- You will set up and maintain our AWS cloud infrastructure, align them with best-practice standards using infrastructure as code, and support the rollout of new payment products and services from an infrastructure perspective- You will support releases and ensure the reliable operation of CI/CD pipelines, including up-to-date compliance and security checks for our builds and deployments- You will further develop our data pipeline and integrate it with other systems- You will leverage Datadog features to monitor changes to our infrastructure- You will contribute to IT Operations activities during the rollout of products to new markets and use cases- You will collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions and contribute to AI-based IT Operations solutions at Mercedes pay- You will play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platformQualifikationenWHAT WE EXPECT- You have a strong passion for IT and bring an open-minded, highly motivated attitude- You have strong solution-oriented, problem-solving, and analytical skills- You are proficient in cloud service architecture best practices and have experience writing infrastructure as code- You are proficient in Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm, and have experience in software development (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and the Atlassian toolchain- You have successfully completed a relevant degree in Computer Science or have equivalent professional experience- You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation- You have knowledge of IT security best practices and common standards- You are fluent in business English and technical EnglishWHAT WE OFFER- Modern and dynamic work environment- Flexible and mobile working- Attractive fitness offer- Numerous employee discounts- Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). jobs.occupation: Internship within Commodity Management for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m) (Fachwirt/in - Einkauf/Bachelor Professional in Procurement)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the Commodity Procurement IT Infrastructure, Airbus Defence and Space is offering anInternship within Commodity Management for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Buyer/Commodity Manager for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us at Commodity Procurement IT Infrastructure as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: 01.04.2027- Duration: 6 monthsAs an intern (d/f/m) you will acquire an in-depth insight into divisional sourcing for IT Infrastructure for products and external customers.The internship covers three main learning areas: IT Demand Management and Standardisation, which involves learning how Airbus aggregates and standardises IT demands for complexity reduction and procurement efficiency; Supplier Evaluation and Development, focusing on the rigorous assessment and continuous improvement of the supplier base; and Strategic Supplier Landscape Development, where the intern contributes to the long-term evolution of the supplier base by analysing market trends, managing risk, and developing resilient sourcing strategies.By engaging in these activities, you will receive practical exposure to the full lifecycle of commodity management, from initial demand planning and strategic sourcing to ongoing supplier relationship management and development within a leading global aerospace and defence context.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Assisting in the identification and gathering of purchasing potentials.- Support and launch RFI (Request for Information) /RFP (Request for Proposal) events (via the Airbus Defence & Space procurement tool) and follow up the ordering process.- Preparation of negotiation results and supplier proposals.- Assisting in the creation of the respective commodity- and supplier strategies.- Special tasks. e.g. project tasks to support team leaders.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full time student (d/f/m) within Economics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering or similar field of study- Very good Google Workspace and MS Office knowledge- Discretion mandatory - strong focus on accuracy- Fluency in English is mandatory- German / French / Spanish would be a plusPlease upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and applyonline (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and devleopment opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Transform the everyday.In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers working closely with Siemens DI functions to identify, design, deliver, and operate impactful AI solutions. You will help stakeholders understand what is possible with AI, translate domain challenges into concrete impactful use cases, and guide solutions from early discovery through prototype, MVP, and production readiness.How you will make an Impact with us- Lead a team of Applied AI Engineers delivering impactful AI solutions for Siemens DI business functions.- Partner with domain/functions experts and business stakeholders to transform internal processes with AI.- Translate business pain points or business process into clear AI use cases, technical solution concepts, value KPIs, and delivery plans.- Guide AI solutions from consulting and PoV/prototype through MVP and production-ready operation.- Provide technical leadership on AI architecture, software engineering, evaluation, monitoring, and security.- Coach AI engineers in both technical excellence and stakeholder-facing consulting.- Build trust with senior stakeholders by explaining AI opportunities, limitations, risks, and value potential.- Ensure AI solutions are robust, secure, maintainable, compliant, and measurable.- Collaborate with DI IT, HUB, platform teams, cybersecurity, legal, worker-council stakeholders, product teams, and domain organizations.What you bring- 5+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering.- 2+ years of experience leading AI engineers/ Data Scientist, or complex cross-functional technical software initiatives.- Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and delivering AI/ML solutions cloud first, including evaluation, guardrails, and observability.- Strong software engineering foundation, including Python, APIs, data pipelines, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production operations in the cloud.- Ability to communicate effectively with both executives and AI engineers.- Strong business-value orientation and ability to define measurable business outcomes and drive the technical implantation to measure them after go live.- Experience in enterprise environments with security, compliance, data governance, and integration constraints.- High ownership, pragmatic judgment, and the ability to create clarity in ambiguous situations.- In this role, your focus will be on sales (configuration, pricing, quoting, sales ops & performance) related business functions and SHERPA related use cases.You are the right person if- You can walk into a domain conversation, understand the real process, and identify where AI could create value.- You are obsessed with creating real measurable impact with AI- You can inspire stakeholders with what is possible, helping them transform the way they work in their departments with AI, while staying grounded in feasibility, data, risk, and measurable impact.- You can guide your team in architecture and jobs.description: At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. deep understanding of biomarker applications across the drug development lifecycle. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. You will work in close alignment with an internal Expert who leads the Cyber Defense topic strategically, while owning the day-to-day execution independently. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, well-organized, and can operate with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment.What You'll Do:- Serve as the primary operational interface to our external managed SOC provider and as the primary escalation contact for internal teams during security incidents. Steer service delivery, manage and prioritize the operational backlog, plan sprints and deliverables in line with shifting priorities, define and refine detection use cases, manage escalation processes, and ensure SLA adherence across all regions.- Integrate and maintain the security toolbelt for SAP Cloud Infrastructure's logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities. Ensure timely triage, containment, and resolution of security events — executing against defined runbooks and operational processes, and continuously identifying improvements as the threat landscape and platform evolve.- Work with the SOC provider and internal teams to develop and refine threat detection rules, analyze threat intelligence, and adapt the detection strategy to the evolving threat landscape for cloud infrastructure.- Support vulnerability management processes for SAP Cloud Infrastructure, ensuring findings from scanning, penetration testing, and threat intelligence are tracked, prioritized, and remediated.- Maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting for Cyber Defense operations. Provide regular status updates to the Cyber Defense Expert and Security Engineering leadership. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational workflows and tooling, and drive actionable improvements.- Adapt Cyber Defense operations, tooling, and processes as SAP Cloud Infrastructure expands into new regions with specific regulatory requirements.- Collaborate across teams to transform security requirements into reliable and observable solutions.What You Bring:Technical Foundation- Several years of experience in security operations — SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, or vulnerability management — in a cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.- Hands-on experience managing security incidents, including triage, escalation, containment, and post-incident review in cloud or large-scale infrastructure environments.- Experience coordinating or managing an external managed SOC provider, including service steering, use-case development, and escalation management.- Working knowledge of logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR tooling in cloud environments.- Familiarity with OpenStack and/or Kubernetes from a security operations perspective.- Experience operating security for multi-region, 24x7 datacenter environments.- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to cloud infrastructure operations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5, BSI IT-Grundschutz, ANSSI SecNumCloud).- Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple regions and time zones, and manage operational complexity without close supervision.- Proficiency in scripting and coding for automation of security operations tasks.We don't expect you to have experience with every technology listed. If you have a strong foundation in several of these areas and are interested in learning the others, we'd be happy to hear from you.Core AI Skills- AI-assisted engineering is part of how we work at SAP.- Experience using AI tools for engineering tasks such as coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.- Ability to provide effective context and instructions and critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in production.- Experience using AI to support automation, infrastructure tooling, or prototyping.- Willingness to share useful AI practices and contribute to their responsible use within the team.Professional Skills- Comfortable collaborating across teams, cultures, and locations and sharing knowledge with others.- Able to communicate technical topics clearly, both verbally and in writing.- Structured and reliable, with the ability to take ownership while working collaboratively. Able to manage a shifting backlog, re-prioritize deliverables as context changes, and keep external teams aligned to current priorities.- Curious and pragmatic when approaching unfamiliar or complex problems.- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate escalation paths and establish the right contact persons in the face of a dynamically growing organizational environment.- Fluent English. German preferred. French appreciated.Tech You Bring- SIEM/SOAR platforms- Logging and monitoring tooling- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms- Kubernetes ecosystem- GitHub for configuration and issue management- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages- Cloud computing environments- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana- Threat intelligence platforms- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNowMeet the Team:You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.Why Tanso?• Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.• Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.• Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.• Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.• AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.• Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.Your roleTo build the engine that lets Customer Success scale, we are looking for a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager (f/m/x) .As a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager, you will shape how Customer Success works at Tanso, from operating model and data to tooling, automation and scaled customer formats. Working closely with our Head of CS, you take ideas from concept to hands-on execution and make every CSM more impactful: more customers served, more value delivered, targets hit.Key responsibilities• Strategy & Operations: You shape how Customer Success operates. Together with the Head of CS, you continuously sharpen our operating model (segmentation, lifecycle, playbooks) and OKR/goal process – and bring it to life, from concept to rollout. As the central link to Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Climate Intelligence, you make sure everything we build and do is aligned on customer value.• Tooling & Process Excellence: You keep the CS engine running and make it run smarter. You own and build our tech stack hands-on (HubSpot, Intercom, no-/low-code) and use automation and AI to free up CSMs to focus on what matters most: our customers.• Scaled Engagement & Enablement: You help CS scale. You build and run 1:n formats such as Tanso Academy, Tanso Update and our customer advisory board, and grow our customer community. With playbooks and templates, you enable CSMs to serve more customers without compromising on quality.• Projects & Strategic Initiatives: You turn ideas into impact. You will lead the integrated PLM360@GS program framework, bringing together solution design, migration, business and digital workstreams, S4E integration, templates, pilots and rollouts into one aligned and transparent program. Working across teams, you will turn complex dependencies, risks and priorities into clear actions, enabling reliable delivery of Siemens Energy’s strategic PLM platform. Every day, you will connect business and technology perspectives, create organizational alignment, and help drive part-centric, data-driven lifecycle management across engineering, manufacturing and service.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead the execution of the PLM360@GS strategy, coordinating solution design, migration, business and digital workstreams, S4E integration, templates, pilots and rollout activities while actively managing dependencies across the program landscape.* Own and maintain the integrated program plan, consolidating milestones, project management gates, releases, migration activities, critical paths and cross-program dependencies to ensure delivery transparency and readiness.* Facilitate alignment across stakeholders, priorities, resources and timelines, partnering with project managers, workstream leads, providers and governance bodies to resolve conflicts and drive informed decision-making.* Run program governance and reporting, preparing executive decision forums, managing risks and escalations, overseeing change control, and maintaining a single source of truth for program status, actions, decisions and responsibilities.* Oversee integration and migration assurance, collaborating with relevant teams to govern PLM-to-S4 interfaces, testing, releases, cutover, handover and operational readiness while ensuring successful rolloutWhat You Bring* Degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a comparable field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.* Proven experience managing complex end-to-end IT or digital programs with multiple workstreams, governance structures and diverse stakeholder groups.* Strong knowledge of product lifecycle management processes and enterprise PLM implementations, including hands-on experience with Teamcenter projects; experience integrating PLM environments with SAP or S/4 is a strong advantage.* Expertise in integrated planning, dependency management, risk and issue management, change control, governance and executive-level reporting, with the ability to translate complexity into clear decisions and accountability.* Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills in an international, cross-functional environment. You have fluent English skills, and German language skills are an advantage.About the TeamOur Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. About the roleWe're looking for a Principal C++ Engineer to own the factory simulation of our next game. The game is built in Unreal Engine 5 , but the simulation will be self-contained and written in raw C++.Players will place hundreds of thousands of machines, belts, pipes, and more across a large world, and every one of them has to deterministically update on every player's device in a co-op session.You'll design that simulation module from the ground up as one of the first engineers on a new game team , working closely with the Engineering Team Lead and the Game Design department.Your responsibilities• Design and build a deterministic factory simulation that scales to hundreds of thousands of player-placed buildings• Own the sim architecture: data layout, tick model, threading, and serialisation format• Work with the Networking Engineer so the sim and co-op are designed together, not bolted on later• Set and meet the CPU performance budget for the sim on our minimum specification target• Review code and mentor other engineers on C++ and architectureAbout youYou will likely have:• Experience in professional C++ environments where you have architected, implemented, and maintained performant modules which are built on by other engineers, and lived with the consequences of your design choices• Deep knowledge of data-oriented design, multithreading, and performance, including CPU profiling and applying algorithmic complexity-based analysis to select the right data structures• Built a deterministic or lockstep system, or can show how you'd approach one• A track record of mentoring engineers and making architectural decisions in writing that others could follow and challengeIn addition, you may have:• 2+ shipped game titles• Worked on a factory, automation or simulation-heavy game• Worked in Unreal Engine, especially with Mass Entity or a custom ECS in UnrealIf you match most of this and the problem excites you, please apply.What we offer• Fully Remote: We employ directly inside Germany• Flexible working hours!• Paid overtime, on the rare occasions it happens• A hardware budget to ensure you have the ergonomic setup and hardware you need to work comfortably• A monthly personal growth allowance for courses, books or other learning material• Focus days to research or learn new skills• A yearly team gathering to meet and collaborate in person• A yearly salary review to keep your pay in line with the market, and an automatic increase of 2% per yearNext Steps & How to ApplyPlease apply via our recruitment agency 8bit via https://8bitplay.com/jobs/principal-c-engineer/• A one-hour technical conversation with the Engineering Team Lead about work you have done• A one-hour meeting with our HR and either our Founder/CEO or our Studio Producer, depending on availability, to assess shared values, how we will work together, and culture add• A second technical round in a format we pick together, based on what we need to assess for the specific role, taking no more than 2-3 hours of your time in total• A casual, unscored conversation with a group of people you'll be working with closely to learn more about us and for the team to learn more about you• An offer callWe give you a decision within a few working days of each stage, and we aim for the whole process from the first interview to an offer to take four weeks or less.For this role:• The first technical conversation covers systems you've built and how you would build ours• For the second technical round, we decide together on either:• A whiteboarding session where we collaborate to design the broad strokes of the simulation• A take-home code review (you should not need more than two hours), with your feedback then presented in real timeWe are happy to discuss any requested accommodation to the above process.About usWe are a small indie studio that makes factory and automation games. We started with web games and found our success on PC. Our current 17 staff come from 5 continents, with a diverse range of experiences and backgrounds. We value direct communication and ownership over bureaucracy. We design for our players, in close collaboration with our community.We work completely remote and in English; professional working proficiency is enough. We have critical meetings and collaborate with other staff during CET core working hours (approx. 11:00-15:00).We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, genders, ages, abilities and identities, and we evaluate everyone on the same criteria.

We are looking for someone who can review our current setup objectively and identify practical, sustainable improvements.Because you will collaborate across the business, clear communication is essential. their daily workKey Responsibilities- Collaborate across teams: Work closely with a multi-disciplinary team (Engineering, Administration, and Product) to align the Salesforce platform with our business goals.- Bridge business and technical needs: Participate in discovery sessions to gather and validate requirements, translating them into scalable solutions that prioritize a clean user experience.- Configure and build: Perform declarative Salesforce configuration using best practices, including Flow, permission sets, dynamic layouts, approval processes, and custom reporting.- Manage the day-to-day: Handle core system administration, including user management, resolving support tickets, and facilitating user training.- Ensure data integrity: Monitor and improve data quality using validation rules and automation, and perform mass data updates using ETL tools (e.g., Salesforce Data Loader, G-Connector).- Oversee deployments and environments: Manage our sandbox environments and support the wider team with release deployments.- Support third-party tools: Maintain and troubleshoot business application integrations, such as Slack, Outreach, and Clay.- Document our systems: Create and maintain clear technical documentation to ensure our platform architecture remains transparent and accessible to the team.Required Skills and Experience- Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator, ideally within a complex stakeholder environment.- Core Certifications: You hold the baseline Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.- Solution Design: Experience of creating best-practice declarative solutions, particularly Flows, Lightning Apps, Validation Rules, and Approval Processes.- Stakeholder Collaboration: Experience working directly with diverse stakeholder groups. You know how to build trust, ask the right questions, and manage expectations.- Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. You are comfortable translating technical requirements clearly for non-technical colleagues.Preferred Skills and Experience- Advanced Certifications: Additional certifications, such as Certified Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder are a strong plus.- Code Familiarity: Any experience with Apex and/or related languages would be a positive.- Integrations: Experience of using/managing integrations with third party apps such as Hubspot, Outreach, Clay, and Demodesk would be highly desirable.Don’t fit all of our criteria? If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! jobs.occupation: Experienced Red Teamer / Pentester - Cybersecurity Audit (m/f/d) - DISW (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Start your cyber career with us!As part of the global Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing Board and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management, we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact that drives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures a variety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world.Our Cybersecurity team provides core assurance over the cybersecurity health of the company which includes IT infrastructures, product security, software development and cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of them?To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf) .What part will you play?- As valuable member of the assurance team you will be responsible for conducting and driving Cybersecurity assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems, and software development centers. During this process you will plan and perform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations to translate technical findings into management information so that they can take effective actions. - Apply advanced hacking principles and red team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurity experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern challenges.- You independently conduct research on latest developments in cybersecurity technologies and threats and understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree) in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as GIAC GPEN, OSCP, OSWE, CRTO, CREST, etc. are a plus. - Good scripting and programming skills and experience with languages such as Bash, Python, Powershell, and C++ / C#.- At least 5+ years of professional full-time working experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing / red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously challenging environment.- You have solid experience with one or more of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated experience in capture the flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a plus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a diverse teamWhile commitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretch beyond our comfort zone. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. jobs.description: **Accelerate your career.**Our mission at Finance Assurance (FIN A) is to provide objective, factual and independent foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of the company. As a business partner to Siemens’ management, we apply our expertise in a wide range of topics to create organizational impact. Collaborative ecosystems help create and use innovative methods for better assurance. We offer an inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop professionally and personally. Our core values, being respectful, curious, humble and open, define how we work together as a department.As Siemens is creating technology to transform the everyday for everyone, the Technology & Financial Audit Practice plays a pivotal role in providing assurance to the Managing Board and the Audit Committee. We cover a wide range of technology and finance-related global audit topics such as assurance over entire digital ecosystems, AI and data governance, SW development, major IT transformations, customer project execution, organizational maturity at small / mid-size entities, sustainability reporting or new digital products and business models.To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, FIN A offers a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe int the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, training and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world. This is your chance to build your network within the company and become part of a truly international and innovative team.To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is your place to thrive, challenge the status quo, make a difference and grow in a team of pioneers who share your passion for technology.Discover more about FIN A: Siemens Finance Assurance (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)You’ll make an impact by:- Identify and assess key risks across Siemens Financial Services / Siemens Bank, including digital environments, IT transformation programs, and evolving business models.- Lead end-to-end audit engagements (e.g., regulatory annual audits and project-accompanying audits) across various IT topics.- Design and execute risk-based audit programs and control assessments to address identified exposures.- Drive audit planning, scoping, and budgeting, supported by targeted analyses to identify key organizational risks.- Independently drive assurance objectives, aligning conclusions and actionable recommendations to enable measurable organizational improvements.- Lead stakeholder engagement with auditees and senior management to co-ordinate audit planning, present findings, secure alignment, and drive implementation of recommendations.- Build and maintain a strong internal network across Siemens businesses and functions to strengthen audit impact and collaboration.- Challenge and enhance audit methodologies, leveraging AI, automation, and data analytics to increase audit effectiveness and efficiency.- Promote and develop digital audit use cases in partnership with data analytics teams to expand coverage and deepen assurance insights.- Collaborate effectively with external auditors to ensure coordinated, efficient, and high-quality audit execution- Execute audits in accordance with FIN A’s Agile Audit Framework.This is how you'll win us over:- Education & Experience:- Proven track record of career development including  7+ years  of professional experience in a financial services or IT function within Siemens, an IT organization of a regulated financial institution or alternatively in a financial services practice of a ‘Big 4’ / leading consulting firm. - Strong academic history with a degree ideally in Banking, IT, Business or Engineering.- Expertise & Skills: - Comprehensive IT risk expertise, including general IT controls audits and IT governance across diverse IT infrastructures such as Cloud environments,  ERP systems, operating systems, databases, networks and security tools. Experienced knowledge in auditing AI is advantageous.- Detailed knowledge of process-oriented audit approaches in accordance with current standards (e.g. IDW, DIIR) as well as relevant frameworks (CobiT, ITIL) and regulatory requirements (MaRisk, BaFin, BaIT, DORA, EBA and MAS).- Strong desire and drive to develop into a business or functional role after 3-5 years in audit.- Understanding of IT risk management and assurance principles, along with basic logic programming is beneficial. - Excellent communication skills to summarize and describe audit results.- Professional certification e.g. CISA, CISSP, or in COBIT, ITIL is an advantage.- Languages: Fluency in English, German is a plus. - Additional: Flexibility to travel (up to 20%, incl. international travel) and embracing our hybrid working model is essential.As part of our team, you will have: - A hybrid working model comprising 2 to 3 days of working from the office per week. - Attractive remuneration package and relocation support (if needed).- FIN A Grow & Development program for both professional and personal growth.- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for you and your family.- Access to employee share plans.Since each of over 300,000 employees feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) . The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About us.Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.com/careers (https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens. FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/jobs/faq.html) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.description: The Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics (WIAS) is an institute of the Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (FVB). The FVB comprises seven non-university research institutes in Berlin which are funded by the federal and state governments. The research institutes belong to the Leibniz Association.WIAS invites applications for aResearch Assistant Position (f/m/d)(Ref. 26/22)in the Research Group “Nonsmooth Variational Problems and Operator Equations”(Head: Prof. Dr. Michael Hintermüller),starting on January 1, 2027.Field of work:The successful candidate will work in the MATH+ project "DOC-TWIN: Duality-Based Error Control for Optimal Control Problems in Digital-Twin-Based Structural Health Monitoring". The project aims at developing a convex-duality-based framework for reliable error control in PDE-constrained optimal control problems motivated by digital-twin-based structural health monitoring.The Tasks include:- Developing and analyzing duality-based a posteriori error identities for PDE-constrained optimal control problems;- Deriving corresponding discrete a priori error identities and using them for convergence-rate analysis and certified nonlinear solver control;- Designing, implementing, and numerically validating finite element methods, including adaptive mesh-refinement strategies and suitable post-processing techniques;- Preparing scientific publications and presenting the results at workshops and conferences.**We are looking for: **Applicants with:- A very good university degree in mathematics, computational science, engineering, or a closely related field;- A strong interest in numerical analysis, optimization, partial differential equations, or scientific computing;- A willingness to work on both the mathematical analysis and the implementation of numerical methods for PDE-constrained optimization problems;- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment;- Good written and spoken English skills.Desirable Qualifications:Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage but not a requirement:- Finite element methods, adaptive methods, or a posteriori error estimation;- Convex analysis, nonsmooth optimization, or optimal control;- PDE-constrained optimization or inverse problems;- Numerical methods for elasticity, structural mechanics, or related models;- Implementation of numerical methods in Python, MATLAB, Julia, C/C++, or finite element software.What we offer:- The opportunity to work at WIAS Berlin, a leading research institution with strengths in partial differential equations, mathematical modeling, nonlinear optimization, and applied mathematics in general;- The option of mobile working;- A certified family-friendly work environment (Audit berufundfamilie);- The opportunity to live and work in Berlin, one of the world's most culturally rich and diverse international cities. Berlin offers a wide range of opportunities to enjoy life outside work while remaining relatively affordable compared with other major cities. Neither the position nor living in Berlin requires knowledge of German, although WIAS offers free German courses. We particularly welcome international applicants. Berlin also offers a rich scientific landscape, with numerous research opportunities and career prospects in both academia and industry;- Close mentorship from the supervisor and other peers through a dedicated mentorship program.Please direct scientific queries to Prof Dr. Michael Hintermüller (michael.hintermueller@wias-berlin.de).The appointment is limited to two years. The position is full-time (39 hours per week), with a salary based on pay grade E 13 of the German TVöD Bund pay scale.WIAS is committed to fostering diversity and equal opportunities and particularly encourages women to apply. Applicants with disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal qualification. If you have any questions or want to provide us with information related to diversity, inclusion or disabilities, please feel free to consult our website orcontact our Diversity Officer, Sara Krummenacher (sara.krummenacher@wias-berlin.de).How to apply:Please upload your complete application documents (motivation letter, detailed CV, certificates, copy of the master thesis, etc.) via our applicant portal using the button “Apply online”.The application period opens immediately and remains open until the position is filled.We are looking forward to your application!
