jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionIn everything we do and in everything we say, we strive for the best possible ways to help our business serve our patients.By putting our colleagues in Drug Development Departments for chemical and biological entities (CMC) at the center of our actions, we jointly identify, develop, and implement innovations that enable faster and better decisions across the overall Boehringer Ingelheim pipeline. With the rapid advent of generative AI, LLMs, and agentic technologies, we have the opportunity to accelerate this dramatically and fundamentally change the way we work. Only very few IT roles offer such a direct connection to Boehringer Ingelheim's scientific value chain.As our Senior System Engineer for Agentic AI / LLM solutions, you will help shape the transformation of CMC into the era of generative and agentic AI. You will work hands-on with and for our business to develop solutions ranging from simple agents to designing and building complex solutions from scratch, while also driving implementation and upskilling initiatives that accelerate the adoption of these technologies across CMC.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you will design, develop, deploy, operate, and continuously enhance highly complex and globally distributed GenAI agents, multi-agent systems, workflow automations, and data integrations- You will develop production-ready solutions based on modern software engineering, DevOps, and AI-assisted development practices- Working closely with business stakeholders, you will identify, prioritize, develop, and deliver AI-based use cases that drive measurable business value while adhering to security, privacy, and Responsible AI standards- You will explore and evaluate the latest GenAI, LLM, and agentic technologies, turning innovative ideas into scalable solutions that accelerate business value and enhance future readiness- You will shape the foundation for scalable AI innovation by defining governance frameworks, operating models, and architectural standards that drive the successful development and continuous improvement of GenAI, LLM, and agent-based solutions.- Act as a trusted advisor and AI ambassador—driving adoption through community building, stakeholder engagement, onboarding initiatives, and targeted upskilling programs across our business and IT partners﻿Requirements- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related field, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in AI, software engineering, digital innovation, or related disciplines.- Hands-on experience designing and implementing LLM-based agents, multi-agent systems, workflow automations, and data integrations (e.g., using Python, modern API frameworks, orchestration frameworks, or MCP/tool-calling patterns).- Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining software solutions in enterprise environments using modern software engineering, containerization, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development practices.- Proven experience establishing scalable architectural standards, LLMOps practices, and governance structures for GenAI, LLM, and agent-based solutions.- Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into practical technology-based solutions, applying structured problem-solving approaches and integrating relevant data sources.- Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor colleagues, and foster the adoption of best practices in AI solution development.- Nice-to-have: Good understanding of pharmaceutical development and CMC processes (e.g., process/analytical development, formulation, or manufacturing science) and GxP-regulated environments.- Strong communication, consulting, and collaboration skills, combined with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset and the ability to rapidly turn ideas into practical solutions.- Excellent written and spoken English skills.Start date: asapAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 13th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to October 30th, 2026, are guaranteed to be considered.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from beginning till mid of NovemberStep 3: On-site interviews beginning mid of NovemberPlease submit your application documents in English.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com

Purpose of your JobOur Science and Technology team is looking for a Modelling Scientist to advance data-driven drug development through cutting-edge computational approaches.In this role, you will apply mechanistic models, machine learning, and molecular simulations to predict the stability and behaviour of biopharmaceutical products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate modelling into experimental workflows and support innovative, model-informed development strategies.Are you passionate about scientific modelling and pharmaceutical innovation?Join us and shape the future of computational drug development—apply today!Your Responsibility- Act as a scientific contributor in cross-functional research and development projects, supporting the integration of advanced modelling approaches into biopharmaceutical development.- Develop, validate, and apply advanced computational models to simulate the physical and chemicals stability, as well as the behaviour, of biopharmaceutical drug products.- Integrate experimental and structural data into predictive modelling frameworks.- Utilize a range of modelling techniques, including mechanistic models, machine learning approaches, and molecular simulations, to generate actionable scientific insights.- Contribute to the development of internal modelling platforms, tools, and workflows to enhance scalability and reproducibility.- Design and execute simulation studies to investigate formulations parameters, degradation pathways, and process related risks.- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including formulation scientists, analytical experts, and business developers to align modelling strategies with project objectives.- Analyse and interpret complex data to generate actionable insights.- Translate and present complex modelling outcomes into clear, impactful recommendations for internal stakeholders and project teams.- Ensure model quality through rigorous validation procedures and documentation, following internal standards and regulatory expectations where applicable.- Drive continuous innovation by exploring and implementing state-of-the-art computational approaches relevant to pharmaceutical formulation science.- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of developments in computational modelling, data science, and biopharmaceutical development to ensure the scientific relevance and competitiveness of modelling approaches.- Contribute to scientific excellence by co-authoring peer-reviewed publications.- Support regulatory submissions by providing modelling data and documentation as needed.What you need to succeed- Master’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field (PhD preferred)- Formal training or academic coursework in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, bioinformatics, or molecular dynamics is advantageous.- 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical research and computational modelling, ideally with exposure to protein- and nucleic acid-based therapeutics.- Strong programming and data analysis skills, with proficiency in tools such as Python, MATLAB, or R, and familiarity with modelling and simulation libraries.- Expertise in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, molecular modelling, or molecular dynamics simulations.- Solid understanding of biopharmaceutical products, including structure-function relationships, degradation mechanisms, and formulation challenges.- Experience in integrating computational models into experimental workflows and interdisciplinary project settings.- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of scientific contributions such as peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations.- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex modelling results into clear insights for diverse audiences.- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.- Collaborative and team-oriented mindset with a proactive and open approach to interdisciplinary work.- A passion for scientific innovation, curiosity, and a commitment to staying at the forefront of computational and pharmaceutical science.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Modellbildung, Simulation (IT)Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Data Fabric, Molekularbiologie, Modellierungs- und Simulationssprache SystemC, Arzneimittelinformation, Galenik, Angewandte Informatik, KI-Detektoren, MathematikExpertenkenntnisse: Data Engineering, Quantitative Forschungsmethode, Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Programmiersprache R, Bioinformatik, Angewandte Mathematik, Biomathematik, Datenvisualisierung, Data Science, Machine LearningZwingend erforderlich: Forschung, Arzneimittelentwicklung, Pharmazeutische Technologie, Programmiersprache Python, Analysis

Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.Key purpose  - Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.Structure and reporting relationship The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  Internal Communications- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  External Communications- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.Integration Communications- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.Social Media & Content Creation- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.Stakeholder Engagement- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.Additional / special features of the role - Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration EuropeDesirable- Must: German native or fully proficient- Must: English level B2- Desirable: French- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

execution, particularly with Transformation & Customer Success, Product Management, Rollout and other teams, ensuring alignment from strategic intent through adoption and value realizationWhat You realities of a global Procurement organization* Experience in digital strategy, business transformation, strategy consulting, product management, Customer Success or comparable strategic initiatives, jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position in Preclinical Development of Bicyclic Peptides for Nuclear Medicine (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network. Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.Together with selected university partner sites, the DKFZ has established the German Cancer Consortium (DKTK) (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) . The alliance between the DKFZ as the core center and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen operates joint translation centers at the University Medical Centers of each of the selected partner sites. The DKTK contributes significantly to filling the translational gap between basic and clinical cancer research, thereby developing new strategies for personalized oncology in prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer. DKTK conducts transformative translational cancer research, educates the next generation of translation-oriented medical and clinical scientists and establishes strong pipelines towards clinical cancer research and the economy.At the DKTK partner site Freiburg, we are offering, starting at the earliest date possible, a Postdoc Position in Preclinical Development of Bicyclic Peptides for Nuclear Medicine.The Division of Radiopharmaceutical Development at DKTK Freiburg focuses on the development and clinical translation of novel radiopharmaceuticals for molecular imaging and targeted radionuclide therapy. A key emphasis is on radiotheranostics, from the identification of new targets and tumor-targeting compounds to preclinical evaluation and first-in-human translation.The position is located at the University Medical Center Freiburg, Department of Nuclear Medicine (www.uniklinik-freiburg.de/nuklearmedizin/radiopharmakaentwicklung).Your TasksThe position is part of a long-term collaboration with the company Bicycle Therapeutics (https://www.bicycletherapeutics.com/)  and covers the preclinical characterization of novel bicyclic peptides for clinical translation. This established and successful research platform includes the identification and evaluation of novel radiopharmaceuticals for positron emission tomography (PET) and radionuclide therapy. The relationship between DKFZ and Bicycle Therapeutics has expanded to include a more continuous and purpose-driven commitment towards advancing candidates towards the clinic. The current project aims at the preclinical development and clinical translation of novel radiolabeled, tumor-targeting bicyclic peptide conjugates for diagnostic and therapeutic application in nuclear medicine. The bicyclic peptide conjugates are synthesized by solid phase synthesis and modified by bioconjugation chemistry. Finally, the conjugates are labeled with several clinically relevant radioisotopes for in vitro and in vivo evaluation. Your task is to elaborate the scientific data within this work plan and to communicate the results with our collaboration partner. Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)München, HybridFull-timePermanent employeeRoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.Responsibilities- Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.- Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.- Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.- Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.- Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.- Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.- Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.- Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.- Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.- Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the foundersRequirementsMust Have- 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company- You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them- Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers- Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on- Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry- Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking- Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe- Fluent English (German is a very big plus)- Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sitesNice to Have- An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators- Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics- Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting oneÜber unsWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- **Compensation. **We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: CRM-Systeme

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day This position involves the technical and disciplinary leadership of a team of IT/OT technicians, the coordination of IT/OT projects, and the responsibility for maintaining and further developing the local IT/OT infrastructure.The Local IT Team Lead works closely with other departments to ensure the seamless and high quality delivery of IT/OT services. In addition, he or she, together with the team, is integrated into global support and project structures and provides support for international initiatives as required.How You’ll Make an Impact * Leadership, guidance, and performance management of the local IT/OT team, including mentoring and feedback* Coordination and prioritization of local and global IT/OT support requests, including first‑ and second‑line technical support* Setup, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of local and global IT/OT infrastructure (servers, networks, security systems, and end‑user devices)* Planning, leadership, and execution of local and international IT/OT projects and strategic initiatives* Cross‑functional collaboration with internal departments and the global IT organization to ensure stable operation of the global DT environment and remote site support* Compliance assurance with IT/OT policies and best practices, including documentation, ticket tracking, continuous process improvement, and evaluation of emerging technologiesWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline* Proven experience in IT/OT support or a comparable role, with leadership experience as an advantage* Strong knowledge of IT/OT systems, hardware, software, networking, and troubleshooting methodologies* Familiarity with IT service management frameworks (e.g. ITIL), relevant certifications (e.g. CompTIA A+, Network+), and SAP knowledge as a plus* Proficiency in the local language and English; additional language skills as an advantage* Strong personal attributes, including problem‑solving capability, communication skills, attention to detail, customer orientation, adaptability, a hands‑on mindset, and commitment to continuous learning About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.Your Tasks- Organization and coordination of day-to-day laboratory operations, including inventory management, procurement, equipment maintenance, shipping, and logistics- Coordination of occupational safety, biosafety, and laboratory safety procedures, including support with regulatory documentation and internal inspections- Organization and quality control of shared consumables, reagents, and laboratory spaces- Experimental and administrative management of the organoid biobank and bacterial strain collection- Performance and coordination of key laboratory assays, particularly genotyping and mycoplasma testing- Onboarding, practical instruction, and supervision of students and new group members- Communication and coordination with suppliers, service providers, internal DKFZ units, and external collaboration partnersYour Profile- Completed vocational training as a laboratory technician or an equivalent qualification- Very good practical knowledge of biological and/or molecular biology laboratory work and laboratory organization- Ideally, experience with inventory management, procurement, equipment coordination, and laboratory documentation- Knowledge of occupational safety, biosafety, and relevant documentation requirements is an advantage- Independent, structured, and reliable working style with strong organizational skills- Very good communication and coordination skills when working with scientists, students, internal service units, and external partners- Motivation to work in a diverse role combining hands-on laboratory work with administrative and organizational responsibilities- Very good written and spoken English and GermanWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Dr. Jens PuschhofPhone: +49 6221 42 4953​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.Application Deadline: November 4, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. imaging and molecular phenotyping- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscienceA particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.This may include:- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models- management of genetically modified mouse colonies- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfareYour profile:We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular BiologyYou should have:- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline- substantial hands-on experience in independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments- excellent scientific communication skills in English- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working styleParticularly well as mouse breeding and colony management- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniquesWe offer you:- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.- We offer At the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law, scholars pursue research relating to fundamental issues and current developments in the areas of public international law, European Union law, and the constitutional and administrative law of individual states, together with numerous visiting scholars from all over the world. In its fields, our library is the largest in Europe and one of the most comprehensive in the world.The newly established Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER), headed by Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg, invites applications for twoResearch Fellow positions (Doctoral Researchers) (x/f/m)with a preferred starting date of 1 January 2027 (the positions are funded for three years)The Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER) investigates how global order is transformed as states - particularly great and middle powers - pursue competing visions of the principles, rules and institutions that structure international relations amid intensifying geopolitical rivalry. The group conceptualizes these processes as constellations of global (dis)ordering through which states seek to advance their visions of order by creating, reshaping, connecting, bypassing, or disengaging from international institutions, building new formal or ad hoc institutional arrangements, and strategically leveraging economic and technological interdependence. DISORDER examines how such constellations emerge across the fields of security, economy, and technology, and what forms of global order they produce, transform, or erode.Job descriptionThe successful candidates will develop independent doctoral dissertation projects within the framework of the Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER). Their research should contribute to the group’s broader inquiry into how states pursue competing visions of global order through international institutions and how these processes reshape global order across different issue areas.Possible orientations of the doctoral projects include:- an actor-centred perspective, examining how a particular great or middle power pursues its vision of global order across different issue areas institutional settings; or- a domain-centred perspective, comparing how different states interact with and reshape international institutions within a particular field, such as security, economy, or technology.Potential empirical cases may include, but are not limited to, the United States, China, Russia, India, Brazil, Japan, and other international actors such as the European Union.The doctoral researchers will:- develop and conduct an original PhD project that contributes to the conceptual and empirical agenda of the DISORDER research group;- conduct empirical research using qualitative methods such as process tracing, qualitative content and discourse analysis, and semi-structured interviews;- contribute to the comparative and collaborative research activities of the group;- participate in research group meetings, workshops, conferences, and other academic activities;- present research findings at international conferences and prepare publications for peer-reviewed academic outlets;- contribute to the organization of workshops, conferences, and other activities of the research group and the MPIL.Your profile- An excellent Master’s degree or equivalent in Political Science, with a specialization in International Relations or Foreign Policy Analysis- A strong research interest in global order, international institutions, and great- and middle-power politics, including their foreign policies- A substantive interest in one or more of the group’s empirical issue areas (security, economy, and technology)- A strong interest in qualitative research and familiarity with relevant research methods- Excellent written and spoken English- Additional language skills and country- or region-specific expertise relevant to the proposed doctoral project are considered assets- The ability to conduct independent research while contributing actively to a collaborative research environmentWe offer- An attractive and international work environment with an unparalleled research infrastructure and a good working atmosphere- A varied, responsible and team-orientated job- Remuneration in accordance with the guidelines of the MPG funding agreements (65 per cent of EG13, TVöD-Bund)- Access to our world-leading library and a multitude of databases- A workplace that is easy to reach by public transport and free employee parking spaces- A job ticket for public transport- Offers for work-life balance and four affiliated daycare centresApplicationThe Max Planck Society has set itself the goal of employing more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society aims to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore strongly encouraged to apply.Interested candidates are invited to submit their complete application exclusively via the online application system (https://jobs.mpil.de/3vrp7) available on our website by 22 November 2026.Applications should include a CV, a cover letter of no more than two pages, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts of records, a one-page summary of the applicant’s Master’s thesis, a five-page PhD project proposal that clearly relates to the research agenda of the DISORDER group and indicates which of the thematic orientations outlined above the proposed project primarily addresses, and two letters of recommendationThe documents will be deleted after the application process. The interviews will take place in late November/early December in person at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg. Application expenses cannot be covered.For questions regarding the positions, please contact Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at friedrichs@mpil.de (https://mailto:friedrichs@mpil.de) .

We, the Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, are one of 85 institutes and research centers of the Max Planck Society (MPG) for the advancement of science. Our focus is on basic medical research. We currently employ around 270 people in science and administration, mainly at our location in Heidelberg. Another location for our institute is currently being established in Heilbronn. We are also part of the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim, an association of the region's leading life science research institutions.The MPG strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. As the MPG has set itself the goal of employing more people with severe disabilities, applications from people with severe disabilities are expressly welcome. In addition, the MPG wants to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore expressly encouraged to apply.The female reproductive tract is a highly dynamic system in which tissue mechanics, active forces, and fluid flow interact with cellular and physiological processes. Yet, how these physical properties contribute to reproductive function remains poorly understood.Within the ERC Starting Grant project REPROMECH – Quantitative Mechanics of the Oviduct: Force, Flow, and the Physiological Operating Point, our group investigates how forces and mechanical properties shape the function of the female reproductive system. We combine approaches from reproductive biology, mechanobiology, and experimental biophysics to quantitatively characterize living tissues across cellular and tissue scales.The doctoral project will investigate the mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract and their relationship to tissue function.Tasks- Quantification of mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract using complementary mechanical measurements and advanced microscopy- Preparation and culture of ex vivo tissue samples- Histological characterization of biological samples- Quantitative image and data analysis- Critical analysis and interpretation of experimental resultsProfile- You hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in reproductive biology, developmental biology, biology, biophysics, physics, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, or a related discipline.- We are looking for a candidate with strong experimental aptitude, excellent practical laboratory skills, manual dexterity, and a quantitative and analytical mindset.- You should enjoy technically demanding experimental work, be able to interpret complex data critically and rigorously, and be motivated to work across disciplinary boundaries.- Willingness to work with laboratory mice and to complete the required laboratory-animal training is essential.- Previous experience in reproductive biology, experimental biophysics, microscopy, or work with laboratory animals is advantageous but not required. Candidates with a background in reproductive biology and an interest in quantitative and biophysical approaches are particularly encouraged to apply.- Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English are required.Our offerThe position is funded for an initial period of three years within the ERC Starting Grant REPROMECH, with the possibility of extension, and is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible.We offer a vibrant international research environment, access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for quantitative microscopy and mechanobiology, and opportunities for scientific training and conference participation.Remuneration: 75% of pay group E13 under TVöD Bund.We look forward to receiving your application, including a cover letter, curriculum vitae, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts, and contact details of two academic referees. Applications must be submitted electronically via the application portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/5572b068e91236d723de14e45b3737686f35fab70/apply) by 1 November 2026.For further information, please contact Dr. Stephanie Möllmert (stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de) ).For general questions, please contact Ms. Julia Gauglitz (julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de) ) from human resources.

jobs.description: About us Global protein consumption is skyrocketing—especially meat.And that’s creating massive challenges for health, climate, andanimal welfare. At Project Eaden, we’re tackling this head-on withour patented fiber spinning technology: plant-based meat withauthentic texture and taste. Our LEKKA products are already inmillions of homes across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Yourmission If you're a mechanical engineer and want to apply your skillsto food production technology, this is your chance to developinnovative mechanical systems for plant-based meat manufacturing, thisis your chance to take the next step and take operationalresponsibility. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing,purpose-driven startup. Key responsibilities Machinery Installation &Commissioning: Support installation of new food processing equipment,perform commissioning and validation procedures, and conductfunctional testing to ensure proper operation before production use.Continuous Modification & Improvement: Analyze existing processes andequipment performance, identify improvements, and design modificationsto increase efficiency, reliability, and food safety compliance.Implement optimizations in the production environment. EquipmentRepair & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical,integrated and pneumatic equipment failures. Troubleshoot complexissues in mixers, conveyors, industrial machines, and automationequipment. Implement timely repairs to minimize production downtime.Mechanical Design & Process Optimization: Build and test mechanicalprototypes and operational processes, validate design performancethrough testing and prototyping, iterate designs based on productionfeedback and food safety requirements. Cross-functional Collaboration:Work closely with production, R&D and quality teams to optimizeequipment performance and resolve complex production challenges.Communicate equipment status and maintenance needs to productionplanning and leadership. Technical documentation: Develop and maintaincomprehensive technical documentation including S.O.P.s, schematics,mechanical drawings, process diagrams, and system specifications.Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage relationships with externalvendors, contractors, and service providers. Coordinate procurementactivities, oversee contractor performance, and ensure projectdeliverables meet specifications. Your profile In this role, you'll beresponsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developingmechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, andsupporting the mechanical engineering needs of our productionoperations. As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work oneverything from equipment design to production support. RequirementsProfessional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineeringexperience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably withexposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automatedsystems. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in MechanicalEngineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, orrelated technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance,reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge offood industry applications preferred. Technical Skills: Knowledge ofmanufacturing processes and production optimization techniques,familiarity with lean manufacturing principles. Strong troubleshootingabilities with hands-on experience developing mechanical solutions anddiagnosing and repairing mechanical equipment failures. Proficiencywith CAD software, process modeling tools, and manufacturing softwaresystems. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solvingabilities with experience in root cause analysis and processtroubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and developlonglasting cost effective engineering solutions. Operational Agility:A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adaptquickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. LanguageProficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional levelin the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.Why us? Why you should apply now Scaling Big: We’re at an excitinginflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scalingoperations. Be part of something transformative and build it from theground up. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs andangels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time isNow: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creatingirresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch awayfrom animal-based meat, fast! A word on Diversity, Equity & InclusionWe embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared valuesand alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. Wewelcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age,color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation,gender identity, or marital status. Workspace and culture We’rebuilding something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Ourteam thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power offace-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively.Currently, we spend most of our time together at our workplace inBerlin to nurture our team spirit and culture. As we grow over thenext few years, we aim to evolve into a more distributed workplace,blending the flexibility of remote work with the strength of ourshared values and connection.

jobs.occupation: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.What we offer you:- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by:- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.Your defining qualities:- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.Your tasks:- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.Essential experience/ qualifications:- Above the average motivation and work ethics- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology- English writing and speaking skills- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalentadditional advantages:- Experience in omics data science- Hands-on experience in human immunologyWe offer:- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors- High end translational research- State-of-the-art laboratories- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )- Comprehensive health promotion offers- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)- Family-friendly enviromentFurther information:Prof. Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerMedizinische Klinik 5Phone: 09131 - 85 43107Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenMedizinische Klinik 5 -Hämatologie & Internistische OnkologiePD Dr. med. habil. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.What you bringLeadership & Governance- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.Mechanical & Mechatronic Components- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.Methodological Expertise- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:- Process FMEA- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)- 8D Problem Solving- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis- 5 Why Analysis- Pareto Analysis- Process Audits- Corrective Action Management- Lessons Learned Processes- Control Plans- KPI and Performance Reviews- Structured Escalation ProcessesCommunication & Collaboration- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plusYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.About usSiemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Under the keyword "Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)", satellites are being consistently integrated into the mobile communications standard for the first time, subsequently paving the way for a global and dense communication network in the future 6G generation.Due to the inherent conditions of wireless communication – and particularly with the deployment of open standards and vast coverage areas – the threat posed by jammers and spoofers is ubiquitous. At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company.
