This will include the running of, and reporting to, a working committee.- Financial reporting.  Responsible for ensuring timely quarterly financial reporting including an understanding of any variance from plan and agreed actions to remediate that situation.- Programme monitoring, evaluation and learning. Working with Fairtrade International monitoring, evaluation and learning experts and the Producer Network to ensure implementation and prioritisation of effective monitoring, evaluation and learning in a timely manner.- External programme reporting. Working with Fairtrade International monitoring, evaluation and learning experts, Producer Network and National Fairtrade Organisations ensuring agreed reporting deadlines are met with quality reporting to be used with commercial stakeholders, government and other interested stakeholders.- External stakeholder engagement, traders. Working closely with the Producer Network manage relationships with exporter, importer and processers of cocoa who purchase Fairtrade cocoa from Small Producer Organisaitons. Traders are a critical part of the supply chain and their incorporation into the programme is desired and necessary.- External stakeholder engagement, events. Working with National Fairtrade Organisations you will be speaking at public and trade events on the strategic objectives of our work, the progress and impact with the aim of influencing the sector.- External stakeholder engagement, media. Where required you will interact with media.- Fairtrade Standards and Pricing. Liaising with the lead department in Fairtrade on standards and pricing, Fairtrade’s Standards Unit and Pricing Unit, you will be working on standards and pricing matters relating to Fairtrade’s cocoa work and the programme. This will include and not limited to consultations, queries and evolution of standards and pricing. Other tasks that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.SKILLS REQUIRED:Level of education: The position holder will have an undergraduate degree in science or the arts. Years of professional experience: A minimum of three years' experience in complex project management which includes implementation in the global South and preferably West Africa.Language requirements: Fluency in English and French required. Professional proficiency in Spanish is an advantage. The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

**Job Description Summary

**The Production Engineer – Calibration & Maintenance is responsible for the calibration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production, inspection, measurement, and test equipment used in a regulated medical device manufacturing environment.

The role works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, equipment owners, and external service providers to ensure equipment remains calibrated, maintained, compliant, and available for production.

Responsibilities include day-to-day calibration and preventive maintenance coordination, HxGN EAM administration, calibration assessments, controlled procedures and work instructions, supplier coordination, and equipment compliance.

This is a hands-on Production Engineering role supporting manufacturing operations across scanner/system assembly, mechanical and electrical/electronic assembly, software configuration/loading, packaging and labeling, and testing/final acceptance.

**Job Description

****Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Coordinate the site calibration program, including calibration schedules, call-in activities, equipment status, due dates, and timely completion.

• Coordinate internal and external calibration activities, including equipment preparation, shipment, return, documentation review, and release back to production.

• Ensure new, returned, overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment is appropriately assessed and controlled before use.

• Act as SME for calibration and maintenance activities in HxGN EAM, maintaining asset records, calibration setups, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, task plans, and supporting documentation.

• Perform and support calibration assessments, including equipment requirements, criticality, acceptance criteria, calibration methods, frequencies, and maintenance needs.

• Develop and maintain calibration and maintenance procedures, SOPs, and work instructions in collaboration with equipment owners, SMEs, and Quality.

• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for production and test equipment while minimizing disruption to manufacturing.

• Support investigations, risk assessments, and product-impact assessments related to overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment, and provide input to NC/INV/CAPA activities where applicable.

• Coordinate external calibration and maintenance suppliers, including quotations, service activities, documentation, and AGORA purchase orders.

• Support internal and external audits by ensuring calibration and maintenance records are complete, traceable, compliant, and audit-ready.

• Monitor calibration and maintenance performance and drive improvements in equipment compliance, availability, data quality, and execution efficiency.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Metrology, Maintenance, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Experience with calibration, preventive maintenance, equipment management, or Production Engineering in a regulated manufacturing environment.

• Understanding of calibration principles, equipment control, documentation, traceability, and manufacturing process requirements.

• Experience with computerized maintenance or Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably HxGN EAM or comparable systems.

• Experience working within controlled procedures, work instructions, and change management processes.

• Experience coordinating suppliers, service activities, quotations, and purchase orders.

• Knowledge of GMP and Quality Management System requirements within regulated manufacturing.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Experience within medical device manufacturing or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Hands-on and practical approach to supporting manufacturing equipment and production operations.

• Structured working style with strong ownership and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

• Strong collaboration skills across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external suppliers.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable balancing equipment compliance, production continuity, quality requirements, and operational priorities.

• Proactive and improvement-focused approach to equipment reliability and calibration/maintenance processes

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.occupation: Executive Director Partnerships, Advocacy, Engagement & Resource Mobilisation
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape how one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations builds partnerships, and mobilises resources needed to support people affected by displacement?

This is an opportunity to bring your leadership, external engagement and resource mobilisation experience to a mission with human impact. As Executive Director for Partnerships, Advocacy, Engagement & Resource Mobilisation (PAER) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will strengthen DRC’s voice, relationships and funding base - positioning DRC as a trusted partner and advocate for displaced people.

You will join DRC at an important time for the humanitarian sector, as needs continue to rise while funding and humanitarian space are under increasing pressure. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help set DRC’s strategic direction and lead a broad global portfolio spanning strategic partnerships, institutional and private fundraising, advocacy, external communications, press, international representations, and asylum and refugee rights.

**About The Job

**Reporting to the Secretary General, you will set direction for DRC’s global partnerships, advocacy, engagement and resource mobilisation agenda. Working closely with the Executive Management Team, country leadership, and senior functional leaders, you will expand high-level relationships with institutional donors, global foundations, private contributors, private-sector partners to secure more sustainable and flexible funding.

You will harness DRC’s global advocacy, communications and press efforts across countries, regions, representations and headquarters, strengthening DRC’s position as a relevant influencing and dialogue partner for donors, political stakeholders, peers and the wider humanitarian system. You will also oversee DRC’s representations in Geneva, Brussels and Berlin, as well as our representative presence in London, and provide leadership for the Asylum & Refugee Rights department and its specialised expertise in asylum procedures, refugee rights and legal aid.

You will lead and develop leaders across the PAER portfolio, foster collaboration across the organisation, and ensure sound people planning, employee well-being and financial management. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will represent DRC internally and externally, communicate its priorities with clarity and build trusted relationships across cultures, sectors and geographies.

The impact you will make:

• Shape DRC’s global strategy and PAER agenda as a member of the Executive Management Team, helping translate organisational priorities into coordinated action.

• Expand institutional and private partnerships to secure more sustainable and flexible funding for DRC’s humanitarian mission.

• Strengthen DRC’s global advocacy, communications and influence on displacement-related agendas with donors, policymakers and humanitarian partners.

• Lead DRC’s international representations with a focus on external relations, and its asylum and refugee rights portfolio, connecting specialist expertise with global engagement.

• Develop senior leaders and promote effective collaboration, people management and financial stewardship across the PAER portfolio.

**About You

**You are a purpose-driven executive who combines political judgement, entrepreneurial energy and strong relationship-building skills. You understand the global humanitarian and development landscape and can translate opportunities into lasting partnerships, influence and income. You are an inclusive, inspiring and empowering leader with the ability to create momentum across a complex international organisation.

What you will bring:

• Senior-level experience building institutional and private partnerships in the international humanitarian or development sector.

• Deep knowledge of humanitarian funding to forced displacement and related global policy priorities.

• A proven record in resource mobilisation, high-level advocacy, external engagement and policy dialogue.

• Political acumen and credibility with senior government, donor, foundation and private-sector stakeholders.

• Executive leadership experience and an inclusive, entrepreneurial and high-integrity leadership style.

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity.

**We offer

**Contract length: Permanent

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken station

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit.

**Application process

**If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through partnerships, advocacy, engagement and resource mobilisation, we would welcome your application. Korn Ferry is assisting the Danish Refugee Council with the recruitment of the Executive Director, Partnerships, Advocacy, Engagement & Resource Mobilisation. Please submit your motivated application and CV through the designated recruitment channel.

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English.. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 5th November 2026

Further information For questions regarding the vacancy please contact: Georgie Horn, Senior Associate Korn Ferry: DRC_PAER@KornFerry.com

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo .

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

On-call Waiters & Bartenders - Bring your personality to Hobo Copenhagen

A warm hello. A thoughtful recommendation. Noticing when someone could use a hand. Great hospitality starts with small moments, and we’re looking for people who enjoy creating them.

We’re looking for on-call waiters and bartenders to join our F&B team at Hobo Copenhagen, helping out across our cocktailbar, all-day bar & café, restaurant and breakfast service.

You might already have some hospitality experience, or you might be looking for your first opportunity in the industry. What matters most is your personality, reliability and willingness to learn. Bring your curiosity and energy, and we’ll help you build your skills.

Find your feet with us

You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues who will show you the ropes and support you during service. Depending on your experience and interests, you’ll:

• 
Welcome guests and help them feel comfortable from the moment they arrive.

• 
Serve food and drinks, learning about our menus so you can share favourites and make recommendations with confidence.

• 
Support service behind the bar, preparing drinks and keeping the bar ready for the next round.

• 
Help prepare for service, set tables and keep our spaces welcoming throughout the shift.

• 
Stay attentive to guests, listen to their requests and ask a colleague whenever you need a hand.

• 
Support the team with clearing, resetting and the everyday details that keep service flowing.

You don’t need to be equally experienced on the floor and behind the bar. Tell us what you enjoy and where you feel confident, and we’ll explore where you fit best.

What you bring

You enjoy meeting people and are happy to let your personality show. You’re curious, approachable and willing to get involved, even when something is new to you.

You take your commitments seriously, arrive ready for your shift and support your colleagues when things get busy. You’re comfortable asking questions and taking feedback as you learn.

You can communicate with guests and colleagues in English. Experience from a restaurant, café or bar is welcome, and being comfortable working both on the floor and behind the bar is a definite plus.

You should be available to work at least every other weekend. Being able and keen to work more is a welcome plus. Shifts can be in the morning, daytime or evening.

What you’ll be part of

At Hobo, we bring a professional, passionate and playful approach to hospitality. We care about good service and want people to feel comfortable being themselves, both as guests and as colleagues.

You’ll join a new team during our opening journey, with hands-on training, supportive colleagues and the chance to grow in confidence as you gain experience.

Hobo Copenhagen is part of Strawberry, alongside hotels such as Admiral Hotel and Villa Copenhagen. You’ll be part of a wider hospitality family, with staff benefits according to your employment terms.

Let’s talk

We’d love to hear a little about you, what you enjoy and why you’d like to join Hobo. Tell us whether your interests lie on the floor, behind the bar or a bit of both, along with when you’re available to work.

If you have hospitality experience, tell us about it. If you don’t, tell us what makes you keen to get started.

The practical details

• 
Position: On-call waiter or bartender, with shifts agreed according to business needs and your availability.

• 
Start date: February 2027, with the exact date to be agreed.

• 
Location: Hobo Copenhagen, Helgolandsgade 3, 1653 Copenhagen V.

• 
Working hours: Morning, daytime and evening shifts, primarily at weekends. You should be available at least every other weekend,  and we’d love to hear if you’re keen to work more.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

You care about good food, enjoy a busy service and know how much a kitchen depends on the people in it. Now you’re ready to help build something new.

We’re looking for chefs to join Hobo Copenhagen in full-time positions, with a primary focus on our evening à la carte restaurant. You’ll also contribute to the food offering in our all-day bar, working as part of one kitchen team.

You know your craft. You care about what goes into the glass, how a bar runs and how people feel when they walk through the door. You understand that a warm welcome, eye contact and genuine attention can set the tone for an entire evening. Now you’re ready to help build something new.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

**Job Description

**As the Business Operations Program Manager you will be important member of the Global IPP Operations team and drive business productivity, process optimization, and organizational change projects across the IPP business. You will focus on improving end-to-end operational performance by implementing sustainable business improvements that enhance efficiency, collaboration, scalability, and customer responsiveness.

Acting as a strategic partner, you will support Project Management, Application Engineering, Manufacturing, and Business Operations teams. You will lead cross-functional initiatives that achieve four key objectives: simplifying processes, improving operational effectiveness, accelerating execution, and enabling business growth.

You will work closely with the Manufacturing teams in Katowice and CUBIC, ensuring strong alignment between operational improvement initiatives, production capabilities, and business objectives across the global IPP organization. You will combine data-driven decision-making, change management expertise, and continuous improvement methodologies to deliver measurable business outcomes and ensure successful adoption of transformational projects.

You will report to the Global IPP Business Operations Manager. This position is hybrid and located in EMEA, preferably near a Rockwell Automation IPP facility.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• 
Business Productivity and Process Improvement

• 
Lead business productivity projects across the IPP organization focused on improving efficiency and enhancing operational performance.

• 
Identify process bottlenecks and improvement opportunities across Project Management, Application Engineering, Manufacturing, and Business Operations.

• 
Develop and implement standardized processes, best practices, and governance mechanisms across the IPP business.

• 
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence across the organization.

• 
Change Management and Business Transformation

• 
Lead change management activities associated with strategic business initiatives, organizational transformations, system implementations, and process improvements.

• 
Partner with functional leaders to reinforce desired behaviors and ensure long-term adoption of new processes and tools.

• 
Establish change management methodologies, frameworks, and best practices within the IPP organization.

• 
Cross-Functional Business Integration

• 
Act as a liaison between Project Management, Application Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Operations, Commercial teams, and IPP Leadership.

• 
Drive alignment of priorities, processes, and performance goals across departments and regions.

• 
Support implementation of integrated business processes that enhance visibility and accountability

• 
Facilitate stakeholder alignment and resolution of process-related challenges impacting business performance.

• 
Performance Analytics and Operational Effectiveness

• 
Analyze operational trends to identify improvement opportunities and support data-driven decision-making.

• 
Monitor key metrics including productivity, lead time, OTTR, process adoption, and operational performance.

• 
Measure and communicate the impact of productivity and transformation programs.

• 
Support data governance efforts to improve visibility and reporting accuracy.

• 
Strategic Program Management

• 
Lead and coordinate productivity and transformation projects aligned with IPP strategic goals.

• 
Develop project charters, business cases, implementation roadmaps, and success metrics.

• 
Identify project risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions.

• 
Provide regular updates and recommendations to the IPP Leadership Team.

• 
Continuous Improvement

• 
Lead or support continuous improvement projects focused on operational productivity, process simplification, organizational effectiveness, and business performance.

• 
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve reporting efficiency, and streamline workflows.

• 
Drive standardization of tools, methodologies, and governance processes across the IPP organization.

• 
Benchmark best practices and implement solutions that support long-term business growth.

**The Essentials - You Will Have

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Organizational Development, or related field.

• Minimum 5+ years of experience in Change Management or Business Operations, Operational Excellence, Business Transformation, Project Management.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have

**

• Experience working within Engineering-to-Order (ETO), manufacturing, industrial automation, or project-based business environments.

• Demonstrated experience leading business improvement and change management projects.

• Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations.

• Proficiency with business analytics tools.

• Strong change management and business process improvement skills.

• Strong understanding of project-driven and engineering-to-order business environments.

• Experience leading cross-functional programs in global organizations.

• Experience with data analytics & business performance measurement.

• Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for operational excellence.

**What We Offer

**Our benefits package includes …

• Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees

• Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.

• On-demand digital course library for professional development

• Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm

• Employee Assistance Program

• Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program

• and other local benefits!

_At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

_Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Operator for AGC Biologics in Søborg
jobs.description:
Would you like to work for an international company where your work contributes to the production of life-saving medicines? AGC Biologics is looking for Warehouse Operators.

The Job

We are looking for Warehouse Operators to join AGC Biologics' GMP Warehouse in Søborg. Depending on your experience and qualifications, you will become part of either our Picking team or Goods Reception team, both of which play a vital role in supporting the production of life-saving medicines.

At AGC Biologics, we work with the purpose of "Bringing purpose to life", and your role will help support the production of life-saving medicines for patients around the world.

At AGC Biologics, you will handle materials and products that are of great value and play a critical role in pharmaceutical production. Therefore, quality, accuracy, and accountability are essential in the daily work.

You can expect an active workday with plenty of walking, structured routines, and close collaboration with colleagues across warehouse and production departments. At the same time, you will become part of an international workplace with employees from many different cultures and nationalities, where positivity, respect, and teamwork are a natural part of everyday life.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Picking and packing materials and goods

• 
Scanning and registering goods in warehouse management systems

• 
Receiving goods from external warehouses and logistics partners

• 
Storing and placing goods in designated warehouse locations

• 
Inventory counting and quality control

• 
Processing inventory transactions and warehouse documentation

• 
Forklift operation and internal transport of materials

• 
Cleaning and maintaining general warehouse order to support GMP requirements

• 
Various ad hoc tasks in the daily operation

This is a physically demanding warehouse position where heavy lifting may occur, so it is important that you enjoy staying active throughout the workday.

What We Offer

• 
A workplace with strong team spirit, a positive atmosphere, and a culture where colleagues support one another

• 
Thorough training in warehouse processes and GMP requirements

• 
The opportunity to work in an international company with an important purpose

• 
Great colleagues who collaborate and succeed together

• 
A canteen scheme as well as access to fruit, coffee, and excellent facilities

Your Profile

We imagine that you:

• 
Have experience from warehouse operations, preferably around 2 years or more

• 
Thrive in an active and physically demanding work environment

• 
Are comfortable working with warehouse systems, scanners, and documentation

• 
Work in a structured manner and pay attention to quality and details

• 
Are reliable, punctual, and take responsibility for your tasks

• 
Understand the importance of handling products and materials correctly

• 
Have a positive attitude and contribute to strong teamwork

• 
Can read and understand English, as training materials and procedures are provided in English

Experience from the pharmaceutical, biotech, GMP, or other quality-regulated industries is an advantage, but not a requirement. You will receive training in the relevant processes.

A forklift certificate is a strong advantage and will be required for some functions.

A clean criminal record must be presented as part of the hiring process.

Practical Information

Please note that your first week will include onboarding, certifications, and training. A significant part of the introduction is conducted through written training materials and procedures in English, so it is important that you are comfortable working with English documentation.

Working hours are either:

• Day shift: 07:00 - 15:00

The position is Monday to Friday.

This is a full-time temporary position running until December 31, 2026, with an immediate start. For the right candidates, there may be opportunities for further extension and potential permanent employment.

Salary is based on the applicable collective agreement and follows AGC Biologics' salary framework.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

The company

AGC Biologics (AGC) is a global Contract Development Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) with bio-manufacturing facilities in Europe, Japan, Italy and the USA. The company provides a comprehensive range of commercial and clinical cGMP biologics manufacturing services, from DNA to active pharmaceutical ingredient (API). The company’s team and approach are tailored to each of its client’s needs, whether turnkey manufacturing or sophisticated, stand-alone analytical, formulation and stability services.

Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

We are looking for a student software developer to join our system development team in Global IT.

As a student software developer, you will play an important role in supporting the team's development efforts by contributing to real business-critical solutions, helping maintain high quality through testing, and bringing fresh perspectives on emerging technologies such as Azure and AI.

• Developing new features and fixing bugs in our applications, APIs and services

• Building front-end components and backend endpoints under guidance from experienced developers

• Helping perform testing of our applications, running test cases, reporting defects and writing automated tests to keep our quality high

• Taking part in our agile ways of working, stand-ups, sprint planning and code reviews

• Exploring new tools and technologies, such as cloud services on Microsoft Azure and AI and sharing what you learn with the team

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A self-learner who picks up new technologies and tools on your own initiative and is not afraid to ask questions when you get stuck

• Are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field

• Have some experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and ideally a modern framework such as React

It’s a bonus if you have tried automated testing, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

Maybe you’re the kind of person who loves it when everything comes together: a candidate feels well taken care of, a new colleague has everything ready for their first day, payroll is spot on, and the details in our HR systems are exactly where they should be. If that sounds satisfying to you, you might be our new People Operations Specialist.

This is a broad, hands-on HR role where you’ll work across payroll, recruitment, onboarding, and HR administration. You’ll have plenty of opportunity to take ownership, improve the way we work, and make your mark as the role develops. You’ll be part of the HR team at Evosep, reporting directly to the HR Manager, and the role is based at our HQ in Odense.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

HR Administration & Payroll

• Manage the monthly payroll process for our Danish employees in Zenegy in close collaboration with the HR Manager, including the administration of vacation, parental leave, and other employee-related changes.

• Support the administration and maintenance of our HRMS, HR-ON Staff, ensuring employee records, organizational data, salary band information, and HR metrics are accurate and up to date.

• Prepare and provide HR data and reporting to support business needs and decision-making.

• Support the HR Manager with employment documentation, including contracts, addenda, and amendments.

• Support a wide range of day-to-day HR administrative activities.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Coordinate the recruitment process through HR-ON Recruit, including job postings, candidate communication, interview coordination, and recruitment administration.

• Track and report on recruitment metrics and KPIs, using insights to continuously improve our recruitment processes and candidate experience.

Preboarding & Onboarding

• Coordinate the employee journey from signed contract through onboarding, including IT equipment, employee accounts, system access, and coordination with relevant stakeholders.

• Ensure mandatory training is completed and correctly documented in our QMS.

• Gather feedback and track relevant metrics to continuously improve the onboarding experience.

Policies & Process Improvement

• Support the development and maintenance of HR policies, guidelines, and documentation.

• Identify opportunities to continuously improve our HR processes, systems, and overall employee experience.

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive can-do attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team. For this particular role, we also imagine that you bring:

• Hands-on experience with payroll and day-to-day HR operations.

• A relevant degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. A bookkeeping or administrative background combined with practical HR experience is equally relevant.

• A genuine interest in supporting employees throughout their journey at Evosep.

• Strong communication skills. particularly in writing, and professional fluency in English

• Confidence working with digital tools and learning new systems. Payroll experience is essential, while Zenegy and HRIS/HRMS experience are a plus.

• Curiosity about AI and how it can make operational HR smarter and more efficient.

• Good Microsoft Office skills.

• A solid understanding of Danish employment legislation.

• A high level of discretion when working with confidential and sensitive information.

• A structured and detail-oriented way of working, even when several things are happening at once.

• A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership and improve the way we work.

• Excitement about joining a fast-growing life sciences company and helping shape a new role.

You don’t need to tick every box to apply. If this sounds like a role where you could thrive and contribute, we encourage you to apply and tell us what you would bring to the team.

What We Offer

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supportive colleagues with a can-do mentality and a strong belief in our ability to make a real difference through what we do.

• An innovative, open, and dynamic culture where we continuously learn, improve, and develop.

• The opportunity to join a rapidly growing life sciences company and contribute to solutions aimed at improving quality of life and patient care.

• A competitive benefits package and lunch arrangement.

• Flexible working hours and work-life balance.

• New, modern office facilities in Odense.

• And the list goes on. Learn more about us on Evosep Careers.

Hit the apply button below to apply for the position. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

We are looking for someone who can join our team in January 2027. Gram Equipment is the world’s leading supplier of sustainable ice cream manufacturing equipment. With production facilities in Denmark, Turkey, and Italy, plus sales and service offices in the US and China, Gram Equipment supplies advanced industrial equipment, helping ice cream producers make many of the well-known ice cream products sold in supermarkets or the local convenience store.

At Gram Equipment, they nurture a balanced, supportive, and innovative workplace where every individual can grow and contribute. Core values of trust, respect, and dedication build a culture of collaboration and excellence.

Since Gram Equipment was acquired by FNS Capital, it has delivered strong results and continues to strengthen its global presence in the industry. The company has 600 employees and is headquartered in Kolding, Denmark.

Drive international growth with a global market leader.

Are you a commercially driven Sales Manager who thrives on building relationships with major international customers and selling complex technical solutions?

We are looking for an ambitious Sales Manager to strengthen the global sales team and accelerate growth within the largest international accounts.

You must expect 90-100 days of traveling per year.

A unique opportunity to make an impact.

You will take commercial ownership of key customers and projects, develop new business opportunities, and drive complex sales processes from initial dialogue to successful execution. Collaborating closely with experienced colleagues, you will deliver high-value, customized solutions.

What makes this opportunity attractive?

• Join a global market leader and technological frontrunner.

• Interaction with prestigious international customers and advanced solutions.

• Enjoy significant commercial responsibility, autonomy, and influence.

• Become part of a professional, ambitious organization with a robust growth strategy.

Your profile

You bring a proven track record in international B2B sales of complex technical solutions, such as process lines. Experience from projects within the food industry is preferred.

Your technical insight is combined with a strong commercial drive, and excellent relationship-building skills.

You are based in Europe and able to join your colleagues in Kolding from time to time.

Ready to make your mark on a global stage?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the future of ice cream production worldwide.

Do you want to use your understanding of electronic systems design to create innovative products that make a difference to people with hearing disabilities?

At GN Hearing, your work will support hearing solutions that help people engage more easily in the conversations and surroundings important to them.

As an Electronic Design Engineer, you will work across the development journey: shaping system specifications, exploring new technology, building and verifying prototypes, and preparing solutions for production. You will bring your experience and curiosity to a team that works closely across disciplines to solve complex technical challenges.

Your contribution will ensure our technology forms a perfect synthesis and creates a good sound when packed into our tiny hearing aids. This process takes you through system design development, prototyping and advanced platform integration technologies.

Whether you bring established PCB design experience or are ready to build further on a solid foundation, you will have knowledgeable colleagues around you and opportunities to contribute your perspective.

Welcome to GN Hearing

You will join the Electronic Integration team, part of Product Development in R&D. Our team consists of specialist engineers who collaborate across hardware, platform and product development. We value open technical discussions, practical problem-solving and sharing what we know. You will join colleagues who take their work seriously while maintaining an informal and supportive way of working.

Together with other teams, we define, design, implement and verify the ReSound programmable DSP platform, including 2.4 GHz Bluetooth Low Energy and Auracast™ wireless communication capabilities.

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

• Contribute to electronic design development of hearing aids and accessories, from prototype stage and design verification through to production, influencing architecture and design decisions

• Evaluate and implement new technologies in hearing-aid electronics

• Design and coordinate test verification activities to ensure reliable product performance

• Create and maintain documentation required for regulatory compliance

• Collaborate with cross-functional colleagues to integrate platform technologies into compact hearing solutions

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

• Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic engineering, with a focus on signal integration or a related field

• Bring relevant experience in analog and baseband digital design

• Understand electronic systems design

• Can work through and enjoy complex technical questions and analytical problem solving

• May have experience with Cadence Allegro schematic tools

• Work well with others across technical disciplines

• Communicate proficiently in English

We pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it is needed most.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 27, 2026. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and we may close the position before the application deadline if we find the right candidate. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 10,000 people in 48 countries. Collaborating with our clients across real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, we specialise in major programmes, programme management, cost and commercial management, net zero and digital solutions.

Job Description

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is looking for a Commissioning Manager to work on a large, complex, Data Center project in Denmark.

As Commissioning Manager, you will be responsible for managing the project Commissioning process on behalf of the Turner & Townsend Project management & Consultancy team (PM-C) on site.

This role additionally includes travel within the EU for off site factory testing & witnessing.

You’ll work closely with other business functions across projects to ensure adherence to regulatory compliance and budget requirements.

About The Job

If you love storytelling, are passionate about PR and communications, and enjoy working with the media, we’d like to hear from you.

We are looking for a skilled PR & Communications Manager to join Saxo’s Global Communications team.

In this role, you will work at Group level while taking responsibility for driving our PR efforts in the Nordics, with a strong focus on Denmark. You will help strengthen Saxo’s position in the media and build awareness of Saxo as a leading choice for investors and traders who want to take control of their financial future.

We are looking for someone who is ready to grow with us as we welcome more clients to Saxo and continue to strengthen our brand and relevance among key audiences.

Responsibilities

• Drive PR and support brand positioning for Saxo in the Nordics through multi-channel communications, content development, and thought leadership

• Develop and execute proactive media strategies and campaigns, with a strong focus on Denmark

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key journalists and media outlets across the Nordics

• Identify relevant stories and media opportunities that can strengthen Saxo’s visibility and position in the market

• Draft press releases, media pitches, Q&As, talking points, and thought leadership content to support product launches, campaigns and corporate announcements

• Work closely with local management and senior leaders to align communications and prepare spokespeople for media engagements

• Ensure a consistent and compelling positioning of Saxo across external communications and media engagements

• Support issues and crisis communications at Group level, including the development of statements, Q&As, and leadership briefings

You will be based at Saxo’s headquarters in Copenhagen and be part of the Global PR & Communications team. You will report to the Global Head of Communications & PR and work closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the Nordic markets.

The Global PR & Communications team consists of six employees and is responsible for external and internal communications across the Group. The team works closely with colleagues across the business as well as PR agencies in local markets.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who combines strong communications skills with curiosity, initiative, and a good understanding of what makes a story relevant to the media.

You are energetic, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and working independently in a fast-paced international environment.

You are structured, creative, resourceful, and enjoy identifying new communications opportunities.

• You have several years of relevant experience from journalism, a newsroom, a PR agency, or a corporate communications function

• You have a strong understanding of the Danish media landscape and what drives the news agenda

• You know how to turn complex topics into clear, engaging stories for different audiences

• You are confident building relationships with journalists, senior stakeholders, and colleagues across functions

• You keep up with developments in PR, media and communications and know how to translate them into practice

• You are a native Danish speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How To Apply

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

jobs.occupation: Cluster Lead & Theme Integrator – Core Payments Platform
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Payments sit at the heart of what Danske Bank does for its customers every day. As the Core Payments Platform modernises domestic and cross-border payments, this role gives you the chance to lead a cluster of five squads through a period of real transformation. You will combine functional and HR responsibility with ownership of a strategic commercial theme on our cross-border platform.

**What You Will Be Doing

**The area is undergoing significant change, driven by customer expectations, regulation and platform modernisation. In this role, you will set direction for the squads, build a strong leadership environment and establish effective governance around commercial cross-border initiatives. Your focus will be to turn strategy and commitments into coordinated delivery in 2027 and beyond.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Leading and developing five cross-functional teams with full functional and HR responsibility

• Setting direction for the cluster and aligning priorities with the tribe strategy

• Acting as Programme Manager (Theme Integrator) for commercial cross-border initiatives, coordinating scope, dependencies, risks and decisions

• Establishing transparent governance and reporting that supports timely decisions and clear accountability

• Translating strategic objectives into an executable roadmap, balancing customer value, commercial outcomes, regulation and resilience

• Managing senior stakeholders across business and technology while creating conditions for strong team performance

**About You

**

• Experience leading teams through others and developing people at different levels

• Strong programme management skills, including governance, planning and dependency management

• Structured, pragmatic approach to moving complex topics towards decisions and delivery

• Confident communicator with senior stakeholders across business and technology functions

• Background in financial services is beneficial; knowledge of payments or cross-border platforms is a clear advantage

**What We Offer You

**This is a central leadership role in an area that is critical to Danske Bank and its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically spending three to four days per week in the office, alongside committed colleagues in an informal and supportive atmosphere. You will have real scope to shape strategic investment decisions and develop your career in an international organisation that takes inclusion seriously.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to get in touch. Please reach out to Christoffer Fuglsang at chra@danskebank.dk or Thomas Kirkegaard Sierant at sie@danskebank.dkwith any questions about the role.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 20 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

STINE GOYA is looking for an experienced and highly creative Head of Design to lead our design team and oversee the design process across ready-to-wear, accessories and special projects. Combining a strong creative vision with hands-on design expertise and excellent leadership skills, you will translate the direction of our Creative Director, Stine Goya, into distinctive, cohesive collections.

Reporting to Stine Goya as Creative Director, you will have line management responsibility for the design team. Working closely with the development and production team, you will guide collections from initial research and concepts through to sampling and final design decisions. Alongside your own design work, you will support the team’s development and keep priorities, responsibilities and timelines clear.

Main responsibilities

• Collaborate with the Creative Director on seasonal direction, developing concepts, mood boards and colour palettes that bring newness while staying true to the STINE GOYA aesthetic.

• Lead and inspire the design team - a print design manager, junior textile / graphic designer and interns -  setting clear expectations, allocating work and providing regular feedback and guidance.

• Design and oversee cohesive collections across ready-to-wear and accessories, developing silhouettes, fabrics, colours, trims and details with attention to both creative ambition and wearability.

• Work closely with the team to integrate print, jacquard and embroidery into the overall collection, aligning creative direction and priorities while supporting their ownership of artwork and technical print development, graphic work and presentation materials in line with collection needs.

• Oversee design development, fittings and sampling with the development and production team, ensuring that proportions, fit, construction, materials and finish reflect the design intent and quality standards.

• Lead planning across the design team in line with the collection calendar, coordinating milestones with the design team and other teams, resolving competing priorities and addressing potential delays early.

• Lead the design of capsule collections and special projects, present collections and support PR and marketing with collection information, photoshoots and runway shows.

The ideal candidate

• A degree in fashion design or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Substantial experience in contemporary womenswear design, with a portfolio demonstrating a strong creative point of view and cohesive collections developed into finished products.

• Experience leading a design team, with the ability to motivate people, delegate effectively, give constructive feedback and develop individual strengths.

• Understanding of the STINE GOYA aesthetic and a confident eye for colour, silhouette, proportion and the relationship between print and garment design.

• Solid technical knowledge of fabrics, garment construction and fit, with the ability to guide sampling and find creative solutions to design and development challenges.

• Excellent sketching and illustration skills, combined with proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and ProCreate.

• A structured and collaborative approach, with the ability to overview the collection structure and SKU’s according to plans and make clear decisions when priorities compete.

• A proactive, flexible approach, an interest in responsible design practices and the ability to maintain creative quality while supporting the team in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluency in English.

Application process

Please send the following to job@stinegoya.com with “Head of Design” in the subject line:

• Your CV.

• A digital portfolio showing your creative process, collection development and examples of finished garments or accessories from previous work, with your role in each project clearly indicated.

• A cover letter of no more than one A4 page outlining your interest in the role and relevant design and leadership experience.

About the role

Do you have your first years of experience in buying, merchandising or sourcing – and are you ready to take ownership of your own product area at an international children’s wear brand? We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Junior Buyer to join our Buying & Supply Chain team.

You will be based at our Head Office in Gentofte, report to our Chief Supply Chain Officer and work closely with Design, Sales, Logistics and ESG. You will be responsible for a defined product group and its suppliers, and play an active part in building our collections – from planning, costing and negotiation to orders and delivery.

This is a role with real ownership. You will be accountable for the figures and deadlines in your product area, while having experienced colleagues around you to spar with – and room to grow towards a Buyer role as your responsibilities expand.

Your responsibilities

As Junior Buyer, you will own a product group and a selected part of our supplier base. This means that you:

• Are responsible for your product group’s buying budget, target margins and buying quantities – and for getting the right products delivered on time and to the agreed quality.

• Lead the day-to-day dialogue and price negotiations with your suppliers, and follow up on their performance on quality, delivery precision and compliance.

• Represent the buying team in collection meetings and contribute data-driven recommendations on assortment, depth and pricing.

• Make sure your products meet our requirements for responsible production, certifications and product safety.

Your responsibilities will grow with your experience – for example with additional product groups, new suppliers or cross-functional projects in Supply Chain.

What you will work with

Suppliers & negotiation

• Negotiate prices, terms, MOQs and lead times with your suppliers, and prepare each negotiation with clear data and targets.

• Follow up on supplier performance – delivery precision, quality and responsiveness – and handle claims and corrective actions.

• Help develop our supplier base, including evaluating new suppliers and materials together with the team.

• Make sure certificates (e.g. GOTS and GRS), test reports and product safety documentation are in place for your products.

Collection & orders

• Take part in collection meetings from line planning to final range, working closely with Design and Sales on assortment and priorities.

• Place and manage purchase orders, making sure quantities, prices and master data are correct in our systems.

• Follow your orders through production and shipment in close cooperation with Logistics, and react quickly to delays or changes.

• Drive the sample flow and seasonal timeline for your product group, and make sure deadlines are met across teams.

About you

You are commercially minded and enjoy combining numbers, products and people. You take ownership of your area, keep track of the details without losing the big picture, and want a real say in what ends up in the collection. We imagine that you:

• Have 1–3 years of experience in buying, merchandising, sourcing or product development – ideally within fashion, footwear or lifestyle.

• Hold a relevant education, e.g. Design Technology (Fashion Management), a Bachelor in Design & Business, a Bachelor in International Sales & Marketing, or similar.

• Are analytical and confident with numbers, Excel, costings and margin calculations. Experience with an ERP or PLM system is a plus.

• Have hands-on experience with supplier dialogue and are comfortable leading price negotiations.

• Work in a structured way and take responsibility for your results from start to finish.

• Communicate clearly and confidently in English, both written and spoken. Danish is a plus, but not a requirement.

• Can prioritise between several tasks and deadlines at once, and keep a cool head when plans change.

• Are interested in products, fashion and responsible production – knowledge of certifications or product safety requirements is a plus.

We care more about your drive, commercial sense and willingness to learn than about ticking every box.

What we offer

• Real ownership of a product group and its suppliers at a growing international brand

• A clear path towards a Buyer role as your responsibilities and results develop

• Sparring and support from experienced colleagues in Buying & Supply Chain

• Insight into the full value chain – from design and sourcing to sales and delivery

• A warm and collaborative work environment where well-being, trust and professional development are priorities

• Competitive salary and employment terms that match the role and your experience

jobs.occupation: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!

Your position 

In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.

Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.

You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.

As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.
You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.

Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.

Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.

The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences.

"We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."
– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line Management

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.

Your tasks will include:

• Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
• Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
• Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
• Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
• Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
• Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
• Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.

Your profile & qualifications 

To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
• Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
• Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
• Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
• Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
• Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
• Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
• If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
