Communications Manager, Defence - Aarhus, Denmark

Do you want to shape how Systematic is seen across the Nordic defence sector, as the thought leader behind C5ISR software that supports allied forces every day? As our new Communications Manager, you will drive external communications for Systematic Defence in the Nordics working closely with international colleagues and taking real ownership of our story, from breaking news to speaker platforms.

The job

As Communications Manager, you will turn complex defence technology, customer developments and industry trends into clear, relevant stories for Nordic audiences. Working across Defence, Sales, Product Management and the international MarCom organisation, you will identify strong angles, engage subject-matter experts and take stories from idea to publication. You will also build trusted media relationships and help position Systematic and the SitaWare suite as an authoritative voice within C5ISR.

Some of your key tasks will be to:

• create content for media outlets and Systematic's own channels

• engage with internal and external sources and stakeholders to uncover and shape stories that position Systematic as a thought leader in C5ISR

• drive communication efforts around tradeshows and events, working closely with our international offices — particularly our Danish offices

• translate relevant international stories into Danish content

• support the wider positioning of Systematic and SitaWare across the Nordics

Expect around 30+ days of travel a year to Systematic offices, tradeshows and events.

Joining the team

You will join a collaborative Defence MarCom team of seven colleagues based across Aarhus, Cologne, Washington and Farnborough. Although we work across locations, we stay closely connected through daily collaboration on Teams and come together in person every six to eight weeks. You will also work closely with colleagues across Systematic Defence, bringing different perspectives and specialist expertise together to strengthen our position within C5ISR. Here, you will have the freedom to take ownership of your own stories and projects, while benefiting from the ideas, support and experience of an international, multi-skilled team.

What you bring

You bring at least eight years of relevant communications experience and a professional background in journalism, communications or marketing. You are an accomplished storyteller who can turn complex subject matter into clear, engaging content for different audiences and channels.

We are also looking for:

• experience working with Umbraco or another content management system

• familiarity with HubSpot or a similar marketing platform

• native-level Danish and fluency in written and spoken English

• independent, proactive and structured workstyle, combined with a collaborative mindset and the confidence to engage colleagues, subject-matter experts, journalists and other external stakeholders

• experience working in central government, the defence or technology sector would be an advantage

**Join Our Team

**We are looking for three Automation Engineers who are eager to develop their expertise and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive team. DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where your ideas matter. We're building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning, and making a difference. As an employee at DESMI, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects, develop cutting-edge skills, and connect with a diverse team of talented individuals. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.

**Ideally, We Are Looking For Someone Who Is

**

• Curious and eager to explore new technologies and solutions

• Driven by solving technical challenges and delivering high-quality results

• Collaborative and motivated by working across disciplines to create robust solutions

**A glimpse into the role

**As an Automation Engineer, you will become part of a global Automation team with 8 colleagues in Denmark and 2 colleagues in China. Automation is a key strategic focus at DESMI, and you will play an important role in further developing and strengthening our automation solutions.

We are expanding our team and are looking for engineers with different strengths and interests. Whether your expertise lies in PLC and software development, electrical and hardware design, system integration, or technical leadership, you will help develop robust and reliable automation solutions across DESMI's product portfolio. Working closely with colleagues across Product Development, Engineering, Production, Service, and Sales, you will contribute to delivering high-quality solutions that create value for our customers.

**Depending on your strengths and interest, your main responsibilities could include:

**

• Development and maintenance of automation solutions for DESMI products and systems

• Design and implementation of PLC and HMI software

• Development and integration of electrical, control, and communication systems

• Participation in system testing, commissioning, and technical verification

• Preparation of technical documentation and support material

• Technical support for DESMI's global organization

• Driving continuous improvements of products, processes, and technical quality

• Ensuring solutions can be efficiently handed over to Production and Service

**Your next opportunity starts here

**As someone who will join our Automation Team, we are looking for a skilled engineer who is a self-driven individual with expertise in automation technology, electrical engineering, or a related field.

**We Also Imagine That You

**

• Have an educational background within Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

• Have experience with automation systems, PLC programming, electrical systems, or a combination of these disciplines

• Enjoy solving technical challenges and turning complex requirements into practical solutions

• Have a structured approach to your work and take ownership of your tasks

• Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with colleagues across functions and locations

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

• PLC platforms such as Siemens Step 7 and TIA Portal

• Hardware design, electrical schematics, and documentation in SEE Electrical or similar CAD tools

• Industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP, or Profinet

• Pumping systems, water treatment systems, or other industrial applications

• Marine, defense, or other highly regulated industries

**The perks of being at DESMI

**At DESMI, we want you to feel supported, valued and motivated. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that make a difference – from flexibility and career opportunities to security.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

• Flexible working hours With the option to work from home two days a week, supporting a hybrid work environment that fosters productivity and teamwork.

• Global career prospects Be part of DESMI’s global team. Working with dedicated colleagues across Europe, Asia and USA.

• Skills development and career growth Opportunities for training, job rotation and internal mobility.

• Pension With employer contributions up to 10% depending on your contract type.

• Private healthcare and life insurance Your well-being is important to us. We provide comprehensive private healthcare coverage, giving you access to quality medical treatment when needed.

• On-site canteen Including a light breakfast, lunch buffet and fruit snacks throughout the day, with a focus on healthy and varied meals.

• Company sports & social activities Join events like badminton, bowling, summer parties, art clubs and more.

**What We’re About

**But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.

**When You Join DESMI, You Can Expect

**

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.

• A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.

• A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

**Ready to apply?

**If you're a motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply through the platform!

To learn more about this opportunity please contact Søren Flummer at sorf@desmi.com . We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As a Senior Service Engineer at DESMI, your primary responsibility is to install, service, maintain, and repair our customers’ products and equipment, primarily related to pumps. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products are serviced correctly, operate reliably, and meet the customers’ needs. Your role also involves delivering excellent customer service and maintaining strong relationships with our customers.

**Work Tasks

**Your work will include gaining knowledge of, or developing expertise in, our own pump range – particularly our centrifugal pumps used by district heating and industrial customers. You will also work with sprinkler units and pressure boosting systems at various customer sites. Work on equipment from other manufacturers should also be expected.

You will perform regular maintenance to ensure optimal performance of the equipment, identify and resolve faults during maintenance, and carry out repairs either on-site or at the company’s facilities. Troubleshooting and diagnosing faults, followed by implementing appropriate solutions, will often take place in close collaboration with the Service Manager.

Customer service is an important part of the role. You will deliver excellent customer service, respond to customer inquiries, and provide technical support and guidance when needed.

Documentation is also a key responsibility. You will be expected to complete accurate documentation of all tasks performed, including installations, maintenance, and repairs, and report back to management regarding status updates and any challenges encountered.

DESMI currently uses an IT-based Field Service system, so good IT skills and language skills are considered an advantage.

**About You

**

• We imagine that you have experience with installation, maintenance, and repair of technical products.

• Technical knowledge and skills relevant to our product range.

• You possess strong problem-solving abilities, good communication skills, and a customer-focused mindset.

• You are able to work independently and efficiently.

• Your background may include experience as an electrician, automotive mechanic, agricultural mechanic, electro-mechanic, marine engineer, or another relevant technical education or professional experience within the field.

DESMI offers a wide range of training courses depending on your current competencies.

It is necessary that you have a flexible approach to working hours and are prepared to perform service and repairs while systems are still in operation when required. We always strive to provide the best possible service to our customers, as fully functioning installations are essential to their operations. Much of our equipment forms part of critical infrastructure.

DESMI Denmark A/S’ service organization performs preventive maintenance, emergency troubleshooting, and repairs on all pump installations. Services are provided both on request and through established service agreements. As our new Service Technician, you will therefore work with many different types of pump applications. Currently, we primarily work with three product groups: submersible pump installations, dry-installed gear and centrifugal pumps, and sprinkler systems.

The department in Hvidovre currently consists of 12 service technicians and 4 office staff. In addition to the service department in Hvidovre, DESMI Denmark A/S also has service departments in Kolding and Nørresundby. Altogether, the service organization consists of 35 employees.

jobs.occupation: 171819 Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)
jobs.description:
Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)

  Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical associate professor (research) of Paediatrics to the Department of Clinical Medicine to commence as soon as possible.

  The clinical research professorship (research) is combined with a clinical position at Zealand University Hospital, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the clinical associate professorship (research) and the clinical position. In order to be considered the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the clinical associate professorship (research)) and to the hospital (the clinical position) cf. the simultaneously advertised clinical position. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at the Hospital. Applicants should only apply for a clinical position at one of the hospitals. The advertisement for the clinical position is available from 

  Sundhedsjobs.dk - Clinical position as staff specialist combined with a clinical associate professorship (research) in Paediatrics- Børn og Unge, Sjællands Universitetshospital

  Information on the Department of Clinical Medicine, University of Copenhagen can be found at: Institut for Klinisk Medicin – Københavns Universitet

  Job description

  The clinical associate professors’ (research) duties will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research - Conduct and lead research on the development, treatment, and outcomes of diabetes in children and adolescents. The research is anchored in the Clinical Research Unit, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine, and carried out in collaboration with departments at Zealand University Hospital, other hospitals, and regional and national research partners. Responsibilities include dissemination of research findings through peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and other academic activities. 	
• Research-based teaching – Deliver pregraduate teaching and examinations as part of the Clinical Course in Paediatrics for medical students, including lectures and student-centred learning activities such as tutorials. Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students, and contribute to teaching within the mandatory Research Training Programme for Doctors in Specialist Training. 	
• Research leadership - Co-leadership of the Clinical Research Unit in the Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine. Conduct independent research and development activities, and provide academic leadership, mentorship, and supervision for early-career researchers. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society – Contribute to the dissemination of scientific knowledge to healthcare professionals, patients, policymakers, and the wider public. 	
• Academic assessments – Participation in academic assessment and evaluation activities as a member of the assessor group within the Department of Clinical Medicine.   The division between the different tasks may vary over the 5-year period of employment. Teaching obligations are equivalent to a previous external clinical associate professorship rate B.

  Any current employment as clinical associate professor (rate A, B or rate C) will expire if the applicant is employed as a clinical associate professor (research).

  Required qualifications 

  The qualification requirement for the clinical associate professor (research) is a master’s degree in medicine, specialist status as well as further teaching and research qualifications, for example PhD or doctorate and subsequently documented scientific production on an international level. In addition, there will be an emphasis on experience with scientific guidance, research administration and international research collaboration.

  The clinical associate professors (research) are also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment

  A clinical associate professor (research) is paid in accordance with Aftale om kliniske lektorer af 11. februar 2024 mellem Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet, Foreningen af Speciallæger og Yngre Læger, Cirkulære om aftale om kliniske lektorer ved universiteter under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet

  Salary and other terms and conditions of appointment are set in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. The position is covered by the current Ministerial Order on the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

  Questions

  For further information please contact Deputy Head of Department of Clinical Medicine, Professor Lone Baandrup, lone.baandrup@regionh.dk 

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen – University of Copenhagen

  Application

  The application must be submitted in English and must include the following:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• A complete list of publications 	
• List of 5 publications to be considered in the assessment (Please note that we do not you to upload a copy of the 5 publications) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Self-declaration form (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/self-declaration-form-klf.docx) 	
• Teaching portfolio (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/template-teaching-portfolio.docx (English) or https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/skabelon-undervisningsportfolio.doc (Danish)) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan   Application procedure 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The head of department  appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at jobportal.ku.dk.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59pm, Monday 30 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position will most likely be held in the month of March 2027.

Sushi Chef – Full-Time Position

Job Title: Sushi Chef
Employment Type: Full-time, permanent position
Work Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Working Hours: Full-time, approximately 37 hours per week
Salary: To be agreed based on qualifications and experience
Start Date: As soon as possible

About the Position

We are looking for a skilled and dedicated Sushi Chef to join our team at our sushi restaurant in Copenhagen.

The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing high-quality sushi and Japanese dishes while maintaining excellent food safety and hygiene standards. We are looking for someone who is passionate about Japanese cuisine, takes pride in their work, and can contribute positively to our kitchen team.

Prepare and produce a variety of sushi, including nigiri, maki, uramaki, and other sushi specialties.

• 
Prepare fish, seafood, rice, vegetables, and other ingredients according to established standards.

• 
Ensure consistent food quality, freshness, presentation, and portion control.

• 
Maintain proper food storage, temperature control, and hygiene procedures.

• 
Keep the kitchen, equipment, and workstations clean and organized.

• 
Monitor ingredient stock and assist with ordering and inventory management.

• 
Follow Danish food safety regulations and workplace procedures.

• 
Work efficiently and cooperatively with other kitchen staff.

Qualifications and Requirements

• 
Relevant experience in sushi preparation and Japanese cuisine is preferred.

• 
Good knowledge of sushi ingredients, preparation techniques, and food hygiene.

• 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• 
Reliable, responsible, and detail-oriented.

• 
Ability to work in a fast-paced restaurant environment.

• 
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required.

We Offer

• 
Full-time employment in a professional working environment.

• 
Salary and employment terms based on qualifications and experience.

•

jobs.description:
Er du klar til et job, hvor du kan vokse, bidrage til et fedt arbejdsmiljø og lede og motivere personale? Vi søger en Souschef til vores køkkenteam!

Om os
Vi er Pincho Nation, et sprudlende og anderledes restaurantkoncept med små tapasretter, ekstraordinære drinks og en oplevelse lidt ud over det sædvanlige. I vores kommende restaurant i Horsens lægger vi stor vægt på gæsteoplevelse, kvalitet, og teamwork. Hos os får du mulighed for at udvikle dig og være en vigtig del af vores team. Vi er passionerede omkring at skabe magiske oplevelser, og vi leder efter en, som deler denne passion.

Din rolle
Som Souschef vil du arbejdet tæt sammen med Head Chef. Det er dit job at administrere og lede restaurantens køkkenproduktion når Head Chef ikke er der. Du er ansvarlig for at sikre at service forløber godt og effektivt, og at gæsteservice, hygiejne og produktivitet følger Pincho Nations standarder, såvel som resten af køkkenpersonalet. Som Souschef får du chancen for at udvikle både dit team, men også ansatte individuelt. En af vores kerneværdier er “people before business". Derfor bør det altid være en hovedprioritet for vores ledere at sikre en god produktkvalitet og samtidigt lede dit team på en omsorgsfuld og motiverende vis.

Hvem er du?
Vi leder efter en, der:

• 
Er motiveret for at arbejde i restaurationsbranchen og gerne vil være en del af vores koncept.

• 
Ønsker at bidrage til et godt og positivt arbejdsmiljø.

• 
Er ansvarlig, engageret og trives i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø.

• 
Har erfaring fra lignende roller.

Hvad vi tilbyder:

• 
Fællesskab og godt arbejdsmiljø: Vi sætter stor pris på et positivt arbejdsmiljø, og vi er altid klar på at hygge os sammen både på og udenfor arbejdet.

• 
Løn: Løn efter kvalifikationer

• 
Medarbejderfordele: Personalerabat i alle vores restauranter, inkl. restauranter uden for Danmark, samt personaleevents.

Er du klar til at søge?
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Send din ansøgning og CV og fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at være en del af vores team.

Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og vi afholder samtaler løbende. Stillingen besættes, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat, så vi opfordrer dig til at sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Ansættelsesstart er 1. februar 2027.

Souschef – Pincho Nation Vejle

Are You Ready for a Job Where You Can Grow, Make a Difference, and Lead a Great Team?

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Souschef to join our kitchen team at Pincho Nation Horsens.

About Us

Pincho Nation is a vibrant and unique restaurant concept offering small tapas dishes, extraordinary cocktails, and an experience beyond the ordinary. In our coming restaurant in Horsens, we place great emphasis on guest experience, quality, and teamwork.

Joining us means becoming part of a dynamic team where you will have the opportunity to grow professionally and play an important role in our continued success. We are passionate about creating magical experiences for our guests, and we are looking for someone who shares that passion.

Your Role

As our Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef. Your primary responsibility will be to manage and lead the kitchen operation whenever the Head Chef is not present.

You will be responsible for ensuring that service runs smoothly and efficiently while maintaining Pincho Nation’s standards for food quality, guest satisfaction, hygiene, and productivity. You will also play an important role in supporting and developing the rest of the kitchen team.

One of our core values is "People Before Business." Therefore, we expect our leaders not only to deliver excellent results but also to lead their teams with care, respect, and motivation.

Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Is motivated to work in the restaurant industry and excited to be part of our unique concept.

• 
Wants to contribute to a positive and supportive working environment.

• 
Is responsible, committed, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic workplace.

• 
Has experience from a similar leadership role in a professional kitchen.

• 
Enjoys coaching, developing, and motivating others.

What We Offer

Great Team Spirit and Work Environment

We highly value a positive workplace culture and enjoy spending time together both during and outside of work.

Salary will be based on qualifications and experience.

Employee Benefits

•

• 
Employee events and social activities.

• 
Opportunities for personal and professional development within a growing restaurant concept.

Ready to Apply?

Send us your application and CV and tell us why you would like to become part of the Pincho Nation family.

We look forward to meeting you!

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be held continuously. We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible. The position will have first day at work February 1st, 2027.

About Bixter

 

At Bixter, we’re transforming how international recruitment is done, through a complex, connected ecosystem. We build experience‑first products on an AI and human‑in‑the‑loop infrastructure, and our digitalization is data‑driven and iterative. We put the customer experience at the core, and design our services and products to deliver that experience in one unified, consistent digital ecosystem.

 

We’re looking for our first Customer Experience Researcher. You’ll work at the very start of the design process, understanding our customers, their journeys and their needs, before anything gets designed. You’ll build the foundations for this from the ground up and work across product, sales, support and marketing to create a 360° view of our customers, users, market and competition. You will set up analytics, user testing in our future digital ecosystem as well. 

 

Responsibilities

·         Visit customers, conduct interviews and build a customer feedback community

·         Run customer discovery with qualitative and quantitative methods

·         Map customer journeys, archetypes and personas

·         Uncover pain points, triggers, motivations and key moments across the customer experience

·         Validate new business ideas, including new products, services and pricing packages

·         Benchmark competitors’ services and digital products

·         Run user testing on our digital products, and set up measurements and analytics

·         Build research systems for documenting, sharing and collecting customer insights

·         Turn findings into actionable insights for sales, marketing and product development

 

Requirements

·         5+ years of experience in service design, UX research or customer insights, with hands‑on research as a core part of your work

·         A mix of qualitative and quantitative methods

·         Strong interviewing and field research skills, and confidence meeting customers in person

·         Skilled at visualizing insights, for example through journey maps and service blueprints

·         A business mindset, and the ability to connect insights to commercial decisions

·         Comfort with numbers, from reading analytics to analyzing surveys

·         Experience setting up a research repository or knowledge system with modern tools and AI

·         Experience working across departments conduct market research and competitor analysis

This job is Onsite and this is a requirement

 

What we offer

·         Build and own customer understanding at Bixter from the ground up

·         Shape how the whole company understands its customers

·         Directly influence our future products, services, sales and strategy

jobs.occupation: Work in the evenings and earn extra – Join Imerco’s Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary evening job in November and December? Do you enjoy being physically active, working at a fast pace, and being part of a great team? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for the evening shift at Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4-5 evening shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6. The training will take place in the beginning of November.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

We are looking for

We are looking for someone who:

• Enjoys routine-based and independent work

• Has a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

• Is reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for their shifts

• Is physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the shift

• Has good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

• Is available for 4 evening shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

• Is available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking, dependable, and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We offer an exciting temporary evening position in a well-established retail company, where you will become part of a friendly and supportive team. You will gain valuable warehouse experience, work in a structured environment with clearly defined tasks, and have the opportunity to earn extra money during the busy Christmas season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour, in addition to which evening and weekend supplements are provided.

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you!

Are you motivated by building and operating robust, secure, and scalable IT infrastructure in a business where reliability and performance matter? Do you enjoy working hands-on with modern cloud platforms while ensuring stability, security, and efficiency across the organization?

We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Specialist to take ownership of our cloud-based IT environment. In this role, you will not only to operate and improve our infrastructure, but also to make technical decisions and drive direction within your domain.

You will play a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations while continuously improving our infrastructure to support a growing and demanding business. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization as part of a small, focused IT team where ownership, execution, and continuous improvement are central.

This is a broad role with the opportunity to work across multiple areas of IT infrastructure. We’re looking for someone with a solid foundation, a curious mindset, and the drive to continuously develop both our environment and your own expertise.

Your responsibilities will include

• Operate our cloud-only IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, and security

• Administer and optimize our Microsoft 365 environment (including Entra ID and Intune)

• Manage endpoints, identities, and access controls across the organization

• Design, implement, and maintain networking solutions (e.g. cloud networking, firewalls, VPN)

• Monitor systems and respond to incidents, including security and operational events

• Implement and maintain security controls, policies, and procedures, ensuring alignment with standards (e.g. NIS2, NIST, GDPR)

• Automate and standardize infrastructure and operational processes

• Collaborate with teams across the business to ensure IT supports evolving needs

• Drive continuous improvement of infrastructure, tooling, and ways of working

• Provide day-to-day IT operations and end-user support, including walk-up support and troubleshooting

What we’re looking for

• Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure (Azure) in a hands-on role

• Ability and willingness to take ownership and make technical decisions independently

• Strong understanding of identity and access management (Entra ID or similar)

• Experience managing endpoints and device policies (e.g. Intune or similar tools)

• Solid knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation) and experience implementing them in a cloud environment

• Practical experience with security operations (incident handling, hardening, monitoring, access control)

• Experience with Microsoft 365 administration

• Ability to automate tasks and workflows (e.g. PowerShell, scripting, or similar)

• Understanding of compliance and security frameworks (e.g. NIST, NIS2, ISO 27001, GDPR)

It would be an advantage if you also have

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management

• Experience setting up and managing monitoring, alerts, and logging systems

• Experience working in a small team with broad responsibility

• Exposure to environments where uptime and reliability are business-critical

What we offer

• A young, ambitious, and fun working environment

• A steep learning curve and early responsibility

• Close collaboration with skilled developers, traders, and analysts

• The opportunity to work on business-critical systems with real impact

• Brand-new office in the heart of Aarhus, right by Dokk1

• A fun and social work environment with regular team events and social activities throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to strengthen team spirit, including our Nitor running club.

• Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen

• Competitive salary package

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is transforming its existing client base to SimCorp One, our flagship enterprise platform for the world’s largest investment managers. SaaS is the foundation that makes this transformation scalable, resilient and commercially compelling.

As Sales Director, SaaS, you will sit at the centre of this growth mission. You will join a global specialist SWAT team working with regional Sales and Customer Success teams to move clients from on-premise deployments to SaaS-based SimCorp One. This is a client-facing, quota-carrying role with real ownership: from the first executive conversation and business case through solution shaping, commercial negotiation and signature.

You will help clients make one of their most important technology and operating-model decisions, while directly contributing to SimCorp’s global SaaS growth and the successful adoption of SimCorp One.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**Own complex SaaS transformation sales

• Lead the SaaS commercial motion for selected existing clients across EMEA, in close partnership with regional Sales and Customer Success teams.

• Own qualified opportunities from first client engagement through discovery, business case, proposal, negotiation and signature.

• Translate each client’s business, operating-model and technology priorities into a credible SaaS transformation roadmap and commercial proposition.

• Carry and deliver a multi-million-euro ARR target, maintaining clear opportunity strategy, forecast discipline and deal momentum.

Orchestrate the deal team

• Mobilise and lead virtual deal teams across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Product, Platform, Services, Legal and Commercial Finance.

• Create clarity on roles, decisions, dependencies and next steps, ensuring complex sales processes progress with pace and quality.

• Engage confidently with C-level, technology, operations, procurement and risk stakeholders, adapting the value case to each audience.

• Lead commercial negotiations and internal governance, balancing client outcomes, speed and long-term value for SimCorp.

Accelerate the global SaaS growth engine

• Work as part of the specialist SimCorp One and SaaS SWAT team, sharing expertise and supporting priority transformations across markets.

• Partner with GTM, Marketing and regional leadership to identify the right clients, build pipeline and focus resources where conversion potential is strongest.

• Improve the SaaS pitch, value proposition and competitive positioning against alternatives such as remaining on-premise, running a client-owned cloud journey or full outsourcing.

• Capture field insight and feed it back into offer development, pricing, contracting, product roadmap, sales materials and enablement.

Build market confidence and repeatability

• Act as a visible SaaS thought leader internally and externally, making complex cloud and operating-model topics commercially relevant and easy to understand.

• Use standard sales plays, artefacts and governance while adapting the client journey to market maturity, installed landscape and transformation readiness.

• Create reusable deal patterns and lessons that improve conversion, consistency and scale across EMEA.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise software, cloud, managed services, financial technology or a comparable complex solution-sales environment.

• Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals and meeting or exceeding multi-million-euro ARR targets.

• Strong commercial understanding of public cloud, SaaS, enterprise technology and recurring-revenue business models.

• Experience selling transformation rather than a standalone product, including the ability to build an executive business case and navigate long decision cycles.

• Good understanding of financial services and preferably the buy-side investment management industry.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional deal teams without formal authority and to create momentum in a global matrix organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional European languages are an advantage, preferably German

• Relevant higher education in business, economics, technology, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Capabilities and working style

• Commercial owner: You take accountability for the outcome, keep the client and internal team aligned, and move decisively from interest to commitment.

• Executive seller: You create trust with senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and connect technology choices to measurable business value.

• Deal orchestrator: You bring the right experts together, simplify complexity and maintain clear governance across large virtual teams.

• Transformation mindset: You understand that a move to SaaS changes technology, operations, risk, economics and ways of working, and you can lead clients through that change.

• Builder and collaborator: You improve the sales motion while executing it, sharing insight freely and contributing to one global SaaS growth mission.

• Disciplined and curious: You combine rigorous forecasting and deal management with the curiosity to understand each client’s context and identify a path forward.

• AI-enabled: You use AI tools responsibly to research, prepare, synthesise and scale high-quality commercial work.

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more.

In addition to our traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and a hybrid workplace model.

We are committed to supporting continuous professional growth through training, knowledge sharing, leadership exposure, and opportunities to work with some of the most sophisticated organizations in the global investment management industry.

There is never just one route for development at SimCorp. We offer an individual approach to career development and encourage employees to pursue paths aligned with their ambitions and interests.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)

Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

The Role

As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.

• Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.

• Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.

• Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.

• Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.

• Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

Your Potential Background

We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.

You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

Required Skills

• Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.

• Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.

• Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

• Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.

• Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.

• Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.

• Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

**Enhance the Security of Future Endoscopy Solutions

**Are you passionate about cybersecurity and interested in protecting innovative medical technologies that help clinicians improve patient care?

We are looking for a Product Security Engineer to help build cybersecurity into the next generation of endoscopy systems and connected healthcare solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing cybersecurity function and contribute directly to the security of products used by healthcare professionals worldwide.

In this role you will work closely with software, electronics, systems, quality, regulatory, and product development teams to ensure cybersecurity is integrated throughout the product lifecycle. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, improve security practices, and make a tangible impact on both product security and patient safety.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Product Security Engineer, you will drive cybersecurity activities throughout the development and maintenance of advanced endoscopic visualization platforms.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Drive cybersecurity risk management activities for medical devices throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead and facilitate threat modelling workshops, security assessments, and architecture reviews.

• Define, document, and maintain cybersecurity requirements for product development projects.

• Own vulnerability monitoring, assessment, prioritization, and remediation coordination across development teams.

• Manage Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, analysis, maintenance, and governance activities.

• Investigate and drive resolution of cybersecurity issues identified during development, verification, and post-market surveillance.

• Contribute to and help ensure compliance with applicable medical device cybersecurity regulations, standards, and industry best practices.

• Collaborate closely with software, systems, electronics, quality, and regulatory teams to integrate security into product development activities.

• Drive continuous improvement of Product Security processes, templates, guidance, and tools.

• Act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for development projects and support teams in making risk-informed security decisions.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen product security posture and proactively initiate improvement activities.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we know the perfect profile cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you bring many of the following:

• An educational background within Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Strong interest in product cybersecurity and secure product development.

• Experience working in a regulated industry is a great advantage; but medical device experience is not required.

• Hands-on experience with design control, requirements management, risk management, and traceability.

• Knowledge of compliance with global cybersecurity regulations and standards.

• Good understanding of networking fundamentals, operating systems (Linux), secure software development practices, and fundamental cybersecurity concepts.

• Experience with system integration and complex hardware/software/software interactions.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to balance technical depth with product-level decision-making.

• The ability to work independently, structure complex work, and proactively drive progress across many stakeholders.

• Comfortable navigating complex technical challenges and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills in a global, cross-functional environment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and drive activities to completion.

**This is more than a product security role

**You will help secure technologies that clinicians rely on every day to visualize, diagnose, and treat patients. Working within the Product Security Team, you will contribute to the development of products where cybersecurity directly supports patient safety, product reliability, and regulatory compliance. You will join a collaborative environment that values learning, innovation, and continuous improvement while helping establish cybersecurity as a key capability across the organization.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

We’re looking for an AI Engineer who enjoys building useful software and wants to do more than experiment with AI, someone who can turn it into reliable solutions that people actually use.

At Boyum IT, we’re exploring how AI can make a real difference across our products and the way we work internally. That might mean building an assistant that helps colleagues find the right information faster, supporting our customer-facing teams with smarter tools, or connecting AI capabilities with our existing products and systems.

This is a practical, hands-on engineering role. You’ll have space to explore new ideas, but the goal is always the same: build something useful, reliable, and ready for the real world.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack from day one. We’re looking for a strong software engineer who already has some hands-on experience with AI and wants to go deeper.

Location: Aarhus, Denmark - regular office presence is required.

About the Team: We call ourselves the “Unified Platform Services” team and work across products and development teams to build shared solutions and make individual product teams more effective. We also help shape how AI is used across our different products. We are a small team with a mix of skills across AI, DevOps, and traditional software development.

What You Will Be Doing

As our new AI engineer colleague, you will be assigned to specific AI projects and deliveries, but you’ll also share what you learn and help other development teams make effective use of AI tools. As part of these two focus areas, you will:

• Design, build and maintain AI-powered applications, assistants and services.

• Develop backend services and APIs.

• Work with LLM-powered applications, RAG, semantic search and agentic workflows.

• Build and improve data pipelines and knowledge bases used by AI applications.

• Help evaluate AI solutions and improve their quality, reliability and accuracy.

• Deploy and operate solutions in Azure.

• Work with Docker, CI/CD and Azure DevOps as part of the development lifecycle.

• Collaborate with product teams and internal functions to understand problems and turn them into practical technical solutions.

• Build reusable tools, integrations and templates that help other teams work effectively with AI.

• Share knowledge and contribute to how we use AI across the company.

Our current technology landscape includes Python, PostgreSQL/vector, Dagster, Azure, Azure AI Foundry, MCP, Docker and Azure DevOps.

What We Are Looking For

We think you’ll be a good match if you have:

• At least 3+ years of software development experience, ideally in backend or software engineering

• Experience building production services or APIs – ideally AI-related ones

• Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or integrating AI into software

• A solid understanding of databases, testing, and maintainable software

• Curiosity about where AI genuinely adds value, and where it doesn’t

• The ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues to understand a problem before jumping to a solution

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is a bonus, not a checklist:

• C#

• Azure or another cloud platform

• Docker, DevOps, and CI/CD

• Data pipelines

• RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents

Why Join Boyum IT

At Boyum IT, our culture is built around Energy for Life - the belief that people do their best work when they feel energized, supported, and able to balance work with life outside of work.

For us, Energy for Life means creating a workplace where people can grow professionally, stay healthy, feel connected, and have the flexibility to be present for family, friends, and personal priorities.

What We Offer

• A culture built around our Energy for Life mindset

• Flexible work arrangements and respect for work-life balance

• A diverse, international team with colleagues from more than 45 nationalities

• A supportive workplace focused on wellbeing, inclusion, and belonging

• Career development opportunities aligned with your personal goals

• Helpful, knowledgeable, and collaborative colleagues

• A workplace where your ideas and feedback are valued

• Boyum IT committed to responsible business and positive ESG impact

Interested?

Send us your CV in English or Danish.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so there’s no need to wait until the last minute.

You don’t need experience with every technology listed in the advertisement. What matters most is a strong software engineering foundation, practical experience building with AI, and an interest in taking solutions from an idea into reliable everyday use.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

AD, Clinical Research Scientist

The AD, CRS supports Clinical Strategy.

**Responsibilities

**

• Serve as a key role in the effective implementation of the global development strategy leading or co-leading one or more clinical trials in a therapeutic area for one or more compounds in various stages of clinical development (including clinical trial implementation, and oversight of all aspects of clinical development) working closely with the Medical Director and other cross-functions to provide high-quality and timely deliverables

• Contribute to the development of the program strategy for assigned trials/compounds and participate in the development of the clinical development plan (CDP)

• Author components with Medical Director and reviewer of clinical and regulatory documents and registration dossiers (i.e., protocol, ICF, IB, safety updates, study reports, regulatory submissions, etc.) to support registration and commercialization of the compound(s)

• Participate in the development of case report forms (eCRFs), eCRFs completion guidelines, and provide scientific support for other key data management deliverables (e.g. database lock activities)

• Lead the development of medical data review plan (MDRP), perform ongoing data review, and summarize efficacy and safety data for interpretation/analysis

• Provide medical input for country/site selection, feasibility assessment and engage in KOL interaction

• Prepare charters and coordinate internal/external committee meetings including presentation preparation (i.e., Dose Escalation, DMC, Steering Committee, Safety)

• Participate in the development and review of study plans and serve as a liaison to project teams and CROs

• Prepare presentations for Investigator meetings, CRO/CRA training, SIVs as warranted

• Provide input for the development of publications in coordination with Scientific Communications

• Guide and mentor junior level Clinical Research Scientists

**Qualifications

**

• PhD, Pharm D, MS or equivalent degree preferably within the medical, biological, pharmaceutical science or related discipline

• Minimum requirement: 8+ years of experience in clinical research with at least 4 or more years of drug development experience (preferably in oncology/hematology)

• Significant experience working in a project-oriented matrixed team environment

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

• Proven experience working in teams

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic and goal orientated

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK730.320,00---1.095.480,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Every year, European governments spend billions on mobility: subsidies, contracts, licences, public transport. Most of that money is spent with no clear idea of what it buys for society.

We're building the tech layer that changes that.

**What We Do

**Impact Market builds MIMA, the Mobility Impact Market. On our platform, cities and transport authorities incentivise mobility operators (bike share, e-scooters, car-pooling, car sharing, bike leasing) for trips according to their benefit to society: a car trip replaced, emissions avoided, space and congestion saved, health improved, a neighbourhood connected. By estimating the socio-economic impact of each trip, we design smart incentives that get the most social value out of public funds.

The idea is much bigger than mobility: governments paying for the outcomes they want, with the evidence to back it up. Mobility is our first market, and we intend to move into other areas of public spending.

**Where we are

**

• A production platform (prod + staging), with live trip and rider-survey data from operators flowing in since August 2026

**The Opportunity

**The Coaching, Insights and Analysis group comprises three different teams and their mission is to help coaches and players better understand and learn from their matches through intuitive coaching and analysis tools. We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join us and help turn match data and video into products coaches rely on every day.

You’ll report to the Engineering Manager be part of a cross-functional product team working closely with engineers, product managers, and product designers to build and evolve these tools.

In this role, you’ll work across the stack: crafting intuitive frontend experiences, building scalable backend services, and contributing to systems that power Veo’s growing platform.

**What You Will Do

**

• Contribute across the full stack, building intuitive user interfaces while developing robust backend services and APIs.

• Take part in the full product lifecycle - from ideation and design to development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Build and maintain scalable systems that support Veo’s growing platform and user base.

• Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and data modeling that shape the long-term direction of the product.

• Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability in the systems the team owns.

• Collaborate closely with other teams across Veo, including AI and platform teams, to integrate insights and video-driven features into the product.

• Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through collaboration, code reviews, and shared ownership of the product.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment.

• Experience building and operating full-stack applications, with proficiency in backend technologies such as Python, Django or PGSQL, and well as TypeScript, Node.js and React on the frontend side.

• Openness to using modern AI tools as part of software development workflows, and curiosity about how they can shape the way we design and build software systems.

• A strong sense for building products that solve real problems and deliver value to users.

• Experience designing clean, maintainable systems, with sound judgment around architectural trade-offs.

• Comfort contributing across the stack and collaborating closely with Product and Design to shape user-facing features.

• A thoughtful approach to testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems.

• A growth mindset with curiosity for new tools, technologies, and ways of working.

• Interest in sports, video technologies, or data-driven insights is a plus.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Are you experienced in JavaScript and TypeScript and ready to take the lead on Front-End development for a fast growing B2B SaaS startup? Then we will be excited to hear from you!

**Who are we?

**Supplios is a fast growing start-up based in Copenhagen, developing an all-in-one supplier portal for global manufacturers.

As a manufacturer it is highly critical to have a streamlined, compliant and data-driven supply chain. However, most manufacturers manage the majority of their supply chain with spreadsheets, e-mails and with no unified system of record for supply chain related data. Where existing tools fall short, Supplios is designed to manage the ever-growing complexities in manufacturing supply chains.

Read more about us here www.supplios.com.

Our Supplier Portal is already used by customers in both the US and Europe and we are seeing a very strong demand from new customers. Therefore, we are looking for a new colleague to take lead of our Front-End architecture and development.

**Skills & Experience

****JavaScript/TypeScript Proficiency:

**

• Strong understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript.

• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

**Framework Experience

**

• Experience with at least one or more JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as Vue, React, Angular, Svelte, Next.js, or Nuxt.js.

• Solid understanding of the pros, cons, and tradeoffs of using frameworks, with both client-side and server-side rendering.

**Enterprise Application Experience

**

**Testing & Methodologies

**

• Proficiency in writing unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests for JavaScript/TypeScript applications.

• Experience working in an Agile development environment, using practices such as Scrum or Kanban.

**Good to know

**We have a great office in the heart of Copenhagen (Pilestræde) with lunch, great coffee and plenty of space where we would like you to be as much as possible, yet we also support flexible working hours and remote working when this is needed.

To have a good time, supporting each other and delivering a world class product along with a world class customer experience is the core of our DNA, and we expect all our colleagues to contribute in building an incredible company culture.

Everything we build immediately serves real people in real companies worldwide that are making products which affect our daily lives, from cars, to food, renewable energy, and much more.

Do you love turning menus and interfaces into something players actually enjoy clicking through, and want to own that from first sketch to final implementation? We’d love to talk to you.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're working on our most ambitious project to date: a new systemic open-world game built around a beloved IP, with our own spin on it. A bold new direction for us! And we're just getting started.

Now, we’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to join a team of around 15-20 people and own the UI/UX for the entire game. You’ll be the first dedicated UI/UX designer on the team (and at Triband generally!), so you’ll shape the game’s interface aesthetic and logic as well as player experience from the ground up.

**Here’s What You’ll Do Day To Day

**

• Own the full UI/UX pipeline for the game: from flow, wireframes, and mockups through to final in-engine implementation (we use Unity)

• Design and build UI elements like menus, icons, HUDs, and input controls that are clear, playful, and true to the game’s tone

• Bake in accessibility design and settings from the start, not as an afterthought

• Create dynamic transitions and animations that make the UI feel alive

• Implement your own designs solidly in Unity (you won’t be just handing off mockups!)

• Collaborate closely with game designers and programmers to keep the UI consistent, technically sound, and fun to use

• Maintain a consistent visual language and set of UI standards as the game grows

**You’re probably a good match if

**

• You have solid experience owning UI/UX work end to end, from flow through to final implementation

• You have strong Unity implementation skills and are comfortable taking your own UI work all the way into engine

• You’re skilled in Illustrator

• You have experience mocking up interactive flows in a tool like Figma, Miro, or similar (any tool is fine)

• You genuinely enjoy working within an existing visual style rather than starting from a blank page every time

• You’ve shipped a mobile game before, including responsive/adaptive interfaces

• You have a strong eye for color, shapes, contrast, and readability

**Nice to have

**

• A passion for accessibility and usability, especially for family-friendly/casual audiences

• You see real value in user testing and what it can teach you

• An interest in motion design and UI animation

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**This project is something new, but our ways of working are the same. We’ve always believed that games are made by teams, not solo rockstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. What we also believe in:

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them.

• You’re up for experimentation, and at the same time you don’t get too precious when the experience tells you you’re wrong.

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place.

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• This role is based in the Greater Copenhagen area, and we’re not considering people located outside of commuting distance for this one.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10–15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• A shot at shaping the interface of a live game played by millions

• A tight, collaborative team where your ideas actually make it into the game

• A playful work environment where trying the silly idea is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, and whatever else Tribanders turn into a tradition

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant, with plant-based options and soft ice on Thursdays

• Private health insurance paid by us

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Endless amounts of Noda

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide.

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make people laugh. We explore comedy through gameplay, which means we like to break player expectations, create surprising interactions, use great music and slick art, and build quirky worlds full of personality.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games. And we believe diversity makes teams better. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and who are excited to challenge us and our way of doing things.
