jobs.occupation: AI Red Team Specialist – Lead Researcher in Agentic Security
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced red teamer with proven credentials in agentic red teaming to join our advanced product and research team.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the team dedicated to building and developing a tool that dynamically tests and evaluates large language models (LLMs) and their native application context for vulnerabilities.

You’ll be working with seasoned reverse engineers, application pentesters, red teamers, and data scientists, bridging multiple digital disciplines by creating a unique suite that gives our clients the capability to test, remediate, and harden their agentic workloads.

What You’ll Bring

Most of all, we value ingenuity, curiosity, and drive. You may be a great fit for this role if you have experience with:

• Building or contributing to tools used for dynamic application testing

• Working extensively with open source or proprietary tools used for web and application pentesting

• Actively adopting LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in automating and enhancing your penetration tests

• Spending time researching agentic vulnerabilities and attending relevant trainings or conferences

To Fit Right In Here At The Tech Collective

• You should be genuinely curious about new developments within the red teaming domain

• You possess the willingness to tackle new and technical challenges as they arise

• You know how to break down and structure complex assignments and enjoy sharing your knowledge and insights with your team members

• You possess a startup mentality to help drive the innovation and ingenuity of our red team products

• You can cooperate seamlessly with different profiles in a highly diverse team of researchers, developers, consultants, and red teamers

We don’t expect you to know everything – after all, agentic security is a rapidly evolving field! In this role, we’re looking for someone who wants to own, develop, and innovate the product modules related to testing the application context (e.g., API security, cryptographic implementation, broken authentication, RBAC) and supporting infrastructure (e.g., misconfigurations, server-side vulnerabilities) for the agents that we test.

To succeed in this role, your experience and competencies should include:

Professional experience

• A minimum of five years’ progressive experience in enterprise red teaming or offensive research

• A proven track record of web application pentesting with an emphasis on remediation and hardening

• Experience defining and driving product roadmaps for red team tools (not required, but highly valued)

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technology stacks, including common cloud platforms (M365/Azure, Google, or AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered platforms and systems

• Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and the ability to bring technical assessments to life

Technical competencies

• Familiarity with both Mitre and OWASP frameworks, and experience applying them in client reporting

• Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, etc.) are a plus, indicating solid foundational knowledge and commitment to the offensive security field.

• Prior experience developing agent-specific attack types such as prompt injection, memory & context poisoning, or jailbreaking

• A working understanding of MCP, LLM pipelines, the functional aspects of LLMs, and how modern agent solutions are integrated with widely used cloud suites such as M365 or AWS

Finally, experience in intermediate to advanced vulnerability research related to applications or operating systems will be considered a strong plus, but is not a requirement for this role.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer you the opportunity to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development – whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you’re passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions or enquiries, feel free to contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu // +45 31717487.

Do you want to help shape global ethics and compliance in one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies? Would you like to use your legal and/or compliance expertise and pharmaceutical industry experience to help our organisation make the right decisions? Join Novo as a Senior Compliance Counsel in the Ethics & Compliance (E&C) Strategic Operations and Advice team.

Anchored within the Business Ethics Compliance Office (BECO), this role offers the opportunity to provide practical advice, strengthen global compliance processes and help turn our ethics and compliance strategy into action

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring strong ethics and compliance, legal or adjacent experience from a complex multinational environment, combined with the judgement to turn regulatory requirements into practical advice. You are comfortable building relationships across functions and communicating complex topics clearly.

• A degree in Law, Business or similar

• A strong professional track record from an Ethics & Compliance or Legal function

• Experience identifying, assessing and mitigating ethics and compliance risks

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clear and practical guidance

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Experience working in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology sectors or FMCG, either directly or through a relevant consultancy or law firm

**As a Senior Compliance Counsel, you will act as an expert and trusted adviser on global Ethics & Compliance (E&C) matters. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Operations and Advice, you will work with colleagues across our global Legal, Ethics & Compliance organisation and the business to identify risks and develop practical, compliant solutions. • Provide day-to-day guidance and training on ethics and compliance matters, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption policies and procedures, helping colleagues translate requirements into practical decisions.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy.

You can expect to use your strong design background to broaden your experience across the full development cycle, ensuring continued professional and technical development.

In this position, you will likely thrive the most if you naturally tend to take charge and support your colleagues. You may be a strong mechanical designer in your field, but you should also identify yourself with the values of Taking Charge and Team Up. If you have experience in driving technical development, that will certainly help you succeed in this role.

The role is based at **our Innovation Site in Ballerup, Denmark.

**

Key responsibilities

In this role, you will be in a key position in the development of Ambu’s future products. You can therefore expect to:

• Identify user needs, design inputs and specifications through participation in the project start-up phase where interaction with key opinion leaders, doctors and other experts worldwide is crucial to fulfil the ambitious innovation targets

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Learning-Based Multi-Agent Control under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
The Department of Electronic Systems at the Technical Faculty of IT and Design invites applications for a postdoc in learning-based multi-agent control under uncertainty, with applications to autonomous multi-robot systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments, as per February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is available for a period of 2 years.

Your work tasks   The position focuses on fundamental research in learning-based planning and control of interacting autonomous agents under uncertainty. You will develop new theoretical and algorithmic approaches for distributed and cooperative control, combining learning or online adaptation with principled treatment of safety, robustness, and performance. Research challenges include uncertain dynamics and disturbances, partial or noisy information, changing interactions between agents, and limited or unreliable communication.

A central part of the work will be to formulate rigorous methods and establish their properties, for example concerning stability, safety, constraint satisfaction, robustness, and convergence, where applicable. Depending on the research direction, the work may draw on learning-augmented model predictive control, safe reinforcement learning, data-driven modelling and safety mechanism (e.g. CBF), distributed optimization, or robust and adaptive control. You will develop reproducible numerical studies and simulations to examine the strengths, limitations, and scalability of the proposed methods.

The research will be carried out in the Horizon Europe ROX-6G project, where heterogeneous robot teams provide a compelling application for coordination under uncertain conditions and connectivity constraints. Although the position is primarily theoretical, you will collaborate with colleagues working on robotic implementation and will contribute to experimental validation. You will lead and co-author publications in international journals and conferences, engage with project partners, contribute to research planning and scientific discussions, and support knowledge exchange within the team.

Your competencies

We seek a researcher with a PhD in control engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, and a strong background in mathematical modelling, control, optimization, or multi-agent systems.

You should be able to formulate original research problems, develop and analyse rigorous methods, and demonstrate research quality through peer-reviewed scientific publications. Experience in learning-based control, robust or nonlinear control, distributed control, or decision-making under uncertainty is particularly relevant; expertise in every one of these areas is not expected.

You should have good scientific programming skills, for example in Python, MATLAB, or C++, and be able to evaluate algorithms systematically through simulation. We value independent research initiative, clear scientific writing, and the ability to work constructively with researchers from different disciplines and backgrounds. Experience with autonomous robots, ROS/ROS 2, multi-robot simulation, or physical robotic experiments will be considered an advantage, but is not a prerequisite for this primarily theory-oriented position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 600 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

The position is hosted in the Automation and Control Section, within a collaborative robotics research environment combining fundamental research with real-world applications.

In addition, you will work with an international team and research partners in ROX-6G, a European collaboration addressing autonomous robotic operations in demanding underground environments. Our research interests span safe and resilient decision-making, learning-enabled control, distributed multi-robot coordination, and validation in simulation and on robotic platforms. We encourage scientific independence, close exchange of ideas, and publication of high-quality research. More information: www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

The position is for 3 years, full-time (37 hours per week) and is open for appointment from March 1st 2027.

You will contribute to study planning, take responsibility for data management and statistical analyses of nationwide register data and large datasets collected in PREDICT, and contribute to the interpretation and reporting of the results, including co-authoring of scientific papers.

In addition to the biostatistical task, the position also includes the role of the primary technical contact person on our data infrastructure hosted on the National Genom Center’s HPC system. You will coordinate technical support, manage user access and onboarding, and assist researchers with data management, troubleshooting, and computational workflows. The role also involves ensuring secure handling of research data and contributing to the development and optimization of technical workflows.

•    A master’s degree in statistics or equivalent

•    Experience conducting statistical analyses in epidemiological research

•    Knowledge about time-to-event analysis and related statistical methods.

•    Strong programming skills in R and/or Python

•    Experience in working with Linux-based computing environments

•    Experience working on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems

Classification is based on competence, experience and seniority, with the possibility of negotiating qualification-based supplements.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Technical and administrative positions Academic (AC-TAP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the sections entitled “Academic Officer” and “Special consultant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Help build the next generation of technology leaders. EIFO backs ambitious Danish companies with the potential to become global leaders and strengthen Denmark’s competitiveness. As AI, advanced computing and quantum technologies reshape industries, we are strengthening our Frontier Technologies team. We are looking for an experienced Investment Director who combines solid investment judgment, deep technology insight and a passion for helping founders build globally competitive businesses.

About the role

You will identify, lead and develop investments across deep tech, AI, next-generation computing and quantum technologies, including the infrastructure, hardware and software enabling future technological breakthroughs.

From sourcing and investment execution to active portfolio development, you will work closely with founders, co-investors and industry partners to turn technological potential into commercial success.

Reporting to Sara Sande, Partner & Head of Frontier Technologies, you will collaborate with colleagues across EIFO and the wider innovation ecosystem.

What you’ll do

• Invest in promising technologies

• Source and lead investments from initial assessment through due diligence, negotiation and closing.

• Develop investment theses and assess technology, markets, teams and business models.

• Structure investments alongside founders and co-investors.

• Help build and scale companies

• Manage a portfolio of technology companies.

• Support founders on strategy, financing, governance and international growth.

• Contribute through board work, strategic sparring and follow-on investments.

• Strengthen our team and ecosystem

• Help shape EIFO’s Frontier Technologies investment strategy.

• Build relationships across the international investment community, research and industry.

• Share knowledge, support teammates, and help build a collaborative team.

What you’ll bring

You combine investment experience, commercial judgment and a deep understanding of technology.

We imagine you bring several of the following:

• Experience from venture capital, corporate venture, institutional investment or a similar environment.

• A track record of sourcing, evaluating and leading technology investments.

• Experience developing portfolio companies and working closely with founders, including board experience.

• Extensive experience in deep tech, AI, next-generation computing and/or quantum technologies.

• The ability to translate complex technology into clear commercial and investment perspectives.

You are intellectually curious, methodical and comfortable making decisions in uncertain environments.

You own your work, ask questions constructively and value collaboration. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues succeed.

We value different career paths and perspectives, alongside the skills and judgment needed to make sound investment decisions.

Why EIFO?

EIFO is Denmark’s sovereign investment fund, providing capital and risk-sharing solutions to Danish businesses, from startups to established companies expanding internationally.

At EIFO, you can invest in technologies that matter, work alongside motivated founders and help improve Denmark’s future competitiveness. You will combine investment responsibility with the opportunity to build companies and create lasting economic and societal value.

Are you our next colleague?

EIFO is partnering with Odgers on this recruitment. Please apply by email to Kristian Klint, Engagement Manager, at Odgers at kristian.klint@odgers.com, including your CV and application, as soon as possible and no later than 13 November 2026.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we kindly ask you not to include a photo, age or marital status in your application materials.

The recruitment process will include initial interviews with Odgers, followed by interviews with EIFO. Assessments are part of the process. References will be obtained with your consent, and you will be required to provide a criminal record certificate upon employment.

Desired start date is as soon as possible.

EIFO encourages candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Let’s build the future together.

About Denmark’s Export and Investment Fund

EIFO is Denmark's sovereign investment fund. We provide patient capital to startups, scaleups and growth companies while supporting Denmark's long-term competitiveness and innovation capacity.

Few investment platforms offer the combination of impact, access and long-term perspective that EIFO does. As Denmark's sovereign investment fund, we are uniquely positioned to connect research, entrepreneurship, industry and capital. This creates a rare opportunity to identify and support breakthrough technologies before they become global companies.

At EIFO, you will not only invest in companies - you will help shape the technologies, industries and capabilities that are critical to Europe's future competitiveness, resilience and prosperity.

The Frontier Technologies Team is a part of the EIFO Investment Team.

The department

Welltec is strengthening the Operations team in Esbjerg, Denmark, and actively recruiting for Field Engineer Trainee/Field Engineer positions. We have several openings and we are looking for both experienced and trainee levels.

The position

You will join a team of approximately 8 field engineers and you will be reporting to the Senior Service Delivery Manager.

As a Field Engineer at Welltec, you will receive exceptional training that will guarantee a successful career in diverse roles and responsibilities in the energy industry.

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and execute complex onshore and offshore operations across the European Continent.

• Perform job load-out and rig up/down at wellsite, both land and offshore environments.

• Follow detailed processes and procedures to maintain an industry leading level of service quality.

• Uphold a high level of customer service at all times.

• Undertake technical, safety, and shop/office responsibilities as assigned by the Operations Manager and Serive Delivery Manager

• Maintain equipment and facilities in an orderly and workable condition.

jobs.occupation: Student assistant for Metroselskabet – The Sustainability and Mobility Unit
jobs.description:
Would you like to help reduce the carbon footprint of public transport and infrastructure? And are you skilled at carbon calculations, LCAs, circular economy and similar tasks? Then we have an exciting and meaningful student job for you.

The Sustainability and Mobility Unit is looking for a student assistant to support a range of tasks, particularly within carbon calculations. Within sustainability, the Unit works especially with carbon reductions, circular economy and biodiversity, as well as ESG and reporting. The Unit is also responsible for analysing revenue and passenger numbers on existing lines, as well as planning new lines. As a student assistant, you will primarily assist with carbon calculations and the preparation of LCAs (Life Cycle Assessments) regarding Metroselskabet’s construction projects. In addition, you will be expected to contribute to various other tasks within both sustainability and the Unit’s other areas of responsibility.

Our ideal candidate has the following qualifications:

• Solid knowledge of, and preferably experience with, carbon calculations and LCAs

• Knowledge of the construction industry from a sustainability perspective

• Technical understanding of key materials used in construction projects, such as concrete and steel

• Experience with data processing and quantitative analysis

• Experience using Excel for managing large datasets

• Solid analytical and written communication skills

• Curious, service minded and able to work with minimal supervision on your tasks

• Is pursuing a relevant university degree (Bachelor's/Master's level), such as at DTU Sustain, Sustainable Cities (AAU), or another relevant programme, and have completed at least your 4th semester

• Comfortable in an environment where the language switches between Danish and English

• Some level of proficiency in reading and writing Danish is an advantage

Working at Metroselskabet

We offer an exciting student job with valuable practical experience at a high-profile organization responsible for the operation, maintenance and expansion of the Metro in Copenhagen and Frederiksberg. Metroselskabet has a clear goal to halve the carbon footprint from the construction of new metro lines and works broadly to improve its impact on society. You will be employed in the Sustainability and Mobility Unit, made up of experienced employees with diverse knowledge who work closely together – and across the organization. We take pride in delivering high-quality work, but we also place great emphasis on employee well-being and having fun along the way. The Unit consists of three teams – Sustainability, Planning, and Passenger Economy.

The working hours are approximately 15 hours per week on average and can be arranged flexibly around your studies and exam periods. Start date end of November 2026, or as soon as possible.

Contact information and application process

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Malene Linderoth, Team Manager for Sustainability, at +45 61 88 55 22.

Please send your application together with a transcript of your grades via the link no later than 4. november 2026. Interviews are expected to be held in week 46 or 47.

**Job Description

**_Business Analyst, Repair Services

_Curiosity in growing a business…

…customer minded…

…analytical & professional approach…

…collaborative spirit!

If this sounds like you, we’d love for you to join our international team which is based in Hamburg, Copenhagen and Singapore as the new Product Manager for Repair Services. Our business has been on a stable growth path in line with the market recovery - come along on our journey to continue this successful path and shape the future of Satair Repair Services!

**The Team's Mission

**Our mission is to ensure the commercial success of our product line, “Satair Repair Services” by driving its profitable growth. We hold the full ownership of our services - covering the repair, lease, and exchange of high-value structural aircraft parts (like flight controls) as well as avionics, and mechanical components from leading OEMs, and are in charge of the strategic and tactical steering of the product line.

**Your Role

**Based out of Copenhagen, you will play a central role in enhancing the overall business performance of the Repair Services product line. You will be involved in every stage of the product life cycle: from identifying new business opportunities and guiding partners through collaboration with Satair, to developing effective go-to-market strategies and tracking financial/operational performance. Working closely with cross-functional teams is essential to your success, as is monitoring the End to End (E2E) flow of business value from customer request to delivery.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Commercial Growth: Define go-to-market commercial strategies aligned with product line strategy and business objectives. Lead continuous improvement initiatives that directly drive business growth, managing them from concept to completion.

• Portfolio Evolution: Support enhancement and evolution of our portfolio

• Re-design Business Models & Asset Management: Analyze, map, and simplify complex organizational processes, technical dependencies, and business frameworks into clear, streamlined operational paths.

• Rapid Tool & App Co-Development: Collaborate with AI assistants (e.g., Gemini) and low-code/no-code platforms to rapidly design, prototype, and deploy internal apps and tools that solve corporate needs with the focus being on the business outcome.

• Analytics & Performance Steering: Collect, streamline, and analyze critical financial, operational, and technical data. Actively monitor leading KPIs on business health and initiate corrective measures. Transform historical data into forward-looking trends to enable timely, informed decision-making.

• Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Actively bring together focal points from the wider Airbus & Satair organization (Repair, Finance, Procurement, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Planning, Supply Chain, etc.).

**Desired Skills & Experience

**To be successful in this role, you must thrive in complexity, possessing the analytical depth to manage multifaceted tasks without losing sight of the details.

**Education & Professional Background

**

• A Master’s degree combined with 3 years of professional experience in a multinational B2B corporate environment in sales, product/program management, or supply chain, or in a role within aviation.

• Data Storytelling: High proficiency in data analytics with the ability to translate raw numbers into a compelling narrative and well-designed executive summaries.

• Proficient use of SAP or other ERP systems is a strong plus.

• Comfortable participating in business reporting processes and establishing quantifiable deliverables.

**Interpersonal Skills & Mindset

**

• Change Agent: Brings fresh ideas, challenges the status quo, and suggests highly efficient, scalable workflows rather than settling for the status-quo

• Stakeholder Management: A skilled communicator with excellent presentation and interpersonal skills, capable of aligning diverse cross-functional global stakeholders.

• Resilience & Decision-Making: Strong business acumen, maturity, and self-confidence. Ability to juggle multiple topics simultaneously and make firm, data-driven decisions.

• A diplomatic and strategic mindset.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Are you passionate about shaping a more sustainable future and would you like to play a key role in Vattenfall’s transition to cleaner energy? Do you want to help drive the development, construction, and operation of our offshore wind portfolio? Vattenfall is looking for a Senior Consent Manager to strengthen its Offshore Consenting team in Denmark.

The Offshore Consenting team is an international team with representation in all Vattenfall’s key markets. We are involved throughout the offshore wind value chain, from pre-tender, through the tendering phase, project delivery, and throughout the operational phase. We are responsible for securing permits for Vattenfall’s offshore wind portfolio, and for enabling permit compliance during project delivery and operations.

In Denmark, Vattenfall and its partners are operating 5 offshore wind farms, including the Vesterhav Nord and Syd projects that were fully commissioned in 2024. Beyond our current portfolio, we have been awarded the two new Danish projects Hesselø and North Sea Central both including an onshore and offshore scope.

What will you do?

As Senior Consent Manager, you will play a pivotal role in enabling our offshore wind projects in Denmark. You will act as a coordinator and problem solver within the organization, working together with different teams and disciplines. In addition, you will be a key contact person externally towards authorities. For this position we are looking for a candidate with a strong profile within onshore permitting and environmental conditions, e.g., experience from onshore grid infrastructure projects in Denmark.

Consenting Strategy

• Analyse Consenting requirements, risks, and opportunities to support project execution

• Deliver and implement a Consenting Strategy in development and construction of the projects in collaboration with the offshore scope.

Obtain Consent

• Understand, anticipate and communicate which permits, laws and regulations are applicable to our projects;

• Ensure timely application for and receipt of permits, licenses and dispensations

Enable Consent Compliance

• Actively track and manage our permit requirements and commitments;

• Work with project teams and packages to enable full permit compliance of their respective scopes;

• Engage with and report to both local and state authorities.

Steer Consent

• Monitor and anticipate regulatory developments with a potential impact on our permits.

• Contribute to regulatory developments directly through consultations, or via our industry associations or interest groups.

Location

Copenhagen or Kolding.

Qualifications

You have an analytical mindset coupled with strong project management, communication- and interpersonal skills. You can structure and process complex information and discern implications for our business and can communicate clearly with various stakeholders and secure quality and timelines in projects.

You have experience working in international and multidisciplinary teams and thrive in a dynamic environment, skillfully managing multiple tasks under tight deadlines. Your excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills allow you to build and maintain positive relationships across diverse teams. You can work well independently and in collaboration with others and have the dedication to see a task through despite challenges. Above all, you consistently prioritize health and safety in all aspects of your work.

You can have fun whilst being serious and are serious about having fun.

Next to this you bring:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in the fields of biology, environmental science, spatial planning, or another relevant field;

• Knowledge of onshore environmental and spatial planning regulations;

• Ideally you have +5 years of relevant experience. Alternatively, you have gained (permit management) experience in other renewable energy, or other large infrastructure-, industrial-, or construction projects;

jobs.occupation: Team Leader, Evening Shift - Fruit & Vegetables Salling Group, Terminal Holme
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy bringing people together, creating structure and making things happen? Are you motivated by developing others while ensuring that daily operations run smoothly – even when things get busy? Then you might be our new Team Leader for the evening shift in Fruit & Vegetables at Terminal Holme.

At Salling Group, we believe that good leadership is not just about having a title. It is about taking responsibility, setting clear expectations and helping others succeed.

We are looking for a leader who understands that strong performance and employee well-being go hand in hand.

**Your role – leading people and delivering results

**As Team Leader, you will be responsible for the daily operations of our evening shift, working closely with the Department Manager and your fellow leaders.Our evening shift operates from 12:00 to 20:00, and you will play a key role in ensuring that our colleagues have the right conditions to succeed and that our stores receive their deliveries on time.Your main responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop your team: Create direction, communicate expectations, provide feedback and support the development of colleagues and future leaders.

• Ensure strong daily operations: Plan staffing and resources, coordinate priorities and maintain an efficient operation with a high level of delivery accuracy.

• Drive continuous improvement: Challenge existing routines, involve colleagues in finding better solutions and use KPIs and LEAN principles to improve performance.

• Take ownership of safety and well-being: Create a working environment where everyone is treated with respect, safety comes first and challenges are addressed rather than ignored.

• Follow up and take action: Conduct daily team meetings, follow up on productivity, absence and performance, and ensure that decisions turn into action.

You will report to the Department Manager and become part of the Team Leader group at Terminal Holme.

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who wants to make a difference – both for the business and for the people they lead.

You are comfortable making decisions, including the difficult ones, and you understand that being a good leader sometimes means having honest conversations.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from warehouse operations, logistics or a similar operational environment.

• Have leadership experience or have demonstrated a strong ability to lead and develop others.

• Communicate clearly and confidently in both English and Danish.

• Are structured, solution-oriented and able to maintain an overview when priorities change.

• Take responsibility, follow through on commitments and lead by example.

Most importantly, you are genuinely interested in people. You listen, involve your colleagues and are willing to challenge them when needed.

We do not expect you to have all the answers. We do expect you to take ownership, be curious and have the courage to act.

What can you expect from us?

At Terminal Holme, we supply fresh fruit and vegetables to Bilka and føtex stores across Jutland and Funen.

You will join an international working environment with colleagues from many different backgrounds, where English is a natural part of everyday communication. Our operations run around the clock, and strong collaboration across shifts is essential.

You will become part of a leadership team that values open dialogue, accountability and continuous development.

Our leadership culture is built around a Culture of Care – where we care about our colleagues, challenge each other constructively and never compromise on safety or respect.

You will have the opportunity to influence how we work, develop your own leadership skills and contribute to building an even stronger team.

As part of Salling Group, you will also have access to our employee benefits programme, offering a range of attractive discounts and benefits across Salling Group's stores and businesses.

As an Agile Delivery Manager at RiskPoint, you will become part of a growing IT-organisation, working closely with colleagues across technology and the business. You will play a key role in driving delivery across teams, functions, and external partners, both in Denmark and the rest of the world.

As an Agile Delivery Manager at RiskPoint, you will play a central role in turning priorities into structured and predictable delivery. You will be responsible for coordinating work across teams and stakeholders, establishing a clear delivery rhythm, and ensuring that dependencies, risks, and decisions are identified and addressed at the right time.

This position goes beyond traditional project management. You will support agile ways of working, helping teams plan, prioritise, and deliver effectively, while respecting the responsibilities of Product Owners and the teams' ownership of their day-to-day activities.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office, with occasional domestic and international travel.

Drive day-to-day delivery coordination across multiple teams, stakeholders, and external partners

Turn agreed priorities and outcomes into clear, realistic, and well-sequenced delivery plans

Facilitate planning sessions, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant delivery meetings

Create and maintain a transparent delivery rhythm with clear milestones, commitments, and follow-up

Identify and coordinate cross-team dependencies and help resolve blockers before they affect delivery

• 
Maintain clear visibility of progress, risks, issues, decisions, and required escalations

• 
Coordinate release and implementation activities, including readiness, testing, approvals, communication, and handover

• 
Help teams apply practical agile methods suited to the work, rather than following a fixed framework for its own sake

• 
Support continuous improvement of delivery practices, governance, collaboration, and ways of working

• 
Provide clear and concise status updates to stakeholders and management

• 
Help build a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, cooperation, and reliable follow-through

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken Danish and English is required.

For this position, we are looking for a structured, proactive, and collaborative Agile Delivery Manager who thrives on creating clarity, driving progress, and bringing people together across teams and functions.

You have a relevant educational background in business, technology, project management, or a related field. However, your practical experience and ability to turn priorities into tangible results are more important than your formal qualifications.

We expect you to have a minimum of 4–5 years of professional experience in agile delivery, project delivery, Scrum Master roles, delivery coordination, or a similar position. Experience planning and coordinating delivery across several stakeholders, teams, or external partners

The ability to identify dependencies, risks, blockers, and decisions and ensure they are followed through
