jobs.description:
Context & Environment

Application deadline: 11-11-2026

Contract type: Local, Esbjerg

Appetizer

Do you want to turn cybersecurity requirements into clear governance that people can actually follow? Are you excited by the challenge of protecting both enterprise and industrial environments? Do you enjoy partnering with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and driving risk-reducing actions through to completion? In this role, you will help implement cybersecurity policies and governance, ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements. If this sounds like the kind of impact you want to make, apply now and tell us what you would bring to the team.

Your new team

One IT Denmark delivers the IT and digital services that keep the business running onshore and offshore. We work closely with colleagues across the organization to improve reliability, introduce new solutions, and strengthen cybersecurity.

The department includes four teams: Business Partnering, IT Operations, Project & Performance, and Cybersecurity & Industrial. Together, we support TotalEnergies EP Denmark (TEPDK) and TotalEnergies Upstream Denmark (TUDK) operations and development projects.

In a department with different nationalities and backgrounds, we believe in the power of diversity and collaboration. People are the key to our success; we invest in development and foster an atmosphere of innovation.

Would you like to help shape better energy?

Send your application as soon as possible. For any questions, you are more than welcome to reach out to Human Resources (HR) Recruitment on ep.dk-recruitment@totalenergies.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Activities

Key areas of responsibility

Cybersecurity governance and support

• Help shape and maintain local cybersecurity governance, aligned with group standards and Danish regulations, across both enterprise and industrial systems

• Turn security requirements into practical guidance, templates, and ways of working that teams can apply in day-to-day operations

• Support incident response by investigating and following up on cybersecurity incidents, working with central Headquarters (HQ) teams, local teams, and external service providers.

• Perform systematic vulnerability assessment and vulnerability management

• Assist definition and follow-up on cybersecurity requirements in 3rd party contracts to manage supply chain related risks.

Cybersecurity risk assessment activities

• Manage cybersecurity risk assessment activities

• Identify gaps against security requirements and agree on feasible remediation actions with system owners and business stakeholders

• Build and track remediation plans for vulnerabilities and approved exceptions, and report progress to stakeholders

• Advise project teams and vendor/contract owners on cybersecurity requirements and risk-reducing controls

Operational procedures and security

• Help define and improve security procedures and technical controls (hardware and software) to reduce risk

• Strengthen incident readiness and response by helping define roles, playbooks, tooling, training and supporting response activities during major incidents

• Contribute to training, presentations, and communications to raise cybersecurity awareness in the organization

• Collaborate with teams in central Headquarters (HQ) and other affiliates and share feedback from the Denmark organization

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 669,750 - DKK 893,000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

Candidate Profile

Who we are looking for

• BSc in Information Security (or similar) or at least 10 years of IT experience

• Minimum 5 years of cybersecurity experience

• Knowledge of, and preferably practical experience with, NIS2 directive related Danish Executive Order on resilience and preparedness in the energy sector (No. 260)

• Experience with Industrial Information Systems / Operational Technology (OT) environments is an advantage

• Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to translate requirements into practical guidance

• Structured, analytical approach to risk-, incident-, and vulnerability management

**_Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

_**As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

****Technical Leadership

**

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

**Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

**

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

**AI Services & Agentic Development

**

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

**CI/CD & Reliability

**

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

**Job Requirements

****Education & Experience

**

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

**Soft Skills

**Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Challenges you will work on

Do you thrive in an environment where analysis, planning, and operational decision-making go hand in hand?

As a Flight Dispatcher at SAS, you will play a key role in our flight operation. Working closely with pilots and colleagues in the Operations Control Center, you will be responsible for flight planning, operational follow-up, and support for our intercontinental operations. This role is well suited to someone who is motivated by responsibility, collaboration, and making well-informed decisions in a business that operates around the clock.

SAS Flight Dispatch is part of the SAS Operations Control Center, offering a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

Your responsibilities include

• Preparing flight plans and operational documentation for SAS' intercontinental flights.

• Performing analyses and weight calculations for range-critical routes.

• Working with Flow Management to support an efficient flight operation.

• Monitoring flights and ensuring continuous operational follow-up.

• Providing operational support to pilots and operational management.

To be successful, we believe you have

• Valid Scandinavian FOO (K) licence or equivalent.

• Valid ATPL licence or completed ATPL theoretical training.

• For candidates whose highest qualification is completed ATPL theory, a passing result in the Danish Civil Aviation Authority's Flight Dispatcher examination is required before permanent employment can be offered.

• Relevant experience from the aviation industry.

• Fluency in written and spoken English and at least one Scandinavian language (Danish, Norwegian, or Swedish).

You thrive in an operational environment where the pace can be high and conditions can change quickly. With a structured approach and the ability to prioritize, you maintain an overview even when handling several tasks simultaneously.

As a Flight Dispatcher, you are a team player who values close collaboration and clear communication. You work closely with pilots, colleagues in the Operations Control Center, and other stakeholders to ensure that the right information reaches the right people at the right time. You actively contribute to joint solutions, take a service-minded approach, and understand the importance of collaboration in supporting a safe and efficient flight operation.

You are flexible, adaptable, and enjoy working in an organization that operates 24/7, 365 days a year.

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As Project Manager Real Estate & Facility Management at SAS, you will be responsible for leading and delivering real estate, workplace, refurbishment, and construction projects across Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport. jobs.description:
Are you a proactive and results-driven professional eager to make a significant impact in the green energy sector? Semco Maritime is offering a unique, temporary opportunity for an Associate Category Manager to join our team for a minimum of 12 months maternity cover.

**Your position

**As an Associate Category Manager for Indirect Spend you will play a pivotal role in leading category strategies across various sectors including facility management, professional services, travel, and more. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in negotiating and driving cost efficiencies while promoting sustainable practices within the supply chain.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your workplace will be located at our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, positioned at the heart of the Danish energy industry with stunning waterfront views. This is a full-time, temporary maternity cover for a minimum duration of 12 months.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**As an Associate Category Manager, your primary responsibility will be to support our Group Support Functions, including HR, Marketing and IT, with strategic procurement and day-to-day purchasing activities. You will also manage indirect spend, with particular responsibility for facility management, including Travel.

• Group Support Functions: Partner with functions such as HR, Marketing and IT to understand their requirements and provide procurement support aligned with business needs.

• Contract Negotiation: Lead and support supplier negotiations to achieve competitive pricing and favourable terms and conditions.

• Purchase Order Management: Coordinate and issue purchase orders, follow up on invoice handling and help ensure compliance with the procurement-to-pay process.

• Cost Management: Maintain visibility of expenditure, support budget control and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve commercial value.

• Indirect Spend and Facility Management: Manage relevant indirect spend categories, including facility management services, and support effective supplier performance and service delivery.

• Group Travel: Manage the travel category across the Semco Group, including supplier relationships, commercial agreements, cost optimisation and stakeholder support.

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**We are looking for an outgoing and positive individual who is passionate about indirect spend and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to enhance your skills within the department.

• Minimum experience of 2 years in Strategic Procurement or a related commercial field, experience in indirect spend is advantageous but not required.

• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills, capable of interacting effectively across diverse cultures and functions. Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively.

• Positive, proactive, and a team player with the autonomy to operate independently.

The role requires a detailed understanding of the LIMS and Empower systems used by QC and its maintenance requirements. The IT system administrator will own the system validation packages, the SOPs, and associated training packages.

You will be joining a small team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory. The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency oriented direction. You will report to the Associate Director of QC Support, Laboratory systems and Equipment.

Experience in leading projects and driving cross-functional initiatives/stakeholders

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Role

The Senior Manager, Global Regulatory Labeling Operations plays a key role in leading labeling operations for the EU and Rest of World (RoW) markets, while providing support for U.S. labeling activities. The role is responsible for the timely delivery of compliant, high-quality, submission-ready labeling documents and packaging components, including mockups and artwork, across assigned markets. As a subject matter expert in Regulatory Labeling Operations, the Senior Manager provides strategic and operational guidance on labeling requirements, oversees complex labeling activities, and works closely with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to support regulatory submissions, product launches, and lifecycle management.

The Senior Manager also contributes to the continued development and optimization of Genmab’s global end-to-end labeling processes, systems, and capabilities, helping ensure they remain efficient, scalable, compliant, and aligned with evolving regulatory requirements and industry standards. This is an individual contributor role at Senior Manager level. The role reports to the Director, Global Regulatory Labeling Operations and is based in Denmark.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a Regulatory Labeling Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) for EU and RoW markets, providing guidance on regulatory requirements and operational strategy, and acting as a key SME in driving the resolution of complex labeling issues and escalating significant compliance, business, or strategic risks to functional leadership.

• Lead the planning and delivery of compliant, high-quality, submission-ready labeling documents and packaging components, including prescribing information, patient leaflets, mockups, and artwork.

• Manage EU Linguistic Review activities and coordinate the review and approval of translated labeling documents.

• Ensure labeling deliverables meet applicable regulatory requirements and Genmab standards for quality, accuracy, consistency, and compliance.

• Support labeling operations for regulatory submissions, including new marketing applications and lifecycle submissions, as well as product launches and ongoing product maintenance.

• Oversee external vendors and partners responsible for labeling deliverables, monitoring quality, compliance, timelines, and performance and driving improvements where needed.

• Monitor and interpret evolving EU and RoW labeling requirements and industry standards, assess their operational impact, and communicate relevant changes to key stakeholders.

• Utilize labeling, artwork, and electronic document management systems to support content lifecycle management, review and approval workflows, version control, and inspection readiness.

• Partner closely with Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective planning and execution of labeling activities.

• Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of global end-to-end labeling processes, tools, systems, infrastructure, SOPs, and work instructions.

• Identify opportunities to improve labeling processes and operational efficiency and influence implementation across functions and geographies.

• Represent Global Regulatory Labeling Operations in cross-functional initiatives, governance forums, and strategic discussions that impact labeling processes, systems, and capabilities.

• Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members, supporting knowledge sharing and capability development within the function.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 5+ years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with demonstrated experience in regulatory labeling and/or regulatory operations.

• Strong knowledge of EU labeling requirements and experience supporting labeling activities across international or RoW markets.

• Working knowledge of CTD format and content for EU regulatory submissions.

• Experience managing labeling documents, packaging components, artwork, and/or translation and linguistic review activities.

• Experience working with electronic document, labeling, or artwork management systems; experience with Veeva or similar platforms is an advantage.

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex deliverables, priorities, vendors, and timelines in a global, cross-functional environment.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of U.S. labeling requirements is an advantage.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail and a quality- and compliance-focused mindset.

Sky‑Watch A/S is a leading Danish drone company that since 2009 has specialized in the development, production, and servicing of high‑technology mini UAS systems for Defense – nationally and internationally. With more than 155 dedicated employees and a strong international growth journey underway, Sky‑Watch today stands as one of the most innovative players within tactical mini UAV systems. At Sky‑Watch, robust, reliable, and advanced drone systems are developed for demanding environments and critical situations where predictability, mechanical durability, traceability and user safety are paramount.

As an ambitious scale‑up company in rapid development, Sky‑Watch is fully aware that ensuring our products, processes, and organization consistently meet the highest standards for quality, safety, and compliance is essential to our continued success in a global, highly regulated defense market.

To strengthen the company’s QHSE team, we are now looking for a passionate, inspiring and proactive QHSE Director.

Global Quality Leadership – Full Value Chain Impact – Operational Reliability

Do you want to take a central role in shaping how a high‑tech defense company secures reliability, compliance and world‑class product integrity on a global scale? As the new QHSE Director at Sky Watch, you will own and continuously evolve the company’s Quality and HSE foundation, ensuring that our products, processes and teams operate at a consistently high and predictable standard across the entire value chain.

You will be responsible for safeguarding Sky-Watch’s Quality Management System, driving compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001 and AQAP, and enabling stable, scalable execution in an increasingly demanding international defense environment. Through strong cross functional leadership and data driven governance, you will strengthen decision making, reduce operational risk, accelerate execution stability and help deliver a dependable customer experience built on safety, performance and traceability.

Joining Sky‑Watch means stepping into a fast‑growing scale‑up where reliability is a strategic differentiator — and where your expertise will directly influence both day‑to‑day operations and the company’s ongoing global growth journey.

You will report directly to the CEO, including direct leadership responsibility for the QA Manager and dotted line leadership of the QC Manager.

In this role, you act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Management Team, providing clear, fact based recommendations on quality, risk and compliance, and contributing actively to strategic decision‑making at enterprise level.

Your key responsibilities include:

• QHSE Strategy & Policy

• Sky‑Watch QMS (AS9100 / ISO 9001 / AQAP)

• Quality Governance & Risk Management

• Digital QHSE & Data Governance

• Continuous Improvement & NCR / CAPA

• Supplier Quality Requirements & APQP / PPAP

• Manufacturing Quality & QC oversight

• Audits & Compliance

• Health, Safety & Environment (in collaboration with the Health & Safety Organization / AMO)

• People Leadership & Cross‑functional Collaboration

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing or a related technical field, combined with at least 10 years of experience in global Quality/QHSE leadership within regulated, high‑tech industries with full value chain such as defense, aerospace or equivalent.

You have demonstrated strong results in defect reduction, execution stability and QMS maturity, and you bring hands on experience with MRB, concessions, PPAP and supplier audits. You possess deep knowledge of AS9100, AQAP and ISO 9001 requirements and are comfortable working with lifecycle product safety in a regulated environment.

You work confidently with structured problem‑solving and quality methodologies such as RCA, FMEA, Control Plans and capability analysis, and you are experienced in configuration and document control to ensure consistency and traceability. In addition, you bring strong digital QHSE literacy, using data governance, dashboards and digital adoption to create transparency, support sound decision making and drive continuous improvement across the organisation.

You are based within approximately one hour’s driving distance from Støvring and are willing to travel around 20–30 days per year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. You are proactive and structured, balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, and remain calm and focused in a fast‑changing environment. With a strong analytical and curious mindset, you are able to translate complex quality, risk and compliance topics into clear, actionable messages that create understanding, alignment and strong buy‑in across senior leadership and the wider organization. You work collaboratively across functions, build trust with key stakeholders, and act as a credible role model for quality, integrity and professional judgement.

Are you the new QHSE Director at Sky‑Watch in Støvring? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion.

For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

**

As Experienced IT Specialist in the IT Excellence team, you will take ownership of key transformation and continuous-improvement initiatives, moving between strategic thinking, practical design, stakeholder alignment and hands-on execution. Your key responsibilities will include

• Shape and improve our IT operating model and product-led ways of working, translating ambitions into our product lifecycle model, roadmaps, roles, and processes.

jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?
At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.
Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership
As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.
Your key responsibilities
• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.
• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.
• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.
• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.
• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.
• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.
• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.
• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.
• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.
• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.
• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.
• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.
• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.
• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.
• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.
• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.
• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.Your personality makes the difference
For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.
• Analytical and detail-oriented: You approach technical challenges systematically, question assumptions, and base your decisions on facts and sound engineering judgment.
• Results-driven and accountable: You set ambitious but realistic expectations, take ownership, and follow through to ensure that objectives are achieved.
• Structured and quality-conscious: You value precision, consistency, and well-defined processes and are unwilling to compromise on safety or critical quality requirements.
• Assertive and constructive: You are willing to challenge ideas, address difficult issues, and stand by your professional assessments while respecting different perspectives.
• Demanding but supportive: You set high standards for yourself and others, provide clear feedback, and help your team develop the skills and confidence to succeed.
• Proactive and improvement-oriented: You identify opportunities, challenge inefficient ways of working, and drive improvements that increase efficiency, standardization, and cost competitiveness.
You have the confidence to lead experienced technical specialists, the credibility to earn their respect, and the ability to create an environment where clear expectations, professional discussions, and shared accountability lead to strong results.
What you can expect from us
At Gram Equipment, you will have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise with leadership responsibility in an engineering environment where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

You can look forward to:

• A challenging and varied role combining hands-on engineering with people leadership.
• Responsibility for a team of skilled technical specialists.
• The opportunity to influence technical decisions, engineering standards, and ways of working.
• The opportunity to drive standardization, engineering automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
• Close collaboration across engineering disciplines and other business functions.
• The opportunity to make a visible impact on team performance, technical quality, and project delivery.
• A working environment that values ownership, professional expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• A flexible working approach, with the position primarily based in Kolding and opportunities for hybrid working.Ready to take ownership and make a difference?
If you are a technically strong engineer who enjoys taking the lead, making decisions, and driving high standards while improving engineering efficiency and cost competitiveness, this could be your next career opportunity.

Our operations team is looking for a Finance Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will work closely with our software engineers and operations team to help shape the future of finance in property management.

To be quite frank: if you currently work with bookkeeping in property management, you probably know the pain. Too much manual work, outdated systems, endless reconciliations, and processes built around software from another decade.

We want to change that. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to rethink and shape how bookkeeping and accounting workflows should work for our customers' property portfolio.

Right now is the best time to join because you’ll help define both the role and the systems behind it as we scale across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by legacy software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and financial administration to remove unnecessary friction and human error from the rental experience.

Rumli is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property manager.

We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with operations and product to improve financial workflows and internal systems.

• Handle day-to-day bookkeeping: ensure our automations work as intended across reconciliation, vendor invoice management, payroll and financial administration for the properties we manage.

• Ensure financial accuracy: Manage balance sheet reconciliations, payments, VAT handling, and monthly, quarterly and yearly accounts.

• Help improve the system: Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows and help the product team decide what to automate next.

• Operate at scale: Use modern tools and automation to manage a portfolio size that would be difficult in a traditional setup.

• Support the business: Assist with designing the reporting, budgeting, on- and offboarding of new properties, and ad hoc finance tasks as we continue to grow.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have experience with bookkeeping, accounting, or financial administration – ideally within property management or a related industry.

• Done with manual work and outdated processes: You’ve worked with legacy bookkeeping and already have opinions on how finance workflows could be smarter.

• Detail-oriented: You care about accuracy and structure without losing sight of the bigger picture.

• A systems thinker: You enjoy improving processes, not just following them.

• Comfortable with IT systems: You have worked with different software, like e-conomic, before and are quick at adopting new ones.

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish and comfortable working in English.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable taking ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment.

****What you’ll get

****Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen.

• Daily lunch, drinks and snacks at the office.

• Private health insurance.

• 30 days of paid holiday.

We're looking for people, not bullet points on a CV. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If this sounds like you and you want to build something that matters with people who care, we'd love to hear from you.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Senior Associate Accounts Payable is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role delivers high-quality Accounts Payable execution, supports month-end and audit processes, and acts as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of the Finance team, this position contributes to strong financial governance, VAT compliance, and continuous process improvement, supporting the company's scalability and commercial performance. The role is a full-time position and reports to the AP Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Process and validate supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding, proper approvals, VAT compliance, and high-quality data integrity.

• Manage supplier communication and vendor onboarding, resolving invoice and payment-related queries in a timely, structured, and service-oriented manner while coordinating effectively with internal stakeholders.

• Perform monthly reconciliations, including vendor statement reconciliations, vendor subledger reviews, and balance sheet reconciliations to ensure financial accuracy and completeness.

• Support month-end closing activities by ensuring Accounts Payable accuracy and timely reporting in line with internal controls and accounting standards.

• Contribute to audit processes by providing documentation, analysis, and reconciliation support to ensure compliance and transparency.

• Drive continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes by identifying inefficiencies, enhancing controls, and supporting automation or standardization initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes. You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift. Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

If you love taking a new feature to market, and turning it into something people actually understand and want, you'd rather build it yourself than write a brief about it, and AI is already how you work every single day - come join us!

_Our teams are shipping crazy fast right now. New modules in weeks, months, not years. And we think we have the best product in the space. (No bias.)

Which means there's a LOT to talk about.

But talking about it isn't enough. Every new feature needs to be turned into something a busy operator gets in two seconds. Why should I care? What does it fix for me? How does it fit with everything else?

That's the job. Owning that, all of it. Making sure the product, sales, CS and marketing all tell the same simple story. And building the system so it reaches our own team, our customers and the market - without anyone telling you what to do next.

If you want to be the person who leads All Gravy's product marketing, keep reading!

**🥞 The mission

**All Gravy is the frontline operating system. One platform for comms, learning, engagement, operations and scheduling, with built-in AI. Think WhatsApp meets Duolingo meets Claude for frontline workers. Used daily by 350+ brands like GAIL's, Dishoom, 7-Eleven, and Honest Burgers.

We're growing 3x year-over-year, and the product is moving faster than ever. We need product marketing that keeps up.

**🎯 The role

**You own product marketing. Fully.

Nobody hands you a task list. You decide what releases matter most, what we say, how we say it, and what gets created. And then you build most of it yourself. Copywriting skills, good taste in graphic design, website savviness is needed.

**🔥 What You'll Do

**

• 
Know our customers better than anyone. You dig into sales calls, customer interviews, reviews and our founders' heads. You know who we're for, and who we're not for.

• 
Own positioning. You make the hard choices about what we stand for and what we leave out, so we stand out in the market.

• 
Turn features into selling points. Product ships something new, you find the value in it and say it so simply a customer gets it in one line.

• 
See the whole picture. Every feature is part of a bigger story. You know where it fits, who it's for and how to serve it.

• 
Build the launch system. How big is this release? Who needs to know first? Sales, CS, customers, the market - you make sure it lands everywhere.

• 
Keep every touchpoint telling the same story. Website, sales deck, ads, socials, in-app. If we built it, it's on the site - and ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude know about it too.

• 
Drive adoption, not just launches. Product updates, changelog and in-app messaging, so customers actually use what we ship and stay longer.

• 
Give sales and CS what they need. Messaging, one-pagers, demo flows, battlecards. Stuff they actually use.

• 
Make the content. Landing pages, emails, explainer videos, clickable demos. Mostly you, with AI.

**🧠 Who you are

**

• 
You drive your own stuff. You pick your initiatives, set your priorities and run with it. We give you a goal, not a to-do list.

• 
You're obsessed with simplicity. Fewer words, fewer features in the pitch, one clear message. You'll push for the simple version even when it's super hard to dig out.

• 
You're fast. 80% in a day, ship it, make it better next week. You don't sit on things.

• 
You're AI-first. AI is how you work, it does most of your work and you fine-tune the rest. You use it for research, as a sparring partner and to build. You code, you design, you generate. You max out your tokens, because you can't help it. The shift has already happened here - for example, we build our website in Webflow with the Claude MCP - so you can make changes to anything, in minutes, and publish a new version of the site 10 times per day.

• 
You can write and you can sell. You find the one line that makes people go "oh, now I get it". In engaging English.

• 
You get product marketing. Big plus if you’ve owned launches and positioning in B2B SaaS, and you always start with the customer, not the feature list.

• 
You're the glue. You speak product with product, sales with sales, and get everyone running in the same direction.

• 
You have an eye for design. Taste, detail, a feel for what looks good. Big plus.

• 
You're excited about where this is going. The gap between an idea and getting it done is basically zero now. That should make you excited, not tired.

**🚩 Probably not for you if

**

• 
You do your best work when someone hands you clear structure and concrete projects.

• 
You work the same way you did three years ago.

• 
AI is something you use now and then, or something you're "starting to explore".

• 
You've got 15-20 years in product marketing but AI hasn't really changed how you work. For us, the way you work beats the years on your CV.

**📍 Practical

**

• 
Copenhagen, Nørrebro. Hybrid.

• 
Full-time.

• 
You'll work closely with marketing (video, events, growth), product, sales, customer success and our founders.

_Do you want to shape the future of analytics for the world's largest jewellery brand? Are you passionate about using data, insights, and technology to drive growth, influence strategy, and unlock commercial opportunities? Then you could be the Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights we're looking for.

_As Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights, you will play a pivotal role in defining and driving Pandora's global eCommerce analytics agenda. This is a highly visible leadership position at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and digital growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. Leveraging a deep understanding of digital performance, customer behaviour, and commercial drivers, you will identify opportunities to accelerate growth, optimise performance, and strengthen Pandora's global eCommerce business.

Leading a team of analytics professionals, you will combine strategic thinking, business acumen, and analytical expertise to ensure data remains at the heart of decision-making across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities

**Commercial insights & business partnering

• Act as a trusted analytics partner to Global eCommerce leadership, shaping priorities and key business decisions.

• Identify growth opportunities across traffic, conversion, customer and product performance, and turn them into clear commercial recommendations.

• Lead deep dives into the key drivers of eCommerce performance and translate findings into actions that move the business.

Forecasting & performance management

• Own forecasting and performance measurement that support commercial planning and trading decisions.

• Define the KPIs and frameworks used to track and steer eCommerce growth.

• Continuously sharpen analytical approaches and decision-making tools.

Analytics strategy & Centre of Excellence

• Define the analytics strategy, priorities and roadmap for Global eCommerce.

• Lead Pandora's global eCommerce analytics community and set the standard for how analytics creates business value.

• Build analytical and commercial capability across the organisation through coaching and knowledge sharing.

eCommerce analytics platforms

• Act as business owner of Pandora's key eCommerce analytics platforms, ensuring they answer the questions that matter most to the business.

• Lead the Centre of Excellence around these platforms, connecting business needs with technology teams and vendor partners.

• Ensure stakeholders can rely on trusted, decision-ready data.

Team leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing analytics team.

• Build capabilities in analytics, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.

• Foster a collaborative, curious and commercially minded culture.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**We imagine that you bring significant experience within eCommerce analytics, commercial analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, combined with a passion for translating data into business value and strategic impact.

**Furthermore, We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Extensive experience working within eCommerce, digital, or commercial analytics environments.

• A strong track record of using analytics and insights to influence business strategy, trading performance, and commercial outcomes.

• Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data-driven recommendations.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to broader commercial objectives.

• Experience identifying growth opportunities and proactively defining analytical priorities and agendas.

• Experience leading and developing high-performing analytics teams.

• Strong knowledge of digital performance analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• Experience acting as business owner of web analytics platforms, ideally Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools.

• Experience setting the analytics agenda and ways of working within a global organisation.

• Experience working in complex, matrixed, international environments.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical approaches.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A continuous improvement mindset and passion for cultivating data-driven cultures.

**We Hope To See That You Are

**

• A commercially minded analytics leader who naturally connects data to business outcomes.

• A strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers of performance.

• Comfortable moving between executive-level discussions and analytical deep dives.

• Curious, proactive, and confident challenging assumptions with data and insights.

• An inspiring people leader and coach.

• A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and translate analytics into actionable recommendations.

• Skilled at influencing stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced international environment.

• Passionate about driving business performance through customer, commercial, and digital insights.

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora's Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights team, a critical function enabling data-driven growth across our global digital business.

Working closely with commercial, trading, marketing, product, technology, and analytics stakeholders, you will help shape the future of eCommerce analytics at Pandora and ensure insights play a central role in how we grow and evolve our digital business.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band: 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

jobs.description:
If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AIT Quality Engineer, you’ll be:

• Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer within Real-Time Computer Vision
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled embedded software developer with a passion for cross-platform development for multiple SoC targets? Do you also enjoy turning sophisticated mathematics into high-performing and robust implementations? Do you thrive working with the best of the best in your field in a collaborative setting in the very heart of Copenhagen? If so, we have the opportunity for you!

3Shape is looking for a talented Senior Embedded Software Developer to join our Reconstruction Software Area. As a world leader in this domain, we have driven the field’s evolution for decades and are setting the future standard. This is your opportunity to thrive, learn and contribute to cutting-edge solutions used daily to improve dental health around the world.

You will be joining a collaborative and creative team of over twenty Computer Vision and Software professionals at the absolute forefront. You will team up with great system developers, signal processing experts and mathematicians, many of us with PhDs, forming one of the strongest 3D and computer vision teams in Denmark. Being the leader for decades means our problems yet to be solved and solutions yet to be created are the most challenging and rewarding ones. A challenge we address with collaborative efforts of great minds. In a nutshell, our team turns 2D sensor data into 3D and renders the resulting 3D model. The team has the complete ownership of the area spanning research, signal processing, product development, maintenance, tooling, and test automation. As a member of the Reconstruction Software Area, you will team up with one or more colleagues working on an initiative, which could be a longer-term research project or implementing a product improvement hitting the market near-term. In addition, you will act as a sparring partner on other initiatives and take part in our weekly educational sessions.

About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.

This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.

What You’ll Do

• 
Build real-time 3D computer vision components in C++ and GLSL, targeting both ARM and x86 platforms.

• 
Write, test and benchmark your modules, and take ownership of their performance and accuracy.

• 
Help establish a clean, efficient cross-platform development setup (toolchains, testing, benchmarking and CI) that makes development on every target fast and enjoyable.

• 
Write and optimize demanding shader code for OpenGL and OpenGL ES.

• 
Accelerate CPU algorithms with SIMD (NEON and SSE/AVX), and hand-write intrinsics where the compiler falls short.

• 
Work closely with hardware engineers to get the most out of each target device.

• 
Have fun!

What We’re Looking For

• 
5+ years of professional C++ development on performance-critical applications.

• 
Solid experience with GPU programming in GLSL or a comparable shading language.

• 
Proven experience with streaming and tiling strategies for high performance on devices with limited cache.

• 
A deep understanding of how compiled code maps to the hardware (CPU pipelines, memory access patterns, caching and vectorization) on both ARM and x86.

• 
Experience in computer vision, ideally with registration, filtering and 3D data.

• 
An analytical mindset with attention to performance, scalability and maintainability, and a Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

• 
Curiosity, drive and intellect to understand challenging problems in depth.

Nice To Have

• 
Experience with VTK and its rendering pipeline.

• 
Experience with sparse volumetric data structures and signed distance fields (e.g., OpenVDB, voxel hashing).

• 
Cross-compiling with Clang and CMake, and testing ARM targets with QEMU.

• 
Experience with Eigen.

• 
Knowledge of existing libraries that can be used for cross-platform development.

• 
Experience with SLAM or 3D reconstruction.

What 3Shape Offers

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
Good work/life balance e.g., work from home policy for up to 2 days per week.

• 
An international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 35 nationalities in our DK based office

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Purpose: Endeavor to improve dental patients on a global scale.

Staying true to our values and D&I efforts, we encourage all relevant applicants to apply, and we ask you NOT to add any photos or sensitive information (age, marital status, nationality) during the application process.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: PhD positions in Algebraic Hardness and Applications (AHA) at IT University of Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The IT University of Copenhagen invites highly motivated individuals to apply for a PhD position starting in September 1, 2027, or soon thereafter. 

We invite applicants who want to contribute to the IT University's vision of creating and sharing knowledge that is profound and leads to ground-breaking information technology and services for the benefit of humanity. 

Job description
To be eligible to apply for these positions, the applicants are expected to have a good background and passionate interest in mathematics and computer science, demonstrated by having credited relevant courses such as Complexity Theory, Advanced Algorithms, Probability Theory, Real and Complex Analysis, Calculus, and Combinatorics. Or they may be demonstrated by results at the Olympiads of Mathematics or Informatics, or by publication in relevant internationally recognised conferences or journals.

Applicants need to be motivated for doctoral studies; should possess the ability to work independently and perform critical analysis; and additionally, have good levels of communicative abilities and English language skills. The working language of the group is English, and knowledge of English is also fully sufficient to navigate every-day research life in general.

General information
The IT University of Copenhagen (ITU) is a teaching and research-based university specializing in information technology (IT) and the opportunities it offers. The IT University has more than 160 full-time Faculty members. Research and teaching in information technology span all academic activities which involve computers including computer science, information and media sciences, humanities and social sciences, business impact and the commercialization of IT.

Research at the IT University of Copenhagen
Our research is organized through dynamic research groups, centers, hubs, and labs that promote collaboration across disciplines. These units explore complex challenges at the intersection of people, technology, and society, contributing both to fundamental insights and practical solutions. At ITU, we see research as a shared endeavor – open, critically engaged, and rooted in dialogue with academic communities, industry, and the public sector. We actively pursue international partnerships and networks, and our interdisciplinary approach ensures that our research not only advances knowledge but also generates impact beyond academia.

Teaching at the IT University of Copenhagen
ITU currently offers four BSc degrees, six MSc degrees and one professional master’s degree, spanning across these disciplines. ITU's educations are extremely sought after and produces qualified graduates who are in high demand from the job market.

Working at the IT University
Located in modern architecture, a 6-minute metro ride from the center of Copenhagen, the IT University offers an informal working environment, a varied everyday life, and a highly motivated, innovative, skilled, and diverse international faculty, with PhD degrees from more than 20 different countries. The IT University is an equal opportunity employer and prides itself in actively pursuing an improved gender balance among students and among faculty.

Working in Copenhagen
Copenhagen has a solid educational system, a rich cultural life, universal healthcare, good childcare, and well-functioning infrastructure. Copenhagen is consistently ranked among the world’s most livable cities according to the Economist Global Liveability Index. Living and working in Copenhagen will typically be a great experience for you and your family.

Salary and terms of employment
Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Taxation’s agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and job structure for academic staff at universities.

Qualification Requirements
The following qualifications are required:

• 
3-year programme: candidates should have an MSc (or equivalent)

• 
4-year programme: candidates should have a BSc and one year of university studies on Master level

 The applicants will be employed and enrolled at the ITU University for a period of 3 or 4 years depending on the university degree level of the applicant. 

Application
The application and all other documents ought to be in English and must include:

• 
A motivated application (cover letter), including a detailed description of your qualifications

• 
A full CV, including name, address, phone number, e-mail, previous and present employment and academic background

• 
Documentation of academic degrees (copy of degree certificates etc.)

• 
A statement of purpose, which provides evidence of independent thinking, novelty and originality, of the targeted research field matching the project description

• 
Documentation of English proficiency (see link below to the PhD Admission Requirements)

• 
Relevant scientific publications or/and master thesis written by the applicant (Not required but optional)

 Applications without the above-mentioned required documents will not be assessed.

Please read the guidelines for applicants carefully before filling in the application form. You can see the guidelines through this link. 

The applicant will be assessed according to the Appointment Order from the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation of 13 March 2012.

The IT University may use shortlisting in connection to the recruitment process. In case of shortlisting, the Chair of the hiring committee selects applicants for assessment in consultation with the hiring committee after the application deadline. All applicants are notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The shortlisting of candidates for assessment is based on the criteria in the job posting. 

Further information
Questions about the positions can be directed to Professor Nutan Limaye, IT University of Copenhagen, nuli@itu.dk. Early contact with our faculty staff is encouraged.
Questions related to the application procedure may be directed to HR, hr@itu.dk.

Application procedure

You can only apply for this position through our e-recruitment system. Apply by pressing the button "Apply for position" in the job announcement on our website.

The IT University might upon request in the interview process contact 1-2 references.

Application deadline: December 1, 2026, at 23:59 CET.

Applications/enclosures received at ITU after the application deadline will not be taken into consideration. If you submit an application, it is your responsibility to ensure that it arrives before the deadline so please allow sufficient time for the upload of publications and other documents.

At The IT University of Copenhagen, we have an international environment and view diversity as a valuable resource. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive working environment for all our employees and encourage all qualified applicants, regardless of age, gender, religious affiliation, or ethnic background to apply for the position.

As ITU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.
