jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment
The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description
You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile
We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.
• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets. 
• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.
• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.
• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).
• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project
Who we are
The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students). 

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network. The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer 
• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.
• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.
• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.
• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.
• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.
• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.
Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information
Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579). 

Deadline
All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026. 

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Community of Practice (CoP) Lead, Global Sales
jobs.description:
The Global Sales CoP (Community of Practice) Lead connects global commercial strategy with regional execution through coordination, facilitation, and governance. The role combines community leadership, planning support, stakeholder alignment, and project delivery.

• Leads the monthly CoP agenda and quarterly Deep Dives, turning discussions into clear decisions, accountable owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

• Participates in monthly business reviews with regional and local management and contributes to local commercial planning. This keeps the role close to market realities, provides markets with a direct link to Global, and ensures global priorities are represented in discussions.

• Success requires strong listening and facilitation skills, sound business judgment to focus discussions on the most important topics, effective stakeholder engagement, knowledge sharing, and timely follow-up.

• The role sits within Global Sales, which encompasses Sales Excellence (performance data and global processes), Field Force Effectiveness, the Sales Cloud design and roadmap, and Pricing Excellence.

• The role reports into the Field Force Effectiveness team to maintain a close connection to the markets, while collaborating across all Global Sales functions and particularly with Marketing, Training, and Service, which have similar Community of Practice roles.

• The Global Sales team is a dynamic, multinational group with diverse sales backgrounds. This role is central to the team’s engagement with markets, while the monthly CoP meetings address topics from across Global Sales through a focused agenda.

The Demant Hearing Aid business operates through a shared Commercial Plan. The Global Sales Community of Practice (CoP) Lead is responsible for driving the successful execution of the Commercial Plan by connecting global strategy with local market execution. The role serves as a facilitator, coordinator, and business partner, ensuring alignment between Global Sales, market leadership teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.

As a lead within Global Sales, the role creates a platform for collaboration, knowledge sharing, and disciplined execution. The CoP Lead ensures that strategic priorities are translated into actionable initiatives, regional work maintains momentum, and commitments from planning forums, deep dives, and governance meetings are followed through to completion. The role also supports ad hoc regional projects.

Key Responsibilities

We are looking for two positions, one focusing on EU/Nordics and one focusing on US/Canada & High Growth Markets (HGM).

Community of Practice & Knowledge Sharing

• Lead the regional Community of Practice, aligned with Commercial Plan priorities.

• Foster cross-market collaboration, best-practice sharing, peer learning, and continuous improvement.

• Consolidate market insights, challenges, and opportunities to inform regional and global priorities.

Commercial Planning & Execution

• Support regional Commercial Plan development, annual planning, budgeting, and execution.

• Translate strategic priorities into clear initiatives, actions, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

• Monitor progress and help address barriers, risks, and dependencies impacting execution.

Business Reviews & Deep Dives

• Plan, coordinate, and facilitate quarterly market Deep Dives and other key business discussions.

• Enable fact-based discussions on performance, opportunities, challenges, and transferable practices.

• Ensure discussions result in clear decisions, actions, accountable owners, and follow-up.

Regional Projects & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Lead and support cross-functional regional initiatives across markets and functions.

• Align Global, Regional, and Market stakeholders around priorities and deliverables.

• Ensure clear governance, ownership, timelines, dependencies, and progress across commercial plans, projects, CoP activities, and business reviews.

• Drive accountability and escalate material risks or delays as needed.

Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Project Management, or a related field; Master’s/MBA preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in sales, commercial operations, business development, or a comparable commercial role.

• Demonstrated experience working across regional, international, or matrix organizations and leading cross-functional initiatives.

• Hands-on experience with sales execution, business planning, governance, and strategic execution processes.

• Proven ability facilitating workshops, business reviews, planning sessions, and stakeholder alignment.

• Requires hands-on sales execution or commercial excellence experience, ideally gained in a market-facing role within a large international company, preferably in med-tech.

• Candidates may also come from a local role and be ready to move into a regional or global position.

Success Measures

• Progress and delivery against agreed Commercial Plan priorities and regional initiatives.

• Effective quarterly Deep Dives resulting in clear decisions, ownership, actions, and measurable outcomes.

• Strong Community of Practice engagement, with effective sharing and adoption of best practices across markets.

• Timely and transparent execution and follow-up of agreed actions and commitments.

• Successful delivery of regional projects and cross-market initiatives, supported by strong stakeholder alignment and collaboration.

Knowledge & Competencies

• Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, facilitation and influencing skills, including the ability to drive outcomes without direct authority.

• Skilled translator of strategic priorities into structured plans, clear ownership, actions, and follow-up.

• Strong business acumen and ability to use performance information to support fact-based discussions and decision-making.

• Strong communication, collaboration, organization, and project management skills.

• Ability to balance recurring governance and planning activities with evolving regional business needs.

Expected Travel

The role involves approximately 5% of travel for planning and regional initiatives.

Ready to join?

This is a full-time position based at our headquarters in Smørum, in the Greater Copenhagen area.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation through our online application portal no later than November 13th, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Jacob Melchior, Field Force Effectiveness Lead, at jcem@demant.com.

We expect to conduct first-round interviews in week 47 and second-round interviews in week 48.

At Demant, we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and are committed to fostering an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, or educational background. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA, and we particularly encourage women in STEM fields to apply, supporting United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

We are looking for an experienced QA professional who is comfortable taking ownership and navigating new or unfamiliar areas. As a Senior Manager, you will also act as a subject matter resource within your areas of responsibility, providing quality guidance and advice to stakeholders and contributing to compliant and risk-based decision-making.

This is an individual contributor role at Senior Manager level. The position is based in Denmark and reports to the Director of QA GMP, Commercial & Lifecycle - Storage and Distribution.

**

Responsibilities**

• Plan and conduct GxP audits of external vendors and partners and contribute to audit planning, follow-up and continuous improvement based on audit observations and trends.

• Take ownership of vendor oversight activities, including vendor risk evaluations, quality agreements and follow-up on the performance and compliance of GDP vendors.

• Independently manage operational GDP quality activities, including external notifications, change controls, deviations and other quality issues involving external partners.

• Participate in and support recall operations for the EU market in collaboration with the global QA GMP team and external partners.

• Contribute to shipping lane validation/qualification and perform GDP risk assessments related to storage, transportation and supply chain operations.

• Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of quality systems, SOPs and work instructions.

• Represent QA GDP in cross-functional and global projects, taking ownership of QA deliverables within assigned areas.

• Perform shipment release and support EU serialization activities.

• Support implementation and maintenance of GDP training.

• Participate in regulatory inspections and internal audits.

• Maintain knowledge of new and updated GDP regulations and guidelines and translate relevant requirements into practice.

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations and other stakeholders to ensure compliant distribution practices.

• Handle and contribute to continuous improvement of Product Complaint intake and investigations.

• Take on new quality topics and assignments as business needs evolve, independently building the knowledge and stakeholder network needed to bring activities forward.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in science or related field.

• You have 8+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with significant experience within Quality Assurance and GxP. Experience within GDP and commercial distribution is preferred but not required.

• You have solid experience conducting GxP audits and are comfortable acting as an auditor. Audit experience is a requirement for this position.

• You are proactive, curious and comfortable taking ownership of assignments, independently navigating new or unfamiliar areas and finding solutions where the way forward is not predefined.

• You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills and can establish effective relationships across functions, geographies and with external partners.

• You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable asking questions, challenging constructively and making quality decisions within your area of responsibility.

• You must already be based in Denmark at the time of application, and you are willing to travel approximately 50% of the time across Europe, the United States, and the rest of the world on a long-term basis.

About You

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose.

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do.

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving.

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team.

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative.

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to).

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK607.920,00---911.880,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a Regional Commodity Manager and become a vital procurement partner for business stakeholders across Northern Europe, focusing primarily on the Danish market. In this dynamic role, you will lead the implementation of procurement strategies, governance, and sourcing initiatives while managing supplier relationships. You will collaborate closely with the Indirect Materials organization, identifying commercial opportunities and contributing to sourcing strategies that drive value through supplier optimization and cost improvements. Engage with regional procurement teams, global commodity managers, and suppliers to enhance procurement performance and create a sustainable business impact.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Drive regional procurement initiatives and implement global sourcing strategies across Northern Europe, particularly in Denmark.

• Develop and execute sourcing, tendering, negotiation, and contract management activities.

• Analyze spending, supplier, and market data to uncover savings opportunities and optimize supplier portfolios.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partner to ensure supply continuity and support business objectives.

• Promote procurement governance and compliance while monitoring supplier performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

What You Bring

• A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in procurement, category management, or strategic sourcing within an international and matrix-based organization.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with a balance of strategic thinking and pragmatic execution.

• Experience in indirect materials procurement and supplier management, with knowledge of procurement governance and buying channel strategies.

• Fluent English skills are required; additional Nordic language skills are a plus.

About the Team

You will be part of Siemens Energy’s Procurement organization, joining a collaborative team focused on indirect materials. This role offers a unique opportunity to bridge regional procurement leadership and commodity management. You will enhance stakeholder engagement while supporting the development and implementation of category strategies within Office & Factory Supplies. Together with colleagues across Procurement and our BPO partner, you will contribute to Siemens Energy’s procurement transformation, driving standardization, digitalization, and sustainable value creation.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.

At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

Application

Don’t hesitate to apply before the 10th November 2026. Ongoing selection is applied; the role might be filled before the last application date.

Location: 9220 Aalborg DK

_Are you passionate about ensuring complex IoT and connectivity solutions perform reliably before reaching customers? Do you thrive at the intersection of system architecture, embedded firmware, verification, and AI? And do you want to help shape the future of verification and validation for connected products in a modern engineering organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Test Manager, Connectivity Solutions, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, performance, and release readiness of our connectivity products, embedded firmware, and integrated solutions.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Systems Engineers, Firmware Developers, and Hardware Engineers, you will drive verification activities across disciplines and help shape the future of testing within the Water Division.

More specifically, you will be:

• Defining and driving the verification strategy throughout the product lifecycle

• Leading verification activities across firmware, hardware, connectivity, and integrated solutions

• Ensuring traceability, test coverage, and alignment from requirements to release readiness

• Driving AI-enabled verification, test automation, and modern quality engineering practices

• Building and strengthening the capabilities, processes, and governance supporting the future test organization within the Water Division

Combine hands-on technical impact with strategic influence as you drive verification excellence, shape future testing practices, and help bring innovative connected solutions safely to market.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting to the Director of Connectivity, you will join the Solutions Architect team within the Water Division. Working alongside specialists in connectivity, embedded systems, wireless communication, system architecture, and product development, you will help ensure our solutions are verified and validated before release.

You will be part of an informal and collaborative environment characterized by strong technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and a shared commitment to delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Test Manager who thrives in complex engineering environments and brings structure, quality, and continuous improvement to the verification of connected solutions. Combining analytical thinking with a pragmatic approach, you are comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and driving quality through collaboration, automation, and emerging technologies.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, and have experience testing embedded, firmware-based, connected, or IoT products

• Understand systems integration, and acceptance testing and can develop effective verification strategies and test plans from product requirements and used cases

• Have hands-on experience with Python, embedded C, test automation, and embedded systems debugging

• Collaborate effectively across hardware, firmware, connectivity, and software domains with both specialists and project stakeholders

• Take ownership, communicate clearly, and drive continuous improvements through automation, AI-enabled verification, and modern quality engineering

Experience with wireless communication technologies, Grafana, test management tools, requirements management, systems engineering practices, or AI-assisted verification is considered an advantage.

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Director, Connectivity, Kristen Kasper Hansen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Help shape operational excellence across our global logistics network

Do you want to help create smarter, more connected and future-ready logistics operations across Arla?

In this senior leadership role, you will play a key part in shaping operational excellence across our global logistics network. Working closely with colleagues across sites, markets and central functions, you will help translate strategy into practical standards, processes and solutions while strengthening the capabilities needed to support consistent and sustainable operational performance.

“You will lead our Operational Excellence team and  collaborate closely with logistics sites, market teams and central functions. Together, you will develop, test and embed solutions across both insourced- and outsourced operations,” says Jakob Hartvig, Head of Center of Excellence – Logistics.

How you will make an impact

As Head of Operational Excellence in Logistics CoE, you will help connect global ambition with local execution. You will inspire and provide functional leadership across the logistics network, create clarity on priorities and responsibilities, and work with stakeholders to ensure that improvements  create meaningful and measurable operational value.

In this role you will

• Shape and drive the global strategy and long-term roadmap for logistics operational excellence, aligning priorities and resources across sites, markets and functions.

• Define, implement and continuously improve common logistics standards, SOPs, playbooks and process taxonomy, while strengthening continuous improvement capabilities through approaches such as Lean, A3 and PDCA.

• Develop  and embed the Arla Performance System for logistics, including performance meeting standards, operational KPIs, dashboards, benchmarking and links to financial performance and the SQCDMP balanced scorecard.

• Further advance on the digital transformation of logistics by identifying, assessing and scaling high-value use cases across AI, machine learning, IoT, automation and other smart logistics technologies.

Foster a strong operational excellence network across Arla, by supporting capability building,  change adoption while drawing on external insights and proof-of-concept activities.

What  will help you succeed

You bring  experience within operational excellence, continuous improvement,  logistics transformation or a related field, and you are motivated by creating sustainable improvements in complex environments . You are comfortable working across organizational and geographical boundaries and understand the importance of balancing global consistency with local needs.

You combine strategic thinking with a practical mindset and enjoy engaging with diverse stakeholders to create solutions that work in practice.

We imagine that you bring

• Relevant experience within operational excellence, supply chain, logistics

• A degree in Economics, Supply Chain or related field or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and data-driven performance management frameworks.

• Experience with digital transformation, automation or smart logistics solutions. Leadership experience, either through people leadership or matrix environments

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills

As a leader, you create  direction by translating complexity into clear priorities and actionable plans. You build trust by listening and being curious, involving local market stakeholders and adapting solutions where appropriate. At the same time, you maintain focus on delivering sustainable outcomes and continuous improvements.

What do we offer?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of logistics across Arla and create impact at network scale. You will work with experienced colleagues across markets, sites and central functions, combining global perspectives with practical operational expertise. The role offers broad exposure, meaningful transformation opportunities and the chance to contribute to the development of people, processes and digital solutions that strengthen safety, quality, service, cost and sustainability performance.

We are committed to professional development and a collaborative culture where knowledge is shared and improvements are built together. You will join a farmer-owned, international business with a clear purpose and the ambition to make nutritious dairy products while continuously improving how we operate.

Would you like to join us?

Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we process applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Jakob Hartvig, Head of Logistics Center of Excellence, at jakob.hartvig@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Operational Network Planner - Viby J or Krusaa
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supply chain planning within an End-2-End perspective and motivated by making operational decisions that create value across the entire value chain? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where customer focus, stakeholder management and data-driven decision-making go hand in hand? Then this could be the opportunity for you. We are looking for an Operational Network Planner for CBP Krusaa cluster.

“Joining the Krusaa Cluster Planning team, you will be part of planning the supply of speciality cheese products across a complex and dynamic supply chain. Working closely with Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help connect customer demand with production and supply. If you thrive in an operational environment, enjoy collaborating across functions and want to make a real impact, this could be the opportunity for you” says Christine Carstensen, Supply Chain Network Planning Manager.

The role can be based either in Krusaa or Viby J. To support close collaboration with the planning team and production sites, colleagues based in Viby J are expected to spend a minimum of one day per week in Krusaa.

Read more about Supply Chain at Arla here Inside Arla.

How you will make an impact

As an Operational Network Planner, you will play a key role within the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) horizon, ensuring that we deliver excellent service levels to customers while balancing production capacity, inventory levels and waste reduction across markets and warehouses.

You will join a highly collaborative planning team consisting of 6 Site Schedulers, two Operational Network Planners and one Component Planner, supporting five production sites. Working closely with colleagues across Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help drive operational decisions that create value across the end-to-end supply chain.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Optimizing supply chain performance through root cause analysis and data-driven decisions.

• Monitoring relevant KPIs and implementing corrective actions to achieve targets.

• Conducting scenario planning to mitigate availability risks, reduce waste, and assess the impact of demand fluctuations on finished goods.

• Escalating unresolved short-term imbalances to global or local S&OE executive forums and key stakeholders.

• Leading proactive dialogue between Supply Chain and Commercial teams to solve complex issues.

• Identifying and contributing to optimization initiatives from an end-to-end perspective.

What will make you successful

You are an ambitious and structured professional with strong analytical skills and the ability to work across multiple functions. You thrive on collaboration and have a natural ability to engage with stakeholders from across the business.

You are motivated by change and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of ways of working and collaboration.

We imagine you

• Hold a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Business or a related field.

• Have experience within supply chain planning, logistics or manufacturing, preferably working within S&OE or short-term planning horizons.

• Are comfortable analysing data and using insights to support operational decisions.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders across different functions and organisational levels.

• Are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement and optimisation.

• Are able to communicate effectively both in Danish and in English

What do we offer?

An inclusive corporate culture that creates job satisfaction is important to us, and we prioritize giving our employees good development opportunities. We are looking for you who want to grow with us at Arla Foods!

Arla Foods has a collective agreement and always offers good and competitive working conditions. In addition, we have a high priority on safety and the working environment.

About Arla

We are Arla – a European dairy cooperative with over 19,000 employees and around 8,600 farmers. Our cooperative model creates a unique closeness to our farmers – the owners of Arla – and motivates us every day to deliver the very best for our farmers, colleagues, our milk, our consumers, and our environment.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible. We process applications on a continuous basis and close the position once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions, please contact Supply Chain Network Planning Manager, Christine Carstensen at +45 91 31 58 03.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description:
**Lead a global compliance function and help shape how compliance enables the business

**Are you an experienced compliance, privacy or GRC leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of regulation, business and technology?

Do you thrive in a role where you can set direction, lead experienced professionals, advise Executive Management and the Board, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions?

Then this could be your opportunity to lead Aeven's Group Compliance function.

**The role

**As Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer, you will lead the Global Group Compliance organisation of approximately 27 professionals across four teams and three countries.

You will have overall responsibility for the strategy, direction and development of the function, covering:

• Group Data Protection and the DPO function

• Regulatory Compliance

• Enterprise Risk Management

• Internal Audit

• ISO and external assurance

• Customer and supplier assurance

• Responsibility / ESG

You will lead primarily through your managers, creating clear priorities and accountability while empowering highly specialised teams to own their areas.

The role combines strategic leadership, independent oversight and senior business advisory. You will work closely with Executive Management and the Board, providing a consolidated view of Aeven's compliance, privacy, risk and assurance position and highlighting where action or decisions are required.

At the same time, you will work closely with the business to translate regulatory and customer requirements into clear, proportionate and commercially workable solutions.

****Your responsibilities

• Set the strategy, priorities and roadmap for Group Compliance and lead, coach and develop the management team.

• Advise Executive Management and the Board on significant compliance, privacy and risk matters and provide clear, decision-oriented Management Information.

• Act as Group DPO and oversee Aeven's data protection framework, including significant privacy risks, breaches, regulatory engagement and international transfers.

• Lead the organisation's approach to regulatory developments, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA-related customer requirements, AI Act, Data Act and digital sovereignty.

• Own the Enterprise Risk Management framework and consolidated enterprise risk view, while ensuring risk ownership remains with the business.

• Oversee Internal Audit and Aeven's broader certification and assurance landscape, including ISO and ISAE activities.

• Provide senior oversight of customer and supplier due diligence, audits and regulatory assurance requirements.

• Support significant incidents, investigations, escalations and remediation across the organisation.

• Continuously develop and modernise the function through simplification, automation, better Management Information and effective use of compliance technology.

A key part of the role is ensuring that compliance enables the business rather than unnecessarily slowing it down.

****Your experience

****We are looking for an experienced leader who is comfortable operating where regulation, risk and business strategy meet.

You bring:

• A relevant Master's degree, for example in Law, Business/Commercial Law or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience within compliance, data protection, GRC or a related area, including several years leading managers and international or multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong GDPR and data protection expertise, including DPO experience.

• Proven experience advising C-level executives and Boards and communicating complex risks through clear Management Information.

• Experience with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit and assurance.

• Working knowledge of ISO management systems (ISO9001, ISO27001 and ISO14001) and ideally ISAE 3000/3402 reporting.

• Knowledge of EU digital and cyber regulation, including NIS2, DORA, AI Act and Data Act.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international, regulated or technology-driven organisation is an advantage, as is experience with privacy certification, GRC technology, customer assurance, ESG or transformation.

**Who You Are

**You are a trusted and credible advisor who can challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building strong relationships across the organisation.

You lead through trust, clear direction and empowerment, and enjoy developing managers and creating high-performing teams.

You are strategic but pragmatic, with strong business understanding and the judgement to balance regulatory robustness with commercial realities.

You communicate complex issues simply, drive follow-through and are comfortable raising risks and challenging established ways of working.

Most importantly, you bring integrity, sound judgement, independence and a genuine desire to make compliance work for the business.

**Why Aeven?

**This is an opportunity to take on a broad and influential leadership role at the centre of Aeven's governance and business operations.

You will lead a highly skilled international team, work directly with senior leadership and the Board, and help shape how a technology-driven organisation responds to an increasingly complex regulatory environment.

If you are motivated by leadership, influence, complexity and the opportunity to make compliance a genuine business enabler, we would like to hear from you.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp! At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**_Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic, global environment? SimCorp offers a unique opportunity to join our finance team as a Group Transfer Pricing Director.

_For over five decades, SimCorp has been at the forefront of providing integrated investment management solutions. With a global team of over 4000 professionals from diverse backgrounds, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and innovative workplace.

The Group Transfer Pricing Director will be an integral part of our tax team, a specialized subset within Group Finance. Our team is responsible for overseeing the tax and transfer pricing compliance and strategy across all 40+ SimCorp entities.

Based at our headquarters in Copenhagen, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape SimCorp's transfer pricing strategy and ensure compliance across our global operations.

Reporting directly to the Global Head of Tax, your primary responsibility will be to lead the transfer pricing team and devise SimCorp's transfer pricing strategies. Your team will be responsible for the tax modeling, documentation, and devising transfer pricing procedures.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Group Transfer Pricing Director, you will play a critical role in supporting SimCorp’s global organization by providing transfer pricing solutions. Your work will involve analyzing and enhancing transfer pricing structures, ensuring compliance with global regulations, and continuously implementing improvements in our transfer pricing models.

You will be responsible for reviewing the transfer pricing documentation for SimCorp A/S and its subsidiaries. This includes leading the team to draft reports, collect and analyze financial data, and collaborate with subsidiaries' finance teams and other internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and compliant reporting. We take pride in contributing to SimCorp’s growth through high-quality work. We value a collaborative working environment where we balance hard work with an approachable and collaborative spirit.

As a Group Transfer Pricing Director, you will:

• Devise new transfer pricing policies and update existing policies to ensure compliance with OECD guidelines and local regulations.

• Develop vision, strategy and structure of the group’s transfer pricing models in the rapidly changing environment, including APAs.

• Guide the transfer pricing team to prepare and maintain comprehensive transfer pricing documentation for SimCorp A/S and its subsidiaries in collaboration with the finance teams.

• Review changes in global transfer pricing legislations and ensure the group’s transfer pricing models are efficient and compliant.

• Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, including finance, legal, and business, to ensure effective transfer pricing practices.

• Lead and manage transfer pricing projects, drive change, secure stakeholder buy-in, and ensure high-quality deliverables and outstanding results.

• Represent the group on transfer pricing audits and dispute resolution and influence decisions in complex negotiations with tax authorities globally

• Provide excellent and timely support to our business team and finance team on intercompany transactions such as transfers of intangible property, services, and loans.

• Develop a mature control framework to ensure transfer pricing documentation, returns, notifications, intercompany agreements and related deliverables are maintained.

• Collaborate closely with Group Finance, subsidiary finance teams to ensure that TP policies are accounted for correctly in the Group books during quarter end and year end closing, and local statutory account.

• Provide training to stakeholders both in finance and to business team on transfer pricing policies and changes in legislation.

• Manage external service providers and liaise with our statutory auditors on TP matters.

**What We Value

**Experience and Education:

• Minimum 10 years experience in industry and/or consultancy with emphasis on working with multinational groups.

• Relevant education such as lawyer, CPA, economist or education from tax administration or any combination thereof.

Skills and Knowledge:

• Excellent understanding and experience in dealing with international taxation and transfer pricing, OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, BEPS and local rules and regulations.

• Proven ability to lead complex transfer pricing projects, drive the team to deliver impactful results, and foster a positive, collaborative environment where team members and stakeholders feel engaged and valued.

• Act as an owner with a proactive approach to set directions, drive changes and improvements in transfer pricing practices.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relations with internal stakeholders and teams.

• Excellent communication skills and able to communicate complicated issues in a precise and concise manner.

• Strong team player who can influence others and the ability to work independently.

• Good general accounting/finance skills and experience. Experience with financial systems (ERP, consolidation tools and management reporting tools) is a plus.

• Advanced communication skills, with fluency in English (both verbal and written). Knowledge of the Danish tax system is a plus.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and other MS Office tools.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. To make sure you receive our emails please check your junk/spam folder and add SimCorp to the safe list of your e-mail contacts.

**Please note: Only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. • Lead programme planning, implementation, monitoring, learning and adaptation with partners and ActionAid teams.

• Ensure sound grant and financial management, including budgets, risks, disbursements and donor reporting.

• Turn regional political, economic and social developments into strategic advice and programme decisions making sure, that young people are involved and included.

Working at MS

Apply through our online recruitment system with your CV and a short motivation letter by Tuesday 10th November 2026, at 23:59 CET. Do you have the AI insight and business acumen to determine which technologies will create the greatest value for Arla in the years ahead?

This is a unique opportunity to lead the AI agenda, driving the transformation from experimentation to scaled adoption of AI, Copilot, and intelligent automation across the business.

“In this role you will influence the future of how more than 20,000 colleagues will benefit from emerging technologies across Arla. Your work will help identify the use cases that bring value, and the governance work you d__o will ensure a safe steer on the journey says Søren Bækgaard Hansen, Senior Director, CIO Office and Data Governance.

How you will make an impact

This role combines hands-on thought leadership with transformation execution. You will operate as a key driver in the CIO Office - shaping how AI is governed and embedded into everyday work.

As our new Senior IT Specialist you will take ownership of the AI governance framework and cross-functional collaboration model, ensuring that AI is used responsibly, effectively, and at scale across Arla. You will work closely with stakeholders across the business zones and functions, external partners, IT and senior leadership and act as a connector between strategy, governance, and delivery teams to drive tangible business value and outcomes.

In this role, you will

• Lead the end-to-end AI governance agenda, including policies, standards, and controls across Agents, Copilot, and automation use cases

• Drive business transformation through AI by identifying opportunities, shaping PoCs and MVPs, defining value cases, and leading the transition from experiments to scaled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes

• Enable adoption of AI by defining clear frameworks, practical guidelines, and reusable patterns for business and IT product teams

• Partner with senior leaders to translate emerging AI opportunities into strategic decisions, roadmaps, and practical actions that create business value

• Facilitate workshops and drive collaboration across platform teams, architects, product teams, and business functions

• Lead communication and storytelling that builds confidence, clarity, and momentum around AI at Arla

What will make you successful

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience driving AI, technology, or digital transformation initiatives in a complex organisation. Ideally, you have worked in a similar role within a large global company. Alternatively, you come from a consulting background where AI, emerging technologies, and business transformation have been a core part of your work.

• Strong understanding of governance, risk, and compliance, ideally in the context of AI or data

• Proven ability to drive adoption and influence without formal authority across multiple teams

• Solid stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage both technical experts and senior business leaders

• A pragmatic mindset – able to translate strategy into initiatives that drives real business value, that can be actionable by our IT & Digital organisation

• Strong communicator with the ability to drive fact-based storytelling and engagement

• Solid understanding of business challenges and opportunities in a large internal cooperation ideally in a FMCG context

• Confident in building business cases that demonstrates tangible business value

What do we offer?

You will join the CIO Office at Arla at a moment where AI is becoming a core capability across the Arla business.

We offer a highly visible role where you will help shape Arla’s AI and Agentic AI adoption journey. You will be part of a collaborative and forward-looking environment where innovation and execution go hand in hand, with opportunities to work with leading partners and technologies. You will also join a culture focused on learning, trust, and making a real impact, while helping define how AI creates value across one of the world’s leading dairy companies.

Application & contact

If you want to seize this exciting opportunity, please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please contact Søren Bækgaard Hansen (sorha@arlafoods.com).

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

At Autorola Solutions, we're helping transform how the global automotive industry operates through digital solutions, technology and business process expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Business System Consultant to take a leading role in designing and delivering complex software solutions across customer engagements. Combining strong business process understanding with deep solution expertise, you'll translate business requirements into scalable, high-quality system solutions and take ownership of the technical approach from initial analysis through configuration, implementation and final validation.

As a senior member of the team, you'll be a trusted advisor to customers and an important sparring partner for Project Management Consultants, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries. You'll help shape solution designs, guide technical decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that customer needs are translated into practical, sustainable solutions that create lasting business value.

If you're passionate about solving complex business challenges, advising customers at a strategic and operational level, and driving high-quality software implementations, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us

**The Autorola Group is a global leader in online vehicle remarketing, automotive IT solutions and business intelligence for the used vehicle market. Through Autorola Marketplace, Autorola Solutions and Indicata, we help manufacturers, leasing companies, fleet owners and dealers buy, sell and manage vehicles more efficiently using technology, data and digital solutions.

**Lead the design and delivery of smart, scalable solutions

**As Senior Business System Consultant, you'll take ownership of the technical solution throughout the customer engagement. Working in close partnership with a Project Management Consultant, who is responsible for the client relationship, project scope, planning and overall delivery, you'll lead the solution design and ensure that business requirements are translated into robust, scalable and maintainable system solutions.

You'll bring senior-level expertise to complex customer scenarios, advising on business processes, product capabilities and solution alternatives. You'll challenge requirements where appropriate, identify opportunities to leverage standard functionality, and help determine when configuration is sufficient and when further product development is needed.

Your role will extend beyond individual implementations. You'll contribute to improving our solution delivery practices, establish and promote best practices, share knowledge across the team and act as a trusted technical and functional sparring partner for colleagues. Where relevant, you'll also engage directly with customer business teams to ensure that solutions support real operational workflows and deliver the intended business outcomes.

Success means more than delivering a configured system. It means making sound solution decisions, reducing implementation complexity, ensuring consistent quality and helping customers realise lasting value from Autorola's software solutions.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Lead the analysis and translation of complex customer requirements and business processes into effective, scalable solution designs.

• Take ownership of the technical and functional solution approach throughout customer engagements, from initial assessment to implementation and validation.

• Design, configure and build Autorola software solutions, ensuring that they meet business needs and align with product capabilities, architecture and standards.

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements and recommending solutions that balance business value, feasibility and long-term sustainability.

• Provide senior solution input during project scoping, including technical effort estimates, dependency assessments, risk identification and evaluation of alternative approaches.

• Work closely with Project Management Consultants to ensure that solution decisions support realistic plans, predictable delivery and successful customer outcomes.

• Assess the fit between customer-specific requirements and standard product functionality, identifying when configuration, process adaptation or new development is the most appropriate approach.

• Collaborate with Product Management and Software Development (ASYS) to shape, clarify and qualify enhancement requests and development requirements.

• Take responsibility for solution quality, including configuration standards, test planning, validation and the resolution of functional and technical issues.

• Support customers' operational teams in adopting new solutions and ensuring that implemented functionality works effectively in their day-to-day business.

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, solution consistency and reuse through templates, standards, guidelines and proven practices.

• Act as a senior sparring partner and knowledge resource for colleagues, supporting the development of solution expertise and promoting knowledge sharing across the organisation.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our consulting methods, delivery processes and collaboration across Business System Consulting, Project Management, Product Management and Software Development.

**Who are we looking for?

**We're looking for an experienced Senior Business System Consultant who combines strong business acumen with substantial solution consulting experience, sound technical judgement and the ability to guide customers and colleagues through complex implementation challenges.

You can move confidently between business processes, product capabilities and technical considerations. You know how to challenge requirements constructively, make informed trade-offs and turn complexity into clear, actionable solution designs.

**You Likely Have

**

• Several years of relevant experience in business systems consulting, solution consulting, software implementation, business process consultancy or a similar client-facing role.

• A proven track record of leading or taking significant ownership of complex system implementations and solution designs.

• Strong experience translating complex business requirements into practical, scalable and maintainable software solutions.

• Extensive experience with system configuration, functional design, testing and implementation quality.

• The ability to assess solution alternatives, evaluate technical and functional trade-offs, and make well-founded recommendations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and pragmatic approach to decision-making.

• The confidence to advise customers, challenge assumptions and communicate complex topics clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with Project Management, Software Development, Product Management and other cross-functional teams.

• The ability to identify implementation risks, dependencies and opportunities early, helping create more predictable and efficient delivery.

• A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in developing shared standards, best practices and team capabilities.

• The ability to balance individual customer needs with standard functionality, product consistency and long-term maintainability.

• A willingness to travel internationally for customer engagements when required.

Experience with enterprise software, IT consulting, Agile environments or the automotive industry is an advantage. Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to the development of consulting practices is also beneficial.

**What Success Looks Like

**Within your first 12–18 months, you'll have:

• Established yourself as a trusted senior advisor to customers on complex business processes, solution design and product capabilities.

• Successfully led the solution design and technical delivery of complex customer implementations.

• Built a strong understanding of Autorola's products, business processes, technical capabilities and strategic priorities.

• Helped Project Management Consultants scope customer engagements more accurately through sound technical assessments, effort estimates and early risk identification.

• Improved solution quality, consistency and maintainability through clear design principles and well-founded technical and functional decisions.

• Strengthened collaboration between customers, Business System Consulting, Project Management, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries.

• Contributed to more efficient implementations through reusable solutions, improved templates, standards and best practices.

• Shared your experience and expertise to strengthen the capabilities of the wider consulting team.

• Helped customers adopt their solutions successfully and realise measurable value in their day-to-day operations.

**Why join Autorola Group?

**Autorola Group is a global company with more than 850 employees across 20 subsidiaries in Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

At Autorola Solutions, you'll join an international environment where project management, business process expertise and software development come together to solve complex challenges for leading automotive companies.

As a Senior Business System Consultant, you'll have a significant influence on how we design and deliver customer solutions. You'll work across organisational and geographical boundaries, collaborate with experienced colleagues and help shape the standards, methods and practices that support our continued growth.

We also offer pension and health insurance, social and company events, a great lunch arrangement, access to a fitness room and a lively Friday bar.

**Want to join the team?

**We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that this description reflects our ideal candidate profile. We strongly believe in inclusion and diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

Applications and CVs will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the advertisement may be removed once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Christian Gless, Tech Talent Acquisition Partner, at csg@autorola.com.

We store summer sun for the winter. Now Photoncycle is heading into thousands of Danish homes, and we are looking for a trainee who wants to help build the market from the ground up. Is that you?

About Photoncycle

Solar panels produce plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that problem: we store the energy in a tank in the ground next to the house, so the household can use it for electricity and heating all winter. Surplus power is sold on the electricity market, where it helps balance supply and demand. The household pays a fixed monthly fee, and we build, install and operate the system.

We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

Photoncycle is a completely new technology, and Denmark is our first market.

Why this role

As a trainee, you will be part of building Photoncycle's Danish operations, from research and permit processes to partner dialogues, pilot customers and events. You will work across the full breadth of a market launch and get hands-on experience with how a new energy technology is brought to market in Denmark.

The role is deliberately broad, and the scope will be tailored to the number of hours you work. Tasks will shift as the launch gets closer, and your responsibilities will grow with the role down the line.

What you will do

This is a versatile, hands-on role that mixes research, relationships and the nuts-and-bolts work. You will report to Anne Clara Laugesen, General Manager of Photoncycle Denmark, and work closely with our colleagues in Oslo.

Tasks and responsibility will include:
