Your main responsibilities will be to

• Handle end-to-end network connectivity deliveries between internal and external platforms such as mobile core and probing systems.

• Define IP/MPLS network rules and design.

• Manage firewalls and probing equipment.

• Lead lifecycle management.

• Ensure automation of service development.

Your profile includes

• Experience from working with IP MPLS design and lifecycle management.

• Solid understanding of routing protocols and redundant setups.

• Knowledge of test management and CPE/service validation.

• Preferably CCNP certification.

Requirements

• Ability to obtain a Danish Security Clearance.

• Ability to work from our Norlys office in Århus or Copenhagen several days per week.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken. Danish is an advantage.

Join us!

If you have questions, you can contact Senior Manager of Architecture, Development & Design, Henriette Pedersen at 28 27 08 48 or hpeder@norlys.dk. Please send us your application and CV through our online recruitment system as soon as possible. You decide whether your application and CV should be in English or Danish, we do not differentiate.

Norlys is Denmark’s largest integrated energy and telecommunications group with approx. 800,000 co-op shareholders, 3.5 million customer relations, 4,600 employees and over 100 years of history. As a co-operative, taking responsibility for more than just ourselves is embedded in our DNA. That’s why we don’t just deliver future-proof solutions to Danish homes and companies. We also work consciously towards a green and digital transformation for all of society. And that is why we are passionate about creating progress for people, the local environment and the climate.

We hope you enjoy the experience. Because we believe that the future is as good as we make it. Together.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

• Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

• API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

• CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

• Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

• Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

• API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

• Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

• Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

• Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

• Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript

• Testing: Playwright

• AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks

• Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Are you the kind of person who notices when something could be better, and has the drive to make it happen? At DISA, quality is not just a checkpoint at the end of the process. It is built into the way we design, source, produce and deliver world-class foundry machines. We are looking for a Quality Engineer who wants to be close to the product, close to production and close to the decisions that improve how we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving real quality challenges in a manufacturing environment. Someone who is structured, curious and persistent enough to follow an issue from first observation to sustainable improvement.

What You’ll Do

• Take ownership of quality improvements across supplier quality, production quality and internal quality processes.

• Handle non-conformities, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and ensure follow-up until issues are properly closed.

• Work closely with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers to identify risks, solve quality challenges and prevent repeat issues.

• Support and develop supplier quality performance through audits, structured follow-up, documentation and improvement plans.

• Use data, facts and structured problem-solving tools to analyze trends, set priorities and recommend practical quality improvements.

• Contribute to audits, customer requirements and management systems, with ISO 14001 as an area where you have basic knowledge or interest.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• A role where quality is at the center — not a side responsibility.

• The chance to work hands-on with complex, high-precision equipment and see the impact of your improvements in real production.

• A workplace where your structure, curiosity and follow-through help prevent issues before they reach the customer.

• Close collaboration with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers, so you can turn observations into practical improvements.

• The opportunity to help strengthen quality culture in a global industrial company with strong products, proud craftsmanship and long product lifetimes.

You will not be sitting far away from the product or the people making it. You will be part of the daily dialogue around quality, helping colleagues and suppliers understand what went wrong, why it happened and how we make sure it does not happen again.

Who You Are

• You have a background in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Production Technology or a similar field.

• You have experience with quality work in a manufacturing, production or industrial environment.

• You are motivated by root cause analysis, corrective actions and the satisfaction of closing issues properly.

• You understand supplier quality or are eager to work closely with suppliers on deviations, audits, documentation and improvement plans.

• You like being close to the shop floor and working with people across functions to solve practical quality challenges.

• You are analytical and structured, but also pragmatic enough to find solutions that work in real life.

• You follow through — because you know that quality improvements only matter when they are actually implemented and sustained.

• You have knowledge of ISO 14001 or an interest in building a basic understanding of environmental management systems.

If you are driven by quality, manufacturing and continuous improvement, and if you enjoy turning problems into clear actions and better ways of working, we would like to hear from you. You do not need to tick every box; what matters most is your quality mindset, your curiosity and your ability to follow through.

About Norican

NORICAN. Metal. Made. Possible.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

DISA:

DISA design, build and support premium green sand moulding and cashing machines for the ferrous and non-ferrous foundry industries. For 125 years they have delivered machines that last for decades, and they are highly respected by customers and peers for excellent levels of quality and service. DISA machines keep customers producing relentlessly to the very highest standards. And they empower foundry productivity with a lifetime of efficient and a lower cost per casting.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

We will review candidates continuously, so please send your application as soon as possible. If you have any questions about the role, please contact Johnny Rasmussen at johnny.rasmussen@norican.com.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future

Can you lead technical work packages and coordinate specialist contributions to deliver an integrated solution? You will work on projects ranging from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites. You will coordinate specialist contributions, manage technical interfaces and ensure that individual work packages meet the requirements of the overall substation automation solution.

The role combines technical expertise with responsibility for coordinating engineering activities, monitoring progress and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables. You will work closely with the project manager, technical specialists and other engineering disciplines throughout project execution.

• Plan and follow up on engineering activities, technical deliverables and milestones within your scope.

• Coordinate specialist contributions and ensure consistency across technical work packages.

• Ensure that technical solutions and documentation comply with project requirements, customer specifications and applicable standards.

• Manage technical interfaces between automation, communication systems, protection systems, primary equipment and auxiliary systems.

• Identify and resolve technical issues in collaboration with specialists and other engineering disciplines.

• Participate in project meetings and advise the project manager on technical matters, dependencies and risks within your area of responsibility.

• Coordinate technical activities with customers, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

Your expertise

You combine a strong technical foundation with a structured approach to planning and coordination. You can assess how individual systems and specialist contributions fit together, communicate technical requirements clearly and follow through on agreed actions.

You work independently and build effective working relationships with colleagues, customers and project partners.

You will also bring:

• A degree in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical qualification, together with more than five years of relevant experience in automation for high-voltage substations.

• A solid understanding of substation automation systems, including control and monitoring functions, communication networks and interfaces to protection equipment.

• An understanding of how substation secondary systems interface with high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience coordinating technical work packages, planning engineering activities and following up on specialist deliverables.

• The ability to assess technical solutions, manage interfaces and maintain an overview of quality, progress and dependencies.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and fulfil the requirements for the designated on-site role of “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

STUDIO 9 is looking for a commercially driven Sales Manager to turn strong customer interest in KEYSTONE into signed contracts and long-term partnerships.

This role carries clear responsibility for the sales pipeline and the full commercial process, from initial customer dialogue and pilot to negotiation and agreement.

ABOUT KEYSTONE

KEYSTONE is STUDIO 9’s SaaS platform that enables our customers to collect, structure and manage product data directly from their suppliers.

The platform makes it easier for our customers to meet the evolving compliance requirements in areas spanning from EUDR, supply chain traceability, digital product passport (DPP) and LCA. It is built as a SaaS platform that can easily integrate into our customers’ system landscape (e.g. to their ERP and PIM-system).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Working closely with our Sales Director and Software & Implementation team, you will drive KEYSTONE’s commercial growth and help shape how the platform is positioned, sold and delivered.

You will lead the customer journey from the first conversation through agreement, onboarding and long-term development. This includes identifying the right decision-makers, building support across the customer’s organisation and presenting a clear financial and operational case for choosing KEYSTONE.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Drive customer acquisition and commercial growth for KEYSTONE

• Own the sales process from initial dialogue to signed agreement

• Progress opportunities through demonstrations, pilots, negotiations and internal approvals

• Identify decision-makers and build support across the customer’s organisation

• Build compelling ROI cases that demonstrate KEYSTONE’s financial and operational value

• Maintain a structured pipeline with forecasts and clear next steps

• Ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation

• Support customer adoption, retention and account growth

• Bring customer insights into product positioning and business development, collaborating closely with Sales, Product and Software teams

ABOUT YOU

You are motivated by progressing sales opportunities and turning interest into lasting customer relationships. You work in a structured way, create momentum and follow opportunities through to completion.

You are comfortable exploring a customer’s software landscape, understanding how systems, data and workflows connect, and translating software capabilities into clear business value. You can engage both commercial and IT stakeholders in conversations about business needs, integrations and scalability.

You bring:

• Proven results in B2B sales within SaaS, software or digital solutions, combined with an understanding of enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, PIM and PLM platforms

• The ability to discuss APIs, system integrations and product data flows at a commercial level, connecting technical requirements to customer needs

• Experience managing complex sales cycles from discovery and qualification through solution presentations, proposal development and contract negotiation

• The ability to build a convincing business case around ROI, operational efficiency and data quality

• Strong stakeholder management

• A disciplined approach to CRM, pipeline management and sales forecasting

Experience with product information management (PIM), master data, supply chain processes or compliance is an advantage, as is knowledge of the fashion, furniture and lifestyle industries.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will join KEYSTONE early in its growth journey and play a central role in shaping how the platform is sold and scaled. You will have high ownership, close collaboration across teams, and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

We offer a flexible working environment with our headquarters located by the harbour in Horsens, Denmark. While we value in-person collaboration, we are open to candidates based elsewhere and support remote working arrangements.

READY TO GROW KEYSTONE?

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. If you have questions about the role, please contact Sales Director Rasmus Ravnholt: rasmus.ravnholt@nineunited.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

ABOUT STUDIO 9

At STUDIO 9, we work with branding in every detail. We design and develop physical brand experiences for international fashion, jewellery and lifestyle brands – from garment accessories such as labels and hangtags to packaging, shop fixtures, window displays and complete retail environments.

Our work covers the entire process, from the initial idea and design development to compliance, sourcing, production and delivery.

STUDIO 9 is part of the Nine United family, with our headquarters in Horsens and sourcing offices across Europe and Asia. We are a close-knit team with a culture built on collaboration, trust and strong relationships.

jobs.description:
You will architect and optimize scalable data pipelines, datasets and analytical workflows at EPAM in Copenhagen, Denmark, working in a hybrid model. Initially at one of our Clients in the Advanced Manufacturing / Life Sciences space. Using Snowflake, Dataiku, SQL and Python, you enable feature engineering for machine learning and support robust data products for analytics and business intelligence. You collaborate with data science, product and delivery teams to deliver production-ready solutions with a focus on data quality, performance and maintainability.

**Responsibilities

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate across technical and business teams

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Welcome to Asset Integrity

You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Are you ready to pursue your career within disruptive MedTech working with 3D scanners and software medical devices in a global setting? Then 3Shape offers a unique opportunity to work as Post-Market Surveillance Manager in the center of Copenhagen at Kongens Nytorv.

About the department

You will report to the Head of Scientific Affairs and you will be part of our growing global RA organization based in Copenhagen, which currently includes around 30 people. You will interact with a wide range of stakeholders and especially with Product Creation, Customer Support, Product Management, Global Sales, Resellers, and external consultants worldwide. You will assist with developing the future of disruptive MedTech in collaboration with the entire organization and enable people across the world to enjoy better lives.

Your new job in 3Shape

As our new Post-Market Surveillance Manager (PMS) you will lead and facilitate PMS activities in accordance with relevant global regulations to support our products with regard to safety and performance.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead and maintain the company's PMS program in accordance with EU MDR, FDA, ISO 13485, and other global requirements.

• Develop and maintain PMS Plans, PMS Reports, PSURs, PMCF reports, and trend analyses.

• Monitor and evaluate complaints, adverse events, customer feedback, and other post-market data sources.

• Identify safety and performance trends and support risk management activities.

• Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, Product Creation, and Product Management to drive continuous product improvement.

• Lead vigilance assessments and regulatory reporting activities for adverse events, serious incidents, and field safety corrective actions (FSCAs), ensuring compliance with global medical device regulations.

• Manage submissions and maintenance of regulatory documentation within EUDAMED.

• Assist with audits and inspections

• Present PMS findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

Your profile

We are looking for a person with:

• Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, Healthcare, or related field

• Relevant Quality, Regulatory or Vigilance operational experience from the medical device industry

• Knowledge of EU medical device regulations/directives, including ISO-13485 and ISO-14971

• Excellent planning, cooperation, and communication skills

• Basic AI knowledge preferable within tools used for PMS, Vigilance and trending

• Basic statistical knowledge

As a person, you are a good team player with strong interpersonal skills who thrives working with multiple stakeholders and partners, both internally and externally. Also, you have the ability to successfully handle multiple tasks while managing tight deadlines.

We offer:

• An attractive office environment in downtown Copenhagen, next to Kongens Nytorv

• An inspiring work environment in an informal atmosphere, with social, diverse, and highly skilled colleagues

• A professional challenge in a dynamic, globally-oriented business environment

• Empowerment and influence over your own tasks

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

**Team

**The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

**Role

**The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position: Endocrine Disruption in Fish with Focus on Histopathological Endpoint Development
jobs.description:
We invite applicants for a 3½-years Postdoctoral research position in Environmental Toxicology with a focus on histopathological and behavioral endpoints development in fish. The position is funded by the EU Partnership for Risk Assessment of Chemicals (PARC), the Danish EPA and University of Southern Denmark (SDU). The project will be carried out in the Ecotoxicology group at the Department of Biology, SDU. 

Qualifications: 
The successful candidate must hold a PhD degree in Environmental Toxicology. A strong background in chemical risk and hazard assessment and regulatory toxicology is highly appreciated. This includes knowledge of EU chemicals legislation and regulatory frameworks such as REACH, OECD test guidelines, AOP development, and/or pesticide and biocide risk assessment. Furthermore, the following experiences and skills are required: 

• 
Strong proficiency in English, both written and verbal. 

• 
Experience in teaching and supervision at the university level, including lectures, student examinations, and supervision of MSc students. 

• 
Hands-on experience in assessing endocrine disruption properties of chemicals using the Zebrafish (Danio rerio) model.  

• 
Strong documented knowledge of one or more endocrine pathways relevant to EU regulatory assessments (EATS modalities). 

• 
Extensive experience with OECD fish test protocols such as OECD TG 236 and OECD TG 210. 

• 
Documented experience in histopathology techniques, including tissue preparation, microtome sectioning, cryosectioning, H&E staining, microscopy, and image analysis. 

• 
Experience in behavioral assessment in zebrafish eleutheroembryos, e.g., using EthoVision XT or equivalent tracking and analysis software. 

The following qualifications are considered advantageous: 

• 
Experience with molecular biology techniques, including gene expression analysis (e.g., qPCR, transcriptomics). 

• 
Experience with immunohistochemistry and related imaging techniques. 

This position is particularly suited for a candidate with strong interest in bridging experimental ecotoxicology and regulatory chemical risk- and hazard assessment.

jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is more than a flight school. We are a fast-growing international business in an industry that never stands still – training the next generation of commercial pilots.

Since starting out in Aarhus in 2013, we have grown to seven bases across Europe – from Dublin in the west to Helsinki in the east. Our students fly under the Spanish sun and across European airspace. Today, more than 200 students are training to become commercial pilots with us, supported by over 40 flight instructors and a fleet of 12 Tecnam aircraft, with 13 more on the way.

This is where ambition becomes reality – where safety, people, technology, operations and training must all come together before the wheels leave the runway.

You have an aviation background and have instructed from the cockpit yourself. With us, you will join a highly skilled team with short decision-making lines and plenty of room to shape our development. We turn the dream of flying into a career – and you can help make that journey even better.

The role

The Chief Flight Instructor (CFI) is part of our ATO Core Team and holds overall responsibility for quality, standardisation and compliance in the flight and simulator training delivered by our flight instructors.

You are appointed by the Accountable Manager and report directly to the Head of Training, with whom you work closely to ensure consistent, high-quality training. The Head of Training may delegate tasks and authority to you within your area of responsibility.

Your key responsibilities include:

• 
Standardisation, supervision and training planning for the entire instructor team

• 
Developing and enforcing standard operating procedures for flight training

• 
Ensuring that all instructors hold valid licences, certificates and competencies

• 
Recruiting new instructors as well as guiding, mentoring and providing recurrent training for the existing team

• 
Assessing new bases as we expand into new countries

• 
Updating training materials and operations manuals on our in-house platform, SmartBird

• 
Taking part in ATO and management meetings, where you help set the direction for training

What we offer:

• 
Real decision-making authority over training quality and standards in a growing international organisation

• 
A direct reporting line to the Head of Training and close ties to management

• 
An established ATO with a clear, EASA-approved framework for the role

• 
Access to a modern and growing fleet

• 
An international working environment with colleagues and instructors from several countries

Requirements

The Chief Flight Instructor is a nominated post under EASA Part-ORA (ORA.ATO.210). In line with the regulation, the CFI must hold the highest pilot licence and at least one instructor certificate relevant to the courses the school offers. As GreyBird offers ATPL theory, several aircraft types and type rating-related training, we are looking for:

• 
CPL(A) or ATPL(A)

• 
Instructor certificate: FI(A)

• 
Additional instructor certificates such as CRI(A) and IRI(A) are considered an advantage

• 
A minimum of 1,000 hours as PIC, including at least 500 hours of instructional flying (industry practice is typically 1,500+ hours, and more experience counts in your favour)

• 
Ideally, you also have experience leading, standardising or developing other instructors

• 
Fluent English, spoken and written

Good decisions start with good data. But good data does not just happen. At NORDEN, data comes from many places and is used across our business to understand markets, automate processes and make better decisions. Your job is to make sure that data is actually ready to be used.

Structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.

**

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We are looking for a Product Compliance Manager to join Veo's newly established Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team.

As Veo continues to grow, we navigate a broad range of regulatory requirements across our products and business, from certifications, product safety, and environmental regulation to market access and broader compliance obligations.

In this role, you will focus on product-related regulatory compliance and certifications, while also working across Veo's broader compliance agenda. You will work closely with colleagues across Hardware, Product Development, Production, Procurement and other parts of the business to understand applicable requirements and help translate them into practical processes and solutions.

You will join a small GRC team with a broad mandate and significant exposure across Veo. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding regulation, technology, and business.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Coordinate Veo's product certification and market-access activities across relevant markets, working closely with Hardware, Production and other internal stakeholders.

• Monitor and assess new and changing regulatory requirements relevant to Veo and help determine their practical implications for our products and business.

• Develop and maintain a structured overview of regulatory and certification requirements applicable to Veo's products throughout their lifecycle.

• Drive and coordinate implementation of regulatory and compliance requirements across relevant business functions, ensuring clear ownership, appropriate documentation and timely follow-up.

• Work with regulatory frameworks relevant to Veo's products, including areas such as product safety, batteries, electrical and electronic equipment, environmental requirements, waste and recycling obligations and related product compliance requirements.

• Coordinate with external certification bodies, laboratories, consultants and other specialists where required.

• Maintain and develop compliance documentation, certification records, technical files, declarations and other evidence required to demonstrate compliance.

• Support the assessment of regulatory and compliance implications when Veo enters new markets, introduces new products or makes material changes to existing products.

• Support Veo's broader compliance activities, including policies, procedures, monitoring, due diligence, risk assessments and training.

• Support customer, auditor and other stakeholder requests relating to compliance and certifications.

• Contribute to the continued development of Veo's broader GRC framework and take part in cross-functional compliance projects as required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• Relevant higher education in engineering, technology, law, business, quality/compliance, or another relevant discipline.

• Relevant professional experience within product compliance, regulatory compliance, certification, quality/regulatory affairs or a similar area, preferably from an international company.

• Experience working with regulatory requirements affecting hardware or electronic products is an advantage.

• Experience with one or more areas such as product safety, product certifications, battery regulation, electrical/electronic equipment regulation, environmental product requirements, waste/recycling regulation or similar regulatory regimes.

• Experience coordinating certification processes, testing, technical documentation, declarations or interactions with certification bodies and laboratories is highly relevant.

• Broader compliance experience, for example within sanctions and export controls, third-party due diligence, anti-bribery and corruption or other corporate compliance areas, is an advantage.

• An ability to understand complex regulatory requirements and translate them into practical requirements for technical, operational and commercial teams.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating initiatives across different functions and areas of expertise.

• A structured approach to documentation, monitoring and follow-up, combined with the ability to identify and prioritize material compliance risks.

• Strong business understanding and a pragmatic approach to compliance. You should be comfortable finding solutions that meet regulatory requirements while enabling the business to operate effectively.

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in an environment where processes and frameworks are still being developed.

• Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

At Veo, the Governance, Risk & Compliance team provides oversight, coordination and assurance across the company. We work closely with teams throughout Veo to ensure that regulatory requirements and risks are identified, appropriately owned and effectively managed.

You will report to the Head of Governance, Risk & Compliance and will have considerable opportunity to shape how Veo approaches compliance as the company continues to grow.

Contact Martin Eger Larsen one mel@veo.co if you have any questions

jobs.description:
Own the technical backbone for your workstream. As the Technical Workstream Lead for Procure to Pay you sit side-by-side with the Global Process Owner (GPO) and Global Process Leads (GPLs) to translate process design into robust and scalable technology across ERP, PLM, QMS procurement system solutions. You lead the technical scope for your workstream - architecture, build, environments, integrations, data migration, non-functionals, security/compliance, releases, and hyper-care – through stage gates to successful handover.

Ambu is transforming our core enterprise platforms (e.g., ERP, QMS, PLM), and each workstream needs a dedicated technical leader to ensure high-quality, compliant delivery that enables standardized, high-performing global processes.

**The role

**You are the end-to-end technical owner for one workstream. You co-lead the workstream together with the Business Workstream Lead/GPO, ensuring process-system alignment, decision-ready design, disciplined delivery, and operational readiness for your scope.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• 
Technical governance within your workstream

• 
Run technical governance for the workstream. Prepare decision-ready design packs and status for the Design Authority

• 
Own the workstream technical enablement of the Procure to Pay process. Assess run-time/architecture risks, define mitigations, and escalate with clear options

• 
Safeguard solution integrity against enterprise standards and non-functional requirements

• 
Design, build, environments, and release engineering

• 
Lead technical design for your workstream: integrations, extensions, data model, security roles, automation

• 
Define and manage environments for the workstream: branching strategy, CI/CD pipelines, and code quality gates

• 
Manage technical debt, versioning, and change control with impact analysis across upstream/downstream systems

• 
Data migration and cutover

• 
Plan and execute migration tooling, trial loads, reconciliations, and cutover steps for your workstream objects

• 
Security, privacy, and compliance

• 
Ensure cybersecurity, privacy, SoD, and validation/CSV compliance in collaboration with QA/Validation Lead

• 
Delivery orchestration and hyper-care

• 
Coordinate internal platform teams and external vendors for your scope

• 
Lead hyper-care triage and stabilization for the workstream. Complete documentation and knowledge transfer to run

• 
Program collaboration

• 
Partner daily with the GPO, GPLs, and Business Workstream Lead; align on scope, decisions, and adoption

• 
Work with PMO on stage gates, quality reviews, plans, and dependencies to other workstreams

**Your profile

**

• 8+ years delivering technical workstreams on enterprise platforms (ERP, QMS, PLM or similar) in global settings

• Proven leadership of architecture, integrations (API/iPaaS), data migration, and release management within a defined scope

• Strong command of non-functionals: performance, reliability, security, privacy, SoD, and validation/CSV

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, environment strategy, branching, automation testing, and code quality

• Adept at partnering with GPOs/GPLs to translate future-state processes into scalable solution designs

• Skilled in vendor management and cross-team coordination. Clear, concise communicator in English

• Willingness to travel across Ambu’s footprint and collaborate across time zones

**Nice to have

**

• MedTech/life sciences background (GxP, ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV)

• Exposure to Infor M3 or equivalent ERP, plus PLM, QMS, iPaaS/data platforms, and modern security frameworks

• Experience with Agile-at-scale combined with stage-gate governance

**Key stakeholders for your workstream

**

• Global Process Owner and Global Process Leads

• QA/Validation Lead

• PMO

• External implementation partners and software vendors

**Key Responsibilities Following The Transformation

**

• Participate in approved global projects

• Provide advice for standard systems and best practices of ERP and related systems

• Act as Service Delivery Manager and Subject Matter Expert in ERP in the IT Application Team

• Configure and maintain ERP systems, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.

• Handle system configuration, unit testing, training, and documentation in accordance with standards in close cooperation with external partners.

• Manage Life Cycle Management & release management

• Coach and review work performed by peer professionals

• Work across functions and cultures to deliver high-quality global solutions

• Work independently to solve complex problems

• Train Business Process Owners and other key users

• Follow regulatory compliance

**Ambu – where your technical leadership matters

**Join a fast-growing, international company where your workstream leadership directly enables how we operate globally. We offer strong professional development and a competitive package of professional, social, and financial benefits.

**How To Apply

**Send your CV and a short note describing a program where you led the technical workstream for a specific domain from design through hyper-care, including how you de-risked integrations, data migration, and non-functionals.

We're looking for a marketing intern who wants to manage their own projects and develop creatives that get published.

Great camping experiences start long before guests arrive. At CompuSoft, we build the software that helps campsites turn that first booking into a memorable stay. We’re looking for a marketing intern who wants to take ownership of projects and create content that gets published.

Who We Are

We’re a Danish software company with roots in the camping industry and a story that began in 1987. Today, more than 600 campsites, holiday resorts, attractions, and other tourism businesses use our solutions.

Our technology brings together online booking, guest management, payments, guest apps, and self-service tools. We help businesses simplify daily operations, giving their teams more time to focus on their guests.

With development, sales, and support in-house, we work closely across teams and with our customers to keep improving our solutions.

Your Role:

Your work will cover content, communication, and digital marketing. We’ll shape the internship around your strengths and interests, so tell us what you enjoy working on.

You’ll have your own projects with clear goals and also support the team where needed.

Your tasks may include:

• Writing LinkedIn posts, newsletter articles, and customer stories.

• Creating photos, short videos, and simple graphics.

• Helping plan and run campaigns across our four markets, from trade fairs and webinars to customer events.

• Keeping our messaging clear and consistent across our website, emails, and sales materials.

• Working with our website, email flows, and HubSpot, and tracking results to understand what works.

• Testing new ideas, including ways to use AI tools in our daily marketing work.

...

Who we're looking for

You’re studying marketing, communication, journalism, digital media, or a related subject, and your programme includes an internship.

We hope you:

• Write well in Danish and English. Swedish, Norwegian, or German is a bonus.

• Are curious and enjoy figuring things out independently.

• Have some experience with content, social media, or digital marketing through your studies, work, or personal projects.

• Feel comfortable asking questions and sharing ideas.

You don’t need to know about campsites or software. We’ll teach you that.

What We Offer

You can expect:

• Real responsibility and work you can include in your portfolio.

• A dedicated contact person who makes time for you and provides honest feedback.

• Experience in a growing SaaS company with marketing activities across four markets.

• A place in a team that works closely with sales, product, and customer success.

• A relaxed workplace where we take the work seriously, but not ourselves.

How to Apply

Send a short application and your CV through the application form before December 10. Tell us who you are, what you’d like to work on, and show us one thing you’ve made: a post, an article, a video, or a campaign.

We review applications as they arrive and may fill the position before the deadline.

Help build a stronger and more consistent approach to maintenance at Site Gentofte. As CMMS & Spare Parts Management Lead, you will help centralise and strengthen our computerised maintenance management system (CMMS) and spare parts management, supporting implementation of the Novo Nordisk Reliability and Maintenance blueprint. By connecting systems, master data, processes and people, you will help make maintenance activities more reliable and create practical improvements for daily production.

What you’ll bring

You bring hands-on expertise in SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) and Materials Management (MM), combined with an understanding of how maintenance systems and reliable master data support production. Just as importantly, you can turn complex requirements into clear ways of working and bring stakeholders with you.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• Proven experience in setting up, configuring and implementing SAP PM and SAP MM.

• In-depth knowledge of SAP PM and SAP MM and how they support maintenance and spare parts processes.

• At least two years of experience with reliability and maintenance of production equipment in a regulated environment.

• Experience with spare parts management, maintenance master data, task lists and related processes.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to collaborate across different functions.

• The ability to structure your own work, drive several initiatives in parallel and communicate fluently in English.

You are motivated by creating structure, improving processes and helping colleagues use systems and data to support reliable production.

What you’ll do

Your focus will be on creating robust and consistent processes that work in practice. You will:

• Drive implementation and continuous improvement of CMMS and spare parts management processes in line with the Novo Nordisk Reliability and Maintenance blueprint.

• Support CMMS super users and colleagues responsible for spare parts management in establishing consistent ways of working.

• Act as a subject matter expert and facilitator for CMMS and spare parts management.

• Manage and improve master data for spare parts, maintenance schedules and equipment, working with stakeholders to maintain the required inputs.

• Work with production departments to support a seamless flow of maintenance activities and data and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Understand operational needs across production and translate them into improvements that create value in day-to-day work.

FPRT is looking for a Senior Composite Process Technology Manager for our new composite production in Vojens, Denmark, and Moment Professionals manages the recruitment on our behalf. We are looking for a composite specialist with real depth in the technology who can convert transferred know-how into controlled, scalable and repeatable industrial processes. The role suits you if you want to build a production from the ground up and would rather build processes where little is written down yet than step into a production where everything is already in place.

Your everyday at FPRT

You report to the Chief Production Officer, Composite Manufacturing, and you build and lead the composite technology team of composite process engineers and materials and polymer engineers. You work closely with Production, Quality and NDT, HSE, Maintenance and Engineering, Planning and Supply Chain, and you support the competency and qualification standards for supervisors, technicians and operators together with Production and HR. You are the technical authority for composite manufacturing processes, with the mandate to define process parameters, technical standards and work instructions, and to require technical containment, a process review or a production stop when process integrity, product quality or safety is at risk.

Production starts from an existing process that is being transferred to Vojens, and experienced specialists from the group come to the site to hand it over. You lead the technical transfer and convert it into FPRT-controlled specifications, work instructions, training content and qualification requirements, and you define the technical requirements for equipment, tooling, fixtures, utilities and production conditions through trials, pilot builds and ramp-up. You make sure FPRT has clear local ownership of the critical processes and keeps the technical knowledge for the long term. From day one, you are expected to spot where a step can be done smarter and to have the composite understanding to back that view.

Your time is split between the desk and the floor. You own process flows, critical parameters, material requirements and process-control standards, and you define process qualification, inspection points, acceptance criteria and quality gates together with Quality and NDT. When a process starts to drift, you are the primary escalation point: you go to the floor, lead root-cause analysis, non-conformity investigations and corrective actions, and turn the lessons into updated standards and training. The weight of the role lies in the moulding stage and the material side of the process: resin systems, reinforcements such as carbon fibre, adhesives, curing and the conditions that decide whether porosity and voids are designed out or created. You need a sound grasp of finishing, but your depth is in why a part comes out of the mould as it does.

This is a greenfield site. New buildings are under construction on the site, systems are being selected, and support functions such as maintenance, IT and HR are being built in parallel. In the first period you will help shape how things are done well beyond your own field, and the composite team grows as production scales towards stable serial production.

The role is based in Vojens, and being on site is essential during the build-up. English is the working language in instructions and with colleagues across the group. Danish is a strong advantage in daily life on the floor, and if you are not fluent yet, your willingness to learn it counts.

And then there are the benefits:

Real authority over the processes you own, greenfield impact with no legacy to work around, a professional, international environment with a clear mission and purpose, a modern office with gym, sauna and social spaces, and top-of-market compensation for the right experience.

To succeed in the role…

…you do not need to have carried a manager title or to come from defence. What matters is that you know composite technology in depth: why a resin system behaves as it does, what creates strength and what creates defects, and how the environment affects the part. You may come from composite manufacturing in wind energy, marine, aerospace, defence or another high-performance industry, and work today in process or manufacturing engineering, production, materials or as a technical composite specialist. You also take pride in:

• challenging an established method, including one handed over by experienced colleagues, and agreeing on a better answer together.

• taking ownership and making decisions where little is written down yet.

• going to the floor when a process drifts and staying until the root cause is found.

• turning know-how into standards, instructions and training that engineers and operators can work from.

• developing engineers through technical reviews, coaching and structured problem solving.

What you need to bring:

• Either a relevant technical degree or equivalent strong industrial experience, and at least five years in composite manufacturing, process engineering, manufacturing engineering or materials engineering.

• Practical experience with industrial manufacturing of fibre-reinforced composite components and thermoset resin systems such as epoxy, phenolic or other thermosets, and hands-on experience with one or more of resin infusion or transfer processes, filament winding, lay-up, moulding, curing, bonding or composite machining and finishing.

• A proven track record of developing, transferring, industrialising, qualifying or stabilising manufacturing processes into repeatable production, with a solid grip on process control, documentation, process risk assessment, root-cause analysis, non-conformity handling and technical change management.

• Experience leading, mentoring or coaching engineers and production specialists, or acting as their technical authority.

• Fluent English, written and spoken. Danish is a strong advantage, or the willingness to learn it.

It is an advantage if you:

• come from advanced composite manufacturing in wind energy, marine, aerospace, defence, pressure vessels, automotive or another high-performance application.

• have worked with large or structurally critical components, such as aerospace and defence structures, casings, filament-wound products, UAV components or wind turbine blades.

• have taken part in a greenfield factory, a new production line, a technology transfer or a major ramp-up.

• live within commuting distance of 6500 Vojens, Denmark.

jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in Experimental Quantum Materials Physics
jobs.description:
Join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production at Aalborg University and contribute to research on the quantum properties of matter at the scale of individual atoms and molecules. This is a full-time, fixed-term PhD stipend for three years, commencing on 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter

**Your work tasks

**The Department of Materials and Production is looking for a PhD candidate in experimental physics to investigate how molecular complexes can be used to engineer quantum properties in materials. The project addresses fundamental questions in quantum science while contributing knowledge that may support future applications within electronics, sensing and energy harvesting. You will become part of the Physics Group and work in an international research collaboration funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

Your research will focus on preparing and investigating molecular complexes on crystalline surfaces. You will deposit molecular complexes by electrospray techniques under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and study their structural and electronic properties using low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. The work will involve planning and conducting experiments, documenting methods and results, analysing and discussing data, and communicating findings clearly within the research collaboration and through relevant scientific channels. You will carry out a substantial part of the research independently while collaborating closely with researchers in the project.

Your competencies You hold a master's degree in physics, nanoscience or a closely related field. You have a solid experimental background within physics, surface science or nanoscience, together with documented experience in scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, ultra-high-vacuum techniques, cryogenic systems, surface science and electrospray deposition.

You can organise and conduct experimental research in a systematic manner, from the planning of measurements to the documentation, analysis and interpretation of results. You communicate methods and findings clearly in English, both in writing and in dialogue with other researchers. The position calls for a researcher who can take responsibility for their own work while contributing constructively to a collaborative and international research environment.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

You will join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production, where research activities explore materials and physical phenomena relevant to both fundamental science and future technologies. In this position, you will work at the intersection of molecular science, surface science and quantum materials research, with access to a research environment in which experimental methods and scientific discussion form the basis for developing new knowledge.

As part of an international collaboration, you will have the opportunity to engage with researchers across disciplines and contribute to a research project with both scientific depth and technological relevance. The position offers a strong foundation for further work in academic research, advanced experimental physics or research-intensive development environments.

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
