jobs.occupation: Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus
jobs.description:
R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

You are structured, proactive and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and quality. You enjoy working with fixed deadlines, multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement.

Moreover, you have a keen sense of quality, and you:

• Hold a master’s degree in finance, accounting, auditing, or a similar field

• Have several years of relevant experience from Group consolidation, financial reporting, or an international audit firm

• Have hands-on experience with consolidation processes and a good understanding of the flow from local entity reporting to Group reporting

• Have experience with financial reporting systems. Experience with systems such as OneStream, HFM or Microsoft Dynamics is an advantage

• Are comfortable working independently, driving tasks to completion and collaborating across functions and geographies

• Speak and write fluent English

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

To apply, use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 19 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

• Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.

• Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.

• Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).

• Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

• Ability to communicate in English and Danish or Swedish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

**About The Job

**As the Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our partners to help our customers modernize their operational and analytical data foundations on GCP. We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.

You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. In this role, you will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization.

You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.

Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.860000 - kr.880000 (DKK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.

• Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.

• Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data & AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.

• Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

• Whiteboard modern architectures (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our Director, BU Controlling (f/m/d) and help shape the financial performance and strategic direction of a global business. This role offers flexibility to be based at a Danfoss Power Solutions location within the European time zone, enabling close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our global organization.

Partnering closely with the VP of the Valves & Pumps (VPS) Business Unit, you will drive transparency across performance, profitability, and risk, turning financial complexity into actionable insights that support confident decision-making and **profitable growth.

**You will also help build and develop a high-performing global controlling community, strengthening financial capabilities across the organization while supporting business performance through coaching, governance, and matrix leadership.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive business performance through financial analysis, forecasting, and strategic planning that enables better decisions and profitable growth

• Challenge business and plant leaders with data-driven insights, helping identify opportunities, improve profitability, and mitigate risks

• Coach and develop controllers across a global matrix organization, strengthening capabilities and fostering a high-performing controlling community

• Provide clear visibility into financial performance, ensuring accurate reporting and transparency across key business metrics

• Strengthen financial governance, controls, and continuous improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and long-term value creation

**What We're Looking For

**

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• Proven track record of driving business performance through controlling, finance business partnering, or finance leadership within a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment

• Strong expertise in financial planning, forecasting, profitability analysis, performance management, and risk management

• Proven ability to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders while building trusted relationships across a global matrix organization

• Experience coaching and developing finance professionals, strengthening capabilities, and driving results through influence and collaboration

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you join a purpose-driven company committed to driving sustainable transformation and long-term growth. In this role, you will work closely with senior leaders and influence decisions that shape the direction and performance of a global business.

You will be part of a highly skilled, international finance community, with opportunities to influence senior stakeholders, contribute to global initiatives, and strengthen both people and organizational capabilities.

**Furthermore

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited about combining financial leadership with real business impact, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your perspective, experience, and ambition could be exactly what we're looking for.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Use your skills to revolutionize HR with Team Spirit and Innovation at NTT DATA

**Are you ready to be a part of a team that is reshaping the world of HR, making a real impact for our clients? As our new Employee Central consultant, you will get to combine leadership, technical expertise and business understanding with your genuine mentor mentality.

**A Close-Knit team – and a One-Stop-Shop for Pioneering HR Solutions

**We would like to invite you into a collaborative and inclusive environment where each member is a vital part of our success. Our culture is laid-back yet professional, with room for a good laugh and a shared commitment to excellence. This can be felt all the way to our clients, who often talk about the enjoyable and effective partnerships they have with us.

“We’re proud of being a comprehensive solution for all things HR – from SuccessFactors and support to strategic HR advisory. And as part of the larger NTT DATA Business Solutions network, we can leverage cutting-edge AI technology, ensuring our clients receive the most advanced and efficient solutions available,” says Danny Haschke, SuccessFactors Consultant.

**Innovative Employee Central Implementation with ready2run®

**As a Senior Employee Central Consultant, you will lead large, international and complex implementations, taking ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design through deployment. ready2run® builds on our preconfigured starting solution, proven delivery framework and the way we shape implementation projects and customer offerings.

**Specifically, You Will

**

• Translate business needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Help customers benefit from our ready2run® approach – both as a methodology and a mindset.

• Play an important part in strengthening our collective capability by sharing knowledge, supporting collaboration across projects and helping junior consultants grow their confidence and expertise.

**Combine your strong technical expertise with your business understanding

**In this role, you will need a proactive focus on quality, detail and delivery, using your critical thinking skills and experience in resolving complex technical and functional issues in a timely and effective manner. Also, you possess a genuine desire to guide, challenge and develop colleagues, review work and share practical knowledge – and you can do so constructively in international teams. Moreover, with your strong communication skills, you engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and build trusted relationships with colleagues and clients alike.

Finally, we know nobody is perfect, but we imagine that you may:

• Have several years of hands-on experience configuring and implementing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.

• Have proven experience leading large, international and complex implementations, with ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design to deployment.

• Possess strong Employee Central solution knowledge, combined with the ability to analyze HR processes and translate business priorities into practical, scalable design.

• Be open to travelling and working on diverse projects, adapting to new challenges and environments.

• Be fluent in English (this is required), with additional Scandinavian languages being a plus.

• The role can be based in any Nordic country, with the expectation that you are within practical daily commuting distance of one of our local offices.

**Will you give us the opportunity to let you shine?

**Applicants are assessed continuously, so do not wait! Apply now and take the first step towards a fulfilling career with us at NTT DATA Business Solutions. We are excited to welcome you and see what we can achieve together.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe our strength lies in our diversity. We proudly embrace people from all walks of life, regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or background. Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and create a richer, more creative work environment for everyone.

_At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 19,000 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

_We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ _billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

_NTT DATA Business Solutions: Make this the place where Y__ou grow.

jobs.occupation: Følsgaard is looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager – MarineTech
jobs.description:
Do you build the kind of customer relationships where trust makes the difference?

At MarineTech, we are looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager who will take responsibility for a small portfolio of key customers and ensure an excellent customer experience from agreement to delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on hunting for new business. Your success will come from knowing your customers, understanding their needs and business, and building strong, long-term relationships based on trust, reliability and professional advice.

Your role

You will be the customer’s primary point of contact and trusted advisor, working closely with colleagues, suppliers and partners to make sure everything comes together.

You will combine customer relationship management with hands-on responsibility for orders, forecasts and deliveries. This means staying close to your customers, anticipating their needs and ensuring that commitments are followed through.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Build, maintain and develop strong relationships with existing customers

• Act as the customer’s primary contact and advise on products, solutions and delivery options

• Manage orders from A to Z, including requirements, prices, terms, documentation and delivery

• Follow up on customer forecasts and coordinate internally to support material and delivery planning

• Coordinate closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams

• Proactively keep customers informed about quotations, orders, deliveries and deviations

• Maintain accurate customer, order and activity data in ERP and CRM

• Identify opportunities to further develop existing customer accounts

• Look forward to 10–15 travel days per year as an opportunity to meet customers, build stronger relationships and get closer to their business.

You probably have experience from B2B customer management, order coordination, sales or customer service. More importantly, you enjoy building relationships and creating a customer experience where people know they can rely on you.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience working with B2B customers and coordinating orders or deliveries

• Have a good commercial understanding and an interest in technical products and solutions

• Are comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems and structured follow-up

• Ideally have experience coordinating with suppliers, carriers and complex deliveries

• Communicate professionally in both Danish and English

As a person

You are outgoing and approachable and naturally create good relationships with customers and colleagues. You are service-minded without losing sight of the commercial perspective.

At the same time, you are structured and proactive. You take ownership, keep an overview when several things are happening at once, and make sure agreements and commitments are followed through to completion.

Why this role?

You will get a role where relationships matter. Rather than constantly chasing the next customer, you will have the opportunity to understand a smaller number of important customers in depth and become a trusted partner in their day-to-day business.

You will be close to both customers and the internal organization, giving you a central role in turning customer needs into reliable solutions and deliveries.

Interested?

If you want to help develop the specialized container and maritime transport industry – while developing yourself professionally and personally – then we look forward to hearing from you.

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. Interviews are held continuously and we will hire once we find the right candidate.

If you have questions, feel free to contact HR Manager Louise Buur at +45 21 20 44 67.

**About Hans Følsgaard (**Hans Følsgaard A/S)

Hans Følsgaard A/S is a global technology company with roots in engineering and a clear ambition to support the green transition through intelligent, reliable solutions. Since 1922, we have provided specialised technology expertise to industry, and our team of more than 120 employees is based across locations in Denmark, Norway, Germany, India and China.

Collaboration, accountability and integrity are at the heart of how we work. We operate with flat organisational structures, take a long-term perspective and value curiosity, professional expertise and initiative.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for Sales Operations Specialist to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Sales Operations Specialist who wants to make a difference.

The Role

As a Sales Operations Specialist, you will support the sales organization and other parts of Truesec through sales administration and the coordination of sales-related processes. The role is central to ensuring that our sales operations run smoothly, efficiently, and in line with internal processes, policies, and business requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with a variety of functions across the organization, including Sales, Finance, Legal, Expert Services, and Managed Services. You will play an important part in driving structure, quality, and efficiency throughout our business and customer-facing processes.

As the first Sales Operations Specialist in Denmark, you will have a unique opportunity to shape and develop the role locally while being part of an established team based in Stockholm and Malmö. The role includes occasional travel to our Swedish offices to support collaboration and team development.

Examples of responsibilities:

• 
Create and administer offers, agreements, and digital signing.

• 
Manage deal registrations, incoming communication, and administrative follow-up.

• 
Set up and administer projects in Visma.

• 
Support Finance with data and processes to ensure accurate and efficient invoicing.

• 
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth and quality-assured sales processes.

Your Potential Background

We believe you are structured, detail-oriented, and service-minded, with a strong ability to combine administration, coordination, and business understanding. You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy creating structure, driving initiatives forward, and ensuring that every detail is handled with care and accuracy.

You are comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously, have a strong attention to detail, and communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

We believe you have:

• 
Experience from a similar role within Sales Operations, sales support, administration, or business coordination.

• 
Strong organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously.

• 
The ability to analyze information and translate insights into documentation, reports, and recommendations that support decision-making and follow-up.

• 
Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

It is an advantage if you have:

• 
Experience working with Visma, Jira, or similar finance or administration systems.

• 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Finance, and Legal teams in business-critical processes.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Danish work permit.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

jobs.occupation: Medical Head, Oncology – Denmark – Nordic Marketing Company
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead a country Medical Affairs organization to shape clinical practice and improve outcomes for people living with cancer? In this role, you will set the medical strategy, drive evidence generation, and elevate scientific engagement to close evidence gaps and support access for a portfolio that spans pre-launch through life-cycle management.

Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

You will guide a high-performing office- and field-based team, champion responsible AI adoption, and influence decisions across the enterprise while maintaining Medical independence. How will you translate insights from clinicians, payers and patients into an integrated medical plan that changes practice and accelerates impact?

Accountabilities:

• 
Lead Medical Strategy: Own the country Integrated Medical Plan, connecting therapeutic priorities, patient needs and evidence gaps to measurable impact.

• 
Drive Evidence Generation: Shape the country evidence strategy, including real-world evidence, health data and investigator-sponsored research, in collaboration with Nordic, regional and global teams.

• 
Champion Scientific Leadership: Represent AstraZeneca in scientific and healthcare forums, strengthening our external medical leadership.

• 
Take a proactive and visible leadership internally and externally on how to drive scientific expert mobilisation and advocacy solving market access challenges

• 
Lead by example in external KEE and CoE engagement and establish trusted high level networks of experts

• 
Enable Responsible AI Adoption: Build confidence and capability in AI to enhance scientific impact, efficiency and value, with appropriate human oversight.

• 
Ensure Medical Governance: Provide senior oversight of benefit–risk, compliance and reputational matters, ensuring adherence to internal standards and external regulations.

• 
Influence Cross-Functional Strategy: Bring medical expertise to Market Access, HTA and business planning while safeguarding Medical independence.

• 
Advance Organizational Excellence: Strengthen performance, operating models and ways of working to increase external impact and reduce internal complexity.

• 
Develop Future-Ready Talent: Build a strong leadership pipeline through workforce planning, succession, coaching and inclusive development.

• 
Connect Nordic and Global Priorities: Contribute to Nordic strategy, share best practices across countries and ensure local needs shape broader decision-making.

• 
Manage Resources Strategically: Own medical budgets and deploy resources to priority activities, launches and patient-impact opportunities.

• 
Build Strategic Partnerships: Develop trusted relationships with clinical experts, patient organizations, payers, HTA bodies and healthcare leaders to advance patient outcomes.

Essential Skills/Experience

• 
Scientific Qualification: Advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Natural Sciences or a related field.

• 
Medical Affairs Leadership: Significant experience leading Medical Affairs strategy, operations and capabilities across therapeutic areas and product lifecycles.

• 
Launch and Portfolio Expertise: Proven success delivering pre-launch, launch and lifecycle activities for complex portfolios.

• 
Senior Leadership: Experience influencing across cross-functional, matrixed, regional and global environments.

• 
People Leadership: Track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, empowerment and accountability.

• 
Strategic and Business Acumen: Ability to connect medical strategy with brand, value and access priorities while maintaining scientific integrity.

• 
Evidence and Compliance Expertise: Strong understanding of evidence generation, data, responsible AI, regulatory requirements and HTA expectations.

• 
Communication and Influence: Exceptional communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills; fluent in English and the local language.

• 
Agility and Execution: Strategic, analytical and adaptable, with the ability to prioritize, manage complexity and deliver results at pace.

• 
Industry Knowledge and Integrity: Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare systems and payer environments, with high ethical standards.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• 
Global or Cross-Cultural Experience: Experience working in global organizations or leading international teams.

• 
Additional Qualification: Physician training, PhD or MBA.

• 
Organizational Leadership: Experience leading leaders and developing high-performing organizations.

• 
R&D Collaboration: Experience partnering with Clinical Research, Medical Development or R&D Strategy.

• 
Project Leadership: Strong experience delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives.

jobs.description:
Introduction to Digital Archives and Methods is a moderately computationally intensive standalone course in History BA.

This course is scheduled on Tuesdays 8 -12 and Thursdays 10 - 14 in weeks 6 - 20. The bulk of assistance is needed in Weeks 6 - 15 in a minimum of 4 hr intervals. Each class is attended by circa 50-60 students who work in groups to complete digital tasks. The course is in-person.

We are looking for 2 teaching student assistants who can support the learners in this course through troubleshooting, assistance and conceptual guidance on the main tasks and themes of the course.

The tasks of the assistants are to provide in-class/remote assistance (in class-time):

· setup:

• assist with local software installations or online instantiations of Voyant, Transkribus, UCloud, R, OpenRefine, etc.

• access to course sources and computational environments

· operation:

• help students operate the tools introduced in the course and

• guide students in the pursuit of course tasks. Help interpret tool outputs during the conceptual work towards assessments.

• Act as student liaisons, translating student needs into technical questions for the instructors.

Selected candidates should show initiative, be digitally savvy and enthusiastic as well as reliable and well-organized. The work requires independence, flexibility, and attention to detail. Furthermore, the candidate should have good interpersonal skills.

The ideal candidate's application should demonstrate the following qualifications:

• Good command of English and Danish, both oral and written

• Familiarity with the course materials as well as the digital tools introduced: previous attendance of Digital Archives and Methods or equivalent is recommended.

• Experience with troubleshooting code and a knack for digital problem-solving

• Proactive, motivated and enthusiastic attitude

• Ability to communicate effectively with students and fellow assistants, as well as liaise with instructors.

Please contact Kathrine Juul Svejstrup kjs@cas.au.dk for more information about the positions.

Applications should address how the applicant fits the qualifications listed above, be written in English and accompanied by a brief CV. Please indicate your availability in class time in weeks 6 to 15 and state which operating systems you are comfortable troubleshooting.

A prerequisite for employment is that the applicant is an actively enrolled student. Employment is subject to the availability of the necessary funding.

Applicants will be notified of the outcome of their application within four weeks of the application deadline.

Employment is in accordance with the Ministry of Finance and SUL Finansministeriet og SUL (student instructors).

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Energy as a Senior Power System Engineering Specialist and lead the conceptual and system design of high-voltage substations from 72.5 kV to 420 kV for onshore and offshore projects. The role combines system design decisions in the early tender and conceptual design phase, where you take part in customer dialogues to optimize the system design, with managing the power system studies as a work package in projects. Working closely with customers, project managers and engineering experts, you define the main electrical parameters of the system. Your work turns complex technical requirements into reliable power system solutions that support the future of sustainable energy.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Leading system design activities for high-voltage substations, including AIS and GIS solutions for onshore and offshore applications

• Developing and reviewing single-line diagrams, electrical philosophies, interface definitions and technical concepts, and defining the main electrical parameters for transformers, reactors, switchgear and auxiliary systems

• Managing the power system studies as a work package in projects, planning which studies are needed at each stage so components can be procured with the right data

• Collaborating with customers, certification bodies, technology suppliers and engineering teams, and driving technical decision-making and the continuous development of engineering best practices and standards

What You Bring

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline

• Minimum 10 years of experience within high-voltage substation and power system engineering, including transmission substations in the 72.5 kV to 420 kV range

• Proven experience with system design, grid code compliance and power system studies for the grid connection of wind farms, for example from offshore wind, utility-scale transmission or renewable energy integration

• Strong understanding of power system behavior under normal and fault conditions, and practical experience with power transformers, shunt reactors, earthing auxiliary transformers and high-voltage switchgear technologies

• Knowledge of protection and control concepts and power system studies, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

This position is part of our Substation engineering department in Denmark, which consists of four engineering teams and a number of specialists reporting directly to the Head of Engineering. The role works across different projects and tenders, together with power system calculation experts in Germany and Denmark.

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

jobs.occupation: Finance Manager, Strategic Finance, Synergies Enabler - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong financial toolbox, a strategic mindset and a passion for turning complex business challenges into tangible value? Would you like to play a key role in realizing the value from Arla’s merger with German dairy company DMK?

“As Finance Manager, Synergies Enabler you will become part of the team supporting synergy delivery from the merger with DMK. You will work closely with finance leaders and business stakeholders, acting as a synergy partner and helping connect strategic ambition with financial execution. You will combine hands-on financial analysis with stakeholder management and project execution,” says Theis Engedal Pedersen, Strategic Finance Director.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**Reporting to the Director of Strategic Finance, you will join a highly engaged team of eight finance professionals working close to Arla’s performance management agenda and across our global organization. Your key responsibilities will include

• Partner with finance leads and business stakeholders in solving synergy-related challenges, using financial analysis and modelling to translate business initiatives into measurable financial impact

• Support the identification and quantification of merger synergies, working closely with finance and business stakeholders to establish robust financial baselines, assumptions and value potential

• Support the tracking of synergy realization and P&L impact, creating transparency on progress and helping connect operational delivery with financial outcomes

• Drive efficient and transparent synergy reporting and help turn complex financial information into clear insights and messages for senior management

• Support the broader synergy agenda through strong project management, bringing structure, follow-up and momentum to initiatives involving stakeholders across the organization

**What will make you successful?

**We are looking for someone who combines strong financial capabilities with curiosity, business understanding and an ability to see the bigger picture. You enjoy getting into the details when necessary, but equally important, you can step back, connect the dots and turn complex information into a clear narrative. The ideal candidate brings

• 6+ years of relevant experience from finance or strategy functions; for example finance business partnering, strategic finance, consulting or corporate strategy

• A relevant university degree within Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills, with an ability to translate analysis into insights, recommendations and actions

• A strategic mind and ability to build the bigger picture and develop a compelling narrative from complex information

• A solid project management tool box and is comfortable bringing structure and momentum to complex, cross-functional initiatives.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to condense details into precise, executive-level messages

• Strong relationship building and sparring partnering, and is comfortable collaborating across functions and organizational levels.

**What do we offer?

**This is an opportunity to work on a complex, high-profile merger agenda, where strong partnering skills make a tangible difference to value creation. You will get exposure to a wide range of senior stakeholders across Finance and the wider Arla business and build a broad network across the organization. You will join a young, highly engaged and collaborative Strategic Finance team with strong opportunities for personal and professional development.

**Would you like to join us?

**If you want to help realise the value of the Arla-DMK merger and shape the future of dairy, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis and will close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information, please contact Theis Engedal Pedersen Director of Strategic Finance, on +45 9131 4630

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome.

As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce.

This is where you make a difference

You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation.

One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business.

From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership.

You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg.

Key responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles

• Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles

• Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models

• Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions

What you bring

You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills:

• Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains

• Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture

• SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences

• Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture

• Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines

• Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns

• CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations

• Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies

• Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA

Why Blue Water

You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality.

What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT.

As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future.

Interested?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. If you are ready to make a real impact in a global organisation undergoing significant transformation, we would love to hear from you.

For questions about the role, please contact Kamil J. Karolak, Head of Data Management.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What we do – Together we create solutions

Blue Water Shipping is a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. Founded in Denmark in 1972, Blue Water is a global organisation of professionals, skilled in offering complete and tailor-made solutions to any shipping requirement anywhere in the world. We offer clients the best service and highest quality in the industry.

The company is represented by more than 80 offices in 30 countries worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise. **Finance Business Partner, VELUX A/S - Østbirk

****Do you enjoy turning data into meaningful insights and working closely with people to influence decisions and drive performance? With a passion for business partnering and a strong analytical mindset, you could be our next Finance Business Partner in Østbirk.

****Meet your future team

**As part of our Global Finance team, you will join a group of dedicated and experienced colleagues supporting our production sites in Østbirk and Brædstrup. Together, we work to bring financial insights to life and enable informed business decisions that create value across the organisation.

In this role, you will work closely with operational leaders, managers, and finance stakeholders, building trusted relationships and gaining a deep understanding of our manufacturing business. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, openness, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone can contribute and develop their skills.

**What We Offer

**As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting business performance and helping operational teams make data-driven decisions. You will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your expertise and insights contribute directly to business success.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Partner with managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and decision support.

• Monitor and analyse efficiency, production performance, material consumption, budgets, and key operational KPIs.

• Prepare financial analyses, business cases, and presentations to support strategic and operational decision-making.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes.

• Contribute to standard costing and product costing activities within a manufacturing environment.

• Develop and enhance reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, efficiencies, and value creation.

• Communicate financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders across different functions and levels.

**What You Will Bring

**We are looking for a collaborative and curious finance professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking with strong business understanding. Whether your background is in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling, Financial Analysis, or a related field, you are motivated by creating value through insights and strong stakeholder relationships.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Have strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

• Build positive and productive relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Have advanced Excel capabilities and an interest in reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI.

• Communicate fluently in both Danish and English.

• Work in a structured and organised manner while remaining flexible and solution-oriented.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment where teamwork and knowledge sharing are highly valued.

• Bring experience with SAP, standard costing, or product costing, although this is considered an advantage rather than a requirement.

If you do not meet every requirement but believe your experience and potential make you a strong candidate, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that diverse experiences and perspectives strengthen our teams and contribute to better outcomes.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Complex transactions, new products and changing business needs often raise accounting questions without a standard answer.

As Senior Financial Controller, you’ll combine hands-on financial controlling and Group reporting with IFRS and technical accounting expertise. You’ll assess those questions, establish the accounting treatment and translate your conclusions into clear, practical reporting solutions across the Group.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being close to the numbers while taking ownership of the accounting questions behind them. You’ll have room to apply your expertise across reporting processes, accounting governance and IFRS as the business develops.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

Your work combines recurring financial controlling and Group reporting with accounting assessments that require deeper analysis.

Your mission is to:

• Support month-end and year-end closing, Group reporting, accounting analyses and quality assurance of financial data

• Provide IFRS and technical accounting expertise on complex accounting matters and contribute to accounting policies, reporting guidance and documentation across the Group

• Analyse new products, contracts, energy trading activities and strategic initiatives to determine their accounting and reporting implications

• Strengthen Group reporting processes, controls and documentation to support consistent and reliable financial reporting

• Work across Financial Controlling, Accounting, Risk, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Trading and Business Development, bringing financial reporting expertise into complex business and accounting decisions

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

You’ll join our Financial Controlling team, where collaboration, learning, high-quality reporting and strong processes are part of everyday work. Curiosity and practical thinking shape how the team approaches financial questions and grows.

Knowledge is shared openly, and colleagues challenge ideas constructively to improve controlling, reporting and compliance. You’ll have room to contribute your expertise from day one while continuing to develop professionally.

This position is based at our Aarhus office, with flexibility to work from home when it fits the work and the team. Expect around 5–10 days of travel each year.

LET'S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You enjoy working close to the numbers and digging deeper when an accounting question requires it. You approach complex questions with curiosity and structure, connecting the details to the broader reporting picture and turning your conclusions into something others can use.

We imagine you bring:

• 5+ years of experience in financial controlling, Group reporting, audit, technical accounting or a similar finance position.

• A master’s degree in accounting, auditing, finance or a related field.

• Solid knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting, with an interest in developing further expertise within technical accounting.

• Experience from a Big 4 firm, an international finance function, Group Finance or a similar controlling and accounting environment.

• The ability to communicate complex accounting and reporting matters clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

You don’t need to tick every box. What matters most is a solid controlling and financial reporting foundation, combined with the curiosity to dig into complex accounting questions.

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting and Christmas afternoons with your family and Santa. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognising that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

Upload your CV and tell us a bit about how you approach financial controlling, reporting quality and complex accounting questions in practice.

We’re particularly interested in hearing about:

• A complex accounting or reporting issue you’ve worked with. How did you analyse it, involve relevant stakeholders and translate your conclusion into a practical solution?

• A reporting process or control you’ve improved. What did you change, and what was the result?

Where confidentiality permits, you’re welcome to include an anonymised accounting assessment or reporting example, as well as your university transcript if available.

Application deadline is November 6, 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process early if we find the right match.

If you have any questions about the role, you're welcome to contact Anton Byg Olesen, Head of Financial Controlling, at anbl@mindenergy.com

For general recruitment matters, contact people@mindenergy.com

Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Delivering software excellence and pushing the limits of technology to make some of the world’s best hearing aids is what we do in Demant.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with broad competencies who wants to develop and strengthen our Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL).

You will be deep down the software stack in a crucial and complex part of our software eco system.

Development, defect support and platform improvements

Our HAL platform connects to hearing aids, apps, fitting software and sophisticated internal tools. Seamless Bluetooth solutions and connectivity are crucial for the end-users to have great experience with our hearing aids.

We embrace agile software development and use Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and releases the HAL platform 2-4 times per year. The backlog of features and enablers are executed by priority.

The features are platform support of audiological or end user features. The enablers are typically platform improvements for the future and general internal improvements that can be either specific or of an exploratory nature.

What you will do

Your job can be divided into these three main areas:

• 
Most of your daily life is analyzing, designing, coding, testing and integrating our platform, always done with a broad mindset. Analyzing logs and unraveling mysteries is a key activity in the role and team.

• 
With an ever-changing Bluetooth environment and incoming defects there will be adjustments, which you must react fast to as part of the team. You will also act as problem solver for other teams consuming HAL.

• 
Lastly, you will be part of simplifying HAL to make the solutions more effective, maintainable and secure. In collaboration with the team, you will identify improvements and come up with suggestions for how these should be implemented.

We need everybody in the team to be on top of technology to keep on improving and providing best-in-class solutions. To support this, we have a monthly learning day for the team to acquire relevant knowledge either individually or on a team base.

We invest in and take advantage of AI, that is part of our development environment and tooling.

Teamwork, teamwork, teamwork

Part of your team consists of six Software Developers, two Test Developers, a Product Owner and a Scrum Master. They are all very experienced and enthusiastic about their jobs.

We encourage and strive for T-shaping, meaning that it is healthy that we share the responsibilities and grow mutual skills between developers and test developers.

Scrum is used as the basic way of working and encourages collaboration, sparring and sharing of thoughts and enables the best possible solutions.

It is important that you can collaborate with others and see the gain of it, rather than just working on your own. We hope that you, with your energy and enthusiasm, will contribute and encourage cooperation.

Your manager is a “servant leader” and will support your needs and development in our trust-based culture.

We believe in the good life

In Demant we trust and value professionalism, experience, and commitment. We recognize that to bring energy and inspiration to work, you need to re-energize and spend time with family, friends, and hobbies in a healthy work life balance.

To ensure the good life we offer good breakfast and lunch in our canteen, free fitness room including weekly spinning and yoga sessions, massage offer, no child’s first sick day meaning you can stay home with your child as long as the child is not feeling well and the possibility to work from home up to two days per week. Just to mention some of the things.

Your profile

• To candidate for this job, you need to be Senior Software Developer with minimum 8 years of experience. You have experience with hardware abstraction layers either as a provider or consumer.

• You are proficient in .NET and #C and have experience with Bluetooth Low Energy and/or have made apps; IOS, Android or MAUI, and are able to grasp, navigate and make a difference in a large eco-system of software and hardware.

• You like to understand how things work and to untangle complex issues in the complex HAL world.

• It will be nice but is not required if you have experience from pharma / medico or other regulated industries and know how it impact our work.

• Other people will say you have a high focus on quality and testing at all levels and that you enjoy the respect of others as a team player, where you seek the optimal solution through a constructive dialogue.

• It is required that you work on-site Smørum from 1st of January 2027 and no later than 1st of February 2027.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Energy as a Technical Project Manager and lead the technical execution of a large-scale high-voltage substation project: a 400 kV AC substation with GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), Control & Protection systems, SCADA, telecommunications and auxiliary systems, which will connect future offshore wind. As the technical authority in the project organization, you report to the overall project manager and coordinate all technical disciplines on the Danish part of this flagship infrastructure project in Denmark, which runs until 2034. From design through installation and commissioning, you represent the technical side in meetings with the customer and a large international project organization, making a significant impact on the future of power transmission and the energy transition.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Leading the technical execution of a complex high-voltage substation project from design through installation and commissioning

• Coordinating a multidisciplinary team of 7-10 discipline leads, scope managers and engineering specialists, and ensuring each discipline delivers its commitments on time and to the required quality

• Driving technical planning and engineering schedules with a clear work breakdown, critical path and intermediate milestones, aligning interfaces and dependencies between work packages and monitoring progress against schedules and budgets

• Acting as the primary escalation point for technical challenges, managing technical risks and mitigation plans, and presenting technical solutions to the customer side by side with the overall project manager

• Participating in customer meetings and technical workshops, and collaborating closely with project management, site management, procurement, construction and commissioning teams

• Ensuring compliance with standards, regulations, employer requirements and contractual technical obligations, leading requirement management and traceability, and supporting design reviews

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline

• Minimum 5 years of experience leading technical teams and coordinating engineering disciplines within power transmission, substations or large infrastructure projects, for example as a technical project manager or senior technical lead

• Strong understanding of high-voltage substations, especially GIS and Control and Protection systems, as well as AIS, SCADA, communication and auxiliary systems

• Strong knowledge of engineering standards, specifications and requirement management, and experience working directly with customers, contractors and external stakeholders

• A structured, proactive and results-oriented leader who is confident in large customer-facing meetings and technical negotiations, and builds strong relationships across disciplines and organizations

• Fluent English, Danish is considered an advantage

About the Team

This position is part of our Substation engineering department in Denmark, which consists of four engineering teams and a number of specialists reporting directly to the Head of Engineering. In the project, the Technical Project Manager is supported by work package managers and experts within each technical discipline.

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Learning-Based Multi-Agent Control under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
The Department of Electronic Systems at the Technical Faculty of IT and Design invites applications for a postdoc in learning-based multi-agent control under uncertainty, with applications to autonomous multi-robot systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments, as per February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is available for a period of 2 years.

Your work tasks   The position focuses on fundamental research in learning-based planning and control of interacting autonomous agents under uncertainty. You will develop new theoretical and algorithmic approaches for distributed and cooperative control, combining learning or online adaptation with principled treatment of safety, robustness, and performance. Research challenges include uncertain dynamics and disturbances, partial or noisy information, changing interactions between agents, and limited or unreliable communication.

A central part of the work will be to formulate rigorous methods and establish their properties, for example concerning stability, safety, constraint satisfaction, robustness, and convergence, where applicable. Depending on the research direction, the work may draw on learning-augmented model predictive control, safe reinforcement learning, data-driven modelling and safety mechanism (e.g. CBF), distributed optimization, or robust and adaptive control. You will develop reproducible numerical studies and simulations to examine the strengths, limitations, and scalability of the proposed methods.

The research will be carried out in the Horizon Europe ROX-6G project, where heterogeneous robot teams provide a compelling application for coordination under uncertain conditions and connectivity constraints. Although the position is primarily theoretical, you will collaborate with colleagues working on robotic implementation and will contribute to experimental validation. You will lead and co-author publications in international journals and conferences, engage with project partners, contribute to research planning and scientific discussions, and support knowledge exchange within the team.

Your competencies

We seek a researcher with a PhD in control engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, and a strong background in mathematical modelling, control, optimization, or multi-agent systems.

You should be able to formulate original research problems, develop and analyse rigorous methods, and demonstrate research quality through peer-reviewed scientific publications. Experience in learning-based control, robust or nonlinear control, distributed control, or decision-making under uncertainty is particularly relevant; expertise in every one of these areas is not expected.

You should have good scientific programming skills, for example in Python, MATLAB, or C++, and be able to evaluate algorithms systematically through simulation. We value independent research initiative, clear scientific writing, and the ability to work constructively with researchers from different disciplines and backgrounds. Experience with autonomous robots, ROS/ROS 2, multi-robot simulation, or physical robotic experiments will be considered an advantage, but is not a prerequisite for this primarily theory-oriented position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 600 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

The position is hosted in the Automation and Control Section, within a collaborative robotics research environment combining fundamental research with real-world applications.

In addition, you will work with an international team and research partners in ROX-6G, a European collaboration addressing autonomous robotic operations in demanding underground environments. Our research interests span safe and resilient decision-making, learning-enabled control, distributed multi-robot coordination, and validation in simulation and on robotic platforms. We encourage scientific independence, close exchange of ideas, and publication of high-quality research. More information: www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
