jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for software programming and are you up for new challenges? Would you like to be part of developing the future’s electricity meters for automated reading systems? Are you interested in an exciting and educational internship at an international green-tech company?

Here is what the job entails

During this internship you will become a part of a Scrum team working with embedded software for electricity meters, as well as the scripts and tools that tie the development process together. Your daily task includes improving and extending automated test software, maintaining test setups based on Raspberry Pi, and participating in proof-of-concept development projects.

The specific content of the tasks will be planned together with you based on your preferences, interests, and competencies. We work in a range of technical disciplines, but some tools you might be using are:

• Python

• Programmering i C

• C#

• GIT

• Automatic software test

• DevOps

Meet your future team

As an intern in Embedded Software Development - Electricity Meters, you’ll become an integral part of our meter development department. This department designs and maintains hardware and software for our metering systems. You will join a team of 8 skilled development engineers, all with a background in firmware development and testing. Collaboration is a key focus, and close interaction with experienced colleagues provides ample opportunities for daily discussions, professional growth, and a steep learning curve during your internship.

Did you know? Even though we are colleagues at work, we also value a bit of friendly competition, and we often take that competitive spirit to the padel court together.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student interested in software development, who values quality and high reliability in our solutions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying a degree in electronics engineering or similar

• Are flexible, structured, and enjoy working closely with your colleagues

• Have a can-do mindset that enables you to take on new and challenging tasks

• Are driven by a passion for developing software

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

_Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

__We are looking for an experienced Azure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD Engineer to help elevate our SaaS operations and internal deployment processes to the next level.

_**Key About Your Role

**We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

We work with two layers of deployments:

• Platform deployments: Low frequency (around once per month), planned well in advance

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon

Both typically take place outside normal office hours. For these, you will be compensated with time off from your regular schedule. Deployments usually last about 15 minutes, with occasional on-call backup needed for unforeseen issues (fortunately, rare).

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

****Key responsibilities:

• Environments: Refining and improving the setup of our internal and external environments in a beautiful Kubernetes architecture in Azure

• CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe

• Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging. Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

**Key About Your Team

**Our team, named Obex, is a business unit of Keylane, employing around twenty-five awesome developers, business analysts and a few other professions. Our main product is our Obex Platform, a SaaS solution for financial advisory used by advisors in a variety of pension funds and banks.

We are proud that finances of an estimated two million Danes have been through our software. The Obex Platform is developed in close collaboration with our customers, resulting in a product that users truly appreciate.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that's a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There's much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let's save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

**Questions?

**If you have any further questions regarding this position, please reach out to the hiring manager Rasmus Amossen via mail to rasmus.amossen@keylane.com.

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.

**Requirements

****Experience?

**

• You are fluent in Kubernetes, have solid experience with Azure services, virtual network configuration, and Azure DevOps

• You know your way around log and performance monitoring tools and have a passion for clean, well-architected systems

• You are not content with things merely working, you want them to work beautifully

• Our platform uses .NET on the backend, React with Typescript on the frontend, and Aspire for local development orchestration. Experience with these technologies is a plus.

• There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together

**Using AI

**

• You are interested in using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex as part of the software development lifecycle. For example, to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate or improve code and tests, refactoring, troubleshoot issues, document solutions and support code reviews;

• You understand that AI-generated code and suggestions must be critically evaluated, tested and reviewed. You take ownership of the quality, security, correctness and maintainability of the code you deliver;

**Other

**Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

**Benefits

**

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment

• A profit share

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 43.000 - 56.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competences, knowledge, and relevant experience

**The Impact You'll Make

**As Senior Manager, Front-End Portfolio Management, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future growth of Sensing Solutions. You will lead our Front-End Engine and growth opportunity portfolio, helping identify where we should invest next across technologies, markets, partnerships, and business models.

Working at the intersection of technology, customer insights, and business strategy, you will turn emerging trends, customer needs, and strategic priorities into actionable growth opportunities. Your recommendations will influence critical investment decisions and help ensure we focus our resources on the opportunities with the greatest potential to create customer value and accelerate business growth.

Sensing Solutions, part of Danfoss Climate Solutions, develops sensor technologies that help customers improve efficiency, performance, and sustainability. In this role, you'll help define the future direction of the business while contributing to technologies that support the global energy transition and reduce climate impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and continuously enhance the Sensing Front-End Engine and portfolio governance processes, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective decision-making across the organization

• Build, maintain, and prioritize a portfolio of growth opportunities by translating customer needs, market trends, emerging technologies, and strategic priorities into validated investment opportunities

• Lead selected strategic initiatives, including new business opportunities, strategic partnerships, and M&A-related assessments, from early exploration through recommendation and decision-making

• Drive portfolio prioritization and resource allocation discussions, ensuring investment decisions are aligned with business priorities, available resources, and long-term growth ambitions

• Partner closely with Product Management, Segment Management, Commercial, R&D, Supply Chain, and senior leaders to accelerate opportunity development, strengthen alignment, and support execution

You will also help build Front-End capabilities across the organization by coaching opportunity owners and promoting a consistent, evidence-based approach to opportunity evaluation and portfolio management.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field, combined with significant experience in strategy, business development, product management, portfolio management, or similar commercial roles within a technology-driven organization

• Proven experience identifying, validating, and developing growth opportunities, turning market insights, customer needs, and business objectives into clear recommendations, business cases, and investment priorities

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to make sound decisions in complex environments and balance opportunity potential with business priorities and resource constraints

• Experience working across functions and influencing stakeholders in areas such as engineering, sales, operations, supply chain, and senior leadership

• A collaborative and proactive mindset, with the ability to build networks, create alignment, and help teams move from ideas to decisions and results

Experience with sensing technologies, particularly pressure, gas, or temperature sensing, is an advantage. Knowledge of the HVACR, data center, water, or off-highway industries, as well as experience with strategic partnerships, business development, or M&A activities, would also be beneficial.

As many of our primary stakeholders are located in Nordborg you will be expected to be on site frequently to build a strong relation with them.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the long-term growth strategy of a global business, working on some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Sensing Solutions. You'll collaborate with senior leaders, gain exposure across the value chain, and help bring new technologies, partnerships, and business opportunities to life.

We promote development from within and support learning through collaboration, mentoring, training and access to global opportunities.

You will have flexibility, autonomy and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We strive to create an inclusive working environment where people of different backgrounds and perspectives are respected and valued.

Benefits may include annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance and other locally applicable benefits.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're creating a new role at the top of our Engineering career ladder: Lead Architect. It's the senior end of our Technical Track — the rung above Tech Lead — and today it's a role we've deliberately left lightly defined, because we want the first person in it to help define it. You'll set Factbird's technical direction: architecture, tooling, and the multi-year technology bets that shape where the product goes next.

This is our most senior technical role, with no direct reports — your authority comes from judgment and track record, not the org chart. You'll work alongside our Tech Leads in Factbird's technical leadership group, partner closely with our Director of Engineering, and be the person other senior engineers go to when a decision is genuinely hard to reverse.

**About the Role

**As Lead Architect, you own Factbird's company-wide technical vision: the architecture our services run on, the tooling and standards our engineers use every day, and the multi-year technology strategy that ties it all together. You make — or sign off on — the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse architecture calls, and you're accountable for getting them right with the full context of where the business is headed, not just where the code is today.

You'll work across a team built on Rust, React, Node.js, and AWS, with AI-assisted development already a core part of how we ship. Some of what this role owns is already well-defined — reviewing RFCs, stewarding language and platform standards, setting the team's AI-tooling strategy. jobs.description:
Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. **About The Role

**We are looking for an experienced financial-crime leader to be our registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig (HVL

• 7, stk. 2) for Monta Pay ApS under our EMI license and to lead Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) across Monta, group-wide for the Danish/EEA EMI plus UK and US compliance as those markets scale. The role is registered with Finanstilsynet, so the appointment is subject to a fit & proper assessment as a change of key function holder.

Monta Pay ApS holds an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license, granted by Finanstilsynet in April 2026. We are now migrating our financial services from Monta ApS to Monta Pay ApS, with go-live planned for Q2 2027. This is the moment the AML/FCP framework moves from build to live operation, and you will own it.

This is a high-profile, senior role. You sit at the centre of our financial-services compliance strategy as we scale, "directly exposed to the fire." You must balance obligations against resources with a risk-based approach, communicate complex issues clearly to senior leaders and the Board, and run your work-streams with strong, solution-oriented project management. In return, you have an outsized impact on how Monta builds and operates financial services compliance, and direct exposure to decision-making at a fast-growing scale-up.

You report day to day to Nick Skovsen, COO of Monta Pay ApS, with direct, independent access to the CEO and executive management of Monta Pay ApS and to its Board and Governance, Risk & Compliance Committee.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig: Act as the statutory AML-responsible person for Monta Pay under the EMI license. Approve AML/CTF policies and high-risk customer relationships escalated by the first line (PEPs, and business involving high-risk third countries). Receive internal escalations, decide on and file SARs/STRs with the FIU, and be the primary AML contact for Finanstilsynet.

• Own the Financial Crime Prevention framework: Steward Monta's FCP model (our nine-pillar "FC9" framework) covering AML/CFT, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery & corruption. Propose the risk appetite and risk-based approach for Board approval and monitor against it, and keep the framework effective and proportionate to our activities, customer types (B2B & B2C), and transaction flows.

• Fraud, transaction monitoring & customer due diligence: Own the frameworks for fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and KYC/KYB (CDD/EDD, PEP and sanctions screening) across onboarding and the lifecycle (EU and US). Set the rules, thresholds and procedures the Financial Operations team runs in the first line, and assure their quality and effectiveness.

• Sanctions & screening: Set the screening standards (lists, thresholds, re-screening frequency) and assure the quality of first-line alert handling.

• Policy suite, risk assessment & governance: Maintain the AML/CFT policy suite in the Centralised Policy Register (with version control and Board-approval tracking), and own the Business-Wide Risk Assessment (BWRA) and the AML risk assessment underpinning the framework.

• Regulatory reporting: Deliver AML and payments regulatory reporting (for example Section 99 Payment Act, KPSD, AML/CTF returns) and ensure CESOP readiness.

• Technology, controls & assurance: Work with Product and Engineering on case management, screening and monitoring tooling and AI/automation, oversee AML-relevant third parties, and run the internal-controls framework (monitoring, QA, remediation).

• Training, culture & Board liaison: Build AML/FCP training and a strong compliance culture, and advise Senior Management and the Board GRC Committee on financial-crime risk, regulatory change, and performance.

• Build and lead the team: Build out and lead the second-line FCP/AML team as volumes grow post go-live.

What You’ll Walk Into (first 6 to 12 months)

• The foundations are in place; the job is to make them operational for go-live.

• On AML: everything required to obtain the EMI license has been submitted and approved. The remaining gap is operational readiness, and that is the focus: embedding the framework in day-to-day operations and rolling it out with our customers and with colleagues across Monta.

• On FCP: This role brings centralised ownership and direction, consolidating what already exists, formalising it into clear Standard Operating Procedures, and training the relevant teams on them ahead of go-live.

• Concrete early priorities include standing up transaction monitoring and fraud detection, locking v1.0 of the policy suite (Sanctions, PEP, EDD, Outsourcing, and the Sanction-Screening and SAR/STR filing SOPs) into the Centralised Policy Register, building the regulatory-reporting data structure and CESOP readiness, finalising KYC/KYB (EU + US), and securing your Finanstilsynet fit & proper approval ahead of go-live. A structured focus-areas plan accompanies this role.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum 3 years (ideally 5+, given this is a registered key-function role) of relevant experience in the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing, ideally in a licensed EMI, payment institution, bank, or regulated fintech. Comparable experience in public authorities, AML consulting, or other AML-regulated sectors (for example gaming/gambling) will also be considered.

• Strong, current understanding of Danish AML law (Hvidvaskloven) and the EU framework (AMLD/AMLR, EBA guidelines), plus sanctions regimes. Awareness of the incoming EU AML package (AMLR + AMLD6, applying July 2027) is a plus.

• Eligibility to pass a Finanstilsynet fit & proper assessment. Prior approval in a fit & proper / key-function role at an EU financial institution is a strong advantage.

• Hands-on experience with fraud prevention and transaction monitoring, and with the underlying tooling (KYC/KYB, screening, monitoring, case management). Data literacy and comfort with AI/automation are a plus.

• Experience across risk controls, compliance, the payments area, credit management, or lines-of-defence leadership. Fintech/scale-up experience is a plus.

• Strong communication skills, autonomy, and sound decision-making, with the ability to build from a blank page and then scale a function and team.

• Analytical and investigative skills to detect patterns and anomalies in financial transactions and to investigate suspicious activity.

• Danish speaking, or willing to learn (the role is regulator-facing).

• Relevant education (economics, mathematics, law, or financial-sector training) is a plus.

• No prior convictions or legal issues that would make the candidate unfit for the role, particularly offences related to financial crime, fraud, money laundering, or other criminal activities undermining trust and integrity.

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Job Description

How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.

Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.

Responsibilities

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe

• Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices

• Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready

• Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

How we work with AI

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. You don't need expertise at the start, but must be willing to learn and maintain high accuracy standards.

About you

We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in economics, political science, statistics, data science or a similar field.

• Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a must; Danish is an advantage.

• Are comfortable working with data: confident in Excel and ideally familiar with Python, R, Stata or a similar tool.

• Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies

• Are willing to learn to use AI tools effectively in your own work, and to keep relating output critically to prior knowledge and theory.

You're a proven strategy leader with deep consulting expertise, exceptional executive presence and a track record of coaching high-performing teams through complex, ambiguous challenges in fast-paced environments.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will join the Clinical Development team, being part of the Endocrine & Rare Disease Medical Sciences organization. You will report directly to the VP of Clinical Science who is based in the US. You will be based in Hellerup together with the Danish team.

Since you will join a team based in different time zones, you must be available for evening meetings. This position also may require occasional international travel.

Your key responsibilities will be

• Contribute to formulation and implementation of the Clinical Development Plan

• Leverage medical expertise and hands-on clinical experience to promote relevance and rigor of the development program

• For clinical trials: design, provide overall oversight, and support site and subject retention

• Serve as a Medical Monitor for clinical trials, ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Provide leadership to teams of medical monitors and study teams

• Ensure successful completion of trial-related documents (including clinical trial protocols, investigator brochures, medical monitoring plans, site training materials, clinical study reports, health authority responses, standard operating procedures, etc.) with cross-functional team members

• Ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Analyze, evaluate, interpret, and report clinical data

• Anticipate and solve complex drug development problems

• Contribute to regulatory strategy

• Contribute to drafting and reviewing of clinical documents, manuscripts, presentations, and regulatory submissions

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant science, medical information, good clinical practices, and regulatory guidance

• Collaborate with—and serve as a clinical research resource for—cross-functional colleagues (e.g. in clinical operations, statistics, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, health economics outcomes research, commercial, finance) to optimize product development

• Contribute to (and may be asked to represent the clinical development department in) corporate strategic and organizational initiatives

• Cultivate relationships with investigative sites, clinical consultants, and key opinion leaders to represent the interests of the company

• Assist in portfolio management and commercial activities as needed

• Complete assigned tasks thoroughly, accurately, and on time

• Adhere to rigorous ethical standards

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold an M.D. degree and preferably also a Ph.D. degree. You have hands-on experience treating patients.

Furthermore, you have:

• At least 5-7 years of industry experience (other relevant experience e.g., post-graduate experience in the clinical and/or academic realms may also be considered on a case-by-case basis).

• Strong track record of scientific and clinical inquiry

• Possess excellent communication skills (written and oral)

• Demonstrate sound judgement in terms of handling complex, confidential, and regulated information

Key competencies:

You have a proven ability to learn quickly, even in fast‑paced environments.

You take ownership of your work, lead by example, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across the organization. You are trusted by others for your sound judgment and discretion, particularly when handling confidential, sensitive, or regulated information.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to be comfortable working with complex instructions, managing multiple priorities, and consistently maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
