jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
• Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
• Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
• Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions) 
• Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.You have:
• A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems 
• Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects 
• Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar 
• Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
• A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by making green commercial investments across Africa, Asia, and Latin America?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor.  We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

We are strengthening our Green Energy and Infrastructure team and are looking for an Investment Professional to join us in our headquarters in Copenhagen. Depending on your experience, you may join us as Investment Analyst or Investment Manager.

Green Energy and Infrastructure invests in businesses and infrastructure that accelerate the green transition in emerging markets. Our investment focus spans renewable energy, circular economy, electric mobility, and water infrastructure. Through equity and debt investments, active ownership and strategic partnerships, we drive impact and value creation aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. We typically invest between DKK 100-350 million per transaction.

You will be reporting to a Managing Director in Green Energy and Infrastructure and work closely with colleagues in Copenhagen and our regional offices across Europe, Africa, Asia and Latin America on investments throughout the investment lifecycle.

 

Investment Analyst

As an Investment Analyst, you will be a key analytical resource in transaction teams, focusing on commercial and financial analysis of investment opportunities.

You will:

• 
Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

• 
Assist in preparing investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling.

• 
Support due diligence, valuation and deal structuring.

• 
Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

• 
Collect and analyse commercial and financial data for deal teams.

• 
Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

• 
Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

• 
Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

• 
Ensure timely and accurate updates of systems with project documents, and financial and sustainability reporting.

• 
Assist in assessing exit timing and support execution.

 

Qualifications:

• 
Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

• 
1-2 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

• 
Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

• 
Skilled user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

• 
Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

• 
Fluent in English (written and spoken).

• 
Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

 

Investment Manager

As an Investment Manager, you will take the lead on many of the tasks performed by an Investment Analyst. You are thus expected to work independently, drive workstreams, and take ownership of parts of the investment process.

You will:

• 
Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

• 
Lead preparation of parts of investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling with guidance from the project manager (Senior Investment Manager or Investment Director).

• 
Support and lead due diligence, valuation and deal structuring workstreams.

• 
Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

• 
Lead the analysis of commercial and financial data for deal teams.

• 
Take part in negotiating terms and drafting legal documentation.

• 
Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

• 
Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

• 
Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

• 
Assist in assessing exit timing and support exit negotiations and execution.

 

Qualifications:

• 
Master’s degree in a relevant field such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

• 
3-5 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

• 
Independent mindset and experienced in owning and managing workstreams.

• 
Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

• 
Expert user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

• 
Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

• 
Fluent in English (written and spoken).

• 
Strong interpersonal skills and business judgment.

• 
Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

• 
Experience in emerging markets and green energy is an advantage but not a prerequisite.

 

Working at Impact Fund Denmark

Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 170 talented individuals from 30+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, across the organisation and between offices in Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

 Candidate and university outreach.

 Work with our CRM system, HubSpot.

Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences University of Copenhagen     We are offering a PhD fellowship in Veterinary Virology commencing 1st of February 2027.  Our group and research Forskningsgruppen udfører forskning og undervisning inden for områderne enzootiske og zoonotiske virusinfektioner hos dyr. Forskningen vil de kommende år fokuseres på influenza infektioner i dyr, med fokus på zoonotiske aspekter af svine influenza virus. Gruppen bestå pt af ca. 20 forskere, phd studerende, studentermedhjælpere og 2 andre labornater. Vi har altid meget travlt, men har et godt arbejdsmiljø med masser af humor, kageklub og fleksible arbejdsopgaver og hvor alle hjælper alle.   The research group for Veterinary and Zoonotic Virology consists of around 20 members and as the name states work on both veterinary and zootonic viruses with a main focus on swine influenza A virus. We utilize different molecular methods such viral isolation in cells, qPCR/PCR, sequencing, ELISA and different immunological assays. The research group is very social and we have journal club, cake and breakfast club and Friday bars etc.   Project description The PhD project will be on cross-reactive vaccines for swine influenza A virus. The first part of the project will be focussed on establishing immunological assays in the laboratory and generating hyperimmune serum in pigs experimentally for following antigenic characterization of Danish swine influenza A virus. The second part of the PhD will be on selecting representative vaccine strains testing them first experimentally in pigs and afterwards in the field.  Principal supervisor is Professor Lars Erik Larsen, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, lael@sund.ku.dk, phone:  +4540998434  Start:                  1 February 2027   Duration:          3 years as a PhD student  Job description Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description: The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., [relevant degrees]).  Qualifications: If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.  Other important criteria are:   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in veterinary virology 	
• Language skills   Place of employment The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and the project will be carried out in collaboration with Statens Serum Institute, Landbrug og Fødevarer and Ceva Animal Health.  Terms of employment  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is 1st of February 2027 or after agreement.  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.  The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree.   Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 27,800 DKK/Roughly 3,700 EUR (October 2021 level) plus pension.  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).  Questions For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website: https://healthsciences.ku.dk/phd/guidelines/  Application procedure Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format:   1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position  3. Certified copy of original Master of Science diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD fellowship employment, your master’s degree must be equivalent to a Danish master’s degree. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database: https://ufm.dk/en/education/recognition-and-transparency/find-assessments/assessment-database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science.  4. Publication list (if possible)  Application deadline:  [Wednesday 4 November 2026, 23.59pm CET   We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.  The further process  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.  You find information about the recruitment process at: http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.description:
Supply Chain Specialist

Mørke, Denmark

About Reblade:

Reblade is a Danish technology company founded in 2020, developing autonomous drone-

based robotic systems for leading edge repair of wind turbine blades.

We design, develop, manufacture and test our own technology, combining mechanical

engineering, electronics, software and robotics.

Our international team works in English, and we collaborate with major wind energy

operators, universities and technology partners across Europe.

We are strengthening our supply chain and purchasing capabilities.

About the position:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Specialist to take responsibility for purchasing, supplier

management, inventory coordination and procurement cost control.

You will work closely with our engineering, production and finance teams to ensure that

components and materials are available when needed, suppliers meet our requirements, and

purchasing costs remain under control.

The position combines operational purchasing with supplier development, cost analysis and

process improvement.

Key responsibilities:

Purchasing and supplier management

• Manage purchasing activities, including RFQs, purchase orders, order confirmations and delivery

follow-up.

• Identify, evaluate and qualify suppliers based on quality, cost, lead time and delivery performance.

• Negotiate prices, commercial terms and supplier agreements.

• Maintain supplier records, purchasing documentation and performance evaluations.

• Resolve supplier-related issues, including delivery delays, incorrect shipments and quality concerns.

Inventory and supply chain coordination

• Coordinate material requirements with engineering and production teams.

• Monitor stock levels, reorder points and material availability.

• Support purchasing planning for prototype development, testing and production activities.

• Identify supply chain risks and propose alternative suppliers or sourcing solutions.

Cost control and administration

• Maintain purchasing cost overviews, spending reports and supplier price comparisons.

• Monitor purchasing budgets and identify cost reduction opportunities.

• Coordinate invoice verification, purchase order matching and payment follow-up with finance.

• Support the development and implementation of purchasing procedures and supply chain processes.

Your profile:

Required qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement or supply chain management.

• Experience working with suppliers, quotations, purchase orders and delivery coordination.

• Understanding of procurement cost control, supplier pricing and commercial negotiations.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Good analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or similar tools.

• Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken.

What we offer:

• A permanent, full-time position in a growing Danish technology company.

• Direct responsibility for purchasing and supplier management activities.

• The opportunity to establish and improve purchasing and supply chain processes.

• A workplace where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have a direct impact.

Application:

Send us your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience.

Applications will be reviewed continuously, and interviews will be arranged with suitable

candidates.

Contact: Stine Alexander Westergaard saw@reblade.dk // Call me: +45 42411163

Workplace: Reblade ApS, Mørke, Denmark

Starting date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

jobs.description: Technician for lab management and user supportCONTEXT: The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is an international centre for scientific research situated in Grenoble, France. It is Europe's leading neutron science facility. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research in a wide variety of scientific fields. The Biology, Deuteration, Chemistry and Soft Matter (BDCS) group operates the Chemistry and Soft Matter support laboratories, which offer equipment, lab space and support for sample preparation and characterisation, serving both external users and in-house scientists. The BDCS group also operates the Lipid and Deuteration laboratories, which are equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation for the production and characterisation of tailor-made deuterated biological molecules for the ILL user community.YOUR TASKS:In the context of the European FEDER EPN-AVENIR-ILL project and the arrival of new laboratory equipment in the BDCS group, you will reinforce the team in the management of the different labs, support the users with their scientific projects, including the activities of the ILL Science Hubs, and liaise between the members of the group. You will welcome and interact with users before, during and after their stay, assist with operating equipment, and help with sample preparation. Your activities will include:. Supporting the scientists and lab managers by communicating with, welcoming and assisting users with their scientific projects in the different labs. Management of laboratory supplies and stocks, and regular calibration of lab equipment. Organisation of lab space and equipment, as well as participation in waste management and the chemical inventory. Supporting the Lipid Lab staff with the user programme, in particular with running the chromatography equipment (HPLC, GC, TLC,.), including the new FEDER equipment. The successful candidate will interact with various actors at ILL, including members of the BDCS group, safety engineers, technicians, as well as ILL users and external companies.YOUR PROFILE:You have a Level 5 qualification (HND or equivalent) in chemistry (or biochemistry). Expertise in the operation of standard (bio-)chemistry laboratory equipment. Sound knowledge of laboratory safety rules and regulations. Autonomy and good communication skills. Experience of working in a research facility, in industry or at a large-scale research infrastructure would be an asset. You must have a sound knowledge of written and spoken English. Knowledge of French would be a plus (a language course could be paid for by the ILL)QUALITY OF LIFE: This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!
